name: Morn Sun Feed Mill Corp.
summary: Morn Sun Feed Mill Corp. is a Taiwanese company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of animal feed within Taiwan. Their product portfolio encompasses a variety of specialized feeds: for poultry, they provide layer feed formulated for ducks and chickens, breeder feed for geese, and specific formulations for local poultry varieties. Regarding livestock, they offer feeds tailored for various stages of swine, including piglets, sows, and hogs. Beyond feed, the company also supplies eggs. Established in 1958, Morn Sun Feed Mill Corp. maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Kee Song Bio-Technology Holdings Limited
summary: Kee Song Bio-Technology Holdings Limited engages in the poultry and processing distribution, and farming business in Singapore, Malaysia, and Taiwan. The company also involves in importing, slaughtering, wholesaling, and retailing various types of poultry and consumable goods; layer and poultry farming; investment holding; property investment; processing and marketing of seafood and poultry related products; provision of supporting services for transportation; food catering; and manufacturing of poultry feed products. In addition, it offers whole chicken and cutting products. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: An-Shin Food Services Co., Ltd.
summary: An-Shin Food Services Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of fast food chain restaurant under the name, MOS Burger. Its products include burgers, snacks, soups, and drinks. The company was founded on November 23, 1990 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Flavor Full Foods Inc.
summary: Flavor Full Foods Inc. is dedicated to the manufacturing and international distribution of a wide array of sesame-derived and other edible oil products. Operating both domestically in Taiwan and across global markets, the company offers a comprehensive selection of oils, including pure, extra premium toasted, blended, black, ginger, garlic, stir-fry, shallot, cold-pressed, and hot sesame oils, as well as crude soybean and corn oils. Beyond its core oil offerings, Flavor Full Foods Inc. also produces pure white, black, and traditional sesame sauces, black sesame spreads, tahini, and sesame salad dressing. Their product line further extends to various sesame seed forms, such as roasted raw black, white, and hulled seeds, along with flavored options, sesame stuffing, and sesame protein and extract powder. These items are primarily marketed under the well-known FOREWAY brand, and the company also supplies SESANOOD products. The firm, headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, was established in 1965. It was originally known as Chien Fa Edible Oil Manufactory before officially changing its name to Flavor Full Foods Inc. in 1983.

name: Tehmag Foods Corporation
summary: Tehmag Foods Corporation operates in the baking industry in Taiwan. The company offers bread products, including margarine flour sheets, flours, flour milling products, instant yeasts, bread improvers, luctor/custido/carlex sprays, bread mixes, flavor powders and series, bread fillings, bread decorations, and sugars; dairy products, such as fléchard sas, other creams, cheese, and dairy whipping creams; and pastry products comprising ingredients for cakes and mousses, waffle mixes, cocoa powders, jelly powders, nappage series/coatings, and ingredients for decor and gold powder. It also provides fruit products consisting of frozen purees, ambiet fruit purees, IQF fruits, frozen coulis, fruit filling series, decorative fruits, fruits preserves, and flavor series. In addition, the company offers liqueur and coffee beans, syrups, juices, and tea; chocolate products; cupcakes; tart shells, cones, savory lines, macarons, and croissants, as well as frozen food; packaging products; and molds, openers, and blades, as well as festival and western bakery products. Tehmag Foods Corporation was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Hi-Lai Foods Co., Ltd
summary: Hi-Lai Foods Co., Ltd, a prominent entity in Taiwan's culinary sector, was established in 1992 and maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung. The company manages a vast array of dining establishments across the island, offering diverse gastronomic experiences. Its extensive portfolio of restaurant brands encompasses names like Hi-Lai Harbor, Hi-Lai Vegetarian, Cantonese Jade Garden, Celebrity Cuisine, Shanghainese Dumpling, Han-Lai Xuan, Roast Duck, PAVO Lounge, Bistro, May Sensei, Seafood Hotpot, Japanese Restaurant BEN KEI, Taiwanse Restaurant, Deli & bakery, Lobby lounge, Flamma, Liu Liu Sauerkraut Fish, and Hi-Lai Cafe.

name: Kanpai Co., Ltd
summary: Kanpai Co., Ltd operates restaurants under the Kanpai brand in China. Its restaurants offer yakiniku and beer. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan. Kanpai Co., Ltd is a subsidiary of Tokyo Gas Co., Ltd.

name: SunWay Biotech Co., LTD.
summary: SunWay Biotech Co., LTD. focuses on professional research and development, and technical material manufacturing and processing business. The company researches, designs, and manufactures Monascus purpureus NTU 568; Lactobacillus paracasei subsp. paracasei NTU 101; and related products. It offers dietary supplements, fermented milk and soy-milk, and formula additives in form of capsules, powder sachets, liquid, and tablets. SunWay Biotech Co., LTD. was founded in 2007 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Lytone Enterprise, Inc.
summary: Lytone Enterprise, Inc., established in 1994 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the research and development of functional food items alongside agricultural and livestock industry provisions. The company delivers comprehensive post-harvest treatments for various fresh produce, including mangoes, guavas, apples, kiwi fruits, avocados, citrus varieties, and tomatoes, extending these services to the floriculture sector as well. In the functional food arena, Lytone develops sophisticated ingredients and formulations designed to support anti-aging, protect the nervous system, boost physical vitality, help regulate blood sugar, and enhance skin health. Their offerings also include probiotics and prebiotics. For the agricultural and animal husbandry industries, they provide specialized agents, performance-enhancing fertilizers, and feed additives. Serving a diverse client base of growers, packaging facilities, and retail businesses, Lytone Enterprise, Inc. maintains a significant international presence. Its operations span China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, Oceania, the Middle East, and East Africa.

name: Hantech Bio-Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2007 and headquartered in Yuanlin, Taiwan, Hantech Bio-Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in creating, producing, and distributing health products grounded in scientific research. The company distinguishes itself through its use of various environmentally conscious pouch packaging styles for its offerings. Under OEM and ODM collaborations, Hantech provides a range of dietary supplements available in gel, liquid, and powder forms. These supplements are presented in an extensive selection of distinctive packaging shapes, such as rectangular, curved, Z-shaped, round, wine bottle-inspired, and standing pouches.

name: Synbio Tech Inc.
summary: Synbio Tech Inc. operates as a biotechnology enterprise, primarily focusing on the development and production of probiotics and their various applications. The company also handles the marketing and distribution of several products in China, such as lactic acid bacteria (LAB) beverages, LAB powders formulated for human health, and specialized probiotic solutions for the agriculture, forestry, fishery, and animal husbandry sectors. Established on June 1, 2000, the firm maintains its principal office in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.

name: Taihan Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Taihan Precision Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells precision molds primarily for system integrators in worldwide. It offers plastic injection products; surface treatment products, such as painting, NCVM, and IMD products; and assembly/installation and welding products and services. The company's products comprise MFP related components; keyboard frames, keyboards, and handset key tops; mobility products, including handset housings, net book housings, DSC housings, and plastic components of digital photo frames; plastic components of photo printers; and projector housing and other plastic components. It is also involved in the mold and die development and fabrication of automotive plastic components. The company was formerly known as TaiHan Steel Mold Corp. and changed its name to Taihan Precision Technology Co., Ltd. in June 2000. Taihan Precision Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Sun Rise E&T Corporation
summary: Sun Rise E&T Corporation, established in Pingtung, Taiwan, in 1995, specializes in manufacturing and supplying High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) products. Its primary offerings include a wide range of HDPE pipes designed for diverse applications such as chemical and pharmaceutical material transport, water supply, sewage, drainage, gas distribution, communication infrastructure, mining operations, and marine water intake and discharge. Beyond pipes, Sun Rise E&T also produces HDPE-based fish farming solutions, comprising injection-molded brackets, buoys, and walkway decks for fish cages. Additionally, the company develops solar floating systems, which feature solar panels and components, floating brackets, pipeline bridges, and HDPE walkway decks. They further supply protection sleeves for cable-stayed and external preload bridges, along with relevant accessories. These products are distributed both domestically in Taiwan and across international markets.

name: Tung Mung Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Tung Mung Development Co., Ltd., with its main office situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as a Taiwanese company specializing in the manufacture, distribution, and administration of stainless steel commodities. The firm provides a comprehensive range of hot-rolled and cold-rolled stainless steel products, such as coils and sheets, to markets throughout Taiwan.

name: SuperAlloy Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: SuperAlloy Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in engineering and manufacturing lightweight metal products primarily for the automotive industry. It provides forged aluminum wheels for luxury and sports automobiles; and engineering lightweight suspension components. The company has operations in Taiwan, the United States, the United Kingdom, Germany, other parts of Europe, Australia, Japan, and internationally. SuperAlloy Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Douliu City, Taiwan.

name: St.Shine Optical Co.,Ltd.
summary: St.Shine Optical Co.,Ltd. designs, manufactures, markets, and supplies contact lens in Taiwan and internationally. It offers daily spherical, frequent replacement spherical, aberration control, toric frequent replacement, color, and silicone hydrogel soft contact lens, as well as lathe-cut, cast-molding, and RGP lenses. The company offers its products for myopic and hyperopic patients for the correction of astigmatism. The company was formerly known as First Optical Co., Ltd. and changed its name to St.Shine Optical Co.,Ltd. in 1986. St.Shine Optical Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Bin Chuan Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Bin Chuan Enterprise Co., Ltd. is a global provider specializing in the manufacture and supply of precision metal-stamped products, primarily for the computer and consumer electronics industries. The company's extensive catalog features a variety of precision metal components, such as casings and internal parts for notebooks and mobile devices, keyboard base plates for laptops, metal enclosures and grilles for home entertainment systems, and specialized elements for POS (Point-of-Sale) systems and medical equipment. Additionally, Bin Chuan supplies non-metal items like plastic keycaps and scissor switches specifically for laptop keyboards. Its manufactured goods find application across a broad spectrum of electronic devices, including various consumer electronics, personal computing equipment (laptops, CD-ROMs), office machinery (multifunction devices, printers), power management solutions (power supplies, UPS), and display technologies. Established in 1972, the company maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: De Poan Pneumatic Corp.
summary: De Poan Pneumatic Corp. manufactures and sells professional pneumatic tools worldwide. The company offers nailer products, including industrial and framing coil, cordless, framing, roofing, finishing, palm, and brad nailers; and staplers, cap tools, and pinners. It also provides air tools such as composite and aluminum wrench and air saw. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Sinmag Equipment Corporation
summary: Sinmag Equipment Corporation engages in the manufacture, retail, and wholesale of baking and food service equipment. The company offers bakery equipment, including spiral mixers, divider rounders, moulders, make up lines, sheeters, proofers, cake machines, planetary mixers, deck ovens, proofers, convection ovens, rack and tunnel ovens, slicers, refrigerators, workbenches, food service equipment, and others. It also provides kitchen equipment comprising pizza equipment, combi oven/convection oven/steamer, rotisseries, fryers, Chinese/western kitchen equipment, meat processing and refrigeration equipment, dishwashers, stainless steel sinks and tubes, and showcases. The company sells its products in Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. Sinmag Equipment Corporation was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: S-Tech Corp.
summary: S-Tech Corp. is a Taiwanese enterprise dedicated to the fabrication and supply of advanced nonferrous metal alloys. The company's product range features titanium, nickel, and various other specialized alloys, all designed for critical use in diverse industries such as chemical processing, aerospace, oil and gas exploration, medical devices, and energy generation. Furthermore, S-Tech provides these high-performance materials in specific configurations, including rods (covering titanium, nickel-based, special steel, and cobalt-based compositions), sheets, and tubes, as well as alloy fasteners like screws and nuts. This company, headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan, commenced its operations in 2002.

name: TopGreen Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: TopGreen Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells various cutting tools in Taiwan and internationally. Its products comprise composite rods, mechanical cutting tools, micro cutting tools, tapping tools, PCB tools, medical tools, diamond tools, aircraft cutting tools, special molding tools, blanks, custom tools, precision punch tools, etc. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: China Fineblanking Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Fineblanking Technology Co.,Ltd. develops and sells fine blanking products in China, Taiwan, and Malaysia. The company offers HDD VCM, gearbox parking and shifting mechanisms, door locks, hydraulic pumps, powertrains, brake parts, seat parts, gear boxes and clutches, gear box parts, synchronize rings, bicycling cassettes, and other products. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Changhua, Taiwan.

name: Inmax Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: Inmax Holding Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells a range of fasteners primarily in the Southeast Asia region. It offers pneumatic and industrial nails; coil roofing nails for roofing, asphalt and fiberglass shingles, lathing, insulation board, vinyl siding, fiber cement roofing and siding, and waterproof tar paper applications; coil nails for use in wooden pallets and wooden boxes assembly, siding, decking, panel sheathing, and fencing; and staples for furniture and wooden box manufacturing, as well as for fastening works, such as architectural applications. The company also provides brads for use in finish, trim, drawers, and cabinets; and plastic strip and paper tape nails for framing, sheathing, sub flooring, roof decking, and exterior decks. Inmax Holding Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in George Town, the Cayman Islands.

name: Chi Hua Fitness Co., Ltd.
summary: Chi Hua Fitness Co., Ltd. is a global enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of fitness equipment. The company offers a comprehensive range of components and systems for exercise machinery. This includes a diverse array of brakes, such as hybrid and pure generator brakes, field coil eddy current brakes, green-ECB, eddy current brakes, and PM brakes. Additionally, their product line features lower control boards engineered for both EMS and generator system applications, alongside TFT and various other console types. Brush DC motors are also part of their offerings, complemented by an assortment of accessories like gear motors, heart rate sensor boards, and hand grip sensors. Established in 1997, Chi Hua Fitness Co., Ltd. operates from its headquarters located in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Ju-Kao Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1963 and headquartered in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan, Ju-Kao Engineering Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive range of engineering and construction services. Their core activities include maintaining steel frames and structures, performing cold work on heavy machinery, and general mechanical processing. The company provides installation, repair, and maintenance for a wide array of industrial equipment, such as diesel generators, blowers, steam turbines, chemical machinery, and cranes. They also specialize in the design, construction, and fabrication of factory buildings, steel frame structures, and other mechanical equipment. Their infrastructure expertise covers the design and construction of substations and wiring systems, as well as the implementation and upkeep of automatic control systems. They engineer solutions for refrigeration, air conditioning, cooling water, electrical, and fire protection systems. Ju-Kao's capabilities extend to general building construction, hydraulic engineering, and extensive earthwork, including surveying and exploration. Furthermore, they undertake specialized projects such as SRC steel structure construction, floating docks, harbor engineering, and complete turnkey solutions for industrial plants. They construct various environmental control systems, including dust collection, conveying, soil and air pollution control, noise reduction, hydraulic machinery, pumping, and water/sewage treatment equipment. The company also fabricates and pipes oil, tower, storage, and pressure vessels, and performs metal painting and coating. Additionally, Ju-Kao Engineering provides a diverse set of specialized services, including landscape engineering, the installation of cables, elevators, computer equipment, satellite television, windows, glass, kitchenware, and bathroom fixtures. Their operations also encompass traffic signal systems, drilling, static electricity protection and elimination, the paving of resin materials for sports venue tracks, and nuclear engineering activities.

name: Chime Ball Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chime Ball Technology Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, is a Taiwanese firm specializing in the design, production, and marketing of advanced exposure equipment for printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its core product portfolio includes energy-efficient LED exposure systems, specifically UV-LED machines for solder-resistant, outer layer, and inner layer applications. The company also offers state-of-the-art digital direct imaging (DDI) exposure machines, leveraging both laser and UV-LED light sources. Complementing these are solder mask exposure machines, fully automated laminating systems, a range of exposure lamps, and UV energy illuminance meters. In addition to its primary PCB equipment business, Chime Ball provides comprehensive plant equipment transfer solutions, encompassing sales, installation, and maintenance services for semiconductor process equipment refurbishment and spare parts. Further expanding its operations, the company distributes various mechanical equipment and electronic components, offers data software services, engages in global trade, and serves as an investment advisor. Founded in 1988, Chime Ball Technology Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Aeontek Co., Ltd.
summary: Aeon Motor Co., Ltd. is primarily involved in the conceptualization, manufacturing, and distribution of a wide range of vehicles. This includes scooters, all-terrain vehicles (ATVs), utility task vehicles (UTVs), motorcycles, and electric vehicles, all marketed under its proprietary Aeon brand within Taiwan. In addition to these vehicles, the company offers various components and related merchandise. Aeon Motor also conducts extensive international export operations. The firm was established in 1998 and operates from its main office located in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Wax Company,Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Wax Company,Ltd. manufactures and sells refined wax in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers refined paraffin wax, microcrystalline wax, and light/heavy foots oil wax. It also imports and sells aquatic products, such as king crab and salmon. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Chiayi, Taiwan.

name: Nang Kuang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Nang Kuang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates as a pharmaceutical company primarily in Taiwan. The company provides parenterals, aseptic parenterals, lyophilized injections, pre-filled syringes, and pre-mixed IV infusion bags, as well as tablets, capsules, topical products, and oral suspensions. It offers various products in the areas of cardiovascular system, gastrointestinal system, nervous system, alimentary and metabolism, blood, antineoplastic and immunomodulatory, musculo-skeletal system, respiratory system, dermatological, genito-urinary and sex hormone, systemic hormone, systemic antibacterial, and cosmetics, as well as hospital solution. Nang Kuang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: SYN-TECH Chem. & Pharm. Co., Ltd.
summary: SYN-TECH Chem. & Pharm. Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) in Taiwan, Asia, Europe, the Americas, and internationally. The company offers test drugs and surfactants, as well as various Chinese, Western, and animal medicines. It also provides products in various categories, such as anticoagulant, attention deficit hyperactivity disorder, skeletal muscle relaxant, antitussive, antipruritic, scabicide, anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, analgesic, muscle relaxant, anxiolytic, antiemetic, anticonvulsant, anti-ulcerative, antihypertensive, a-blocker, vasodilator, bronchodilator, anxiolytic, tranquilizer, local anesthetic, decongestant, antispasmodic, neuroprotective, antimigraine, pharmaceutic aid/lubricant, antiglaucoma agent, hyponatremia, antidepressant, sedative, and analgesic, as well as treatment for hyperparathyroidism and urinary frequency, benign prostatic hypertrophy, and Herpes virus helicase-primase inhibitor. SYN-TECH Chem. & Pharm. Co., Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Allied Biotech Corporation
summary: Allied Biotech Corporation operates as a global producer and supplier specializing in carotenoids. The company's diverse product portfolio features key carotenoids such as: Beta-Carotene, known for imparting vibrant yellow to reddish-orange hues across numerous applications. Beta-Apo-8'-Carotenal, a versatile food colorant delivering shades from rich orange to deep red. Lycopene, a valuable nutrient that provides striking red tones for incorporation into food, dietary supplements, and pharmaceutical formulations. Canthaxanthin, which contributes reddish-orange colors specifically to food and beverage products. Lutein, another carotenoid frequently derived from or associated with green leafy vegetables (like spinach, kale, and broccoli) and egg yolks. Additionally, Allied Biotech offers Nano Coenzyme Q10, an antioxidant crucial for cellular energy production. The corporation caters to a diverse clientele across the food, beverage, dietary supplement, and animal feed sectors. Established in 2001, Allied Biotech Corporation maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Health & Life Co., Ltd.
summary: Health & Life Co., Ltd. is a global provider of medical devices. Established in 1996 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, the company specializes in developing and distributing solutions for critical health sectors, including cardiovascular health, in-vitro diagnostics, and respiratory care. Its diverse product line encompasses advanced vibrating mesh nebulizers, blood pressure monitoring systems, infrared thermometers, and various hearing aid technologies.

name: BIONET Corp.
summary: BIONET Corp. engages in the cell therapy business in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers stem cell banking services, such as stem cell storage, mesenchymal stem cell storage, dental stem cell storage, adipose stem cell, and PBSC and immune cells; and genetic testing services. It also provides storage and application of hematopoietic stem cells; regenerative medicine, analytical testing, clinical and preclinical research, and commercialized cell-derived products; and Exosome, a cell-free therapy. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Solar Applied Materials Technology Corporation
summary: Solar Applied Materials Technology Corporation is a global enterprise engaged in the manufacturing, reclamation, refining, and distribution of a diverse portfolio of materials, including precious metals, specialty chemicals, and advanced target materials. The company provides comprehensive material solutions and integrated services to key industries such as optoelectronics, information technology, petrochemicals, and consumer electronics. Its product offerings encompass a wide array of precious metal compounds, such as gold potassium cyanide, silver potassium cyanide, silver nitrate, and silver plate, alongside precious metal forms like gold and silver slugs, ingots, and various tube, wire, and piece materials. Rare metal materials, including tantalum and niobium, are also supplied. Additionally, Solar Applied Materials Technology develops sputtering targets critical for thin-film deposition across applications ranging from data storage media, photovoltaics, semiconductors, and electronics to functional materials and bonding/vacuum components. The automotive sector is served by a range of specialized chemicals, including antifreeze/engine coolants, brake fluids, engine cleaners, anti-friction engine treatments, power steering repair treatments, and ATF treatment products. Complementing its manufacturing activities, the company provides resource recovery services, specifically recycling and refining catalysts and other metals. It also offers expert chemical and physical inspection and analysis services. Established in 1978, the company was originally known as Solar Chemical Co., Ltd. before officially changing its name to Solar Applied Materials Technology Corporation in October 1999. Its headquarters are located in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: Hi-Clearance Inc.
summary: Established in 1989 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Hi-Clearance Inc. is a prominent supplier of medical devices and associated services throughout Taiwan. The company's comprehensive product range addresses various healthcare sectors, including renal care, cardiac health, radiation therapy, dentistry, oral surgery, and metabolic conditions. Its medical offerings encompass vital equipment such as dialyzers, dialysis machines, and reverse osmosis (RO) systems, complemented by essential consumables and pharmaceutical products. Hi-Clearance also provides specialized devices for interventional cardiology, radiology, and vascular surgery. For the dental field, it supplies consumables, implant materials, and equipment. Furthermore, the company offers blood glucose monitors, along with their related consumables and nutritional products. Beyond product provision, Hi-Clearance Inc. delivers extensive hemodialysis management services and specializes in the development and operation of dialysis centers. Diversifying its business, the company also engages in the distribution and servicing of healthy and natural beverages, and acts as an OEM provider for beverage raw materials and concentrates.

name: GeneFerm Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: GeneFerm Biotechnology Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, markets, and sells fermented products in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers a range of raw materials, such as fermented microbial, fungi, and fruits and vegetables products; probiotics; and herbal extracts and animal derived peptides and powders. It also provides ODM, as well as fermentation toll manufacturing services to companies for the development and manufacture of dietary supplements, functional foods, health food products, and various applications. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Easywell Biomedicals, Inc.
summary: Easywell Biomedicals, Inc., a biopharmaceutical and medical device company, develops and commercializes medical devices, drug substances, and pharmaceutical dosage forms in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers pharmaceutical products, which include high-barrier generics for the treatment of anti-cough, anti-urinary incontinence, breast cancer in PMS women, anti-depression, prevention of pneumocystis pneumonia, epilepsy, chronic angina, and inflammatory lesions of rosacea; and 505(b)(2) drugs for the treatment of Parkinson's, urinary, and pneumonia diseases. It also provides medical devices, including digital clinical, infrared ear, and non-contact forehead infrared thermometers. The company was formerly known as Actherm Inc. and changed its name to Easywell Biomedicals, Inc. in July 2015. Easywell Biomedicals, Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Polylite Taiwan Co., Ltd.
summary: Polylite Taiwan Co., Ltd. manufactures and distributes GIA polycarbonate lenses worldwide. Its products include FSV, SFSV, progressive, KID, and polarized lens. The company also offers dispending, fitting, and edging and finishing services. Polylite Taiwan Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Fulltech Fiber Glass Corp.
summary: Fulltech Fiber Glass Corp. produces and sells fiber glass yarn and fabrics in Taiwan. It offers electronic grade fiber glass yarn for use in the manufacture of fiber glass fabric, printed circuit boards, desktop and laptop computers, cellular phones, PDAs, and projection cloths, as well as industrial grade fiber glass yarn for use in the manufacture of insulation tubes. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Tang Eng Iron Works Co., Ltd.
summary: Tang Eng Iron Works Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the fabrication and global distribution of a wide array of stainless steel products. The company's diverse offerings include various forms of steel such as rolls, slabs, blanks, ingots, substantial steel boards, and both hot and cold rolled coils. These specialized materials find extensive utility across numerous sectors, being employed in applications ranging from food and chemical processing equipment, industrial piping, and structural tubing, to decorative panels, electronic components, and even consumer goods like tableware, kitchenware, and knife production. This Taiwanese enterprise, headquartered in Kaohsiung City, was established in 1940.

name: Feng Ching Metal Corporation
summary: Feng Ching Metal Corporation produces and sells copper wires and enameled copper wires primarily for use in electronic, electrical appliance, and communication technology industries in Taiwan and internationally. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Sheh Kai Precision Co., Ltd.
summary: Sheh Kai Precision Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells bi metal screws, screw anchors, and screws in Taiwan and internationally. It offers bi-metal window, concrete, self tapping, self drilling, and wing screws, as well as self piercing screws and side lap screws; hammer and diamond drill bits, and dust caps; and bi-metal concrete screw anchors, bi-metal concrete anchor stainless steel internal thread heads, galvanized concrete screw anchors, and galvanized concrete screw anchors internal thread heads. The company also provides wood screws, stainless steel self-tapping screw sharps/blue points, special fasteners, hex lag screws, double end hanger bolts, carriage bolts, and automotive fasteners. Its products are used in various applications, such as roof wall steel fastening, curtain wall window, and concrete anchor systems, as well as concrete anchor products. The company was formerly known as Sheh Kai Industrial Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Sheh Kai Precision Co., Ltd. in 2003. Sheh Kai Precision Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Camellia Metal Co., Ltd.
summary: Camellia Metal Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells steel bars and wires in Taiwan. It offers low-carbon, middle-carbon, high-carbon, free cutting, spring, alloy, and stainless steel bars and wires. The company's products are used in motor and mechanical axis, as well as axis of business machines; screwdrivers, hex wrenches, and sockets; torsion and balance bars, and automotive coil springs; and medical and aerospace technologies, household appliances, and high-precision and other materials. Its products are also used in cars, bridges, steel, and screws and other building materials; and electronics, telecommunications, and IT industries. The company was founded in 1971 and is based in Changhua County, Taiwan.

name: Sheh Fung Screws Co., Ltd.
summary: Sheh Fung Screws Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells screws primarily in Taiwan. The company provides various screws, including self-drilling, timber construction, drywall, chipboard, self-tapping, decking, self-piercing screws, and other screws. It also offers hammer drill bits, customized fastener parts, kaitex coatings, and packing boxes. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Sumeeko Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: Sumeeko Industries Co., Ltd. manufactures, repairs, and sells automotive parts, hardware parts, mechanical parts, and screws. It offers power trains, suspensions, transmissions, exhausts, chassis, and interior parts for use in automobiles; appliances; and products for use in mechanism, construction, and other applications. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.

name: Chia Yi Steel Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1974 and headquartered in Chiayi, Taiwan, Chia Yi Steel Co., Ltd. operates as a leading producer and distributor of cast components. While primarily catering to the automotive parts industry, its reach extends globally, serving markets across Asia, Europe, and the United States. The company's extensive product line features a wide variety of items, such as components for jacks, hydraulic valves, rolling rotors, and carrier supports. It also manufactures parts crucial for construction and agricultural machinery, marine transmissions, cranes, hoists, engines, and brake systems. Further offerings include spring brackets, railroad bases, elevator sheaves, pumps, bolt machinery parts, and various assembled products. Beyond specific items, Chia Yi Steel delivers comprehensive casting and machining solutions tailored for hydraulic, industrial, construction, and agricultural applications. The firm’s advanced capabilities are supported by state-of-the-art production equipment for casting, along with rigorous quality control processes and precision machining services. Furthermore, it leverages cutting-edge technologies like computer-based mold flow simulation software, 3D printing for sand molds, sand cores, and metal mold cores, and FARO 3D scanning solutions.

name: Ching Chan Optical Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ching Chan Optical Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures fastener equipment worldwide. The company offers sorter machines for screw/bolt, nut/washer, rod/stud, and eddy current series; second hand machines; and accessories for sorting machines. It also provides screw and bolt making machines, including standard and long stroke bolt, bolt parts, and high performance formers; process monitoring products; automated guided vehicle systems comprising warehouse and transferring robots; and intellectual automation production integration. Ching Chan Optical Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.

name: Chen Nan Iron Wire Co.,Ltd
summary: Based in Taiwan, Chen Nan Iron Wire Co.,Ltd is a prominent manufacturer and global supplier of diverse fasteners and steel wire products. Their extensive fastener portfolio encompasses a wide array of screws, including self-drilling, chipboard, roofing, drywall, self-tapping, collated, concrete, decking, wood, furniture, window, stainless steel, machine, set, trilobular thread-forming, socket cap, SEMS, and nail screws, alongside specialized screw types. The company also produces various bolts, such as carriage, flange, hexagonal, and lag bolts, while their nut selection comprises hex flange, cage, hexagonal, wing, nylon, square, dome cap, and panel nuts. For washers, options range from bonding, external tooth lock, flat, internal tooth lock, spring lock, and umbrella types. Beyond fasteners, Chen Nan Iron Wire Co.,Ltd supplies alloy, stainless steel, and carbon steel wires, in addition to nails, hose clamps, and rivets. Their products are distributed internationally, reaching markets across Europe, the United States, Australia, New Zealand, Asia, and the Middle East. Established in 1992, the firm is headquartered in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.

name: Syong Shun Metal Co. Ltd.
summary: Syong Shun Metal Co. Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise engaged in the manufacturing and sale of steel products. The company primarily furnishes wire rods, which are essential components for producing a diverse array of items, including fasteners like screws and nuts, various types of steel wire and cables, hand tools, automotive parts, and general mechanical components. Established in 2010, its operations are based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Tachia Yung Ho Machine Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Tachia Yung Ho Machine Industry Co., Ltd. primarily manufactures and sells butt-welding pipe fittings and high purity components in Taiwan. The company offers stainless steel butt-welding pipe fittings, such as elbows, tees, reducers, caps, stub ends, etc.; and UHP components, including high purity pipes and pipe fittings, metal gasket face seal fittings, micro butt-welding fittings, LoK-DJ compression fittings, UHP CGA/DISS fittings, diaphragm and ball valves, valve manifold boxes, and special chemical storage tanks. Its butt-welding pipe fittings are used in the areas of petrochemical, ship building, foods, sugar making, paper production, chemical engineering, agricultural chemical, dyeing, synthetic fibers, liquid chemical, gas, industries piping, construction drainage pipe fitting, etc.; and UHP components have applications in the areas of semiconductor, LCD-TFT, solar energy, LED, food industry, chemical piping, gas, liquid, construction pipe fitting, etc. Tachia Yung Ho Machine Industry Co., Ltd. also exports its products to Japan, Korea, Singapore, Malaysia, France, Germany, Ireland, England, the United States, Australia, New Zealand, China, and the Gulf Region. The company was formerly known as Tachia Yung Ho Machine Industry Limited Company and changed its name to Tachia Yung Ho Machine Industry Co., Ltd. in 1977. Tachia Yung Ho Machine Industry Co., Ltd. was founded in 1943 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: C.T.I. Traffic Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: C.T.I. Traffic Industries Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells auto engine parts in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers green power products; DLC piston rings comprising black diamond piston rings; gasoline engine oil rings, such as car and auto oil, car piston, engine oil, and piston ring expanders; diesel engine oil rings, including cast iron rings; liner kits; piston kits; and timing kits and components, timing guides, and timing chains, as well as tensioners, and cam and crank gears. It also provides overhaul engine gaskets, which include CYL heads, cylinder head gaskets, automotive and engine oil seals, valve covers, oil pans, and valve stem and engine valve seals, as well as intake, exhaust, and pipe manifolds; engine valves consisting of auto engine valves, engine valve seats, engine bearings, and engine valve guides; and carburetor kits. In addition, the company offers hydraulic brake systems, such as break, master, brake wheel, and brake master cylinders; compression rings, including hook, step, inside cut, under cut, notch, both-side keystone, slip in, and copper plated rings; and jump starters. Its products are used automotive, agriculture, off-highway, and heavy-duty trucks applications. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: I Yuan Precision Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: I Yuan Precision Industrial Co., Ltd. functions as a comprehensive automotive component supplier, engaging in the manufacturing, processing, distribution, and international trade of its products. Its market reach extends across Taiwan, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. The company's diverse product portfolio features crucial parts like electric cooling fans for engine water tanks, air supply motors essential for vehicle heating and cooling systems, and lift motors that control the raising and lowering of car window glass. Additionally, they provide tire pressure sensors for automotive monitoring systems, along with blower assemblies, window regulators, and washer pumps. Established in 1976, I Yuan Precision Industrial Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Nww Manufacturing Co. Ltd.
summary: Nww Manufacturing Co. Ltd. primarily specializes in the creation and distribution of automotive ignition wire sets and related coil components. Their comprehensive product line features essential items such as ignition rubber boots, cables, PBT tubes, terminals, distributor caps, and coil-on-plug boots, among other critical assembly parts for vehicle ignition systems. Beyond these specialized offerings, the company also engages in the manufacturing and sale of complete automobiles and motorcycles, along with their associated components. Furthermore, they are involved in the bulk distribution of automotive and motorcycle equipment and produce electronic components. Established in 1998, the company operates from its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Kaison Green Energy Technology Co., LTD
summary: Kaison Green Energy Technology Co., LTD researches and develops, produces, assembles, and sells electric vehicles. The company is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Shining Victory Motor Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Shining Victory Motor Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of automotive components. It offers optoelectronic products, automotive electronics, and automotive metal and plastic decorative parts, including car door illuminating welcome pedals, car interior light bar ambient lights, shifting atmosphere lights, sun visors, luggage racks, bright strips, etc. The company is based in George Town, the Cayman Islands.

name: Young Shine Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: Young Shine Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells automotive a/c components in Taiwan. The company offers automotive a/c compressors, heat exchangers, and parts. It also exports its products internationally. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Cubtek Inc.
summary: Cubtek Inc. engages in the complete cycle of research, development, design, manufacturing, and commercialization of advanced automotive safety systems and components. The company extends its operations across Taiwan, mainland China, and other international markets. Its core offerings include sophisticated advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and specialized millimeter-wave radar sensors developed for these vehicular ADAS applications. Additionally, Cubtek produces and supplies associated parts. Established in 2016, the company is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: JET Optoelectronics Co., Ltd.
summary: JET Optoelectronics Co., Ltd., headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, is an enterprise specializing in the development and production of automotive electronic systems. The company's innovative portfolio, catering to both Taiwanese and global markets, includes sophisticated rear-seat entertainment units, advanced vehicle telematics, and a variety of accessories, such as in-car cameras. The firm commenced operations in 2010.

name: Otobrite Electronics Inc
summary: oToBrite Electronics Inc., headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, specializes in the development of advanced driver safety solutions and artificial intelligence innovations. Since its establishment in 2013, the company has focused on providing products such as sophisticated vehicle cameras and comprehensive driver assistance systems.

name: ReaLy Development & Construction Corp.
summary: ReaLy Development & Construction Corp. engages in the land development and administration, and construction management businesses in Taiwan. The company is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Taxi Co.,Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Taxi Co.,Ltd. serves as a prominent provider of diverse transportation solutions throughout Taiwan. The company's primary offering includes convenient, on-demand taxi services. Beyond standard cab rides, its extensive service portfolio encompasses specialized options such as residential relocation assistance, expedited item delivery and retrieval, professional designated drivers, seamless airport transfers, dedicated transport for special education students, and even unique pet pick-up services. Additionally, their operations extend to managing taxi dispatch, providing rapid courier services, and engaging in advertising. With a substantial fleet comprising approximately 10,000 vehicles, the company caters to an expansive customer base of about 350,000 individuals. Founded in 2005, the firm is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Franbo Lines Corp.
summary: Franbo Lines Corp. provides ocean transport and shipping agency services through bulk and general cargo vessels in Taiwan and internationally. Its operating and forwarding business focuses on the transportation of steel, logs, chemical products, and mechanic equipment primarily through Asia and Pacific Regions. The company also owns and charters ocean going and Far East vessels to Japanese shipping companies, as well as offers freight forwarding services. In addition, it offers vessel management services, which include safety, international ship security, and manning management services. Further, the company is involved in the long- and short-term vessel chartering, and freight brokering businesses, as well as provision of technical, marine supply, ship inspection, and insurance claim services. Franbo Lines Corp. was founded in 1998 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Soonest Express Co., Ltd.
summary: Soonest Express Co., Ltd. provides integrated logistics solutions in Taiwan, Asia, and the United States. It offers air and ocean freight forwarding services; custom clearance services; transit/warehouse/transportation services; and courier services. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Jong Shyn Shipbuilding Co., Ltd.
summary: Jong Shyn Shipbuilding Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise primarily involved in the construction, refurbishment, and upkeep of various maritime vessels. The company's extensive manufacturing capabilities encompass a broad spectrum of ship types, such as cargo freighters, naval frigates, towboats, transport shuttles, fishing trawlers, passenger ferries, luxury yachts, crude oil carriers, and scientific research vessels. Additionally, it undertakes land-based engineering projects and produces custom-built specialized ships for unique requirements. Beyond vessel fabrication, Jong Shyn offers a comprehensive suite of services, including dry-docking, extensive mechanical servicing, protective coating applications, precision shaft processing, and interior architectural and engineering solutions. The firm was established in 1985 and operates principally from its headquarters located in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Allmind Holdings Corporation
summary: Pleasant Hotels International Inc. engages in the operation of a hotel in Taiwan. The company's hotel features 388 guest rooms, as well as wedding and meeting halls; and a business center, swimming pool, fitness center, and restaurant. Pleasant Hotels International Inc. is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: TSG Star Travel Corp.
summary: TSG Star Travel Corp. operates as a provider of travel agency services. This company, which commenced its operations in 2003, was formerly known as Star Travel Corp. It maintains its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Architectural Aesthetics Global Development CO.,LTD.
summary: Architectural Aesthetics Global Development CO.,LTD. focuses on the management and operation of international business hotels, with its hospitality services extending across China and Taiwan. This company, which was founded in 2002, was previously recognized as FX Hotels Group Inc. before officially changing to its present name in November 2023. Its corporate headquarters are located in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Yummy Town (Cayman) Holdings Corporation
summary: Yummy Town (Cayman) Holdings Corporation engages in the sale and service of food and beverage chain to sell various leisure tea and beverages, snacks, and light meals. It also franchises various brands. The company operates its business under the Real Brew Tea, Happy Lemon, Tai Quan Trading, THE SPICELAND, RBT TEA CAFE, Tea Opal, Hippo Bobatea, and Alma brands. It operates in Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japan, the Philippines, South Korea, the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia, the Middle East, and other countries. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.

name: TTFB Company Limited
summary: TTFB Company Limited operates a chain of restaurants in Taiwan and internationally. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Miramar Hospitality Co.,Ltd
summary: Miramar Hospitality Co.,Ltd engages in the hotel business in Taiwan. The company operates Miramar Garden Taipei, a 5-star international business and tourist hotel that provides accommodation services, including deluxe rooms, business rooms, executive deluxe rooms, boss suites, and premier suites; dining services under the Rain Forest, Light Café, JIU BAR, and Tic-Tac-Toe Bakery names; and conference services, such as conference rooms, and wedding and banquets. It also provides health club, fitness center, outdoor swimming pool, sauna, fitness club membership, and business center facilities. The company is based in Taipei, Taiwan. Miramar Hospitality Co.,Ltd is a subsidiary of Tze Shin International Co. Ltd.

name: La Kaffa International Co., Ltd.
summary: La Kaffa International Co., Ltd. operates cafes that provides tea, Taiwanese traditional desserts, set meals, coffee and bakery products, and Chinese food products in Taiwan and internationally. Its brand portfolio includes Chatime, ZenQ Dessert, La Kaffa Coffee, Wagokoro Tonkatsu Anzu Ginza, Bake Code, Duan Chun Zhen, Osaka Ohsho Taiwan, ChuNian Shabu Shabu and Chatime Lounge. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Zhubei City, Taiwan.

name: Vigor Kobo Co., LTD.
summary: Vigor Kobo Co.,Ltd. develops, produces, and sells Chinese cakes and pastries in Taiwan and internationally. It offers pineapple, red-in-green mini, chestnut mini, black stick mini, milk sun, cheese honey, and taro mini cakes, as well as beef jerky. The company provides its products through its stores. Vigor Kobo Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Ezfly International Travel Agent Co., Ltd.
summary: Ezfly International Travel Agent Co., Ltd. operates as an online travel agency in Taiwan. The company offers ticket purchase and booking services; and sells domestic air tickets, foreign individual air tickets, and foreign group air tickets. It also provides domestic and international reservation, group travel, mini tour, group and airline free travel, and themed tickets, as well as foreign dynamic packaging free travel, themed project travel, domestic high-speed rail holiday travel, domestic bus travel, various European and Japanese railway ticket, visa, and other travel products. The company offers its services through its ezfly.com website. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Hoya Resort Hotel Group
summary: Hoya Resort Hotel Group operates hotels, resorts, and spas in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Beinan, Taiwan.

name: Hua Hsuan Real Estate Co Ltd.
summary: Mr. Onion International Co., Ltd provides catering services in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Renjie Oldsichuan Catering Management Consultant Co., Ltd.
summary: Renjie Oldsichuan Catering Management Consultant Co., Ltd. operates a chain of catering facilities in Harbin, Mainland China, and Taiwan. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Richmond International Travel & Tours Co.,Ltd
summary: Richmond International Travel & Tours Co.,Ltd provides travel transportation services under the Shan Fu Tourism brand. It offers passenger services, such as passport visa, Wi-fi rental, translator/headset, and tourism encyclopedia; and professional services, such as outbound, inbound, and national tourism, as well as ticket ordering service. The company offers its products through an e-commerce platform. Richmond International Travel & Tours Co.,Ltd was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Life Travel & Tourist Service Co., Ltd.
summary: Life Travel & Tourist Service Co., Ltd. provides group tourism products and services to domestic and foreign tourists in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Hotel Orchard Park CO., LTD.
summary: Hotel Orchard Park CO., LTD. operates a hotel in Taiwan. The company operates the Orchard Park Hotel, an international tourist hotel with business, holiday, and transit functionalities in Taoyuan's Aerotropolis. Its hotel includes 187 guestrooms, such as deluxe king, executive rooms, Washitsu suites, executive suites, park view suites, and orchard suites. The company also provides Hee Yuet Lau Chinese restaurant, Orchard Café, Hanamizuki Japanese cuisine, Atrium Bar, Oasis club, banquet hall, conference room, shopping street, and business center services, as well as ball room, meeting room, pavilion, and spa services. Hotel Orchard Park CO., LTD. was founded in 2009 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: KINGZA International CO.,Ltd.
summary: KINGZA International CO.,Ltd. primarily operates within the food service industry, offering catering services across Taiwan and in various international locations. The company's main corporate office is located in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Tofu Restaurant Co., Ltd.
summary: Tofu Restaurant Co., Ltd engages in the chain restaurant business in Taiwan. It is also involved in the food manufacturing business. Tofu Restaurant Co., Ltd was founded in 1997 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Bafang Yunji International Company Limited
summary: Bafang Yunji International Company Limited operates and franchises restaurants under the BAFANG YUNJI name. The company operates approximately 700 stores in Taiwan; and 100 stores in Hong Kong. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Kura Sushi Asia Co., Ltd.
summary: Kura Sushi Asia Co., Ltd. operates sushi restaurant in Taiwan. Its restaurants offer sushi, warship, hand roll, volume, and side meal products, as well as desserts and drinks. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: YoungQin International Co., Ltd.
summary: YoungQin International Co., Ltd. operates restaurants under the MWD brand name. It also operates retail stores that offer fried chicken products under the Fried Chicken Master name. The company has operations in Taiwan and internationally. The company was founded in 2015 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Lian Fa International Dining Business Corp.
summary: Lian Fa International Dining Business Corporation operates various restaurants. It operates restaurants under the brands of Sharetea, Mamak, and Kampung. The company is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Louisa Professional Coffee Ltd.
summary: Louisa Professional Coffee Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise dedicated to offering a broad spectrum of coffee and associated products. Its comprehensive menu encompasses a diverse array of beverages, including drip, specialty, and espresso coffees, alongside various teas and other refreshments. Furthermore, the company provides complementary food items such as light meals, cakes, and bagels. Customers can access their offerings through both company-owned retail establishments and franchised outlets. Founded in 2006, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Chu Yu Hsiang Co., Ltd
summary: Chu Yu Hsiang Co., Ltd oversees a global network of Ding Tea establishments, with operations extending across China and other international regions. This company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Taichung City, Taiwan.

name: G-Yen Hutong Co., Ltd.
summary: G-Yen Hutong Co., Ltd. oversees a network of various dining establishments throughout Taiwan. Its operations span multiple popular restaurant concepts, including Hutong, Roast Meat Night Food, Taipei Bird's Day, One Magic Ramen, Hu Dong Niu Noodles, and Cape Cape. The firm is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Munsin Garment Corporation
summary: Munsin Garment Corporation manufactures and trades in various knitwear garments in Taiwan. The company offers golf apparel, lightweight sportswear, professional bicycles, equestrian sports products, casual wear, cue bags, handbags, protective accessories, special clothing, sneakers, shirts, trousers, and sporting products, as well as jogging, tennis, and football series products. It is also involved in the product distribution, import, and export businesses. Munsin Garment Corporation provides its products under the Munsingwear, Le coq sportif, Felix Buhler, McGREGOR, HAZZYS, ACUPUNCTURE, NARA CAMICIE, Eminento, As know as de base, POU DOU DOU, and Danskin brands. The company was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Cayman Island Grand Galactica Corp Limited
summary: Cayman Island Grand Galactica Corp Limited is engaged in the comprehensive research, development, manufacturing, and global distribution of an extensive range of infant clothing and related provisions, catering to markets in Taiwan and worldwide. Its diverse product portfolio features maternity necessities, children's shoes, infant feeding equipment and meals, hygiene and bathing essentials, nursery furniture and bedding, toys, school supplies, home goods, outdoor recreational gear, and gift items, as well as general groceries. Furthermore, the company extends its operations into catering services management, the leasing of factory premises, and various investment activities. Established in 1988 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, the firm was previously known as Cayman Tung Ling Co., Limited, officially changing its name to Cayman Island Grand Galactica Corp Limited in November 2022.

name: The Eslite Spectrum Corporation
summary: The Eslite Spectrum Corporation operates department stores and shopping malls in Taiwan. It also provides real estate analysis, investment planning, and operation management services. The company engages in the engineering service, catering supplies, retail store and equipment businesses; operation of retail outlets; and supply of professional kitchen/laundry equipment, hotel supplies, exquisite cuisine, wine cellars, and catering stores. Further, it operates a hotel under the Songyan ‘Eslite Travel' name. The company operates 43 stores. It provides its planning, design, sales, installation, and after sales services to international tourist hotels and fast food chain stores, coffee chain stores, Chinese and Western restaurants, clubs, sky kitchens, hospitals, and staff restaurants. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan. The Eslite Spectrum Corporation is a subsidiary of The Eslite Co., Ltd.

name: Redhorse Group Co.Ltd.
summary: Redhorse Group Co.Ltd. engages in the gift sales, and education and entertainment business operations in Japan and internationally . It operates through three segments: Souvenir Sales, E-commerce Sales, and Other. The company provides support to direct trading between suppliers and restaurants under the OWL brand name; souvenirs; disaster prevention consulting services that offer storage batteries during a disaster; and green drinks, supplement to deal with the sleeping environment, as well as operates game/esports facility, and guesthouses and hostels. In addition, it is involved in the communication, e-commerce, real estate, hometown tax, and regional industry support and revitalization businesses. Redhorse Group Co.Ltd. was founded in 1964 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands.

name: Gseven Co., Ltd.
summary: Gseven Co., Ltd. sells consumer electronic products in Taiwan. The company offers audio, TV projection, health and beauty, digital, and life style products, as well as horn and air conditioning systems, Home theaters, and household and kitchen appliances. It also sells its products through department store counters and outlets. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Bedding World Co., Ltd.
summary: Bedding World Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail of furniture, bedding, kitchen utensils, and decorative products in Taiwan. It primarily offers mattresses and beddings. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Mister International Enterprise Corp.
summary: Mister International Enterprise Corp. designs, develops, retails, and wholesale of ready-made clothing, footwear, and related peripheral accessories in Taiwan. It operates through online channels and physical stores. Mister International Enterprise Corp. is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Jing-Jan Retail Business Co., Ltd.
summary: Jing-Jan Retail Business Co., Ltd. owns and operates a shopping mall. The company is based in Taipei, Taiwan. Jing-Jan Retail Business Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Radium Life Technology Co., Ltd.

name: Zhen Yu Hardware Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhen Yu Hardware Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail of hardware in China. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Bausen Inc.
summary: Bausen Inc. provides home improvement materials in Taiwan and internationally. It offers hardwood flooring, engineered flooring, laminate flooring, and WPC composite flooring products; and floor coverings, moldings, cabinet systems, marble and stone countertops, and home improvement materials and accessories. The company is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: H.H.Galaxy Co., Ltd.
summary: H.H.Galaxy Co., Ltd. specializes in providing a full spectrum of e-commerce operational services. The company's core offerings include managing online platforms and digital storefronts, overseeing platform distribution logistics, and crafting EDM (Electronic Direct Mail) designs. They also facilitate the procurement of various digital advertising spaces and offer agency services for web page administration. Additionally, H.H.Galaxy delivers targeted digital marketing and advertising strategies. The firm was established in 2013 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Astro Corporation
summary: Astro Corporation develops, produces, and operates digital games, systems, and software and hardware for gaming and lottery products in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers various self-service betting halls, monitor centers, and lottery games; casino and multi player games; cabinets; and lottery, VLT, and casino management systems. It also provides digital entertainment and casual software machine rental and point of sales customization, as well as product outsourcing services. The company is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Oasis Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Oasis Technology Co., Ltd. researches, develops, and produces light emitting diode (LED) and related components worldwide. The company offers digit LED, surface mount device (SMD) LED, dot matrix, and light bar display products; chip and PLCC type SMD LED products; LED lamps; and indoor lighting products, including light tubes. It also provides commercial lighting products, including spot lights, downlights, track lights, cabinet lights, and street lights; high power LED products; printed circuit board (PCB) products; and plastic molds and injections, and PCB and LED packaging products. The company sells is product under the Oasistek brand name. Taiwan Oasis Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: PNC International Inc
summary: PNC International, Inc. is a manufacturer and distributor of diverse audio products. The company's expertise spans loudspeakers, both analog and digital amplification devices, various audio mixing consoles (including analog, digital, and self-powered models), wireless sound systems and complementary accessories, alongside specialized test instruments and signal processors. Established in 1972, PNC International is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Adda Corporation
summary: Adda Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells electronic thermal management products primarily for the information technology industry worldwide. The company offers CPU cooler modules, blower fans, DC axial-flow/blower fans, AC axial-flow fans, and waterproof fans; thermal modules; and accessories, such as metal finger guards and plastic filters. Adda Corporation was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Pingtung, Taiwan.

name: Teamphon Energy Co., Ltd.
summary: Teamphon Energy Co., Ltd. operates as a professional consumer electronic IC application design company in Taiwan. It offers Wi-Fi cam solutions, baby monitors, and products for consumer applications, as well as supplies electronic components. The company also provides various products for game applications consisting of fit life, TV game, and gogo TV; and multimedia applications comprising car black box, mobile media player, MP3 player, TV box, PMP/learning aids, and boombox. It also markets its products in the United States, Japan, Europe, Mainland China, etc. Teamphon Energy Co., Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Channel Well Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Channel Well Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells power supply products worldwide. It offers PC and IPC power supply, industrial power supply, wireless charging transmitter and receiver, LED lighting driver/power, enclosed switching power, and open frame power products, as well as telecom power systems, wireless chargers/power banks, adapters, USB chargers, power cables/electronic wires, magnetic components, heat sinks, and electric vehicle chargers. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: LandMark Optoelectronics Corporation
summary: LandMark Optoelectronics Corporation produces and supplies gallium arsenide (GaAS) and indium phosphide (InP) based epitaxial wafers for optical communication, industrial application, and special-purpose usages in Taiwan, the United States, Mainland China, and internationally. It offers InP laser diode (LD) epi wafers for use in LDs used for optics communications; photo-detector epi wafers for use in photo detectors, avalanched detectors, and laser efficiency monitoring for optics communications; and GaAs LD epi wafers for use in high-efficiency laser manufacturing, bar code scanners, GPS systems, 3D sensors, detectors for Lidar autonomous cars, aesthetic medicine machines, and information center communication equipment, as well as provides optical semi-conductors, LDs, and InAlGaP/AlGalnAs. In addition, the company provides Zn-diffusion services for photo detectors; and grating forming and regrowth services for distributed feedback, as well as selected area growth services. LandMark Optoelectronics Corporation was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Chinese Gamer International Corporation
summary: Chinese Gamer International Corporation operates as an online game research and development company in Taiwan. It provides mobile and online game services. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Newretail Co., Ltd
summary: Newretail Co., Ltd operates as an Internet company in Taiwan. The company offers foreign trade e-commerce services; virtual hosting, and other basic services; and search engine and digital marketing services, as well as electronic information supply services to foreign trade manufacturers. It engages in the production and installation of computer web pages, web search optimization login, keyword marketing, and computer advertising design and agency services; and clothes business. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Wayi International Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd.
summary: Wayi International Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs and sells computer software and hardware. It also engages in trading activities; and provision of game software and information software programming services. The company was formerly known as Wayi International Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Wayi International Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. in June 2000. Wayi International Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd. founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Axiomtek Co., Ltd.
summary: Axiomtek Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells PC-based industrial computer products and peripherals worldwide. The company offers industrial PCs, single board computers, system on modules, fanless and rugged embedded systems, intelligent transportation systems, industrial Internet of Things gateway, industrial EtherCAT master solution, touch panel computers, medical panel computers, digital signage solutions, and network appliances products. It also provides road application platform, digital electronic signage, transportation application platform, industrial Internet of Things gateway, touch tablets, etc. The company's products are used in industrial automation, outdoor information booths, renewable energy, traffic control, shipbuilding, medical care, and other application markets. In addition, it develops software packages for AMS smart remote monitoring programs and data collection used in smart factories, smart energy, green energy, and other industries; and cloud application server and network security application platform products for future big data cloud applications. Axiomtek Co., Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Hotron Precision Electronic Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hotron Precision Electronic Industrial Co.,Ltd. manufactures and supplies various wires and cables for signal transmission, telecommunication, IT, power, auto, medical appliances, and other industries in Taiwan. It offers electronic, electric, and other wires and cables. The company also provides copper rods, wires, and fine wires; tooling for metal press/plastic injection; metal pressed work products; insulation composite Mylar Al. foils; and various wire cables and PC board connectors. In addition, it offers terminals, wire assemblies, and molds; PVC plastic formulations and pellets; and plastic extrusion and injection products. Hotron Precision Electronic Industrial Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Kong King Co.,Ltd
summary: Taiwan Kong King Co.,Ltd functions as a dedicated specialist agent, connecting electronics-related manufacturers in both Taiwan and mainland China. The company's product portfolio is extensive, featuring essential electronic components such as rigid and flexible printed circuit boards (PCBs), semiconductors, and LEDs, alongside a range of chemical materials. Additionally, it supplies advanced equipment for surface mount technology, solar energy applications, and optoelectronic communication systems. Beyond product distribution, Taiwan Kong King provides a comprehensive suite of services. These include the installation, maintenance, repair, inspection, refurbishment, upgrading, and relocation of equipment. The company also delivers vital technical training and offers specialized flying probe and fixture contract services for open/short (O/S) circuit testing. Founded in 1977, Taiwan Kong King Co.,Ltd maintains its headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan. It operates as a subsidiary of Wong's Kong King International (Holdings) Limited.

name: Chi Cheng Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Chi Cheng Enterprise Co., Ltd., established in 1973 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is an international specialist in creating and producing precision mechanical components and complete assemblies. The company serves a wide array of sectors, including industrial, medical, and automotive (for both traditional and electric vehicles). Its diverse product portfolio encompasses items like aluminum-magnesium alloy and plastic enclosures, as well as various connectors. These parts are integral to numerous electronic devices, such as handheld and industrial computers, wearable technology, mobile communication devices, digital cameras (including lens components), and electric motorcycles. Furthermore, Chi Cheng is a supplier of medical equipment and a range of automotive parts and sub-assemblies.

name: Partner Tech Corp.
summary: Partner Tech Corp. is a global leader in the production and distribution of flexible, PC-driven point-of-sale (POS) systems and various associated peripheral devices. Their extensive POS product line encompasses desktop solutions such as fanless touch terminals, Android-based systems, transformable units, all-in-one models, and traditional PC POS products. They also offer innovative transformer POS systems and mobile POS solutions. Beyond their core POS offerings, the company provides kiosks, customer displays, LCD monitors, and digital signage products. Their peripheral range includes printers, scanners, cash management systems, I/O boxes, and keyboards. Furthermore, Partner Tech develops cloud-based device management platforms and specialized solutions tailored for smart restaurant operations. Partner Tech's solutions cater to a broad spectrum of industries, including stadiums and event venues, general retail, theater cinemas, cruise lines, and the broader hospitality sector. Established in 1990, the company is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, and functions as a subsidiary of Qisda Technology Co., Ltd.

name: WIN Semiconductors Corp.
summary: WIN Semiconductors Corp., established in 1999 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is primarily engaged in the research, development, manufacturing, and global distribution of gallium arsenide (GaAs) wafers. The company serves markets across Taiwan, Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Its key semiconductor products include GaAs monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMICs) and radio frequency integrated circuits (RFICs). In addition to its core semiconductor offerings, WIN Semiconductors provides a range of related services, suchalling foundry capabilities, testing, design support, high-frequency packaging, and final product testing. The company also maintains a diverse portfolio of other ventures, including: The development and commercialization of technology for hog farming. The research, production, and sale of high-density gene chips, biochip optical readers, and micro-electrophoresis analyzers. The development and trade of farm animal feed. The creation and sale of diagnostic tools for endometrial cancer. Information software services. Biotechnology and pharmaceutical testing, along with biotech research and development. Furthermore, WIN Semiconductors manages its own investment, logistics, and marketing operations.

name: Howteh Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Howteh Technology Co., Ltd. provides active and passive components, and equipment in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers connector, FFC, thunderbolt cable, MEMS, coaxial cable, conversion line, USB type C, audio amplifier, and LED controller products, as well as power management, radio frequency, and touch components. It also provides printed circuit boards and optoelectronic equipment. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Trust-Search Corp.,Ltd.
summary: Trust-Search Corp.,Ltd. provides automated optical laser inspection services for printed circuit boards and related support. The company also produces and offers specialized phosphor bronze and copper spherical products. Its extensive catalog of electronic components encompasses items like copper foil substrates, as well as a wide array of parts and sub-assemblies. These components serve diverse applications, including personal computing, telecommunications, consumer electronics, communication systems, and automotive sectors. Furthermore, Trust-Search supplies core computing hardware such as processors, memory units, and peripheral equipment. The firm was established in 1981 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Tecstar Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Tecstar Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the production and sale of inductors in Taiwan. It offers multilayer chip beads and inductors, including multilayer ferrite chip beads, multilayer chip inductors, and multilayer common mode filters; SMD power inductors and EMI beads, such as SMD power inductors, SMD common mode chokes, and wound chip beads and inductors; and Ni-Zn soft ferrite cores that include EMI suppression ferrite cores and SMD power inductor cores. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Level Biotechnology Inc.
summary: Level Biotechnology Inc., founded in 1989 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operates in the commercialization and distribution of scientific products and services.
