The company supplies specialized reagents and consumables for cell culture, immunology, and molecular biology, alongside advanced biomedical instrumentation, throughout Taiwan. Beyond product distribution, Level Biotechnology offers a comprehensive suite of research and testing services. These include expert assessments in mammalian and genetic toxicology, pharmacological studies, biocompatibility testing, and the production of model animals. The firm's preclinical research capabilities serve a diverse range of clients in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, animal health, and agrichemical industries.

name: Megawin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Megawin Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs and sells ICs primarily in Taiwan. The company offers 8051 MCU and Cortex-M0 products; and USB products, including full speed MCUs, USB keyboards/mouses/joysticks, USB bridges, and charge ICs. It also provides firmware tool kits, such as ICE, writer, and ISP programmer. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Jhubei City, Taiwan.

name: Hi Sharp Intelligence Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hi Sharp Electronics Co., Ltd., a company based in Taiwan, is dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and sales of advanced intelligent surveillance systems. Their extensive product lineup includes NDAA-compliant IP cameras, a wide array of analog solutions such as hybrid cameras, the distinct Hi Sharp brand series, full-color options, value-plus analog cameras, and hybrid DVRs. Furthermore, they offer sophisticated network products, featuring IP cameras built with Taiwan chipsets, models equipped with face detection, economical IP cameras, pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) cameras, AI integration boxes, access control units, and NVR systems. The company also provides crucial accessories like Power over Ethernet (PoE) switches, power adapters, monitors, and other related components. Hi Sharp Electronics Co., Ltd. was established in 1987 and operates its headquarters from Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Grand Process Technology Corporation
summary: Operating from its headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, Grand Process Technology Corporation specializes in the full lifecycle of metal etching and wafer cleaning equipment. Founded in 1993, the company's services encompass initial design and development, bespoke system customization, manufacturing, rigorous testing, product setup, and continuous after-sales support. Their advanced machinery is crucial for key applications within the touch panel sector, flip-chip and packaging industries, the photoelectric industry, and front-end semiconductor processes.

name: Ultra Chip, Inc.
summary: UltraChip Inc. operates as a fabless IC company in the mobile multimedia IC industry. It researches and develops, manufactures, and sells LCD display driver ICs. The company offers professional display products for consumers, automotive, and industrial sectors. It also provides bistable display products comprising pure driver and Tcon, segment type driver, and single chip products; and motor products, such as BLDC control, motor driver, and high and low side driver ICs. The company offers its products for factory automation control, medical equipment, automotive devices, mobile devices, etc. It operates in Taiwan, China, the United States, Japan, and internationally. UltraChip Inc. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: ThinFlex Corporation
summary: ThinFlex Corporation manufactures and sells flexible copper clad laminates (FCCL) and related materials in Asia, Europe, and the Americas. The company offers thin, high heat resistant, high transmittance/transparency, and asymmetric FCCL; black/white/phosphate free coverlays; composite coverlays; high-shield nano materials; composite stiffener films; RCC materials; and polyimide related laminates. It serves IC packaging industry. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. ThinFlex Corporation is a subsidiary of Arisawa Mfg. Co., Ltd.

name: Jetwell Computer Co., Ltd.
summary: Jetwell Computer Co., Ltd. provides IT infrastructure and integration services in Taiwan. The company offers computer system products, including servers, workstations, notebooks, pads, and printer systems; and storage and big data integration services, as well as designs, builds, integrates, and sells thin client systems. It also provides network products, such as firewall and intrusion detection systems, building green IDC, switch hubs, routers, network interface cards, and wireless network products, as well as international system management and planning and digital surveillance systems. In addition, the company offers security software, file and database audit software, anti-virus, anti-hacker, SPAM, VM ware, and back-up software; building private cloud; and BYOD solutions, as well as integrates and sells encrypting file system and file management software. Further, it provides various professional services comprising maintenance contract, on-site maintenance, IT consultation, project management, and cloud rental and security services. Jetwell Computer Co., Ltd. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Syncomm Technology Corp.
summary: Syncomm Technology Corp. operates as a fabless semiconductor company worldwide. It offers portable products, wireless SOC integrating audio and data processors, and wireless digital modules for use in smart TVs, computers, and mobile devices, as well as PC peripheral, console gaming, portable accessory, and home audio applications. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Advanced Ceramic X Corporation
summary: Advanced Ceramic X Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells RF front-end devices and modules for wireless communication applications in Taiwan, China, the United States, Hong Kong, and internationally. It offers antenna switch modules; antennas; low pass, high pass, and band pass filters, as well as filter arrays; diplexers, triplexers, and saw-triplexers; baluns and baluns filters; couplers and couplers filters; power dividers; high frequency inductors; Bluetooth modules; and RF chip ceramic devices. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Hsinchu County, Taiwan.

name: SysJust Co., Ltd.
summary: SysJust Co., Ltd. operates as a financial technology company in Taiwan. It offers various platforms, including XQ Global Winner, XS strategy radar, and XQ mobile platform; WQ new VIP viewing room; MoneyDJ; Lok Fu Finance channel for data analysis and reading on smart phones, tablets, and computers; and database. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: United Alloy-Tech Company
summary: Established in 1991 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, United Alloy-Tech Company Ltd primarily specializes in the forging, fabrication, marketing, and distribution of aluminum alloys. The company maintains a significant international footprint, conducting business across Taiwan, mainland China, Southeast Asia, North America (United States), and Europe, among other global regions. Beyond its core aluminum alloy operations, its diverse portfolio also encompasses the die-casting, manufacturing, and refinement of molds; the production and sale of automotive components, notably car battery housings; the processing and creation of various tapes, foams, and other aluminum materials; and the provision of asset rental services.

name: Browave Corporation
summary: Browave Corporation operates as an original equipment manufacturing/original design manufacturing development, production, and sales company in the optical fiber communication industry in Taiwan and internationally. Its products include compact coarse wavelength division multiplexers and demultiplexers; splitter modules; add/drop filters; amplifier components consisting of isolators and gain flattening filters; fused biconic taper WBC/WDM coupler and planar lightwave circuit splitters; fan-out cabling systems, adapters, and patchcords/pigtails; MPO/MTP cables; and fiber arrays, collimators, and pigtails. The company also provides optical devices and optical module products, such as isolators, couplers, DWDM, IPD, EDFA, ROSA, BOSA, etc. Its products are used in long haul communications network, metropolitan area network, central office fiber-to-the-home, and cloud data center applications. In addition, the company provides contract manufacturing services. Browave Corporation was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: ASIX Electronics Corporation
summary: ASIX Electronics Corporation, an IC Design company, supplies fabless semiconductors with focus on networking, communication, and connectivity applications. The company provides industrial, SuperSpeed USB, and Non-PCI/SPI embedded Ethernet ICs, as well as interface ICs; and RS-232/RS-485 UART transceivers and USB KVM Switch/Wi-Fi/Ethernet SoCs. It offers its products for smart factory, industrial automation, industrial IoT, smart home and office, PC and peripheral, interface connectivity, and USB KVM switch applications. ASIX Electronics Corporation was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Yem Chio Distribution Co., Ltd.
summary: Yem Chio Distribution Co., Ltd., along with its affiliated entities, specializes in the global trade of various packaging materials. The company's operations encompass the distribution, procurement, and export of these essential supplies across Taiwan, mainland China, and other international territories. Its comprehensive product line features items such as adhesive tapes, specialized electronic and protective buffer packaging, plastic bags, packaging machinery, and a wide array of paper-based packaging solutions. Having been known previously as Xin Chio Global Co., Ltd., the organization adopted its current name in July 2024. Its corporate headquarters are located in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Medigen Biotechnology Corp.
summary: Medigen Biotechnology Corp. focuses on the development of therapies for liver diseases and cancers in Taiwan. It offers cell therapies, such as MAGICELL-NK, which are natural killer cells; and MAGICELL-GDT, which are T cells. The company develops PI-88 (MUPAFOSTAT), which has completed Phase II clinical trial for use as an adjuvant therapy for HCC after curative surgery; and Phase III trial for the adjuvant treatment of patients with hepatitis virus related hepatocellular carcinoma after surgical resection. It also provides OBP-301 that is in a Phase I clinical trials for the treatment of esophageal cancer, and Phase II clinical trials for the treatment of esophageal and gastric cancer. In addition, the company develops human native mAbs for therapeutic applications related to infectious diseases; and molecular diagnostics, vaccine, and generic drugs. Medigen Biotechnology Corp. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Gongin Precision Ind. Co., Ltd
summary: Gongin Precision Ind. Co., Ltd designs, manufactures, and sells IC assembly molds and tools in Taiwan. It offers auto mold chase, and MGP and conventional molds; and wafer fabrication equipment components, such as standard and critical/clean room module components, subsystem assembly and test components, and supply chain and system level assembly and testing components. The company also provides display equipment components, including electros, reactors, ground shields, frames, floating masks, chambers, nozzles, TCP/COF, and test fixtures. In addition, it offers landing gear actuators; engine components comprising combustion and transition liners, compressor vanes and retainer rings, hula seals, and other engine hot section sheet metal parts; motion control components, such as servo valve body/housing, servo valve components, relief valve-hydraulics, and actuators; and machined components for the aerospace industry. Further, the company provides micro turbine and combustion generator components, and micro turbine engines; and servo valves for industrial machinery, vehicles, and aviation applications. Gongin Precision Ind. Co., Ltd was founded in 1978 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: MicroBase Technology Corp.
summary: MicroBase Technology Corp. provides drug delivery systems to patients and healthcare professionals. It specializes in Laser LIGA, a non-silicon-based micromachining technology that is used in the manufacture and development of miniaturized devices and micron-scale parts. The company provides vibrating mesh nebulizers under the Pocket Air name for the home care and hospital sectors; and micro-infusion skin care products under the PharMatrix name. MicroBase Technology Corp. was founded in 1997 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Golden Long Teng Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Golden Long Teng Development Co., Ltd. primarily operates within the real estate industry, specializing in the construction, development, sale, and rental of residential and other various types of properties. The company was founded in 2000 and originally conducted business under the name AME, Inc., before officially rebranding to Golden Long Teng Development Co., Ltd. in July 2016. Its main offices are situated in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Yjn Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hold Jinn Electronics Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells electronic parts and materials. It offers SMD transformer wire racks, bakelite transformer wire racks, plastic transformer wire racks, plastic bakelite engineering products, intelligent parking equipment, artificial intelligence algorithms, and smart parking equipment, as well as integrated chip design services. The company also engages in the tourism business. Hold Jinn Electronics Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: High-Tek Harness Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: High-Tek Harness Enterprise Co., Ltd. produces and sells various computer parts and communication equipment. The company offers electronic wires, coaxial cables, and wires. It also engages in the steel structure and engineering projects, and paper businesses. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Sagittarius Life Science Corp
summary: Sagittarius Life Science Corporation operates as a biotechnology research company. It engages in the development of Chinese herbal medicine technology platform for the treatment of various diseases. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Kingstate Electronics Corp.
summary: Kingstate Electronics Corp. manufactures and sells acoustic products in Taiwan and internationally. It offers various products, including piezo buzzers, magnetic buzzers, micro speakers, dynamic receivers, Bluetooth speakers, and electret condenser microphones; and audio products, such as earphones, wired and wireless headphones, Bluetooth headphones, sports headphones, gaming headphones, TWS products, wireless speakers, and PSAP products; speaker module/mic module products; and personal sound amplifiers, etc. The company also provides OEM/ODM smart devices, including personal safety and wireless alarms, VoIP systems, anti-lost devices, smart doorbells, and IP speakers. The company offers its products for use in telecommunications, consumer electronics, information technology, home appliances, automotive, security, medical, and industrial equipment related industries. Kingstate Electronics Corp. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Yao Sheng Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Yao Sheng Electronic Co., Ltd. designs, produces, and sells transformers and inductors in Taiwan and internationally. It offers low frequency, LLC, flyback, LED, and flat wire transformers; and standard reactors. The company also provides FT, T, UU, and ET series common mode chokes; iron, DR, and R core chokes, as well as PFC and high current chokes. Its products are used in LCD monitors and TVs, cell phones, personal computers, TVs, and information appliances. Yao Sheng Electronic Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Dynapack International Technology Corporation
summary: Dynapack International Technology Corporation designs, manufactures, and supplies portable battery packs in Taiwan. The company offers its products for various applications, including notebook/ultrabook PCs, tablet PCs/e-books, smartphones, handy scanners, 2-way radios, power banks, cable modems, server UPSs, and e-bike batteries. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Mildef Crete Inc.
summary: Mildef Crete Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells computer systems worldwide. It provides notebook, tablet, and handheld PCs. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Argosy Research Inc.
summary: Argosy Research Inc. produces and sells electronic connectors and system products. The company's products include electronic connectors, such as USB3.1 type-C, DDR3/4/5, M.2(NGFF), mini PCIe, LVDS, RF coaxial, battery, FAKRA, etc.; antenna and nut metal stamping parts; and injection/molding parts. Argosy Research Inc. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Universal Vision Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Universal Vision Biotechnology Co., Ltd., established in 1992 and based in Taipei, Taiwan, manages a network of eye care clinics across both Taiwan and China. The company delivers a comprehensive range of ophthalmic services, encompassing advanced surgical interventions and treatments for various ocular conditions. Its surgical specialties include laser vision correction for common refractive errors such as myopia (nearsightedness), hyperopia (farsightedness), astigmatism, and presbyopia (age-related vision decline). They also perform intraocular lens procedures for presbyopia and cataracts, employing advanced techniques like phacoemulsification and femtosecond laser surgery. Beyond surgical solutions, Universal Vision addresses a wide spectrum of eye health concerns, offering services for myopia control, dry eye syndrome, retinal detachment, macular degeneration, strabismus (crossed eyes), amblyopia (lazy eye), and numerous other ophthalmic ailments. The company further provides a diverse array of vision products and optical aids, including various eyeglass frames, specialized multifocal and progressive lenses for myopia and presbyopia, sunglasses, orthokeratology, rigid gas permeable lenses, and both conventional and colored contact lenses. Nutritional eye supplements are also available. Additional offerings include oculoplastic and micro cosmetic eye surgery, alongside bespoke aesthetic medicine consultations. Furthermore, Universal Vision engages in optometric services, hospital administration, technical advisory roles, and the distribution and rental of medical equipment.

name: Aethertek technology co., Ltd
summary: Aethertek technology co. Ltd designs, manufactures, and sells automation machinery related equipment in Taiwan. The company was formerly known as Service & Quality Group Co., Ltd. Aethertek technology co. Ltd was founded in 1992 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Tai-Saw Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Tai-Saw Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells electronic components in Taiwan, the rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company engages in the research and development, design, manufacturing, sales, integrated circuit manufacturing, and packaging of wireless and radio communication components and their system equipment, computer hardware, and peripheral equipment components. Its products include SAW oscillators, crystal resonators, crystal filters, crystal oscillators, VCTCXO, OCXO, HiQ SAW, HiQ Xtal, temperature sensing crystal, LTCC filter, dielectric ceramic filter, antenna, dual SAW, HiQ BAW, HiQ BAR, RF SAW, IF SAW, SAW resonators, and SAW duplexer. Tai-Saw Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: MetaTech (AP) Inc.
summary: MetaTech (AP) Inc. engages in the wholesale and retail of electronic products and equipment in Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, and Southeast Asia. The company offers semiconductor components and consumer products, communication products, and connectors. It also provides genetic testing products for the non-invasive tumors, lung cancer, and familial and colorectal cancer; and regenerative medicines. In addition, the company offers travel and reinvestment services. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: LFA Co., Ltd.
summary: LFA Co., Ltd. specializes in the creation, refinement, and commercial distribution of components for the automotive and electronics industries. The firm also provides advanced, environmentally conscious power supply units. Ching Lin Chou founded this company on September 13, 1986, and its corporate headquarters are located in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: PixArt Imaging Inc.
summary: PixArt Imaging Inc. researches, designs, produces, and sells CMOS image sensors and related ICs in Taiwan, Hong Kong, China, Japan, and internationally. The company offers optical mouse sensor, optical track sensor, and finger navigation products; and multiple object tracking, optical motion tracking, gesture recognition, and ambient light and proximity sensing products, as well as CMOS camera SOC products. It also provides photoplethysmography sensors, computer vision, capacitive touch products, and customized ASIC sensors; wireless audio SOC/true wireless stereo IC products; Bluetooth low energy products; and RF chips. The company's products are used in computers and peripherals, smart homes, offices and classrooms, wearables and hearables, gaming controllers, automotive, surveillance and cameras, commercial and others, automation navigation, and health management. It is also involved in the investment and technical support activities. PixArt Imaging Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: RDC Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: RDC Semiconductor Co., Ltd. designs and develops IC for high-end and low power bit microprocessors in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers Emkore DE and Emkore DS processor platforms for embedded commercial applications, such as digital electronic signage, automatic teller machines, smart vending machines, human-machine interfaces, thin computers, and terminal sales systems; and RDC IAD processor platform for mobile networking applications in consumer electronics, and embedded markets. It also provides RDC 32-bit microcontrollers for various applications, including industrial control, automation, NAT routers, home gateway and access points, industrial PCs, thin client applications, and others; RDC16-bit microcontrollers for general embedded market applications, such as industrial controls, control automation, terminals, signal generators, and projectors; and RDC NPU to equipment manufacturers. In addition, the company offers RDC ASIC that provides clients with comprehensive services and industrial application solutions; low power system-on-chip for programmable automation controller, embedded board solutions, data concentrator, and industrial automation control system applications; and multi-function I/O peripheral controllers and PCI express/PCI interfaces expansions. Further, it provides 8-bit MCU IP that is used for DSC, CF card, pattern recognition, LCD monitor controller, USB device controller, scanner controller, MP3 controller, modem controller, and voice recognition applications. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Jiin Ming Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiin Ming Industry Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells products related to metal/plastic body parts and components. The company primarily offers parts and components of notebook computers, LCD monitors, LCD TVs, and other 3C products. Its products comprise LCD display components, including bezels, back covers, support brackets, and reflectors; notebook components, such as frames, bottoms, and shieldings; flat panel display components comprising bezels, middle frames, panel brackets, and covers; and 3C product components, including MP3 covers/components, heat spreaders, and multimedia products. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Sentronic International Corp.
summary: Sentronic International Corp. provides semiconductor components, liquid crystal displays, optical pickups, light-emitting diodes, micro motors, decentralized components, etc. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: TrueLight Corporation
summary: TrueLight Corporation designs, develops, and supplies optical components in Asia. The company offers high-bandwidth semiconductor lasers, photodiode components and submodules, optical engines and cables, vertical cavity surface emitting lasers light source for cloud\data center, 5G mobile internet base station interconnections, and proximity/flood illumination/3D sensing applications in smartphones. It serves optical fiber transceiver, internet equipment, and smartphone module manufacturers. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: ABC Taiwan Electronics Corp.
summary: ABC Taiwan Electronics Corp. (ABC), headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is a leading manufacturer and global supplier of various electronic components. The company's extensive product line includes a wide range of inductive devices such as filter coils, multiple types of line filters, and power inductors (including radial, SMD, shielded, and semi-shielded configurations). They also produce multilayer chip inductors, multilayer chip beads, wound chip inductors, and axial inductors. Beyond inductive components, ABC provides transformers, MPC heat-sinks, and connectors. Furthermore, their capabilities extend to stamping and plastic molding products, as well as modern LED lighting solutions. These versatile components are vital across numerous industries, finding applications in consumer electronics, telecommunications equipment, computer and peripheral systems, industrial machinery, and automotive electronics. Established in 1979, ABC Taiwan Electronics Corp. maintains a strong international presence, with operations spanning the United States, Germany, China, and its native Taiwan.

name: Haiwan International Development Co., Ltd
summary: Haiwan International Development Co., Ltd engages in the development and leasing of residential buildings. It is also involved in the hotel business; and real estate trading activities. The company was formerly known as Haewan International Development Co., Ltd and changed its name to Haiwan International Development Co., Ltd. in 2014. Haiwan International Development Co., Ltd was founded in 1994 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Solid State System Co., Ltd.
summary: Solid State System Co., Ltd., together with its affiliated companies, focuses on the development, manufacturing, and marketing of semiconductor chips throughout Taiwan. The firm provides an array of solutions, including storage technologies like USB flash drive controllers and complete solid-state drive platforms. Additionally, its product portfolio features multimedia audio components, such as control chips for USB speakers, headsets, and line-in audio interfaces. The company also supplies micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) microphones. Founded in 1998, Solid State System Co., Ltd. is based in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: ADATA Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ADATA Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells memory and storage solutions. It offers DRAM modules, solid state drives, USB flash drives, memory cards and readers, power banks, and cables and accessories; external storage products; and wireless, car, and wall chargers, as well as PC system and components, keyboard and mouse, audio products, and accessories. The company also provides industrial SSD cards, and disk on module/USB/embedded products for use in automation, point of sale, digital signage, network video recorder, kiosk, data centers, in-car systems, multifunction printers, casino gaming machines, and aerospace applications. In addition, it offers commercial and industrial lighting products; and powertrain products, such as axial flux motors, air-cooled motors, liquid-cooled motors, and motor controllers. ADATA Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Ardentec Corporation
summary: Ardentec Corporation provides semiconductor testing solutions in memory, logic, and mixed-signal ICs (integrated circuits) to integrated device manufacturers, pure play wafer foundry companies, and fabless design companies. The company offers testing services comprising engineering services before mass production, such as test engineering consultations and recommendations for design, test plan and test program development, test program cross-platform conversion, complete product characterization, and laser program development and analysis; and mass production engineering services consisting of suggestions and services of test time reduction, yield analysis and enhancement, laser repair yield analysis and improvement, timely retrieval of test data on secured Internet, test program management system, test data analysis and periodical report provision, and outlier management services, as well as stable testing services. It also provides probe card design and consultant, outsourced manufacturing, and maintenance and system management for repair record and tracking services; wafer level chip scale packaging backend process services; and wafer probing platforms. In addition, the company offers certification, and quality system and assurance structure services, as well as quality, information security, and hazardous substance free policy services; and IT policy, IT service architecture, and testing information services. Further, it provides testing and assembly services; electronic ICs, diodes, transistors, and semiconductor devices; IC devices testing and trimming services; ICs, module, and component testing services; and manufactures electronic components. Additionally, the company offers burn in testing of wafer types; wafer testing for LCD driver ICs and analog ICs; and wafer and final testing of radio frequency ICs. It operates in the United States, Taiwan, Singapore, Korea, China, and internationally. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Winstek Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Winstek Semiconductor Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and testing of integrated circuits in Taiwan. The company operates through two divisions, Testing and Packaging. It offers wafer sort, final and post test, engineering support, and test platforms services; copper pillar bump, wafer level chip scale package, lead free bump, plating bump / ball drop, and backside metallization services; die processing services, wafer thinning, singulation, and flip chip packaging services; and failure analysis and reliability test services. The company was formerly known as Stats ChipPac Taiwan Semiconductor Corp. and changed its name to Winstek Semiconductor Co., Ltd. in June 2015. Winstek Semiconductor Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan. Winstek Semiconductor Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of Singapore Merchants Bloomeria Limited.

name: Higher Way Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Higher Way Electronic Co., Ltd. operates globally as a supplier of integrated circuits (ICs), specializing in consumer electronics, multimedia applications, and microcontrollers. The company's market footprint extends across Taiwan, Hong Kong, mainland China, and the United States, serving a diverse international clientele. Beyond product distribution, Higher Way actively develops proprietary IC software and firmware. Its service portfolio includes comprehensive technology solutions such as imaging components, wireless transmission modules, sensor integration, application development, algorithmic processing, and tailored design services. The company's extensive product range features video solutions like multimedia processors, dual USB cameras, camera modules, and thermal imaging devices. In the audio domain, it offers components for electric pianos, electronic flipcharts, tablet PCs, speech recognition systems, and USB stereo audio. Its industrial segment includes microcontrollers, flash memory, motor control units (MCUs), and wireless charging solutions. Furthermore, Higher Way is proficient in touch control technologies, display driver development, and advanced AIoT (Artificial Intelligence of Things) and radio frequency (RF) applications. Established in 1991, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Good Way Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Globally, Good Way Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, production, and distribution of USB and personal computer peripheral devices. Its extensive product portfolio features various docking stations, such as cutting-edge USB4, Thunderbolt 3 and 4 models, versatile USB-C docks (supporting single and multi-display setups), universal solutions, and intelligent smart docks. Additionally, the company provides a range of multi-port hubs for both USB and USB-C connections, alongside adapters for dual video, USB video, Ethernet, and USB cables. Furthermore, its offerings encompass video converters, wireless docking solutions, and dongles. Beyond these, Good Way Technology markets peripherals for HDMI/DisplayPort and 3D televisions, DLNA-enabled wireless audio devices, Bluetooth wireless receivers, and a selection of other wireless technologies. Comprehensive sales and technical support services complement its product lineup. Established in 1983, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: T-Flex Techvest PCB Co., Ltd.
summary: T-Flex Techvest PCB Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of FPC and PCB products in worldwide. The company provides original equipment manufacturing services for inner and outer layer printed circuit board lamination; and PCB inner layer optical inspection. Its products are used in portable device, camera module, auto CCD, key pad, cell phone, and LCM module applications, as well as applied in mobile phone, communication, mother, TFT-LCD, high density interconnection boards; and computer peripheral and consumer products, which include note book. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Top High Image Corp.
summary: Top High Image Corp., headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, functions as a global producer and vendor of printing plates and various associated consumables. Its extensive product range features a diverse selection of TOP offset printing plates, such as the T-20 Process Free, T-UV Thermal CTP, T-830 Positive Thermal CTP, HS-920 Positive UV CTP, TP-103 Positive Conventional PS, and HD-UV thermal CTP plates. The company also supplies Durst brand items, including the TAU 330 RSC, TAU 330 RSC E, and TAURSci. Additional offerings include synthetic papers, the SCODIX Ultra Series, and SeiLASER products like Paper One 5000, Mercury 1520, and Label Master 600. Furthermore, they provide hot stamping and cold foils, thermal CTP plate processors, wash cloths, and UV over printing varnishes. Beyond its core operations, the corporation extends its activities into trading and various services, food manufacturing and wholesale, advertising, and real estate agency. Founded in 1995, the entity was originally known as Top Aluminum Co., Ltd. before rebranding as Top High Image Corp. in July 2000.

name: Microtips Technology Inc.
summary: Microtips Technology Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells LCD modules, PCB assemblies, and professional audio and video design and assembly products worldwide. The company offers character, graphic, and TFT LCD modules for industrial control, medical devices, telecommunication, and new emerging products. It also provides musical instruments, including sounds effects testing machines; sound amplifiers for professional recording studios and concerts; digital musical instruments for audio studios, pubs, and clubs; and digital audio processors, live sound recorders, multi-channel mixers, sound effects, machine DSP amps, etc. In addition, the company offers finger printer modules and diaper sensors; and wireless chargers and modules, such as wireless transmitters and receivers under the AirFuel, AirON, and WiChargi brands. Further, it provides custom designed resonators, and PRU and PTU modules for power and ID form factor applications comprising wearable devices, smartphones, handheld devices, tablets, laptops, vehicles, home appliances, etc. Additionally, the company offers ODM/OEM services for audio and video products; and engineering services that include product development, electrical and mechanical engineering, tooling design, prototype engineering, manufacturing process engineering, and quality engineering, as well as valued-added design, electronics manufacturing, and logistics services. Microtips Technology Inc. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Kworld Computer Co.,Ltd
summary: Kworld Computer Co., Ltd provides digital entertainment products in Taiwan and internationally. It offers gaming earphones; and wall and car chargers, as well as TV/video drivers, analog TV tuner cards, and hybrid TV tuner sticks. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Silicon Touch Technology Inc.
summary: Silicon Touch Technology Inc. designs, develops, produces, and sells analogue and digital ICs. The company offers motor, brushless fan motor, CD/DVD ROM motor, stepping motor, and LED display driving IC, as well as power and power supply monitoring, optoelectronic communication and image processing, and optoelectronic interface ICs. It provides its products in the Americas, Europe, Japan, Korea, South Africa, and China. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Integrated Service Technology Inc.
summary: Integrated Service Technology Inc. research, develops, and manufactures integrated circuits, analysis and burn-in, and testing in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides MOSFET wafer backend processes, which offer MOSFET front-side metallization, such as chemical/electro-less plating and front-side metal sputtering deposition; MOSFET backside grinding processes; MOSFET backside metallization processes comprising metal evaporation deposition and thick Ag process; and turnkey solutions for backend processes, which include chip probing, laser marking, vacuum mounting, ring removal, die sawing, frame probing, tape and reel, and final test. It also offers verification analysis services, such as focused ion beam (FIB) circuit edit; engineering sample preparation services, including grinding, wafer dicing saw, die bonding, IC wire bonding/assembly solutions, and surface mount technique process; failure analysis offers electrical characteristics measurement, non-destructive analysis, defect detection, and competitive analysis services; and signal integrity test, and design quality management. In addition, the company offers material analysis solutions comprising sample preparation, structure observation, surface analysis, thermal and component analysis, and crystallographic analysis; reliability design test, such as component and board level reliability test, PCB design verification, automotive electronics test, surface mount technique, warpage verification, and other services; chemical and material analysis services, includes Consultancy for green and environmental protection regulations, and precise and quantitative analysis; and various consultancy services, includes quality assurance and function safety, ESG, and laboratory accreditation and green mark, as well as import and export of semiconductor parts and relevant equipment, electronic parts, computer and computer components. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Donpon Precision Inc.
summary: Donpon Precision Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells automotive electronic products and plastic precision components in Taiwan and Mainland China. The company is involved in mold design, manufacturing, plastic molding, painting and printing, and assembly and processing of professional OEM electrical equipment. It provides automotive electronic products, such as rear-view camera and mirror, HUD, steering wheel switches, audio panel, auto parts molds, air filters, chargers, and trim products, as well as safety products. The company offers camera, backlight module, headphones, power chargers, and mobile phone accessories; and touch glass products, including auto monitors, and mobile phone, tablet PC, and laptop application products. Donpon Precision Inc. was founded in 1995 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: International Games System
summary: Headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, International Games System Co.,Ltd., founded in 1989, specializes in the full spectrum of game development and distribution. The company is involved in planning, designing, researching, developing, manufacturing, marketing, servicing, and licensing a diverse range of games, including arcade, online, and mobile titles. Its arcade game selection features recreational, puzzle, TSG, and simulation machines. Furthermore, International Games System Co.,Ltd. develops computer software and products, delivers computer system integration services, and offers various advisory, technical training, and technical support services. The company's main operational territories are Taiwan, the United Kingdom, and China.

name: Megaforce Company Limited
summary: Megaforce Company Limited engages in the research and development of opto-mechatronics and plastic components in Taiwan, China, Mexico, and the United States. The company engages in precise plastic injection molding, micro-precision structure mold development, electronic assembly, and spray printing activities. It also offers dental electromechanical integration products, surgical systems, medical integration products through Internet of Things, and medical machinery products, as well as medical teaching courses. In addition, the company provides surface treatment, post process, and assembly services; and liquid silicone rubber molding and DFM products. The company's products are used in advanced computer gaming, high-end home entertainment equipment, vehicle components, medical appliances, and aerospace equipment, as well as in computer, communication, and consumer electronics products. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Hunt Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunt Electronic Co., Ltd., a Taiwanese enterprise, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and global distribution of security and surveillance technologies. Their market reach extends across Taiwan, the broader Asian continent, the United States, and Europe. Their comprehensive product lineup includes a diverse range of network cameras, such as specialized explosion-proof IP, corrosion-resistant IP, and thermal IP models, as well as cameras designed for traffic surveillance, speed dome, fisheye, bullet, vandal-resistant dome, fixed dome, box, and cube configurations. They also provide advanced AI-driven thermal IP cameras. Beyond these, the company offers state-of-the-art 4G and 5G LTE cellular cameras, digital recording devices, and a suite of associated software products and applications. The firm was established in 1988 and operates from its main office situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Univacco Technology Inc.
summary: Univacco Technology Inc. manufactures and sells stamping foil products and optoelectronics materials worldwide. The company offers various decorative and functional foils, which include hot stamping, cold, holographic, and digital foils. The company also provides optoelectronics materials, including clean and PET protective films, diffuser, SMD cover tapes, medical films, and OEM for coating. The company provides its products for wine, beer, and spirits label and packaging; food, drink, and confectionery packaging; tobacco/cigarette packaging; greeting cards and printed media; artificial leather book covers; persona care; cosmetics and perfumes; pharmaceuticals; and clothing and textile applications. It markets its products under the UNIVACCO brand. The company was formerly known as Tai Leng Industry Co., Ltd and changed its name to Univacco Technology Inc. in 2002. Univacco Technology Inc. was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: RoyalTek Company Ltd.
summary: RoyalTek Company Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells global positioning system (GPS) products worldwide. Its products primarily include audio video navigation systems, portable navigation devices, driving assistance systems, driving video recorders, electronic accessories for automobiles, and engine boards for GPS. The company also offers ODM/OEM services for car electronics and driver assistance systems. It serves automotive, navigation, safety, leisure, sports, multimedia, mountaineering, tourism, and other industries. RoyalTek Company Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Chialin Precision Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Chialin Precision Industrial Co., Ltd. designs, processes, manufactures, and sells stamping dies and other related parts, precision terminals, and hardware parts in Taiwan. The company's products include bandolier pins, mobile and computer connectors, lamp and piranha lead frames, SMD lead frames, and antennas, as well as other products, such as EMI spring finger and shielding case. It is also involved in the development and leasing of houses and buildings. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Feei Cherng Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Feei Cherng Enterprise Co., Ltd. manufactures and markets active/passive electronic components in Taiwan and Internationally. The company's products include MOSFETs, LAN transformers, and polymer caps, as well as diodes, NTC thermistors, MLCC, and crystals. It also distributes. The company offers its products for use in N/B, M/B, smart phones, mobiles, and GPS system applications. Feei Cherng Enterprise Co., Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Niko Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Niko Semiconductor Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, design, engineering, and global distribution of analog integrated circuits (ICs), serving markets in Taiwan, mainland China, and internationally. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses critical components such as Power MOSFETs, linear and switching regulators (including their control ICs), a variety of diodes like low Vf and SiC types, and other power integrated circuits. Beyond these offerings, Niko Semiconductor also develops, manufactures, and markets metal oxide semiconductors, and provides comprehensive product quality assurance and testing services for its proprietary goods. These advanced electronic solutions are essential for a wide array of applications, including computer motherboards, graphics cards, LCD televisions and monitors, power supply units, laptop computers, and equipment for both telecommunications and networking. Established in 1998, the company initially operated under the name Super Gem, officially adopting its current name, Niko Semiconductor Co., Ltd., in April 2001. Its corporate headquarters are situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Joinsoon Electronics Manufacturing CO., LTD.
summary: Joinsoon Electronics Manufacturing CO., LTD. designs, manufactures, and sells interconnection products worldwide. The company offers precision components, including antennas, cables, and connectors, as well as noninvasive consumable cables, customized cable assemblies, fly-lights, infrared surveillance camera cable assemblies, and CDRW and multimedia cables. It also provides electronics products, such as storage, VoIP and HDMI series, and OEM and ODM products. In addition, the company offers healthcare management products comprising infrared ear and digital thermometers. Further, it provides product consultation and technical support services that include product design and development, procurement and sourcing, and manufacturing and engineering support, as well as design manufacturing services; and electronics manufacturing services. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Celxpert Energy Corporation
summary: Celxpert Energy Corporation produces and sells battery packs in Taiwan. Its products are used in notebook and tablet, network product, smart phone, power tool, E-bike/E-Moto, and energy storage and UPS battery packs. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Auras Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Auras Technology Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing, processing, and retailing electronic materials, computer heat dissipation modules, and other related products in China, Taiwan, Korea, Ireland, and internationally. The company offers coolers, heat sinks, cooling modules, heat pipes, fans, etc. primarily for applications in notebooks, desktops, servers, pads and workstations, mobiles, graphic cards, etc. It also provides server, motherboard, and graphics card cooling modules; all-in-one workstations and DVD player cooling modules; and cooling products for home appliances, such as DVD and Blu-ray players, as well as LED lighting applications. In addition, the company offers heat flow consulting services. Auras Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Casing Macron Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Casing Macron Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, markets, and sells computing products. It offers PC chassis and switching power supply products; peripheral devices, such as card readers, mouse, speakers, and barebone systems; and PC cases, including slim, mini tower, middle tower, mini ITX, server, and gamming PC cases. The company also provides water filter systems and temperature drinking water devices. In addition, it offers OEM and ODM services. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Cincon Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Cincon Electronics Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, sells switch mode power conversion products to the communications, computer, industrial, medical, consumer, and lighting markets worldwide. Its products include single and multiple output DC-DC converters from 1W to 750W, single and multiple output AC adapters from 5W to 150W, open frame AC-DC power supplies from 5W to 700W, and LED power supplies from 15W to 150W. The company also provides modified standard and custom power conversion products. In addition, it offers accessories; and operates iDALI, an app for digital lighting control solution. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Tekcore Co., Ltd
summary: Tekcore Co., Ltd produces and sells LED wafers and chips in Taiwan. It offers standard LEDs, and power and flip chips. The company provides high brightness chips in green, blue, red, yellow, orange, and ultraviolet wavelengths. Its products are used in various applications, including large scale displays and billboards; optic fiber cables; indicator lights; LCD and projection backlighting; low light environments; miniaturized light sources; cell phones, cameras, and other small electronic displays; TV remotes and infrared mouses; signal lights; interior and exterior solid state lighting and other illuminations; and vehicle lights. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Nantou City, Taiwan.

name: Dexin Corporation
summary: Dexin Corporation manufactures and sells IT cordless solutions and high-level devices in Taiwan. The company offers audio and entertainment products, including Bluetooth headsets and speakers, gaming headsets, and audiophile headphones; and computer peripherals and consumer electronic devices, such as office and gaming mouse products, keyboards, and game controllers. It also provides industrial design, research and development, product engineering and manufacturing, and other custom and project design services. Dexin Corporation was founded in 1997 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Microcosm Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Microcosm Technology Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and supplies upstream materials for the electronic industry. It offers PSPI-Brina, a high precision photosensitive developing type Polyimide material; liquid and film type colorless polyimide material for OLED display screens, and other colorless and flexible required electronic products; and high frequency series products. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: TAI-TECH Advanced Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: TAI-TECH Advanced Electronics Co., Ltd., including its subsidiaries, is a Taiwanese enterprise dedicated to developing, manufacturing, and supplying magnetic materials and inductive components. The company offers a comprehensive range of products such as EMI suppression filters, common mode chokes, various chip and power inductors (including high-current and surface-mount device types), LAN transformers, low-frequency antennas, and balun filters. These essential components are widely applied in sectors like television, automotive, networking infrastructure, notebook computers, smartphones, and simulation systems. Established in 1975, TAI-TECH Advanced Electronics maintains its corporate headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Sunnic Technology & Merchandise Inc
summary: Sunnic Technology & Merchandise Inc. provides image processing and optoelectronic products in Taiwan. It offers products ranging from semiconductors, solutions and modules, and systems to factory automation equipment. The company also provides solutions for exterior, mechanism, software, hardware, and firmware designs, as well as one-stop shopping services. Its product research and development covers range of products and applications that include CCD and CMOS analog and digital HD smart cameras for image capture and blue-ray; H.264 IP set top box and IP smart TV box for image storage; HD smart displays and Internet TV for image display; and Wi-Fi, RF, and 3GPP for video conferencing and image transmission. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Ability Opto-Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ability Opto-Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and sale of professional optical lenses in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers various optical lens products, including scanners, projectors, digital cameras, digital video recorders, multi-function printers, cell phone cameras, laptops, tablets, IP-cameras, monitors, automotive lens, etc.; and CCM/NB products, as well as lens for automotive, digital surveillance, special, professional, and other applications. It also provides technical services of precision optical lens. The company was formerly known as SHIAN-JINN Precision Optical Co., Ltd and changed its name to Ability Opto-Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd. in 2001. Ability Opto-Electronics Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Taichung City, Taiwan.

name: FOCI Fiber Optic Communications, Inc.
summary: FOCI Fiber Optic Communications, Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets fiber optic components and integrated modules for communication networks in Taiwan. It offers interconnects, such as connector/adaptor parts, pigtails/patchcords, and patchpanels; couplers/splitters, attenuators, and wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) products; filter WDMs, CWDMs, DWDMs, and filter devices; optical isolators and circulators, including micro optic devices; optical transceivers and active optical cables; and USB 3.0 AOC cables, sub-assemblies, pigtails/receptacles, and detectors. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan IC Packaging Corporation
summary: Taiwan IC Packaging Corporation is dedicated to developing advanced integrated circuit (IC) packaging technologies, particularly focusing on optical and ultra-slim designs. Its extensive product catalog features a wide array of IC package types, including thin small outline (TSOP), small outline (SOP), SSOP/TSSOP, quad flat no-lead (QFN)/dual flat no-lead (DFN), thin PKG, TQFP, quad flat (QFP), LQFP, thermally enhanced versions, and specialized image sensor packages. Beyond these, the firm also offers substrate-based packaging solutions like LGA, VLGA, and packaging for micro-SD and SD cards. Founded in 1998, the company is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Radiant Innovation Inc.
summary: Radiant Innovation Inc. designs and develops infrared technology products. It offers medical infrared thermometers, industrial use infrared thermometers, and CO2 monitors. The company also provides infrared ear and forehead thermometers, multi-function thermometers, disposable probe covers, and TMS products. Radiant Innovation Inc. was founded in 2000 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Xintec Inc.
summary: Xintec Inc. operates as a three dimensional (3D) wafer level chip scale packaging company in Taiwan, the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company offers optical sensor chip-scale package technology for cellular phones, notebooks, gesture sensors, and laser intensity sensor for blue-ray and pico projectors; PPI and 3D Package technologies for use in integrated passive devices, power management IC and analogue IC, cellular phone RF IC, and capacitive couplers; and Micro-Electro-Mechanical Systems (MEMS) and sensor packaging for ink printer heads, motion sensors, temperature and humidity sensors, pressure sensors, identification sensors, pico-projector heads, silicon microphones, and bio sensors. It also provides design and modeling services for its technologies. Xintec Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Benefit Company
summary: Established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1981, Taiwan Benefit Company operates across Taiwan, Europe, the United States, and Japan, focusing on equipment manufacturing, production system engineering, and agency services. The company supplies a comprehensive range of machinery for the food and beverage industry, including advanced processing facilities and diverse packaging solutions. Its product portfolio features integrated rinser/filler/capper monoblocs, tunnel coolers/warmers, wrapping around packers, palletizers/depalletizers, conveyor systems, bag cutting systems, and various labeling machines (including sleeve labelers). Additionally, they offer specialized equipment such as tea extraction units, Clean-In-Place (CIP) systems, and pasteurization systems. Beyond equipment provision, Taiwan Benefit delivers extensive technical services, encompassing engineering design, installation, equipment supply, and complete turnkey project management. The company also engages in trading chemical process equipment, industrial plants, raw materials, and both solid and liquid food processing and packaging equipment along with their associated raw materials. Clients further benefit from production machinery system test runs and dedicated after-sales technical support.

name: Topco Technologies Corp.
summary: Topco Technologies Corp. engages in the import and export of chemical material related commodities in Taiwan, Mainland China, and internationally. It offers silicone related products, including silicone fluid, defoaming and release agent, foam stabilizer, fiber treatment, paint additives, resin, coupling agent, oil, rubber, PSA, powder, and grease, as well as paper release agent, HTV, liquid injection molding system, RTV I, RTV II, sealant, MS-RTV, thermal pad and LED application material, and AF coating agent. The company also provides various adhesives, such as construction structural adhesives; EXELAST; surface treatment equipment; matsumoto microsphere; poreflon membrane; touch panel related materials; poly tetra fluoroethylene films; and other products. In addition, it offers environmental catalysts; micro-capsule foam materials; silicate and anti-static agents; cosmetic raw materials and finished products; gunze fluorine sleeves; UV curing glues; atmospheric plasma; VUV washing machines; and conductive polymers and thermal materials, as well as other trade products. The company was founded in 1981 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Sunflex Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunflex Tech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells flexible printed circuit boards (FPCB) in Taiwan. The company offers rigid flex, multi-layer, double side, single side double access, and single side FPCBs. Its products are used in touch panels, liquid crystal modules, computer accessories, light bars, and automotive electronics. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Remotek Corporation
summary: Remotek Corporation engages in the research, design, production, and sale of radio coverage solutions for 2G, 3G, and 4G mobile radio networks worldwide. The company offers digital repeaters, including PICO ICS, ICS, digital fiber optic, and digital band adjustable repeaters; distributed antenna systems, such as fiber optic repeaters and cable boosters; and off air solutions comprising low and medium power repeaters, high power repeaters, channel selective repeaters, and frequency shifting repeaters. It also provides operation and maintenance system, a management system for controlling and monitoring repeaters remotely; and accessories, such as antennas, couplers, splitters, combiners, dummy loads, coaxial cables, and connectors. In addition, the company offers RF components and related services. It serves providers of mobile communication. Remotek Corporation was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Wholetech System Hitech Limited
summary: Wholetech System Hitech Limited provides turnkey and system integration services in Taiwan. It offers bulk gas, specialty gas supply, hookup turnkey and consultant, and gas hook-up systems; clean room, MEP, process exhaust, pure water treatment, fire, and cooling systems; and vacuum piping systems, vacuum piping fittings, vacuum ball valves, and deposit improvement engineering services. The company also provides gas cabinets and racks, and VMP/P systems; monitoring hardware and software, such as GIS, HPM, FMCS, and heating jackets; scrubbers; and automation engineering software, custom application software, and mobile IoT smart facility management system. In addition, it provides wet process equipment and chemical supply systems comprising semiconductor, LED, solar energy, and LCD panels. The company was formerly known as Wholetech Engineering Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Wholetech System Hitech Limited in 2001. Wholetech System Hitech Limited was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Tai Shing Electronics Components Corporation
summary: Tai Shing Electronics Components Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, researches, designs, manufactures, and sells solenoids, and solenoid valve and relay products in Asia, Europe, the Americas, and internationally. The company offers linear DC solenoid products comprising open frame, permanent, and tubular solenoids; holding, rotary DC, and customized solenoids; water, air, and oil valves; brakes; signal, power, automotive, and SSR relays; crystals, oscillators, and sensors; and lathes, stamping parts and molds, plastic injection parts and molds, lead wire processing, powder metallurgy, forging, tube processing, and other services, as well as parts, including bearings, springs, magnets, and filters. It also provides electromagnets, electromagnetic values, metal valves, other fabricated metal products, electric appliances, audiovisual electric products, wired communication equipment and apparatuses, telecommunication equipment and apparatuses, electronic parts and components, computers and computing peripheral equipment, and cleaning products used in the manufacturing industry. Further, it engages in international trade; manufacture and import of restrained telecom radio frequency equipment; and other business activities. Tai Shing Electronics Components Corporation was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Promaster Technology Corp.
summary: Promaster Technology Corp. distributes general purpose, communication and multimedia products for communication and consumer markets. The company's products are used in desktop and server PCs, notebook PCs, smart phones, LCD TVs, PDA, graphic cards, and audio/video I/O products; networking products, such as LAN, ADSL router and cable modems, and telecom products; and wireless products, including cellular phones, wireless handheld devices, WLAN and Bluetooth, and GPS. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Chitec Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Chitec Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of specialty chemicals for applications in electronics, medicine, automotive, construction, and other industries worldwide. It offers UV absorbers and light stabilizers under the Chiguard name; flame retardants under the Zuran name; antioxidants under the Revonox/Deox name; photoinitiators under the Chivacure/R-gen name; and anti-reversion agents, antiozoants, optical brighteners, and auxiliary thermal stabilizers under the Chitex name. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: ACULA Technology Corp.
summary: ACULA Technology Corp. provides video solutions and services in Taiwan and internationally. It offers closed-circuit television (CCTV) monitors; combo DVR/NVR products; medical displays; IP monitors with POE; IP public view monitors with POE; industrial monitors-touch monitors/point of sale (POS); digital signage/public information display products; and high-brightness monitors. The company also provides OEM/ODM display products. It offers CCTV products for use in apartment complexes, airports, bars, casinos, daycares, schools, parks, fast food restaurants, hotels, night clubs, parking lots, office buildings, shopping malls, train/bus stations, and warehouses, as well as for home owners; and POS products for food service, hospitality, retail, and public markets. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Advanced Analog Technology, Inc.
summary: Advanced Analog Technology, Inc. designs, develops, and sells power management ICs in Taiwan. It provides multifunctional PMICs, such as TFT LCDs, AMOLEDs, DSC/DVs, and portable devices; boost, buck, buck-boost, and inverting switching regulators; WLED drivers consisting of backlights and lighting products; and battery management products comprising battery chargers and battery protection products. The company also offers audio amps, GPMs, LDOs, level shifters, motor drivers, OP amps/buffers, RESETs, and photoflash products. Its products are used in DSC/DV/drive recorder, PND, and discrete and integrated LCD panel applications. Advanced Analog Technology, Inc. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Unique Opto-Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Unique Optical Industrial Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, processes, and trades in various optical glasses, optical lenses, lens blanks, stubble blanks, and prism blanks in Taiwan and internationally. Its products are used in cameras, camcorders, telescopes, microscopes, condensers, projectors, fax machines, copiers, scanners, monitors, digital cameras, measuring instruments, military observation equipment, medical endoscopes, camera phones, and optical communication products. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Nantou, Taiwan.

name: Niching Industrial Corporation
summary: Niching Industrial Corporation markets and sells semiconductor, flat panel display, light-emitting diode (LED), green energy, and nanotechnology products worldwide. The company provides PCB for solid-state drives and memory modules, substrates for IC packaging, capillary wedges, die collet needles, special gas, dispensing nozzles, and die attach films, as well as reclaim, Al coating, dummy, and daisy chain wafers. It also offers screen printing silver paste, Nano imprint silver paste, gravure off set silver paste, low-temperature sintering Ag paste, and low temp adhesive silver paste, as well as printing paste for laser etching and silver ink; chip trays, ABS reels, sputtering targets, and emboss spacers for the LCD industry; and LED tabs and lead frames for the LED industry. In addition, the company provides adhesives for temporary bonding, metal springs for VCM, CPD dryers, and Nano porous materials, substrate for stretchable and flexible modules, and wireless power charging coils. Further, it manufactures and sells touch Nano silver products. Niching Industrial Corporation was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Utechzone Co., Ltd.
summary: Utechzone Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells automatic optical inspection systems and equipment in Taiwan, China, Japan, and internationally. It offers printed circuit board inspection, flat panel display inspection, semiconductor inspection, and other inspection products, as well as IC Substrate and LCD; eye-tracking system; security system; and interactive media system. Utechzone Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: New Advanced Electronics Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: New Advanced Electronics Technologies Co., Ltd. specializes in the design, production, and distribution of a wide array of audio equipment and power solutions, serving markets in the United States, Japan, Canada, and Germany. The company's extensive product line encompasses various speaker types, including powered, bookshelf, surround sound, in-wall/in-ceiling, outdoor, and wireless models, as well as floor-standing units, center channel speakers, home theater systems, tweeters, transducers, amplifiers, crossovers, and LCR systems. Complementing these are their portable power supplies and chargers. Founded in 1993 under the name Samya Technology Co., Ltd., the organization rebranded to New Advanced Electronics Technologies Co., Ltd. in November 2018 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Skardin Industrial Corporation
summary: Skardin Industrial Corporation, a consumer electronics manufacturing company, manufactures, supplies, and exports set top box and broadband industry solutions in Taiwan and internationally. It offers STB platforms, smart home products, WIFI speakers, hybrid soundbase and sound bar audio systems, and software/middleware products. The company also provides electronics manufacturing services. Skardin Industrial Corporation was founded in 1982 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Forcera Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Forcera Materials Co. Ltd. specializes in delivering essential consumable components for the semiconductor and electronics industries. Utilizing its advanced technologies, the company provides comprehensive ceramic application solutions. Its core product lineup, crucial for semiconductor fabrication, features materials such as aluminum oxide, quartz, aluminum nitride, and silicon. The firm was founded on September 11, 1997, and maintains its headquarters in Hukou, Taiwan.

name: Avalue Technology Inc.
summary: Avalue Technology Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells embedded computing solutions in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers industrial and embedded motherboards; industrial PC/computers, such as embedded, transportation, rackmount, and ARM based systems; and panel PCs, including industrial, medical, and open frame panel PCs, as well as industrial touch monitors, audio and video extenders, peripherals and accessories, and panel and touch technologies. It also provides computer-on-module products for critical or industrial applications; point of sale (POS) terminals, which includes desktop and compact POS; medical tablets, and semi rugged tablet and accessories; device management software; E ink solutions, such as public display, healthcare IoT, and E ink technologies solutions; ODM services; and intelligent solutions. The company's products are used in healthcare, retail, gaming, manufacturing, and transportation applications. Avalue Technology Inc. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Forcecon Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Forcecon Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of thermal management products in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers DC axial and blower fans, thermal module active and passive products, vapor chambers, and heat pipes for use in computers, VGA, LED lightings, servers, automobiles, smart-phones, and bio-technology science fields. It serves ODM and OEM customers. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Solteam Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Solteam Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of modular parts and components for power tool, home appliance, automotive, medical, and IT industries worldwide. It offers switches, inlets/outlets, adapters, battery holders, controller modules, EV parts, surrounding/other products, aquarium peripherals, optical products, and medical devices. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Eclat Forever Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Eclat Forever Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and production of production equipment for touch panels, liquid crystal displays, plasma display panels, printed circuit boards, and other related equipment in Taiwan and internationally. It offers display production equipment, including touch panel solutions, cleaning equipment, development equipment, and etching and stripping equipment; automated logistics equipment consisting of substrate automated equipment and automated coating solutions; automated glass and film roll-to roll unwinding and rewinding equipment, as well as film-tearing laminating equipment; and exposure equipment, such as UV LED automatic and semi-automatic exposure machines. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Sun Brothers Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Sun Brothers Development Co., Ltd. engages in the development and sale of residences and buildings. It operates through the following business segments: Construction and Real Property Sales. The company was founded on June 8, 1991 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Single Well Industrial Corporation
summary: Single Well Industrial Corporation designs, produces, and sells molds and auto machines in Taiwan, Japan, and internationally. The company offers semi-conductor and LED molding, IC molding, deflashing, trimming, and forming dies, as well as parts of dies, including overhauling on molding dies. It also provides deflash/trim/singulator auto machines, test products, handlers, tapings, auto loaders, solder dippings, epoxy dispensing products, insert tubes, manu press, and parts. In addition, the company offers package molds, such as resistors/diodes and sim/flash drives; and automated machineries, including photo couplers, high powers, semiconductors, LEDs, and IRMs, as well as engages in solar energy business. It serves manufacturers of electronic parts and semi-conductors. Single Well Industrial Corporation was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Universal Microwave Technology, Inc.
summary: Universal Microwave Technology, Inc. designs, develops, and manufactures custom microwave/mm-wave devices, sub-systems, and antennas for broadband wireless communications. The company's products comprise diplexers, filters, couplers, OMT products, Eband/millimeter-wave products, distributed antenna systems, hanger clamp sets, Ku/Ka band OMT and filter assemblies, waveguide components, circulators/isolators, cable assemblies, flexible waveguides, antennas, die-casting and machined parts, and remote mount kits. Its products are used in point-to-point, cellular, VSAT, WiMAX, and LTE applications. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Keelung City, Taiwan.

name: Advanced Connection Technology Inc.
summary: Advanced Connection Technology Inc., established in 1983 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of a comprehensive range of connectivity solutions. Their product portfolio includes various connectors, such as USB Type-C, standard USB, HDMI, USCAR, and OBD interfaces. They also produce an extensive array of cables, comprising USB Type-C, USB, HDMI, USCAR, OBD, vehicle-specific, DIN, power, RCA, and coaxial types, alongside USB charging devices. Beyond these, the company supplies modules, antennas, waterproof components, LVDS solutions, printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA), and power chargers. Advanced Connection Technology Inc. serves a diverse clientele across demanding sectors, including the automotive, consumer electronics, medical, and aerospace industries.

name: Usun Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Usun Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the flat panel display, customization equipment, intelligent manufacturing system integration, and PCB/FPC industrial automation businesses in Taiwan. It provides dense unpackers; automated handling systems; tap cleaners; polarizers/E papers/OCA/LOCA laminators; PR/OC/PI slit coaters; and LCM+B/L module auto assembly lines. The company also offers mask production equipment, timber industry equipment, de-mura+gamma turing automatic detection equipment, laser scanning system, AVI materials loading and unloading machine, goods retrieval equipment, open cap and remove film machine, auto laminators, automatic sole edge grinding machines, lithium battery production equipment, and LENS mounts. In addition, it provides pallet based automatic storage systems, bin storage systems, warehousing management systems, and sorting systems; and PCB and CCL auto assembly systems, laminated steel auto cleaners, and CCL auto testing and cutting systems, as well as article holders. Usun Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: GlobalSat WorldCom Corporation
summary: GlobalSat WorldCom Corporation manufactures and sells GPS receivers and module makers worldwide. It offers sports and outdoor products, such as Bike Computer, GPS Watch, Heart Rate Monitor, Triathlon Watch, and Wrist Band GPS cycling; and tracking devices, including asset tracker, AVL tracker, personal tracker, animal tracker. The company also provides IoT/M2M products comprising LoRaWAN devices, NB-loT Sigfox, LoRa M.O.S.T; accessories, which include GPS modules, GPS engine boards, GPS data loggers, wireless locators, and GPS active antennas. In addition, it provides customization services of electronic designs, system integration, and software development to meet the project requirements.
