In addition, the company undertakes the Summit project, which consolidates outside procurement of diagnostic reagents at prices as before; and provides related with related logistics management services. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Shanghai, China.

name: Johnson Chemical Pharmaceutical Works Co., Ltd.
summary: Johnson Chemical Pharmaceutical Works Co., Ltd., established in 1959 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a Taiwanese company that engages in the manufacturing, importing, and distribution of pharmaceutical raw materials, active ingredients, and finished drug products. The company's diverse product portfolio addresses a wide spectrum of health conditions, encompassing areas such as the central nervous system, respiratory, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, and endocrine systems, alongside offerings for vitamin supplementation, anti-inflammatory needs, cough and cold remedies, and pain relief. These medicinal products are available in various forms, including traditional solid oral dosages like capsules, tablets, powders, and granules, as well as specialized delivery systems such as nasal sprays.

name: Advanced Echem Materials Company Limited
summary: Advanced Echem Materials Company Limited, based in Taoyuan, Taiwan, specializes in the development and production of advanced chemical materials for the semiconductor and display industries. Its comprehensive product portfolio caters to both sectors. For semiconductors, it supplies materials essential for IC manufacturing, advanced packaging, clean chemical processes, CMOS image sensors, fingerprint-on-display sensors, and chip-on-film technology. Additionally, it provides critical materials for various display technologies, including TFT LCD, OLED, and micro LED. The company was established in 2003.

name: INternational CArbide Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: INternational CArbide Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells firestop products in Taiwan. The company offers firestop system, such as fire barrier caulks, fire barrier silicone sealants, moldable firestop and firestop putty products, intumescent strips, fire barrier foams, firestop bricks, firestop sheets, mortar, fireproof blankets, and coated firestop boards/coatings. It also provides elastomeric fire caulks, putty pads, fireproof paints for wood, intumescent coating, high intumescent lamination, firestop tapes, smoke and acoustic sealants, and spray products, as well as fireproof protections for cable/electrical systems. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Ample Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ample Electronic Technology Co.,Ltd. produces and sells thick-film conductors in Taiwan. It offers pastes for terminal and internal electrodes of passive components, copper and silver paste products, and solar cells; and conductive silver pastes for touch panels, membrane switches, and LED and IC packages. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Pancolour Ink Co., Ltd.
summary: Pancolour Ink Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells UV curable inks, coatings, and adhesives in Taiwan. It offers UV curable printing inks for IC chips, optical discs, plastics, and paper products; UV curable adhesives for bonding needs of metal, glass, and other materials that are applied in handicraft and electronic industries; and UV curable coatings for use in plastic flexible tubes and paper spot varnish for screen print, etc. The company provides its products under the PANOVA, PANCURE, PANOLEN, and RADITHO names. Pancolour Ink Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Cherng Tay Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Cherng Tay Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells adhesives in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers hot melt adhesive products for packaging, bookbinding, assembly, and footwear applications; waterproofing materials, including waterproofing membranes and glues; and reactive hot melt adhesives. Cherng Tay Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Ingentec Corporation
summary: Ingentec Corporation manufactures and supplies fine chemicals and high pressure gas containers to semiconductor front end, semiconductor package, and flat panel display processes. The company offers laser gas; silicon wafer related products, such as quartz crucibles, and polished and reclaim wafers; and specialty gas and wet chemical related products, including PSA argon gas recovery and purification systems, specialty gas, and texturing chemical. It also offers special materials and tools comprising chillers, LED metal clad substrates, mass flow meters and controllers, pigment, sputtering target materials, and thermal spray coatings powder; and solar cell related products, such as platelet calcined alumina, laser machine for PERC and boron dope, SiC powder, slurry recycle systems, solar quartz crucibles, and tungsten seed cables. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Zhunan, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Speciality Chemicals Corporation
summary: Taiwan Speciality Chemicals Corporation is a Taiwanese enterprise dedicated to the production and supply of specialized electronic-grade gases and chemicals. Its product portfolio features key offerings such as disilane, trisilane, and a variety of related silicon compounds. The company, established in 2013, is headquartered in Changhua, Taiwan.

name: VHQ Media Holdings Ltd
summary: VHQ Media Holdings Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the multimedia innovation and creativity, post production, visual effects, and related services for TV advertising, TV drama, online drama, movies, and animation in Taiwan and internationally. The company operates in four segment: Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Beijing. It is involved in the content development and performance optimization business; provision of post production services for commercials and feature films; and multimedia shooting and planning for dramas and movies. VHQ Media Holdings Ltd was founded in 1987 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Da Lue International Holding Company Limited
summary: Da Lue International Holding Company Limited, an investment holding company, provides various wedding services in China. The company offers wedding planning, witnesses ceremony, and wedding dress rental services, as well as wedding photography and video, and other wedding-related services; and wedding banquet, and conference and exhibition services It is also involved in the rental and sale of clothing and flowers, operation of hotels, and real estate business. In addition, the company offers catering and catering management services; and technology development, technical consulting, and other services in the field of network technology. The company's brand portfolio includes Victoria Wedding Club, Coloration LISA Wedding Photography, Taiwan North Suoluo Wedding Photography, Jennifer Wedding Photography, Princess Wedding Photography, Pujue Hotel, and Vienna Hotel. Da Lue International Holding Company Limited was founded in 2011 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.

name: Kuei Tien Cultural & Creative Entertainment
summary: ShengHua Entertainment Communication co.,Ltd. engages in the television program production and screenwriting, film production and distribution, and art performing activities in Taiwan and China. It also provides drama series, as well as engages in the literary and artistic creation, corporate image planning, actor brokerage, and graphic system businesses. In addition, it is involved in the investment consulting, business management consulting, and business information consulting activities. The company was formerly known as Shenghua Entertainment Production Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ShengHua Entertainment Communication co.,Ltd. in June 2012. ShengHua Entertainment Communication co.,Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: United Fiber Optic Communication Inc.
summary: United Fiber Optic Communication Inc., along with its affiliated entities, operates as a global manufacturer and distributor of fiber-optic cables and associated transmission equipment. Its market presence extends across Taiwan, the United States, Japan, and various other international regions. The company's diverse product line features indoor and outdoor optical fiber cables, an array of accessories like patch cords, splitters, and termination panels and boxes, as well as communication systems designed for trains and traffic management. UFOC also supplies wireless technologies, including RFID products, fiber radio modules, wireless transmission devices, integrated personal locator beacons, and mobile rescue platforms. Furthermore, it offers specialized solutions for cable installation and a selection of lighting products. Beyond its hardware offerings, the company develops comprehensive solutions for smart transportation, intelligent building systems, streamlined logistics, cloud and sensing applications, and enterprise cloud storage. Its client base spans telecommunication operators and key sectors such as Mass Rapid Transit (MRT), highways, and subways. Founded in 1984, United Fiber Optic Communication Inc. maintains its primary headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Tainet Communication System Corp.
summary: Tainet Communication System Corp. provides carrier class access equipment to telecom carriers, service operators, and business users worldwide. The company offers Ethernet access devices, VoIP gateway products, xDSL and analog modems, PON, optical transceivers, and interface converters. It also provides copper over fiber connectivity, VoIP gateway communication, xDSL Ethernet, and TDM over IP communication solutions. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Fu Yu Property Co., Ltd.
summary: Fu Yu Property Co., Ltd., based in Taichung, Taiwan, primarily operates within the residential real estate sector, overseeing the development, leasing, and sale of properties throughout the country. Beyond its focus on homes, the company also constructs factories and manages diverse building projects, from their initial creation to subsequent leasing, contracting, and final sale. Established in 1977, the firm was formerly known as Spring Rain Development Co., Ltd. before officially changing its name to Fu Yu Property Co., Ltd. in September 2013.

name: APAC Opto Electronics Inc.
summary: Established in 1998 and headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, APAC Opto Electronics Inc. is a leading provider of fiber optic transmission solutions. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes a comprehensive range of components utilized across various network architectures, including local, wide, storage, metropolitan, and access networks, serving both Taiwanese and international markets. Its product offerings are diverse, encompassing optical and copper transceivers, specialized optical extenders for display port, DVI, and USB interfaces, as well as active optical and direct attach cables. APAC also supplies digital video transceivers, optical bypass modules, and a variety of specialized optical fiber cables like OSA/FTTX/TOSA/FP LD types. Beyond products, the company offers a unique TO-CAN OEM service, providing assembly and testing for TO-CAN packages, which includes die bond, wire bond, and cap sealing processes. Additionally, its portfolio extends to other critical optical communication components such as O/E transceivers, sub-modules, and Ethernet products. APAC primarily caters to communication equipment manufacturers that serve internet service providers and telecommunication operating companies.

name: New Era Electronics Co., Ltd
summary: New Era Electronics Co., Ltd, headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan since its establishment in 1984, is a global manufacturer and seller of various printed circuit board (PCB) solutions. The company produces specialized microwave RF PCBs, which are integral components for base station antennas, low noise block (LNB) converters, and other telecommunications equipment. They also offer robust heavy copper, metal core bonding, and copper coin insertion PCBs, essential for demanding applications such as workstation power supplies, base station transceivers, server components, remote radio heads, and small cell devices. Additionally, New Era Electronics supplies standard FR-4 PCBs for computer accessories and general communication and telecom systems. Their product range extends to mixed dielectric PCBs, which are utilized in advanced telecom equipment, power amplifiers, VSAT transceivers, and remote radio heads. Furthermore, the company develops RF automobile PCBs, crucial for modern vehicle safety and advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS), facilitating functions like blind spot detection, lane departure warning, emergency braking, and both forward and rear collision alerts.

name: G&E Herbal Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: G&E Herbal Biotechnology Co., Ltd., a biotechnology company, focuses on the development and commercialization of novel botanical extraction technology and products in Taiwan. It offers hepato protective agent capsules for the treatment of chronic liver inflammation, cirrhosis, hepatitis, and other liver diseases; botanical anti-aging cosmetic products; and SR-100 skin repair gel. The company also provides botanical healthcare products, such as Astragali Radix for physical strength; Goji for eyes; and Prosta capsule for regulating physiological functions and boosting metabolism, as well as offers adult products. In addition, it is developing Solarise injection for the treatment of gynecological, head, and neck cancer; Apocin capsule for the treatment of lung/breast cancer; and SR-T100 Gel. Further, the company manufactures technology development for various dietary supplements, as well as provides technical advisory services to other biotechnology organizations. G&E Herbal Biotechnology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Force MOS Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Force MOS Technology Co., LTD. engages in the design, development, and sale of MOSFETs and analog ICs in Taiwan. It offers bipolar transistors; diodes and rectifiers; and power management products for light electric vehicles technology and brushless DC motor control applications. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: HTM International Holding Ltd.
summary: HTM International Holding Ltd. engages in the production and sale of precision molds, computer notebook accessories, hi-fi systems accessories, office automation products, and home audio products and related parts. It offers PC components, including gas injection products; PC peripherals, such as portable hard disk covers and CD boxes; and speakers. The company also provides biomass energy products. It operates in Taiwan, Europe, the United States, Japan, and China. HTM International Holding Ltd. was founded in 1989 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: JMicron Technology Corp.
summary: JMicron Technology Corp. operates as an IC design company in Taiwan and internationally. The company designs high-speed data and signal interfaces, such as 3.1 5Gbps, USB 3.2 10Gbps and USB 3.2 20Gbps to connect them to SATA/PCIe/UFS; PCIe interface to SATA interface; and SATA 1.5Gbps/SATA 3Gbps/SATA 6Gbps, and SATA port multiplier/port selector, as well as bridge controllers for SATA to PATA interface. It also provides external data storage products, such as single bay controllers for USB 2.0/USB 3.0/USB 3.1/USB 3.2 host interfaces; dual-/multi-bay bridge controllers for external multiple-bay HDDs, RAID, and SATA port multipliers and port selectors; storage device controllers; and universal flash storage products. In addition, the company offers hard disk drive duplicators and surveillance storage systems, and NAS devices with RAID functionality. JMicron Technology Corp. is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: STL Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: STL Technology Co., Ltd. provides lithium-ion management solutions in Taiwan. It manufactures and sells lithium-ion battery modules for power tools, energy storage systems, and light electronic vehicles. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Ubright Optronics Corporation
summary: Ubright Optronics Corporation manufactures and sells optoelectronics LCD backlight module components for the display industry in Taiwan. It offers prism, multi function, and quantum dot films for backlight displays; polarizer protection and anti-glare films for LCD displays; 3D curve display protection films for OLED displays; anti-static protection, in process panel protection, hard coat, masking protection, and optical clear adhesive films for touch panels; anti-glare films for E paper products; and ceramic window films for windows. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan. Ubright Optronics Corporation is a subsidiary of Shinkong Synthetic Fibers Corporation.

name: Asia Electronic Material Co., Ltd.
summary: Asia Electronic Material Co., Ltd. (AEM) is a Taiwanese enterprise primarily focused on the research, creation, production, and distribution of critical components for flexible electronics. Their product range encompasses both adhesive and non-adhesive flexible copper clad laminates, along with coverlays, stiffeners, and bonding sheets. AEM also manufactures polyimide composite films. These specialized materials are extensively utilized across a broad spectrum of electronic devices, including mobile phones, smartphones, digital cameras, laptops, tablet PCs, LCD monitors, various flat panel displays, printer inkjet and hard drive heads, touch modules, antenna panels, batteries, and LED backlight module light bars. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Jhubei, Taiwan.

name: Crystalwise Technology Inc.
summary: Crystalwise Technology Inc. manufactures and sells hard substrates in Taiwan. The company offers CMOS, GaAs, and CZ wafers, as well as various types of substrates. Its products include sapphire substrate used for blue-light/green-light LED; substrates used for surface acoustic wave filter devices; sapphire cover glasses for smart phones and smart watches, as well as sapphire camera lens and sapphire finger sensor lens; sapphire function, power, volume, etc. keys for phone; sapphire window and heat spread substrates for LED products; and other type of substrate used in optronic and semiconductor industries. The company serves semiconductor, optoelectronics, optical fiber communications, wireless communications, and other industries. Crystalwise Technology Inc. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Miaoli, Taiwan.

name: Sentelic Corporation
summary: Sentelic Corporation operates as an IC design company in Taiwan, China, and Japan. The company offers mixed-signal, ASIC, firmware/software, and multi-media processing services; fan motor drive control IC's for servers, communication equipment, cloud data centers, and 5G base stations; and cooling fans for servers, telecommunication switching equipment, gaming graphics cards, and mining hardware. Sentelic Corporation was founded in 2000 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Cayenne Entertainment Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Cayenne Entertainment Technology Co., Ltd. provides various casual gaming services to online entertainment community in Taiwan. It also provides information software, data processing, and advertising services. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Golden Win International Corp.
summary: Golden Win International Corp., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells stainless steel kitchen utensils and refined cutlery sets in the United States, China, Taiwan, and internationally. It is also involved in OEM/ODM knife manufacturing businesses; and investment activities. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Feature Integration Technology Inc.
summary: Feature Integration Technology Inc. designs, markets, and commercializes ICs and controllers. It offers I/O controllers and I/F management products, such as eSPI/LPC/USB/PCIE I/F controllers; super hardware monitors + SIOs; hardware keyboard controllers; USB consumer IR receiver ICs for Windows Vista/Windows 7; power saving (EUP) SIOs and controllers; transceivers and buffers; SIOs with microcontrollers (uSIO); and bus controllers and transceivers. The company also provides environment sensors and glue logic ICs, including environment sensors and fan controllers, pure logic ICs, performance controllers, and real time clocks; power management and ACPI controllers, such as ACPI, switching, and multi-phase linear controllers; micro-processors; LED driver ICs; interface and connectivity products; and USB type-C and power delivery products, as well as USB fast charging products. It offers its IC products for various applications in personal computers, computer peripherals, digital consumer electronic products, and information appliance products. The company sells its products through professional IC distributors. Feature Integration Technology Inc. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: WITS Corp.
summary: WITS Corp. specializes in providing a comprehensive range of information technology (IT) services, including system implementation, expert consulting, and various outsourcing solutions. The company also assists clients with product globalization, ensuring their offerings are adapted for international markets. Beyond these core areas, WITS Corp. is actively involved in research and development, rigorous testing, and the ongoing operation and maintenance of IT systems. They further extend their services to include specialized business process outsourcing (BPO) and localization. The firm was established on June 1, 1992, and its main office is located in New Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Parade Technologies, Ltd.
summary: Parade Technologies, Ltd., a fabless semiconductor company, designs, develops, and sells high-speed interface standards, and touch controller and display processing integrated circuit (IC) chips for products used in computers, consumer electronics, and display panels. The company offers display port LCD timing controllers, embedded display port timing controllers, display port format converters, display port transmitters and receivers, and scalers with display port and high definition multimedia interface (HDMI) inputs; high-speed interface solutions; display port based solutions; display port repeater and switch products, including serial advanced technology architecture, PCI express, HDMI/DVI, and universal serial bus products; source drivers; and truetouch controllers, and touch and display driver integrations, as well as mixed-signal ICs. It operates in South Korea, China, Taiwan, Japan, and internationally. Parade Technologies, Ltd. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands.

name: IntelliEPI Inc. (Cayman)
summary: IntelliEPI Inc. (Cayman) manufactures and sells epitaxy-based compound semiconductor epitaxy wafers to the electronics and optoelectronics industries worldwide. The company utilizes its proprietary real time in situ growth monitoring technology on molecular beam epitaxy (MBE) systems for the manufacturing of epi-wafers on gallium arsenide (GaAs) and indium phosphide (InP) substrates. Its GaAs based products include pseudo-morpic high electron mobility transistors and MHEMT products; and InP based products comprise hetero-junction bi-polar transistors, HEMT, RTT, and RTD. The company also provides Sb based products, such as type II SLS photodetectors, GaAsSb-base InP HBT, and epi-ready GaSb substrates; and mismatched Epi products comprising III-V on Si, III-V on Ge, and high in content InGaAs on Si. In addition, it offers opto-electronics, including avalanche photo diodes, lasers, high-speed high-frequency surface-emitting lasers, optical receivers, quantum well infrared photodetectors, modulators, and quantum cascade lasers, as well as infrared light detectors. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Tons Lightology Inc.
summary: Tons Lightology Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs and manufactures commercial lighting products in Taiwan, rest of Asia, Europe, Oceania, and internationally. The company offers light-emitting diode, high-intensity discharge, fluorescent, and halogen lighting products. Its indoor lighting products include tracks and structures, luminaires for tracks, recessed downlights, frameless and adjustable downlights, assemblies, surface-mounted ceiling lights, pendant lights, wall lights, display spotlights, linear lights, task lights, and micro track lights. The company's outdoor lighting products comprise outdoor downlights, outdoor ceiling lights, outdoor wall lights, in-ground lights, projectors, flood lights, bollards, and outdoor accessories. Its products are used for architectural, retail display, residential, entertainment, outdoor area and commercial/industrial lighting applications. Tons Lightology Inc. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Silicon Power Computer & Communications Inc.
summary: Silicon Power Computer & Communications Inc., founded in 1992 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, functions as a global producer and distributor of diverse memory and storage solutions. The company's extensive product portfolio includes consumer electronics such as flash memory cards, USB flash drives, portable hard drives, solid-state drives (SSDs), DRAM modules, and various external storage devices, power banks, and accessories. Beyond its standard offerings, Silicon Power also provides tailored services and a dedicated selection of industrial-grade products, including specialized SSDs, flash cards, DRAM modules, and USB drives. These advanced components are utilized across a multitude of industries, including healthcare, casino gaming, transportation, automation, cloud computing and networking, smart retail, surveillance (NVR), and embedded systems.

name: Asia Tech Image Inc.
summary: Asia Tech Image Inc., established in 2004 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a company that produces and markets contact image sensor (CIS) modules. These modules are specifically designed for use in multi-functional business equipment. The firm conducts its business activities across both Taiwan and China.

name: LuxNet Corporation
summary: LuxNet Corporation designs, develops, and manufactures optical semiconductor devices and packaged optical components in Taiwan. The company provides laser and photo diode chips, transmitters, receivers, and optical sub-assemblies. Its products are used in high speed voice video and data communications for networking, storage, and cable TV, as well as optical communication applications. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Jorjin Technologies Inc.
summary: Jorjin Technologies Inc. provides modular processing, sensing, and wireless connectivity solutions worldwide. It also offers wireless system in package, application processor, imaging, and audio visual modules, as well as modules for the Internet of things; and driver software, as well as design-in support services. In addition, the company distributes a range of components, such as barcode scanning modules, filters, TCXOs, chip antennas, and EMI shielding components, as well as 2, 3, and 4G modems. It serves wearable consumer electronics, automotive infotainment, cloud connected devices, and industrial mobile computing markets. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Godex International Co., Ltd
summary: Godex International Co., Ltd, an engineering company, designs, manufactures, and sells barcode printing products worldwide. The company offers desktop, industrial, and mobile printers; scanners; label stands; and wax, wax/resin, resin, and near edge ribbons. It also provides label design and printing software under the GoRibbon, GoLabel, GoLabel PDF, and QLabel, GoAPP, and GoUtility names. The company's products are used in healthcare, retail, logistics and transportation, manufacturing, government, travel and leisure, and special material applications. It distributes its products through a network of value add resellers. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: GCS Holdings, Inc.
summary: GCS Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures compound semiconductor wafer and foundry related services in China, the United States, Taiwan, and internationally. It also manufactures and sells optoelectronics technology products and optical chips, as well as grants royalty rights for intellectual property. In addition, the company develops, manufactures, and sells mobile phone radio frequency, filter, optical communication chip, power management, and optical fiber products, as well as positive, intrinsic, negative components, and avalanche photo diodes for telecommunication systems and data communication networks; and engages in manufacturing, retailing, and wholesaling telecommunication devices and electronic components. Further, it provides product design, outsourcing management, and research development services. The company serves wireless devices and fiber-optic communication providers. GCS Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1997 and is based in George Town, the Cayman Islands.

name: Litemax Electronics Inc.
summary: Litemax Electronics Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of LCD panels and monitors in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers industrial computing products, such as embedded box, rugged panel, modular panel transportation PCs, as well as boards and modules; industrial displays, including Spanpixel resizing and square LCDs, Durapixel sunlight readable LCDs, and Navpixel marine displays, as well as custom LCD displays; accessories comprising AD, power, HDMI daisy chain, intelligent thermal control, expansion, and AMIO boards; and AIoT solutions, such as smart display and kiosk module, and AI edge computing products. It serves the transportation, digital signage, industrial, point of sale/kiosk, rugged portable, gaming, marine, and healthcare industries. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Gloria Material Technology Corp.
summary: Gloria Material Technology Corp. manufactures and sells alloy steel and valve-parts in Taiwan and internationally. The company's products include super and titanium alloys; and high cleaning steel, alloy tool steel, high speed steel, stainless steel, quenched-tempered steel, and mold material supply products. It also provides machined parts, such as actuators, blocks, boss products, load caps, and actuator blanks; compressor spacers, seals for gas turbine, turbine blades, and transmission shafts; and copper rod rollers, dummy bar heads, guide rolls, sendzimir rolls, and rolls for slab continuous cast. In addition, the company offers air compressor rotors, bolts, couplings, cryogenic BV shafts, HPBV shafts, locking pins, parts for vacuum equipment, pump shafts, pipe fittings, plugs, turbo charger parts, wheel rings, stems, and taper pins. It serves aerospace, energy, oil and gas, water, medical, and machinery and mold industries. Gloria Material Technology Corp. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: OFCO Industrial Corporation
summary: OFCO Industrial Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of fastener products in Taiwan. Its products include screws, nuts, bolts, and structural assemblies. The company was formerly known as Oriental Fastener Industry LTD. and changed its name to OFCO Industrial Corporation in 2004. OFCO Industrial Corporation was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: New Best Wire Industrial Co.,Ltd
summary: Established in 1993, New Best Wire Industrial Co.,Ltd operates from its headquarters in Tainan City, Taiwan, offering both wire products and electro-polishing services throughout the country. The company's diverse product portfolio encompasses a variety of wires, including carbon, stainless steel, and alloy steel types. Furthermore, they supply a comprehensive range of screws, such as drywall, chipboard/wood, self-drilling, self-tapping, set, and custom-engineered options. Their offerings also extend to essential fasteners like bolts, nuts, and washers, along with industrial components such as pipes, tubes, fittings, multi-tees, clean tanks, and chambers.

name: Chain Chon Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Chain Chon Industrial Co., Ltd., based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, operates as a prominent manufacturer and global supplier of stainless steel products. The company handles the processing and commercialization of a wide array of stainless steel forms, including hot and cold rolled coils, sheets, plates, and strips. Their offerings extend to specialized items such as patterned plates, structural elements like angle and flat bars, and welded H-beams, alongside polished finishes for coils and sheets, and other metallic materials. These versatile stainless steel products are deployed in a vast spectrum of applications. They are essential for industrial uses such as chemical storage tanks, piping systems, industrial plant components, machinery parts, and laboratory equipment. In the construction sector, they contribute to building structures, infrastructure projects, escalators, diverse flooring solutions (including non-slip and engineering stairs), and decorative elements like reflection mirrors. Furthermore, their materials are integral to manufacturing medical equipment, aviation components, various kitchenware, food processing apparatus, and automotive hardware. The firm was established in 1980.

name: Rodex Fasteners Corp.
summary: Rodex Fasteners Corp. manufactures and sells stainless steel wires and precision made screws worldwide. The company offers stainless steel wires, tapping screws, chipboard screws, machine screws, self-drilling screws, socket cap screws, socket set screws, stainless steel blind rivets, stainless steel thread cutting screws, triangular thread screws, wood screws, high-low thread screws, coarse thread screws, drywall screws, security screws, washer assembly of sems, screws for automatic line, electronic screws, JIS screws, special screws, hexagon nuts, and hexagon nylon lock nuts. Rodex Fasteners Corp. was founded in 1984 and is based in Chungli, Taiwan.

name: Song Ho Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Song Ho Industrial Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells various steel products in Taiwan, Japan, Thailand, Mainland China, Vietnam, and internationally. The company offers hard drawn steel, roping, spring, spoke, flat, annealed steel, and galvanized steel wires; and cross lay ropes, fiber core and independent wire rope core (IWRC) parallel lay ropes, elevator wire ropes, IWRC 8 standard elevator wire ropes, profile wire ropes, non-rotation ropes, strands impacted wire ropes, and galvanized steel wire strands, as well as wire ropes for suspension bridges. It also provides cold drawn steel bars, such as low and medium carbon, free cutting, alloy, and stainless-steel bars; spheroidized wires, including alloy steel, nipple, bearing, low carbon steel, middle-high carbon steel, and cold heading wires; and water-control gate machinery. The company was founded in 1972 and is based in Nantou City, Taiwan.

name: Fu Chian Tire Co.,Ltd.
summary: Fu Chian Tire Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells retread tires in Taiwan. The company also offers high and low temperature tread rubber products, gums, backing products, rubber flooring products, silicone products, rubber compounds, and other rubber products. It is also involved in the provision of rubber manufacturing machines, as well as in the import and export activities. Fu Chian Tire Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is based in Yuanlin City, Taiwan.

name: K WAY Information Corporation
summary: K WAY Information Corporation specializes in delivering software solutions tailored for Taiwan's financial and securities industries. Its comprehensive offerings for capital markets encompass a variety of systems, including those for trading, settlement and clearing management, order handling, gateway connectivity, and both online and mobile trading platforms, as well as quote service provisions. Expanding its services to the banking sector, the company provides a robust loan collection management system that efficiently manages overdue receivables across diverse categories such as regular loans, credit and cash card balances, restructured loans, and outsourced collection processes. Additionally, K WAY offers MultiCharts, a powerful analytical software suite for traders, and the nStock APP, which supplies extensive fundamental data for Taiwanese equities. The company was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: NewSoft Technology Corporation
summary: NewSoft Technology Corporation provides personal, enterprise Web, and digital signage solutions worldwide. The company offers personal solutions, including digital document, digital recognition, digital images, and mobile application solutions; and enterprise Web solutions, such as customer and salary management, electronic authorization, project management, attendance, resource management, performance management, document management, and digital signage systems. It also provides custom development services, which include optical character recognition software development kits (OCR SDK); identity card recognition software development kits (IDR SDK); driver and network, and document imaging cloud applications; mobile and cloud application customization; and digital image editing and management services. The company sells its products through store outlets, online channels, hardware distributors, and enterprise and government contact windows. NewSoft Technology Corporation was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Green Environment Technology Inc.
summary: Taiwan Green Environment Technology Inc. specializes in the management of water resources and the processing of waste materials. The company offers a complete range of services for purified water treatment projects, encompassing initial planning, design, construction, installation, ongoing maintenance, and operational management. Furthermore, it supplies essential equipment and chemical products required for these systems. In the waste sector, the company delivers comprehensive treatment and recycling solutions, which include project conceptualization, facility development, and the distribution of relevant processing equipment. It also undertakes the construction of biomass power generation systems. Beyond its core environmental endeavors, Taiwan Green Environment Technology Inc. diversifies its operations into the electronic components business and the distribution of everyday consumer goods. Its product offerings additionally feature continuous water supply construction and operational systems, specialized screening buckets, and stainless steel corrugated tubing. Established in 1989, the company maintains its headquarters in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Kunyue Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Kunyue Development Co., Ltd. provides real estate development and maintenance services. The company is involved in the land development, building construction, residential development, home sales, and customer service activities. It also offers structural, hydropower, waterproof, and intimate engineering services. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: CTCI Advanced Systems Inc.
summary: CTCI Advanced Systems Inc. provides system integration services to the hydrocarbon, power, industry, transportation, and high technology markets in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides main automation contractor services in the areas of project planning, design, procurement, installation, test, commissioning, start up, and running or turnkey projects. It also offers railway electrical and mechanical (E&M) solutions, such as signaling, telecommunications, SCADA, and related information system solutions; airport and satellite E&M services for airport terminal, airfield runway, and satellite industries; and hi-tech plant E&M services for wafer, electro-optical, display glass, or bio-tech plants. In addition, the company provides process simulation and IT systems, including process optimization, energy saving and waste reduction, facility reliability, and plant safety and emergency planning products and services, as well as distributes and maintains SmartPlant P&ID intelligent solutions, plant EPC projects engineering information management solutions, and visualize plant's engineering information management solutions. Further, it offers smart water network platform integrated with GIS to manage and monitor water network; cyber security software for detecting the abnormal signs caused by equipment malfunction, operational mistake, and cyber-attack; construction safety management platform; and rotary machine predictive maintenance platform to collect sound and vibration data of rotary machines, and build baseline models to analyze machine condition. Additionally, the company distributes NovaTech D/3 DCS and batch control management systems; Intergraph Process, Power & Marine - PP&M products and solutions; AspenTech process optimization software; and Mr. Energy 50001, an energy information management system platform. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Apex International Financial Engineering Res. & Tech. Co., Ltd
summary: Founded in 1988 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Apex International Financial Engineering Res. & Tech. Co., Ltd delivers specialized financial information services, primarily catering to clients in Taiwan and China. The company provides a comprehensive suite of financial engineering solutions, including tools for managing financial assets, overseeing investment transactions, and mitigating financial risks. Its offerings extend to intelligent investment solutions, such as real-time stock market systems, alongside various technological applications like VR/AR/MR simulation platforms, smart energy conservation systems, and videoconferencing solutions. Apex International is also a key developer of FinTech software and project services for both financial and academic institutions. This includes a variety of Robo-Advisor services, complemented by educational initiatives and platforms like its digital finance school, smart cloud finance platforms, and applications utilizing Blockchain and Big Data analysis. Furthermore, the company supplies advanced derivatives systems to the local financial sector and provides integrated financial trading systems designed to assist securities firms and bill-finance corporations in obtaining new licenses for diverse products such as warrants, IRS, FRA, IPO, swaptions, PGN, and ELN.

name: Penpower Technology LTD.
summary: Penpower Technology LTD., engages in research and development of devices with built-in intelligent human-machine interface technologies in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides handheld pen scanners and translators, pen scanners and translators for computers, and multilingual dictionary pens; wireless writing pads; embedded memory and digital memo writing pads; touch screen stylus; and business card management, voice, graphic design, and document management solutions. It also offers electronic signature solutions, as well as software services. Penpower Technology LTD. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Hyweb Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hyweb Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of electronic government, book education, and electronic payment related software technology in China and internationally. Its products include HyCMS, a website management platform; Greeting, a paperless conference system; HyEIP, an administrative information portal; HyCase, an application review process engine; and eServices, a customer service system. The company's products also comprise HyRead, an e-book solution and mobile library-reading display machine; HyLib, a library automation system; Jumper, a library resource exploration service system; and SpaceMe, a space management solution. In addition, its products consist of HyLoyal, a bonus points management system; HyPro, a credit card/debit card system; and HyPstar, a card data preparation system. Further, the company offers UHF RFID chip tags, security detection doors, self-checking machines, automatic book borrowing and returning station systems, librarian work systems, and book searching/counting machines; and various consumer finance, retail banking, and payment solutions. Hyweb Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: YeaShin International Development Co., Ltd.
summary: YeaShin International Development Co., Ltd. engages in the business of residential and building development in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Higgstec Inc.
summary: Higgstec Inc. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, sale, and service of various touch solutions. The company offers standard and custom 5-wire resistive, and projected capacitive touch solutions, as well as PCAP touch controllers, and 5-wire resistive touch controllers and panels. Its products and solutions are used in various fields, including aviation, marine, education, medical, military, gaming arcade, IPC, vehicle, POS, ATM, cash register, house appliances, office automation, smart home appliances, security monitoring systems, etc. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Transcom, Inc.
summary: Transcom, Inc. operates as a microwave device and subsystem company in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers wideband and narrowband solid-state power amplifiers; MIC and transceiver modules; FET chips; packaged FETs; monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMIC); hybrid ICs; directional couplers; power dividers; fixed attenuators and termination; and MIS chip capacitors. It also provides MMIC foundry services. Transcom, Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Anli International Co., Ltd.
summary: Anli International Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the development, production, assembly, and sale of various precision metal stamping and magnesium aluminum die casting in China and Taiwan. The company is also involved in the design, research, and development of electronic components, vehicle components, new metal materials, machine parts, communication equipment, and computer software; manufacture of fine blanking die products; inductance components; metal finishing activities; and installation of automated equipment, as well as in CNC processing business.It also provides automotive products, optical communication products, vision system application products, household products, and other products. The company's stamped and cast metallic parts and components are used in notebook PCs, tablet PCs, desktop PCs, cell phones, wearable devices, internet communications, home appliances, and daily items. It primarily serves the computers, communications, and consumer electronics industries. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.

name: Advanced Lithium Electrochemistry (Cayman) Co., Ltd.
summary: Advanced Lithium Electrochemistry (Cayman) Co., Ltd. researches, manufactures, and sells lithium iron phosphate Nano co-crystalline olivine materials (LFP-NCO) in China, other Asia countries, Italy, Taiwan, and internationally. The company also offers olivine-type structure lithium battery materials; and manufactures and distributes batteries, and cars and its peripherals. In addition, it manufactures and installs electricity generation, transmission, and distribution machinery. Advanced Lithium Electrochemistry (Cayman) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Max Echo Technology Corp.
summary: Max Echo Technology Corp., a Taiwan-based enterprise, specializes in the production and distribution of electronic components, primarily focusing on miniature inductors. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses various inductor types, including high-frequency ceramic chip, wire-wound ceramic chip, multilayer ferrite power chip, and standard multilayer ferrite chip inductors. The company also provides an array of ferrite chip beads, such as multilayer and high-frequency variants. Additional offerings include wire-wound common mode filters, adaptable sintered ferrite sheets, and coils designed for wireless charging applications. These sophisticated components are integral to a wide range of industries, finding application in telecommunications, automotive systems, industrial equipment, energy management solutions, consumer electronics, and medical devices. Established in 1992, Max Echo Technology Corp. maintains its corporate headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Ledlink Optics, Inc.
summary: Ledlink Optics, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells optics for lighting companies and other LED manufacturers in Taiwan and internationally. The company's products include multi-lens modules, single street lenses, multi street lenses, silicone lenses, wall washer lighting lenses, color mixing lenses, waterproof lenses, elliptical beam lenses, narrow beam lenses, high-bay lighting lenses, automotive optics, V-cut lenses, ultra-thin hybrid lenses, hybrid lenses, fresnel lenses, reflectors, stage lighting lenses, and indoor lighting lenses. Its products are used in residential, commercial, street, and architectural lighting applications. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Amita Technologies Inc.
summary: Amita Technologies Inc. manufactures and sells lithium-ion polymer batteries in Taiwan. The company offers cells, soft packs, hard packs, energy storage systems, E bank products, camcorder series products, and accessories. Its batteries are used in data center UPS units, power banks, power tools, battery-powered vehicles, and energy storage systems for household appliances, commercial or industrial facilities, and smart grid. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan. Amita Technologies Inc. is a subsidiary of Energy Absolute Public Company Limited.

name: Sunplus Innovation Technology Inc.
summary: Sunplus Innovation Technology Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and markets microcontrollers and system-on-chips with embedded software solutions in Taiwan. It offers wired optical mice, wireless desktops, and MCU for HID and toy devices; and Web, NB, and IOT camera controllers. The company's products are used in human interface devices, PC external HDD/ODD drives, and PC/NB camera and industry control market segments. It also provides image data services for AI datasets, including data collection, labeling and tagging, verification, model training, 2D bounding box, line and polygonal annotation, semantic segmentation, landmark/key point annotation, other annotation services, product features tagging, queue monitoring, data transcription, emotion analysis, feedback entry, data entry-data capture, de-identification service, training, and system integration. The company is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan. Sunplus Innovation Technology Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Sunplus Technology Company Limited.

name: ACTi Corporation
summary: ACTi Corporation operates as a global provider of advanced video surveillance solutions. The company offers an extensive range of cameras, including traditional analog models, high-resolution and high-frame-rate units, versatile pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) and panoramic cameras, and specialized options such as AI-powered and covert cameras, alongside those designed to meet specific certifications. They also supply various camera selection tools and intelligent analytics cameras for applications like people counting, face analysis, and automatic license plate recognition (ALPR). Beyond their camera offerings, ACTi delivers comprehensive video management solutions. This includes standalone Network Video Recorders (NVRs), sophisticated software platforms, and central management systems. The company provides video encoders and decoders, complemented by robust system health management tools that monitor the operational status of cameras, NVRs, and other critical infrastructure components. Additionally, they supply digital signage devices capable of decoding and displaying video streams from their surveillance hardware. To support these systems, ACTi offers a full suite of accessories. This encompasses diverse mounting hardware like camera mounts, housings, and dome covers; network and storage peripherals, such as extended storage devices, Power over Ethernet (PoE) data switches, and hard drives; power supply accessories, including PoE injectors and power adapters; and other essential items like camera installation kits and controllers. Their products cater to a broad spectrum of markets, including banking, education, commercial buildings, manufacturing, municipal and government sectors, healthcare, hotels and casinos, parking facilities, residential areas, restaurants, retail, stadiums, transportation, and utilities. Established in 1992, ACTi Corporation is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Brightek Optoelectronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Brightek Optoelectronic Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells semiconductor package solutions. The company offers automotive application products, such as signal and lighting, and electronics; lighting products; and solutions for security monitoring and disinfection systems. The company was formerly known as Taiwan Brightek Optoelectronic Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Brightek Optoelectronic Co., Ltd. in 2009. Brightek Optoelectronic Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: WiseChip Semiconductor Inc.
summary: WiseChip Semiconductor Inc. researches, designs, develops, manufactures, and markets organic light emitting diodes (OLEDs) in Taiwan. Its principal products include OLED displays, full color displays, and monochrome displays; and bendable OLEDs, transparent OLEDs, matrix OLEDs, etc. used in consumer, PC peripheral, industrial, medical, automotive, and communication applications. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Chu-Nan, Taiwan.

name: ProbeLeader Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2002, ProbeLeader Co., Ltd. is dedicated to engineering and manufacturing sophisticated testing solutions for a variety of high-tech industries. These include the semiconductor, LCD panel, optoelectronics, and passive components sectors. The company's extensive product offerings encompass essential components like probe cards, load boards, and test sockets, alongside a selection of specialized equipment and tools. ProbeLeader maintains its corporate headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Pixon Technologies Corporation
summary: Pixon Technologies Corporation manufactures and sells imaging and optical components for makers in communications, computers, and consumer electronics field in the United States, Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. The company develops optical, electronic circuit design and application software programming of linear micro lens array, linear light source, light pipe, and contact image sensor modules (CISM) products. It offers linear light guide, CIS modules, linear micro lens array, COB chip on board, and 3-in-1 modules. The company's products application includes document scanning and printing, fax, photocopiers, MFP multifunction printers, banknote counterfeit machines, lottery, electronic whiteboard, large format textile and paper printing and scanning, and other visual inspection. Pixon Technologies Corporation was founded in 1999 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: JSW Pacific Corporation
summary: JSW Pacific Corporation manufactures and sells wireless connectivity products in Taiwan. The company offers IP cameras, video doorbells, security lighting cameras, security home control products, and smart locks. It also provides hardware and software development services. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Cen Link Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwanese enterprise Cen Link Co., Ltd. is engaged in the production and sale of electronic connectors. The company offers a wide spectrum of connector types, including those for batteries (such as battery holders and spring pins), pogo pins, machine pins, and both pin and female headers. Their product range further extends to various data and power interfaces like USB 2.0, mini and micro-USB, SATA, audio jacks, and DC power jacks. Other specialized connectors available include PAD, RJ jacks, card reader connectors, and box headers. Moreover, Cen Link provides custom-designed connectors tailored to specific client requirements. These vital components are integrated into a broad array of electronic applications, such as set-top boxes, LCD displays, mobile phones, digital video/still cameras (DV/DSC), and laptop computers. Established in 1981, Cen Link Co., Ltd. has its main office situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Gigastone Corporation
summary: Gigastone Corporation manufactures and sells memory modules and consumer electronics products in Taiwan. It offers microSD and SD cards; USB drives; monitor, gaming keyboard and mouse, DRAM, SSD, and type-c hubs; and mobile accessories, including wall and car chargers, cables, power banks, wireless pads, Bluetooth earphones, and microphones. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Brogent Technologies Inc.
summary: Brogent Technologies Inc., a technology company, provides digital content creation services in Taiwan. Its business primarily includes software and hardware research and development, manufacturing and system integration, theater design, and planning, and construction capabilities. The company's products include i-Ride, a flying theater built on six degrees of freedom motion platform; m-Ride, a flying theater built on the design of 180-degree rotating gondolas; d-Ride, a media based interactive dark ride solution for gaming; and GestureMagic that offers effect-driven 4D experience in gaming. It also provides v-Ride 360, a cylinder screen that provides 360-degree panorama balloon ride; t-Ride, a Jurassic age ride; and Q-Ride, an ultrarealistic ocean VR adventure. Brogent Technologies Inc. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Lung Pien Vacuum Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1991 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, Lung Pien Vacuum Industry Co., Ltd. is a prominent global manufacturer and distributor of advanced optical vacuum coating equipment. The company engineers specialized machinery for various applications, including the deposition of metal, plastic, and glass coatings, particularly for eyewear such as sunglasses. Beyond its core optical vacuum coaters, its product portfolio extends to sophisticated in-line sputtering coating systems, cutting-edge plasma technology, and the supply of Olympus optical measurement devices. Lung Pien also provides extensive customer support, offering complete turn-key system implementations, expert technical assistance, and acting as a key supplier for components and instruments essential to vacuum coating operations. These high-performance coating solutions serve a broad range of industries, from producing decorative finishes and enhancing sunglasses and goggles to fabricating lights, mirrors, and other specialized optical components for the wider optical sector.

name: Horng Tong Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Horng Tong Enterprise Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, design, manufacture, and sale of electronic connectors in Taiwan. The company offers connectors for mother boards, notebooks, and networks/antennas/RJs; AMOLED materials, sublimation machines, and cameras; and car electronics, including DVRs and AVMs, car chargers, wireless chargers, AVN and ADAS products, dash cam-mirrors, head-up displays, portable car chargers, ATL system products, and 8 in 1 control boxes. It also provides Internet of Things products, such as police devices and equipment, modems, wireless modules, emergency phones, smart crutches, and LTE Mifi products; and communication products. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: AMICCOM Electronics Corporation
summary: AMICCOM Electronics Corporation, a semiconductor company, provides RF ICs in Taiwan. The company offers 2.4 GHz, sub 1GHz, and 5.8/5.2 GHz short range devices, as well as wireless audio, Bluetooth LE/Zigbee, and satellite/LNB/DBS products. Its products are used in thermometer and voice remote control applications. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: ASPEED Technology Inc.
summary: ASPEED Technology Inc. operates as a fabless integrated circuit design company in Taiwan, China, the United States, and internationally. It offers server management product lines; PC and AV extensions; desktop virtualization infrastructures; and Cupola360, a spherical image processor for 360-degree/180-degree cameras. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Da Hui Limited
summary: Da Hui Limited functions as an investment holding company, with its core business revolving around the manufacturing and global distribution of motorcycle parts and child safety seats. The company maintains a notable market presence in the United States, Malaysia, and various other international regions. Among its specific product lines are motorcycle lighting solutions. Established in 1994, Da Hui Limited's corporate headquarters are situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: ProLight Opto Technology Corporation
summary: ProLight Opto Technology Corporation engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of LED packaging products in Taiwan. The company offers LED products for use in entertainment, architecture, general, automotive, UV, IR, and plant growing lighting applications. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Sunfun Info Co., Ltd.
summary: Sunfun Info Co., Ltd. operates online dating and social networking services in Taiwan, the United States, Mexico, India, and the Southeast Asia. The company offers iPair, weTouch, and SweetRing websites that are dating applications; information software services; and other online platform services. It also engages in the biotechnology and healthcare business. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: StrongLED Lighting Systems (Cayman) Co., Ltd.
summary: StrongLED Lighting Systems (Cayman) Co., Ltd., an investment holding, researches, develops, manufactures, and sells LED lighting equipment in China. The company offers outdoor LED lighting products, including LED flood lights, linear lights, dot pixel lights, and in-ground/underwater lights; and indoor LED lighting products, such as LED wall washers, wall grazers, linear lights, flexible strips, downlights, dot pixel lights, and module lights, as well as smart lighting products, panel lights, and pendant lights. It also provides LED lighting control systems and software; intelligent lighting controllers, touch control panels, and LED lighting circuit expanders; and LED power supplies for indoor and outdoor lighting systems. StrongLED Lighting Systems (Cayman) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.

name: ADDCN Technology Co., Ltd
summary: ADDCN Technology Co., Ltd operates online trading platforms in Taiwan and internationally. It operates 8591.com.tw, which offers a virtual treasure trading platform; 591.com.tw and 591.com.hk, a real estate information network platforms; 8891.com.tw, a second-hand car trading platform; and 518.com.tw, a job search and recruitment platform. The company also operates 100.com.tw that offers design case pictures of interior design companies; marry.com.tw, a wedding service platform for wedding-related services, such as wedding photography, records, and bride secretaries; chickpt.com.tw, a part-time job finding APP; and tasker.com.tw for home task function that includes water, electricity, maintenance, and cleaning activities. ADDCN Technology Co., Ltd was incorporated in 1997 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Innodisk Corporation
summary: Innodisk Corporation provides industrial embedded flash and DRAM storage products and technologies in Taiwan. The company offers flash storage products, such as solid state drives (SSDs); SATA Slim for hand-held devices, thin clients, and industrial applications; ServerDOM for server use; CFast, a small form factor for industrial and embedded applications; and mSATA, a compliant module for space-constricted applications. Its flash storage products also include Mini PCIeDOM for server boot applications; M.2 for ultra-thin or compact systems; SATADOM compact form factor suitable for 1U server applications; nanoSSDs; compact flash cards; embedded disk cards; SD and MicroSD cards; USB and EDC; and server boot cards. The company also provides embedded DRAM modules; server memory modules; wide temperature DRAM modules; and special customized DRAM modules. In addition, it offers embedded peripherals comprising AI accelerator cards, storage expansion cards, disk arrays, display cards, and communication modules, as well as flash storage products with various interfaces and form factors. The company's products are used in the aerospace and defense embedded systems, server applications, casino gaming, and in-vehicles, as well as automation, surveillance, networking, healthcare, and retail markets. Innodisk Corporation was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: EISO Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: EISO Enterprise Co., Ltd. develops and sells PCB products. Its products are used in industrial computers, Internet communication products, cars, computer equipment, electron products, power boards, and others. The company also provides LED products for use in professional cycles; and renewable energy products. EISO Enterprise Co., Ltd. was founded in 1994 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Desiccant Technology Corporation
summary: Desiccant Technology Corporation, through its subsidiary, Shanghai Huajing Environmental Protection and Energy Saving Equipment Limited Company, produces and sells air purification and treatment equipment, plastic processing peripherals equipment, energy-saving equipment, and spare parts. The company was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Zhongli, Taiwan.

name: 3s Silicon Tech., Inc.
summary: 3s Silicon Tech., Inc., established in 1998 and headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, specializes in providing die bonding solutions for discrete power devices to customers both locally and globally. Their comprehensive product line includes advanced clip die bonders for power devices, which incorporate functionalities such as clip attachment and precise pick-and-place capabilities. The company also offers a diverse range of snap ovens, encompassing standard models, units with vacuum reflow processes, formic acid reflow ovens, and flux eutectic reflow ovens, alongside complete power module assembly automation solutions. Additionally, 3s Silicon Tech. engineers custom automation equipment tailored for both power device and power discrete assembly. Clients can also utilize their open lab platform for thorough product and fabrication process verification.

name: Excelliance MOS Corporation
summary: Excelliance MOS Corporation operates as a power device and IC design company in Taiwan. The company is involved in the power semiconductor process development, as well as power device, IC, and system design activities. Its products include power MOSFETs, Schottky rectifiers, AC/DC and DC/DC power ICs, and LED drivers. The company's products are primarily used to the power system of electronic products, including personal computers, notebooks, pads, monitors, TVs, LED lighting, switching power, and other consumer electronics. Excelliance MOS Corporation was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: CJW International Co., Ltd.
summary: CJW International Co., Ltd. designs and sells jewelry products, and tobacco and alcohol in Taiwan. The company offers diamond, jade, and coral jewelry products. It is also involved in the wholesale and retail of beauty products. The company was founded in 1967 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Syntek Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Syntek Semiconductor Co., Ltd. operates as a fabless IC design company in Asia. It offers car DVRs/miniDVs, PC/NB camera controllers, and microcontrollers, as well as wireless solutions. The company also develops products for photo capturing and video recording applications. In addition, it offers wireless IP connected multimedia recording solutions; and system-on-chip solutions. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: KMC (Kuei Meng) International Inc.
summary: KMC (Kuei Meng) International Inc. manufactures and sells various types of chains, motorcycle components, and vehicle components in Asia, Europe, and the United States. The company offers bicycle chains, such as road bike, mountain bike, BMX, E-bike, and rust buster chain series products, as well as EcoProTech chains. It also provides motorcycle chain and gears, including standard driving, heavy duty, cam, and silent chain series products, as well as standard driving sprockets, and chain and sprocket kits. In addition, the company offers automobile timing systems and garage door openers. Further, it is involved in investing activities. The company was formerly known as CNet Technology Inc. and changed its name to KMC (Kuei Meng) International Inc. in July 2012. KMC (Kuei Meng) International Inc. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan. KMC (Kuei Meng) International Inc. is a subsidiary of KMC Transton Industries Limited.

name: Sysgration Ltd.
summary: Sysgration Ltd. provides industrial IoT, automotive electronics, energy management, and redundant power supply solutions in Taiwan. It offers integration and mobile apps to control various vehicle on-board devices; real-time and wireless location tracking technology products for animals and assets; and smart retail services to connect vending machines for real-time telemetry and user behavior analytics services. The company also provides internal and external BLE TPMS products; and commercial solar and container based solar energy storage systems. In addition, it offers battery pack products, such as power stations, EV battery packs, and UPS LIB packs; rackmount solutions comprising slim type, CRPS, flex ATX, flex RPS, narrow type, battery backup PSU, and PSII mini RPS products; and power supply and battery backup centralized solutions. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: CGS International Inc.
summary: Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, CGS International Inc. primarily specializes in supplying computer peripheral equipment across the Taiwanese market. Beyond its core hardware provisions, the company offers extensive system integration services and essential repair and maintenance support. Its operations further encompass a broad range of software solutions, from strategic planning and development to implementation and expert consulting. Additionally, CGS International Inc. is involved in the creation and commercialization of mobile and platform-based video games.

name: Formosa Optical Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Formosa Optical Technology Co.,Ltd. is a dedicated supplier of vision care products across Taiwan. Their diverse portfolio features corrective eyewear such as prescription glasses and sunglasses, alongside a variety of contact lenses, including both clear and colored options. Additionally, the firm furnishes professional optometry equipment. The company, which was established in 1976, conducts its operations from its primary office located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Myson Century, Inc.
summary: Myson Century, Inc. provides micro-controllers (MCU), automobile IT solutions, fiber solutions, and motor control solutions in Taiwan. The company also offers dual CMOS operational amplifiers, as well as ASIC design services. Its products are used in automobile, motor control and drive, embedded networking, and optical network applications. Myson Century, Inc. was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: United Radiant Technology Corporation
summary: United Radiant Technology Corporation manufactures and sells liquid crystal display panels and modules. The company's panels and modules include TN, WTN, STN, WSTN, FSTN, WFSTN, and TFT. It also offers LCM products, capacitive and resistive touch panels, heat dissipations, LED lighting products, electronic shelf labels, and automotive products. The company offers its products through a network of approximately 20 distributors worldwide. United Radiant Technology Corporation was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: United Recommend International Co., Ltd.
summary: Best Friend Technology Co., Ltd manufactures and sells printed circuit boards (PCBs). It offers flex PCBs; and rigid PCBs, such as wireless WIFI, projector, light, and power system drive boards, as well as solar panels. The company was formerly known as Yeti Electronics Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Best Friend Technology Co., Ltd in June 2008. Best Friend Technology Co., Ltd was founded in 1983 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Shihlin Development Company Limited
summary: Shihlin Development Company Limited operates in real estate development business in Taiwan. It offers land development, building planning, engineering construction, and after sales services. The company is also involved in catering, hotel, leisure, and recreation business. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Hua Jung Components Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hua Jung Components Co.,Ltd., a Taiwanese enterprise, specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of film capacitors within Taiwan. Their comprehensive product portfolio encompasses various capacitor types, such as metallized polyester, metallized polypropylene, power film, and EMI suppression models. The company also offers products related to technology exchange. Primarily serving clients in the power supply and lighting sectors, Hua Jung Components was established in 1983 and maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Baotek Industrial Materials Ltd.
summary: Baotek Industrial Materials Ltd. manufactures and sells fiberglass fabrics in primarily Taiwan, China, and internationally. It offers aerospace fiberglass fabric, a reinforcement material for airplanes' internal structure; high temperature filter bag used in power and steel plants, incinerators, and cement factories; fiberglass sun shade that are use in buildings, interior designs, construction, and furniture; PTFE fabrics for use in PTFE coating areas; and electronic fiberglass fabrics. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Vate Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Vate Technology Co., Ltd. provides integrated circuit (IC) testing services in Taiwan and China. The company offers IC testing services related to the service of wafer probing and final testing; BURN IN, a test service on electrical components and final products; and LED products. It also provides chip probing test, final test, SLT system module test, CMOS image sensor testing, and back end services, as well as sells LED panel light products. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Fullhome Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1990 and based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Team Young Technology Co.,Ltd. delivers intelligent power management and automation solutions throughout the country. The company's extensive product range includes smart outlet sockets, adapter plugs, power strips, and remote control devices. Additionally, they provide specialized controllers for applications such as electric roll-up doors, electronic door locks (including versions for hotels), power switches, and electric curtains.

name: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation
summary: Vanguard International Semiconductor Corporation, together with its affiliated companies, operates as a comprehensive global player in the semiconductor industry. Established in 1994 and based in Hsinchu, Taiwan, the firm delivers end-to-end services, encompassing the computer-aided design, manufacturing, packaging, quality assurance, and distribution of integrated circuits and various other semiconductor components. The company's advanced foundry capabilities extend across a diverse portfolio of specialized process technologies. These include high voltage, ultra-high voltage, Bipolar-CMOS-DMOS (BCD), Silicon-on-Insulator (SOI), discrete, mixed-signal, analog, and embedded flash technologies. Furthermore, Vanguard is actively involved in the production and supply of masks. Beyond its core manufacturing, the company provides an extensive array of supplementary services. These comprise multi-project wafer fabrication, a complete suite of mask services (covering frame generation, production, and repair), and a broad range of backend solutions. The backend offerings specifically include front-side and backside metallization, chip probing, gallium nitride compound semiconductor material processing, wafer-level chip scale packaging (WLCSP), and redistribution layer (RDL) development. Additionally, Vanguard offers tailored services for the automotive sector, alongside intelligent manufacturing and management systems.

name: Empower Technology Corporation.
summary: Stem, Inc. provides artificial intelligence (AI)-driven clean energy storage services. It delivers and operates smart battery storage solutions that maximize renewable energy generation and help build a resilient grid. The company's Athena, a AI-powered analytics platform software that uses artificial intelligence and machine learning to automatically switch between battery power, onsite generation, and grid power. Athena stabilizes the grid, reduces carbon emissions, and solves renewable intermittency across the network of distributed energy storage systems. The company serves customers, including Fortune 500 corporate energy users, project developers and installers, and utilities and independent power producers. Stem, Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Millbrae, California.

name: Etron Technology, Inc.
summary: Etron Technology, Inc. develops buffer memory and system-on-chips in the United States, Europe, Japan, and Asian countries.
