The company's products include DataPilot 10, a handheld digital evidence acquisition instrument; big data platforms; Cisco data center and virtualization, Cisco cloud collaboration, and Cisco enterprise network services; information security solutions; search and exploration engine systems; storage systems; and data protection solutions. Its solutions include information and communication system integration, big data analysis and knowledge exploration, information security, digital banking and financial, and smart police solutions. It serves finance, manufacturing, retail, telecommunications, and government agencies. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: TUL Corporation
summary: TUL Corporation develops and markets hardware solutions in IT industry worldwide. The company offers gaming and embedded graphics cards, SoC based mainboards and systems, FPGA products, thunderbolt adopters, and SSD storage solutions. It serves OEMs, distributors, VARs, and system integrators. The company was formerly known as C.P. Technologies and changed its name to TUL Corporation in March 2004. TUL Corporation was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Ginar Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ginar Technology Co., Ltd. produces and sells performance materials in the field of engineering thermoplastics in Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It offers MAPEX polyamide engineering plastics, such as impact modified, mineral reinforced, glass fiber reinforced, and flame retardant polyamide 6, polyamide 66, and high temperature nylon compounds for automotive, electrical/electronic, and other industries; and mineral fiber, glass fiber, and impact modifier or flame retardant APLAX polypropylene engineering plastics. The company also provides impact modification and glass fiber reinforcement or flammability KAPEX polycarbonate engineering plastics; KAPEX PC/ABS alloys for cars instrument panels and dashboards, notebook covers, and cell phones; and KAPEX green products that contain r-PET and/or r-PC, which are from post-consumer recycled products for notebook PC, desktop PC, LED TV, monitor, and OA products. In addition, it offers flame retardant high performance nylon composite engineering plastics. The company's products are used for automotive and consumer electronics applications. Ginar Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Sunfar Computer Co., Ltd
summary: Sunfar Computer Co., Ltd sells various goods for consumers in Taiwan. It offers home appliances, personal computer hardware and peripheral equipment, computer supplies and consumables, computer software and books, consumer electronics and communications, etc., as well as OA merchandise and maintenance services. The company provides its products through 64 stores and online shopping platform. Sunfar Computer Co., Ltd was founded in 1982 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Song Shang Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Song Shang Electronics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells magnetic components, printed circuit boards, and wire products. Its magnetic components include coils, line filters, power chokes, and transformers primarily used in the production of transformers, filters, and inductors, as well as in adapter, LED TV, LCD TV, charger, game console, desktop, monitor, printer, lighting, and communication applications. The company's printed circuit boards are used in consumable electronic products, power supplies, machinery, instruments, and automobile industries, as well as other industries. It also offers wire products for LED TV and display, car audio, battery, power supply equipment, and home appliances. The company was formerly known as K-Bridge Electronics Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Song Shang Electronics Co., Ltd. in March 2011. Song Shang Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1988 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: P-Two Industries Inc.
summary: P-Two Industries Inc. is a Taiwan-based enterprise that specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a broad spectrum of computer-related components and connectors. The company offers a comprehensive range of advanced connectivity solutions, which includes flexible flat cables (FFC), floating and locking board-to-board connectors, FFC/FPC connectors, power and standard wire-to-board (WTB) connectors, USB Type-C connectors, SATA connectors, and LVDS socket connectors. Furthermore, P-Two Industries also supplies essential components for display panels, notebook computers, and television sets. Its products cater to a diverse array of industries, notably the automotive sector, computer and peripheral manufacturers, visual display producers, and consumer electronics companies. The firm was established in 1986 and operates from its corporate headquarters located in Táoyuán, Taiwan.

name: Cipherlab Co.,Ltd.
summary: Cipherlab Co.,Ltd. designs, manufactures, markets, and sells automatic identification and data capture products under the CipherLab brand worldwide. The company offers windows/android and proprietary mobile computers; general purpose, business durable, and pocket sized barcode scanners; HF and UHF radio frequency identification readers; and software solutions comprising deployment and development tools, device management, browser and emulation, programming, and scanner software. It serves warehouse, transportation and logistics, field mobility, retail, manufacturing, and healthcare industries, as well as the government. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Jetway Information Co., Ltd.
summary: Jetway Information Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells motherboards and other IT products worldwide. It also provides AIO products, graphic cards, IPC boards, barebones, and chassis products. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: HwaCom Systems Inc.
summary: Hwacom Systems Inc., a broadband system integrator, supplies mobile, fixed, and IP networks related services in Taiwan and internationally. The company also supplies multimedia applications. Its product portfolio includes interactive personalized television (IPTV) set-top boxes, OTT set-top boxes, hybrid set-top boxes, and video gateways, as well as video streaming related consulting and integration services. It also provides broadband infrastructure solutions, value added services, customized network management systems, and integrated video solutions; cloud computing and data center solutions; and IPTV solutions. In addition, the company offers smart city solutions comprising video and traffic surveillance systems; intelligent transportation services; information security management services; multi-channel acquiring and network management solutions; and 3D radar reimage solution. It serves payTV operators, telecoms, and MSOs. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Powertip Technology Corporation
summary: Powertip Technology Corporation manufactures and sells small to mid-size full color TFT and monochrome displays, and touch panels worldwide. The company's offers embedded solutions, full viewing angle displays, EM touch products, TFT displays, TFT with projected capacitive touch panels, graphic and chip-on-glass LCD modules, character LCD modules, FS-LCDs, VATN/PBT LCD modules, resistive and capacitive touch panels, and evaluation boards; and surface mount technology, chip-on-board, chip-on-flex, tape automated bonding, and screen printing products. Its products are used in white goods and gas pumps/parking meters, as well as for industrial, medical, consumer, automotive, communications, and test and measurement applications. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: InterServ International Inc.
summary: InterServ International Inc. develops games worldwide. The company is involved in edutainment related activities; and the research, development, and operation of TV/PC/online/Web/mobile games. It also develops PC MMORPG, casual games, console games, and mobile games, as well as app, online, social, PC console, and Xbox360 games. InterServ International Inc. was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Welldone Company
summary: Welldone Company, together with its subsidiaries, engages in telecommunication, IC, and other access businesses primarily in Taiwan. It sells prepaid mobile SIM cards, trading of online game point cards, and foreign migrant worker remittance services. The company also engages in the mobile phone top-up services; international human resources business services project, including human resources agency, foreign caregivers, management consulting, laws and information, foreign worker translation services, abnormal incidents involving foreign workers, and conducting periodic visits to employers and foreign workers; and airport access business. In addition, it provides online games and payment services; and I-MONEY, a convenient and secure purchasing channel. Further, the company offers telecom apparatus; retails and wholesales of food and cosmetics; manufactures and wholesales of batteries and electronic components. Welldone Company was founded in 1966 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Tacheng Real Estate Co.,Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Aries Co.,Ltd. manufactures, processes, and trades in various electronic parts in Taiwan. It is also involved in residential and building development, rental, and sales; building materials wholesale and retail, landscape and interior design, import and export trading, real estate trading and leasing, and other businesses. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Prosperity Dielectrics Co., Ltd.
summary: Prosperity Dielectrics Co., Ltd. manufactures and exports ceramic dielectric powders and multilayer ceramic chip capacitors in Taiwan, the United States, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific. Its products include ceramic dielectric powders, disc type semi-conductive capacitor elements, multilayer ceramic chip capacitors, chip resistors, diodes, inductors, and coils. The company also provides SBL elements. Its products are used in power, communications, and consumer applications; and medical, military, and measurement equipment, as well as the automotive sector. Prosperity Dielectrics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1990 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Aker Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Founded in 1990 and headquartered in Taichung City, Taiwan, Aker Technology Co., Ltd is dedicated to the design, production, and worldwide sale of a diverse range of frequency control solutions. The company's product line specifically includes clock oscillators and quartz crystals for the automotive industry. Aker Technology Co., Ltd's global reach extends to markets such as Taiwan, Europe, mainland China, the United States, and Hong Kong, supported by its extensive international distribution networks.

name: Liton Technology Corp.
summary: Liton Technology Corp. manufactures and sells etched and formed aluminum foils in Taiwan, Mainland China, Europe, the Americas, Japan, Korea, India, and Southeast Asia. The company offers middle and high voltage formed aluminum foils; low voltage formed aluminum foils; and middle and high voltage etched aluminum foils. Its products are used in industries and products, such as aerospace, high-speed rail, MRT systems, solar and wind power, computers, mobile phones, automobiles, home appliances, and industrial products. The company was formerly known as Liton Electrics Corp. and changed its name to Liton Technology Corp. in April 1998. Liton Technology Corp. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Miaoli, Taiwan.

name: ATE Energy International Co., Ltd.
summary: ATE Energy International Co., Ltd. delivers comprehensive engineering, construction, and equipment maintenance services. The company's expertise includes a wide array of marine engineering solutions, such as seawater cooling systems, deep seawater applications, power generation utilizing marine resources, desalination facilities, and the cabling infrastructure for offshore wind farms, alongside ongoing maintenance for these installations. Beyond its marine focus, ATE Energy operates within various energy sectors, including battery energy storage systems, environmental sustainability initiatives, waste-to-energy conversion, clean coal cogeneration, and the generation of power from solar, wind, and hydro resources. Additionally, the firm supplies medical devices and contributes to transportation and infrastructure development projects. Established in 1995, the company was originally known as Accusys Storage Ltd. before officially changing its name to ATE Energy International Co., Ltd. in September 2013. Its corporate headquarters are located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Gamania Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd.
summary: Gamania Digital Entertainment Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, publishes online and mobile games in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Japan, and Korea. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Wafer Works Corporation
summary: Wafer Works Corporation engages in the manufacture and supply of silicon wafers worldwide. It offers polished silicon and epitaxial wafers, as well as single crystal ingots and doped silicon wafers used in semiconductor devices for power and digital applications. The company supplies its products through sales representatives. Wafer Works Corporation was founded in 1997 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Plastron Precision Co., Ltd.
summary: Plastron Precision Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and market of connectors in Taiwan and internationally. It offers board to board, header/socket, USB, memory card connectors, etc.; and serial ATA products, I/O connectors, and edge card connectors. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Shin Ruenn development Co., LTD
summary: Shin Ruenn development Co., LTD. engages in the development and rental of housing and buildings. It is also involved in the sale, leasing, and purchase of real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Jinglay, Inc. and changed its name to Shin Ruenn development Co., LTD. in July 2011. Shin Ruenn development Co., LTD. was founded in 1998 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: All Ring Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: All Ring Tech Co., Ltd., founded in 1996 and headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, is a prominent firm specializing in the creation, production, and assembly of automation machines for both Taiwanese and Chinese markets. The company boasts a comprehensive product line addressing diverse industrial needs, which includes: Dispensing and Mounting Systems: Such as underfill dispensing machines and various mounters for FPC, PSA, optical components, and ACF. Inspection and Measurement Equipment: Featuring general and wafer Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) machines, alongside advanced image measurement instruments. Material Handling and Assembly Solutions: Including loaders/unloaders, ball mount machines, and apparatus for glue coating and heat sink attachment. Processing and Fabrication Machinery: Encompassing cutting, rotary plating, coil winding, resistor stacking and granulating, PC rolling machines, and power inductor dispensers. LED Specific Technologies: Providing LED sorting (including rotary tower models), packaging, rolling, CSP cleaving, and dispensing machines. Beyond its primary manufacturing, All Ring Tech is also actively involved in the research, development, and design of computer software, as well as the fabrication of optical instruments. It produces and sells equipment for the semiconductor, passive component, and light-emitting diode sectors, in addition to offering mechanical engineering automation products. Furthermore, the company undertakes the R&D and manufacturing of specialized electronic equipment, precision testing instruments, and related accessories. Its business interests extend to investment activities, the marketing of its manufactured goods, and delivering associated technology testing services. All Ring Tech diversifies its operations by handling electrical appliances and audio-visual electronics, engaging in trading, and participating in other machine manufacturing ventures.

name: Quanta Storage Inc.
summary: Quanta Storage Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells optical storage products to computer manufacturers worldwide. The company offers storage and peripheral products, such as NAS, DAS, USB-C power delivery and mini docks, adapters, and Wi-Fi storage products. It also provides solid state drives and intelligent automation systems; and storage manufacturing services of storage devices and systems, computer peripherals, and IoT related products. In addition, the company offers project planning, product development, technical, design, engineering mechanism, electrical engineering, logistics management, and repair and maintenance services. Quanta Storage Inc. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Wonderful Hi-tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Wonderful Hi-tech Co., Ltd. manufactures, purchases, sells, and imports/exports various wires and cable in Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. It also manufactures and sells a range of furniture and electronic equipment. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Yufo Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Yufo Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily manufactures and sells printed circuit boards in Taiwan and internationally. It offers computer motherboards for use in personal computers, industrial computers, and medical equipment; and high frequency impedance control printed circuit boards for use in servers, communication base station, network communication equipment, and high-precision instruments. The company was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Scan-D Corporation
summary: Scan-D Corporation, established in 1995 and based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, specializes in the wholesale and retail supply of various home and kitchen essentials. The company provides a diverse selection of products, such as furniture, bedding, kitchen apparatus, and fittings, to consumers and businesses in both Taiwan and Singapore.

name: Rich Circle Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Rich Circle Development Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of semiconductors. Its offerings encompass a range of technological components, including integrated circuits, memory chips, digital communication products, and computer peripherals. In addition to its tech operations, the company maintains a presence in the real estate market, undertaking the development of buildings and housing, as well as the sale and rental of properties. Founded in 1987, the firm's headquarters are situated in Taipei, Taiwan. The company was rebranded in January 2024, changing its name to Rich Circle Development Co., Ltd. from its previous identity as AverLogic Technologies, Corp.

name: TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD.
summary: TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD. operates as a flash storage manufacturer in Taiwan. The company designs, manufactures, and sells portable storage products. It offers flash card readers/writers and adapters, digital photo frames, digital signage products, LCD TV player modules, fingerprint devices, and flash drives. The company was formerly known as DataFab Systems Inc. and changed its name to TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD. in July 2015. TienPin United Enterprise CO., LTD. is headquartered in Pingzhen, Taiwan.

name: Sea Sonic Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1975, Sea Sonic Electronics Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the design, production, and sale of power conversion products. Operating from its Taiwanese base, the firm specializes in manufacturing a variety of power supplies for both consumer and industrial applications, marketed under its Seasonic brand. These offerings are also widely exported to global destinations, including the United States and Europe.

name: Taiwan Alpha Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Alpha Electronic Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and distribution of electronic components and customizable sensor solutions. Its products include Potentiometers, Switches, Encoders, and Jacks. The company was founded on February 14, 1970 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Laser Tek Taiwan Co.,Ltd.
summary: Laser Tek Taiwan Co., Ltd. is a multifaceted enterprise with operations extending across Taiwan and into international markets. Its principal activities include the processing of surface-mounted devices (SMD), supplying surface mount technology (SMT) equipment, developing intelligent information systems for businesses, and delivering specialized laser precision solutions. The company's extensive portfolio also covers the production, processing, and distribution of laser trimming machinery and various printing materials. They are also involved in the design and sale of critical testing probe cards, as well as providing comprehensive solutions such as FDR information retrieval systems, LCD testing, and electronic test fixtures. Further diversifying its business, Laser Tek engages in the construction of lighting infrastructure, the trading and sale of electronic components, and the distribution of electrical appliances. The firm provides maintenance services for semiconductor equipment and components, installs solar thermal energy systems, and offers engineering and energy-related technical expertise, including acting as a trading agent. Additionally, the company manufactures equipment for pollution control, processes and markets packaging materials for electronic components, and specializes in the slitting, production, and sale of antistatic chip resistor packaging carrier tapes (both top and bottom variants). Its broad reach even encompasses the planning of cultural and artistic events, the distribution of chemical raw materials and food products, and facilitating the import and export of goods and technologies. Established in 1988, Laser Tek Taiwan Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Highlight Tech Corp.
summary: Highlight Tech Corp. designs, manufactures, and sells integrated vacuum coating chamber solutions for original equipment manufacturers worldwide. It offers cylindrical, box, D shape, spherical, polygon, bell jar, large, and aluminum vacuum chambers, as well as vacuum modules and systems; vacuum chamber kits; ultra-high vacuum chambers; and vacuum valves, such as vacuum poppet valves, aluminum alloy angle valves, vacuum gate valves, vacuum butterfly valves, rectangular gate valves, pendulum valves, teflon coating vacuum valves, vacuum ball valves, vacuum check valves, vent valves, metal valves, and vacuum valve kits. The company also provides vacuum components, including elbows-tees-crosses, vacuum flanges, teflon bellows, hydroformed vacuum bellows, centering rings, vacuum clamps, adaptor fittings, vacuum viewports, vacuum feedthroughs, and vacuum accessories, as well as KF, ISO, and CF components; and vacuum pumps comprising edwards turbomolecular pumps, scroll and refurbished vacuum pumps, and Ebara dry pump repair kits. In addition, it offers sanitary fittings comprising ferrule blanks, fittings, gaskets, clamps, and adaptors, as well as sanitary valves; perfluoroelastomer O'rings; IC dispensing machines; and centrifugal vacuum mixers. Further, the company provides vacuum pump and valves overhaul services; and refurbished vacuum pump services. Highlight Tech Corp. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Kintech Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Kintech Electronics Co. Ltd. engages in manufacturing, processing, and trading of single-sided and multi-layer printed circuit boards and electronic components in Taiwan, the United States, Europe, Japan, China, and the Southeast Asia. It offers its products for consumer and other products, communication products, PC and peripheral, industrial equipment, and servers. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Li Ming Development Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Li Ming Development Construction Co., Ltd. operates primarily within Taiwan's real estate development sector. The company's core business involves the construction, rental, and sale of various building types. Beyond property initiatives, they also distribute construction materials at both wholesale and retail levels and provide interior design and decoration services. Founded in 1966, the firm is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan. It was formerly known as M.E.T. Technology Co., Ltd. before officially adopting its current name in January 2007.

name: C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd.
summary: C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells spring loaded probes and connectors in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers testing solutions, including high frequency testing, Kelvin contact testing, memory testing, burn-in testing, fine pitch connector testing, IC and ICT test probe, ATE connecting, general final testing, panel testing, wafer level testing, battery probe, and high current IC testing solutions. It also provides pogo pin connectors, such as standard and non-standard, single pogo pin, waterproof, ball point, magnetic, high current and frequency, and ultra-small pin connectors, as well as screw pins; female and industrial connectors; and DAC network cables. The company was formerly known as CCP Contact Probes Enterprise Co., Ltd. and changed its name to C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd. in 1998. C.C.P. Contact Probes Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Hauman Technologies Corp.
summary: Hauman Technologies Corp. develops products and solutions for information technology, semiconductor, optoelectronics, and photovoltaic industries in Taiwan, Mainland China, and the United States. The company offers hardware and software products; and application services, including planning, marketing, sales, installation, training, system maintenance, and integration services to the government agencies, institutions of higher learning, research institutes, financial institutions, and multinational corporations. It also provides materials, equipment, and automatic packaging and testing instruments; and wafer probers, IC test handlers, underfill dispensers, package inspection solutions, ATE testers, LED probers and sorters, X-ray inspection systems, solar cell texturing and manufacturing AOI systems, ESD monitoring systems, cleaning systems, sealing machines, cutters, forming machines, machine vision systems, texturing systems, automatic inspection systems, LED and LCD process, etc. The company was formerly known as Hauman Enterprise and changed its name to Hauman Technologies Corp. in 2000. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Full Wang International Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Full Wang International Development Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the real estate market in Taiwan. The company's diverse property activities include the construction, development, and commercial trading of real estate, alongside providing leasing and agency services for property transactions. Additionally, Full Wang engages in the retail of cosmetic and skin care products. Established in 1986, its corporate headquarters are located in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: YFC-Boneagle Electric Co., Ltd.
summary: YFC-Boneagle Electric Co., Ltd. engages in the developing, manufacturing, and sale of power cord sets, LAN cables, patch cords, and networking accessories in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides power cables, including wires, power supply cords, cord sets, and portable hand lamps; electronic wires and cables comprising UL AWM cables and hook-up wires; and networking accessories, such as patch panels, keystone jacks, outlets, plugs, wiring connectors and blocks, and cable management products, as well as LAN cables and patch cords. It also offers fiber optic products, which comprise adapters, cables, connectors, enclosures, and patch cords; and other application and connector products. YFC-Boneagle Electric Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Genesis Technology, Inc.
summary: Genesis Technology, Inc., along with its affiliated entities, delivers a full spectrum of information system integration services and IT solutions throughout Taiwan. Their core activities involve the distribution, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of various software applications, computer hardware, and telecommunications infrastructure. The company's extensive solution set includes advanced software-defined data centers, cutting-edge corporate data storage systems, and strategies for optimizing enterprise core operations. They also specialize in securing corporate digital assets and designing safe, efficient digital work environments. Furthermore, Genesis Technology provides robust information security measures, encompassing foundational infrastructure defense, advanced malware protection, specialized factory security, secure remote access, and comprehensive cloud service security. The firm also develops intelligent communication and digital collaboration platforms. A notable offering is GeCloud, their proprietary hybrid cloud service. Complementing these, the company offers expert IT consulting and professional services. Genesis Technology, Inc. was established in 1983 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Li Hsuan Development & Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Soaring Technology Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells liquid crystal displays and lighting products in Taiwan and internationally. It offers LED bulbs and lamps, LED tubes, and LED indoor and outdoor fixtures, as well as dimmers, switches, and plugs. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: MPI Corporation
summary: MPI Corporation, established in 1995 and based in Zhubei, Taiwan, is a global entity engaged in the manufacturing, processing, maintenance, and trade of semiconductor production and testing equipment. The company's product line features a variety of probe cards, including cantilever, FCB, EVS, and osprey types. They also deliver specialized instruments for the optoelectronics, semiconductor, and laser sectors, such as point test equipment, photoelectric measurement sorting systems, and AOI (Automated Optical Inspection) equipment. Furthermore, MPI provides automated visual and LED inspection systems tailored for optical sensing, communications, and micro-display technologies. Their offerings extend to manual and automated probe systems, alongside RF probes, which are vital for applications like device characterization, power, RF and mmW testing, design verification, failure analysis, wafer-level reliability, silicon photonics, MEMS testing, and signal integrity. The company additionally supplies thermal temperature testing and thermal cycling systems. MPI serves a broad spectrum of industries, including semiconductor manufacturing, materials research, aerospace, automotive, fiber optic, and electronic components.

name: Macnica Galaxy Inc.
summary: Macnica Galaxy Inc. distributes IC products and services in Taiwan and internationally. It offers software, artificial intelligence, and Internet of Things products, as well as semiconductors to customers in the cloud, Internet of Things, communication, industrial electronics, and automotive industries. The company was formerly known as Galaxy Far East Corporation and changed its name to Macnica Galaxy Inc. in July 2017. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan. Macnica Galaxy Inc. is a subsidiary of Macnica Chungju Co., Ltd.

name: Pacific Image Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Pacific Image Electronics Co., Ltd. provides advanced scanning and imaging technologies to customers both within Taiwan and globally. The company's product portfolio encompasses high-fidelity film scanners. Additionally, they offer specialized diagnostic and research instruments such as rapid test readers for lateral flow and biochemical assays, biological imaging systems, array imaging platforms, and SPR (Surface Plasmon Resonance) platforms. Established in 1993, Pacific Image Electronics is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: V-TAC Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: V-TAC Technology Co.,Ltd., established in 1992 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, functions as both an integrated circuit (IC) application design house and an IC sales agent. The company's operations span Taiwan, Hong Kong, and mainland China, where it develops and provides comprehensive solutions for a diverse range of electronic products. These offerings cater to the consumer market, including LCD games, universal remote controls, calculators, timepieces, sport-meters, and healthcare devices. V-TAC also addresses the telecommunications sector with solutions for caller ID systems, answering machines, and commercial terminals utilizing PSTN wired tele-transport technology. Additionally, its expertise covers USB-connected storage devices such as card readers, thumb drives, U-disks, and HUB/IDE/SATA interfaces, alongside multimedia products like digital photo frames (DPF), MP3 players, TV entertainment systems, portable media players (PMP), and other media playback devices. Finally, the company contributes to the educational and toy markets by providing solutions for translators, electronic dictionaries, RF pens, optical learning aids, children's laptops, and interactive toys.

name: Insyde Software Corp.
summary: Insyde Software Corp. provides system firmware and software engineering services for companies in the mobile, desktop, server, and embedded systems industries worldwide. It offers client, server, and Internet of Things (IoT)/embedded solutions; developer tools; Supervyse, a systems management software; BlinkBoot UEFI Boot Loader; and mobile applications. The company also provides engineering services in the areas of project planning, design, implementation and integration, acceptance and deployment, and maintenance and field updates; and UEFI training programs. It serves mobile computing, desktop, servers, and embedded/IoT markets. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Prolific Technology Inc.
summary: Prolific Technology Inc. operates as an IC design company and ASIC design service provider for USB smart I/O, intelligent green energy saving, and mixed-mode hall sensor solutions. The company offers IC and SOC solutions for USB serial/parallel converters, USB storage products, brushless motor drivers, hall sensors, power meters, and MEMS motion sensing products. It sells its products in Taiwan, Mainland China, Japan, Korea, Canada, and the United States. The company was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Tera Autotech Corporation
summary: Tera Autotech Corporation manufactures and sells automation equipment in Taiwan. The company offers automatic storage and logistic equipment; whole plant automated logistic equipment; automatic re-grind machines, product inspection machines, RGV machines, and lock screw machines; CNC machines, welding equipment, and chamber processing machines; and measurement equipment. It also offers drill products, including standard, micro, large, UC, and slot drills, as well as router bits. The company was formerly known as Tera Automation Corporation and changed its name to Tera Autotech Corporation in 2001. Tera Autotech Corporation was founded in 1982 and is based in Taichung City, Taiwan.

name: Neith Corporation
summary: Neith Corporation operates in diverse sectors, encompassing biotechnology, medical aesthetics, and preventive health solutions. The company provides a variety of nutritional supplements, including L-One, a liquid formula designed to support ocular well-being, and EPlus, a multi-enzyme blend. Additional nutritional offerings are marketed under the King One brand. Beyond supplements, Neith also offers genetic testing services. Its product portfolio extends to a wide array of wellness and energy-enhancing items, such as versatile mattresses (energy and dual-purpose), energy-infused masks, silicon gel necklaces, waistbands, heated energy stones, and massage tools. The company further supplies water purification systems and specialized Ganbanyoku energy stone spa beds. In the beauty segment, Neith presents a line of skincare products focused on cell regeneration and rejuvenation. Other offerings include energy-focused household items, as well as microcontrollers and their associated peripheral devices. Established in 1997, Neith Corporation was initially known as Come True Biomedical Inc. The company's headquarters are situated in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: C-Media Electronics Inc.
summary: C-Media Electronics Inc., operating with its subsidiaries, specializes in the development, production, and sale of electronic components and integrated circuits. The company's reach extends across Taiwan, Mainland China, and international markets. Its product portfolio encompasses a variety of audio solutions, including USB audio codecs, controllers, and amplifiers, alongside general codecs and audio digital signal processing (DSP) technologies. Beyond these core offerings, C-Media also handles the import and export of electronic components, integrated circuits, and computer peripherals. The company provides information software services and is engaged in the manufacturing of optical instruments and lighting equipment. Furthermore, C-Media dedicates resources to hardware and software development, particularly for the technology, cultural, creative, and multimedia entertainment industries. Its activities also include general technology research and development, market operations, and the distribution of multimedia products such as MP3 and MP4 players. Established in 1991, C-Media Electronics Inc. maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Sung Gang Corp.Limited
summary: Sung Gang Corp.Limited engages in the information software wholesale in Taiwan. The company is also involved in the book publishing; real estate leasing; sale of electronic parts and computer peripherals; parking lot operations; financial debt purchase; and purchase of financial institutions. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Amigo Technology Inc.
summary: Amigo Technology Inc., an OEM/ODM company, provides various support services related to the design, manufacture, and after-sales service for networking and communication products. It offers Wi-Fi access points, such as enterprise indoor and ruggedized access points; and mesh routers. The company was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Li Kang Biomedical Co., Ltd.
summary: Li Kang Biomedical Co., Ltd. specializes in the development and distribution of nutritional supplements, cosmeceuticals, and health-focused beverages. Beyond its product lines, the company also provides consulting and operational support for tourism factories, and offers telemarketing solutions. Established in 1982, the firm initially operated under the name BAFO Technologies Corporation, before adopting its current moniker, Li Kang Biomedical Co., Ltd., in September 2014. The company maintains its headquarters in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Motech Industries Inc.
summary: Motech Industries Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells solar products and services in Taiwan and internationally. It provides photovoltaic (PV) cells, PV modules, PV power systems, and PV inverters. The company was formerly known as Meter International Corporation. Motech Industries Inc. was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Lanner Electronics Inc.
summary: Lanner Electronics Inc. provides design, engineering, and manufacturing services for advanced network appliances and rugged applied computing platforms for system integrators, service providers, and application developers worldwide. The company offers network appliances, such as modules and acceleration cards, white box hardware solutions, wide temperature network appliances, desktop network appliances, and rackmount network appliances; and telecom datacenter appliances consisting of cloud storage, HybridTCA, vCPE/uCPE, and video transport platforms, as well as modules and blades, and hyper-converged appliances. It also provides intelligent edge appliances, including DIN-Rail industrial gateway, edge AI appliance, embedded platform, intelligent video platform, rackmount industrial computer, rugged wireless gateway, vehicle gateway, and vehicle/rail computer; and extension modules comprising LTE radio modules. The company offers its products for use in various applications, such as network computing, telecommunication, transportation, power and energy, industrial automation, intelligent systems, software-defined wide area network, and edge AI applications. Lanner Electronics Inc. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Thick-Film Ind. Corp
summary: Taiwan Thick-Film Ind. Corp manufactures and sells transformers, backlight modules, light emitting diode (LED) light bars, and light guide plates in Taiwan. It offers back light modules, such as in-vehicle and industrial control, tablet series, NB series, and monitors; LCM assemblies; LED light bars for consumer electronics, industrial control, medical, military, automotive, and other applications; and automotive/new energy automotive electronics that include vehicle charging station main boards, vehicle charging indicator main boards, car door lock main boards, automotive control switches, anti-pinch window lift monitor main boards, and vehicle indicator light switches. The company also provides cultural and creative business unit that provides brand licensing, product image design, cross-industry alliances and strategic alliances, creative products, 3C-related products, daily necessities, and auto supplies. Taiwan Thick-Film Ind. Corp was founded in 1982 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Jazz Hipster Corporation
summary: Jazz Hipster Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and sells audio speakers worldwide. It offers hi-fi and multi-room speakers; and earphone/mic products. The company markets its products under the JS brand. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: TMP Steel Corporation
summary: TMP Steel Corporation, based in Taipei City, Taiwan, is a leading producer and supplier of iron and steel products for the construction industry. The company specializes in manufacturing and distributing steel reinforcing bars, which are essential for enhancing the structural integrity of a wide range of developments, including residential properties, commercial high-rises, and major public works. Its extensive product portfolio also features steel billets, various types of steel wire (such as general and galvanized options), steel rods, spot-welded steel wire meshes, and section steel products. The company was originally incorporated in 1984. It operated under the name TMP International Corporation until July 2016, when it officially rebranded to its current identity, TMP Steel Corporation.

name: Bull Will Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1993 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, Bull Will Co., Ltd. operates as a manufacturer, distributor, and agent for an extensive range of electronic components. The company's diverse product portfolio encompasses various transformers, including switching power, switching power-LED drivers, and LLC resonant types, alongside light-emitting diodes (LEDs). Bull Will also specializes in a wide selection of power inductors, offered in configurations such as SMD, DIP, molded, high-current flat, high-current bead, toroid, DR, and assembly types. For electromagnetic interference (EMI) and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) solutions, they provide lead wire ferrite beads, AC line filters, SMD chip inductors, beads, filters, and common mode chokes. Further offerings include power hybrid devices, reactors, and SMD varistors. The firm additionally excels in producing customized and high-reliability magnetic components, such as ferrite cores, alloy powder cores, and amorphous powder cores, as well as critical parts like touch switches, connectors, and MOSFETs. These essential components are vital for a broad spectrum of applications and industries, including power supply units, LCD monitors, smartphones, laptops, server infrastructure, air conditioning systems, the automotive sector, and solar inverters.

name: Youngtek Electronics Corporation
summary: Youngtek Electronics Corporation provides semiconductor back-end foundry services in Taiwan. The company engages in wafer testing, wafer grinding and cutting and die picking, IC product testing, special substrate cutting, test program development, platform conversion, engineering support, and valet shipping; and AOI automatic optical inspection of LED dies and VCSEL components, die picking inspection, visual inspection, and other post-process OEM activities. It also offers IC sorting and bonding; WLCSP die sorting packaging; label flip-chip binding; and die and LED bonding machines. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Planet Technology Corporation
summary: Planet Technology Corporation, established in 1993 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a global provider of IP-based networking products and solutions. The company caters to small-to-medium-sized businesses, large enterprises, and diverse network infrastructures across Europe, the United States, Asia, and other international markets. Their comprehensive product portfolio spans core local area network (LAN) Ethernet switches and accessories, alongside robust industrial Ethernet devices such as switches, routers, media converters, fiber bypass switches, and DIN rail power supplies. They also provide industrial automation solutions, including serial device servers, protocol gateways, and EtherCAT slave I/O modules. Further offerings encompass diverse media conversion technologies—ranging from converter chassis and various media converters to Ethernet extenders, optical fiber bypass switches, SFP/SFP+/QSFP transceivers, and video optical transmission systems—as well as broadband communication products. A significant portion of their catalog is dedicated to Power over Ethernet (PoE) solutions, featuring PoE switches, injectors, splitters, media converters, extenders, power over coaxial options, PoE gateways, renewable energy PoE systems, and PoE network interface cards. Moreover, Planet Technology supplies wireless LAN solutions, including access point controllers, routers, indoor/outdoor access points/bridges, and associated antenna and cable accessories. Their IP telephony range covers IP PBX systems, VoIP gateways, phones, and IP intercom/paging systems. For security and surveillance, they offer IP surveillance devices like video recorder servers, cameras, extended surveillance tools, mobile device software, and a variety of mounting, PoE, and media converter accessories. Finally, the company's repertoire extends to home automation products (control gateways, IP intercoms, Z-Wave devices), various network peripherals, network security solutions (VPN firewalls/gateways, gigabit/VPN routers), and advanced network management systems.

name: Kingland Property Corporation Ltd.
summary: Kingland Property Corporation Ltd. engages in the construction business. The company was formerly known as DSG Technology Co., Ltd. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Kuen Chaang Uppertech Corp.
summary: Kuen Chaang Uppertech Corp. engages in the electronic component channel business in Taiwan. It is also involved in the semiconductor business. The company was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Top Union Electronics Corp.
summary: Established in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, in 1990, Top Union Electronics Corp. specializes in the design, manufacturing, and technical support of electronic products and communication equipment. Its operational footprint extends across Taiwan, the United States, and China. The company delivers a broad range of services, including Surface Mount Technology (SMT) processing, Dual In-line Package (DIP) assembly, rigorous testing, product integration, and expert consulting. Additionally, Top Union diversifies its business through investment activities, processing operations, and international trade.

name: Professional Computer Technology Limited
summary: Professional Computer Technology Limited operates within the Chinese market, focusing on the development, manufacturing, quality control, and distribution of electronic products and components for computers. The company's offerings encompass a range of items, including active and passive electronic parts, core and application-specific computer software, and various business-to-business (B2B) components. These products are marketed under its own brands: PCT, NOR, and Flash. The firm was established in 1981 and maintains its corporate headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Wieson Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: Wieson Technologies Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells interconnect components and wireless components. It offers I/O connectors, board mount connectors, card and socket connecters, connecters and cables, cable assemblies, optical fiber components, wires, wireless modules, automotive electronics, and LED lighting products, as well as antennas. The company was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Union Technology Corporation
summary: Taiwan Union Technology Corporation is a global enterprise active within the electronics industry. The firm specializes in the production of core materials like copper-clad laminates, prepreg, and mass laminates, in addition to supplying printed circuit boards. These products are vital for diverse applications, including radio frequency systems, high-speed digital infrastructure, high-density interconnect solutions, automotive electronics, and various substrate requirements. Established in 1974, the company's primary operations are based in Zhubei, Taiwan, having previously operated under the name Taiwan Union Glass Industrial Co., Ltd.

name: Yen Sun Technology Corporation
summary: Yen Sun Technology Corporation is dedicated to the innovation, manufacturing, and distribution of a diverse portfolio of household consumer electronics and advanced thermal management components. Its product offerings span various domestic appliances, including electric and induction cookers, juice extractors, water dispensers, bowl drying units, dehumidifiers, and electric heating devices. Furthermore, the company supplies a range of fans, from standard electric and cooling models to specialized DC cooling and ventilation systems, alongside intricate heat sink and thermal modules. Yen Sun also engages in the creation and sale of comprehensive living technology systems. Established in 1987 and headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, the firm maintains a significant international footprint, conducting operations across Taiwan, mainland China, Germany, the United States, Japan, South Korea, and other global regions.

name: Antec Inc.
summary: Antec Inc. engages in the manufacturing and selling of computer components and accessories for the gaming, PC upgrade, and do-it-yourself markets worldwide. It offers cases and power supply products, as well as cooling products, such as case fans, and CPU liquid and air coolers. The company was formerly known as Ming Jong Technologies Co., Ltd. Antec Inc. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Fremont, California.

name: Hu Lane Associate Inc.
summary: Hu Lane Associate Inc., headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a global producer and supplier of a wide array of metal stamped terminals. Established in 1977, the company provides essential components for various high-tech sectors, including the automotive, electronics, medical, and solar industries. Its product portfolio features items such as laser-welded terminals, connectors for electric vehicles, fuse boxes, crimping machinery, and a selection of rubber-based parts like grommets. The company rebranded to Hu Lane Associate Inc. in 2001, having previously been known as Hu Lane Industrial Co., Ltd.

name: INPAQ Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: INPAQ Technology Co., Ltd. provides circuit protection components and antenna products for computing, communication, consumer electronics, and automotive electronics primarily in Taiwan, China, Korea, and North America. It offers RF antennas, such as patch, active, chip, dipole, NFC, RFID, and customized antennas, as well as automotive, wireless power charger, module system, and LTC technology products. The company also provides SMD metal oxide varistor, ESD, transient voltage suppressor, and multilayer varistor; chip ferrite bead and common mode filter; and power, general circuits, and high frequency inductors. Its products are used in phones, tablets, NBs, TVs, and set top boxes, as well as automotive and network applications. INPAQ Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Miaoli, Taiwan.

name: Longwell Company
summary: Longwell Company, together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells electronic components and cable products in Taiwan, China, the United States, Japan, and internationally. The company offers power cords for various applications, such as computers, telecommunications, consumer electronics, and home appliances; and electronic wires and cables, insulation tubes, and heat-shrinkable tubes for use in computers, home appliances, telecommunications, and other electronics products. It also provides cable assemblies for various market sectors, including computer, communication, and consumer electronic and networking industries; connectors primarily for mobile devices, computers, and GPS; wire, AC, and DC halogen free products; and USB output, desk top, car, and wireless chargers, as well as interchangeable plugs, AC and wall-mount adapters, EV charging units, and mechanical components and plastic parts. In addition, the company offers a range of support services. Longwell Company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Analog Integrations Corporation
summary: Analog Integrations Corporation, a fabless IC company, designs, manufactures, tests, and markets analog integrated circuits in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers power conversion products, including low and ultra-low dropout linear regulators, DDR regulators, and voltage references; DC/DC converters for high power and portable applications; and LED backlights and lighting solutions. It also provides power management products, such as USB and regulatory USB power switches, and bare-bone USB switches; supervisory products; and NiMH/NiCd battery chargers, Li-ion battery protection products, and high current drivers. Its products are used in 3C applications in the areas of LCD TV, DSC, mobile phone, MP3, PMP, etc. Analog Integrations Corporation was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Axis Corporation
summary: Axis Corporation, based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is a leading manufacturer and supplier of transformers in the region. The company's diverse product portfolio includes various types of transformers, such as plate-type units, toroidal coils, and high-frequency models, alongside a selection of inductors and other specialized coils. Additionally, Axis produces sealed infusion products. These components are crucial for a wide array of applications, powering everything from commercial business machines, game consoles, and plotters, to charging systems for electric vehicles, hybrid vehicles, and car audio setups. They are also integral to medical precision equipment, lighting power supplies, and a broad spectrum of industrial and communication systems, including transformers specifically designed for power grids. Established in 1986, the company initially operated under the name Gomore Corp. before officially rebranding as Axis Corporation in 1994. Its headquarters remain in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Tekom Technologies, Inc
summary: Tekom Technologies, Inc provides tutoring services in Taiwan. It offers national examination, correspondence, double-effect, and travel teaching products and services. The company is based in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: AcSiP Technology Corp.
summary: AcSiP Technology Corp., an Internet of Things solution company, provides wireless communication services and solutions in Taiwan. The company offers wireless connectivity solutions, including Bluetooth, NFC, Zigbee, GPS, 2G, 4G, and IoT-Wi-Fi and loT-LoRa products, as well as development kits. It also provides system integration and size shrinkage services. AcSiP Technology Corp. was founded in 2009 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Mutual-Tek Industries Co., Ltd.
summary: Mutual-Tek Industries Co., Ltd., established in 2006 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a key player in the design, manufacture, and sale of printed circuit boards (PCBs). The company provides a diverse array of specialized boards catering to various high-tech applications. Their offerings encompass multi-layered flexible and rigid PCBs suitable for camera modules, wearable devices, and medical equipment. Furthermore, they produce slender circuit boards for substrate products, ultra-thin rigid boards specifically for notebook camera (NB CAM) applications, and robust automotive-grade boards.

name: Amazing Microelectronic Corp.
summary: Amazing Microelectronic Corp. provides electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection related solutions in Taiwan. It offers ESD solutions for use in industrial, automotive, and LCM panel, as well as IPC, and DVR and medical electronics applications; and EMI filters for use in LCD/camera display, multimedia card/secure digital memory card, and keypad products of mobile phones and hand held portable devices. It also provides analog switches for video, LAN, Bus, and USB applications; HDMI re-drivers and switches; and RS485/RS232 interface IC solutions for industrial and medical process control, automobile electronics, monitoring system, and building automation networks. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Securitag Assembly Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Securitag Assembly Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells RFID transponders in Taiwan and internationally. It offers cards; keyfobs; tags; and NFC sensor-enabled tag products, as well as metal, non-metal, NFC, tamper proof, and rain RFID labels. The company also provides value-added services, such as thermal transfer printing or encoding on used chips. It serves clients in access control, healthcare, automation, logistic, industrial, entertainment, and NFC markets. Securitag Assembly Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Y-S Electronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1987 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Y-S Electronic Co., Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse range of electronic components. Their core business encompasses cable assemblies, various connectors, and PCB (Printed Circuit Board) assemblies. The company's extensive catalog of cable assemblies and adapters includes solutions such as HDMI, DisplayPort (including Mini DisplayPort), DVI, VGA, and a wide array of USB cables (Type-C, 2.0, 3.1). They also provide coupler adaptors, durable industrial and waterproof cables, medical-grade cables, KVM cables, and networking options like LAN/patch cables. Further offerings consist of D-Sub, RS 232, PS/2, mini DIN, wire harnesses, custom OEM cables, RF cables, audio cables, IEEE 1394, LVDS, as well as fiber optic connectors and cables. Their connector selection features D-Sub Miniature, Modular Jacks, Keystone Jacks, and a variety of USB connectors (3.2 Type-C, 3.2, 2.0 A/B, Micro/Mini USB), alongside specialized waterproof options. Regarding PCBA dongles and OEM products, Y-S Electronic supplies adapters for DisplayPort, Mini DisplayPort, HDMI, and Type-C, in addition to USB peripheral series and bespoke PCB assemblies. These advanced electronic products are widely utilized across various sectors, including computing equipment, information technology, telecommunications, medical, and automotive accessories.

name: NUUO Inc.
summary: NUUO Inc. provides surveillance solutions for recording, monitoring, and third party solution integration for IP and analog cameras in Taiwan and internationally. Its NUUO Crystal Family solutions, such as NUUO NuStation, a Linux enterprise solution; NUUO Titan Pro, a Linux-based VMS solution; NUUO Network Storage solution for surveillance applications; and NUUO Crystal, a VMS solution. The company's NUUO Mainconsole Family solutions include NUUO central management system to manage large scale installations and alarms; NUUO Mainconsole, a NUUO PC based video recording server; NUUO Hybrid Appliance solution to choose a pure DVR, pure NVR, or a hybrid system; NUUO NVRmini 2 and NUUO NVRmini 3 portable NVR solutions; NUUO intelligent video surveillance solution; NUUO IP Appliance solution that provides integration between older and newer types of cameras; NUUO Report Service, which visualizes the people counting data into various graphic types; NUUO NVRSolo_Plus, a Linux embedded standalone solution; and NUUO IVS, a video analytics solution. It also offers NUUO Point of Sale (POS) solution that connects surveillance video with transaction data from POS and ATM; NUUO Facial recognition solution that connects surveillance videos with NUUO Nuface software; NUUO license plate recognition (LPR) solution, which connects surveillance videos with third party LPR solutions; and NUUO Access Control solution that connects surveillance video with access control systems from third party partners. In addition, the company offers NUUO iViewer solution to remotely monitor live video from security cameras; NUUO software development kit; NUUO Temperature Monitoring Panel; NUUO thermal detection solution; IP cameras; VZIII, a retail analytics system; and accessories. It serves retail, transportation, industrial, educational, banking, hospitality, and home markets, as well as government. NUUO Inc. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Easy Field Corporation
summary: Established in 1977 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Easy Field Corporation conducts the full spectrum of activities for machinery and equipment, from research and development to manufacturing and distribution across Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Taomee Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Taomee Co., Ltd. provides online gaming services in Taiwan. Taiwan Taomee Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Arlitech Electronic Corp.
summary: Arlitech Electronic Corp. supplies inductors for LCD panel industry in Taiwan. It offers high current power, SMD power, DIP power, and RF inductors, as well as automotive grade and EMI suppression filters. The company also provides business items; cooling materials, such as graphene papers, thermal conductivity die-casting aluminum alloy, and graphene coating; and thermal solution designs. Its products are used in the display panel, network, industrial, entertainment, storage device, and computer applications. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: TacBright Optronics Corp.
summary: TacBright Optronics Corporation researches, develops, manufactures, and sells triacetate cellulose (TAC) films. It offers TAC films for protective film in liquid crystal displays (LCDs), as well as for sunglasses, photographic equipment filters, anti-glare goggles, car navigation, other polarizing microscopes, special medical glasses, and other purposes. The company serves LCD polarizer manufacturers in Taiwan, South Korea, Japan, and Mainland China. TacBright Optronics Corporation was founded in 2006 and is based in Miaoli, Taiwan.

name: Sinopower Semiconductor, Inc.
summary: Sinopower Semiconductor, Inc. operates as a fabless IC design company in Taiwan. The company designs, markets, and sells power discrete devices, including MOSFET and IGBT; and high voltage power ICs. The company's products are used in various applications, such as computers comprising PCs and servers, as well as power suppliers, communication equipment, handheld devices, consumer products, industrials, etc. Sinopower Semiconductor, Inc. was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Ibase Gaming Inc.
summary: Ibase Gaming Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells gaming systems worldwide. It offers gaming solutions for lottery terminals, kiosks, and casino slots. The company also provides OEM and turnkey ODM solutions for terminals, cabinets, class leading PC hardware, and gaming support peripherals. Ibase Gaming Inc. was founded in 2011 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: PharmaEssentia Corporation
summary: PharmaEssentia Corporation engages in the research, development, production, and sale of therapeutic products for the treatment of human diseases. Its products include ropeginterferon alfa-2b that is used for the treatment of polycythemia vera, essential thrombocythemia, and hepatitis B and C; and Anti-PD-1 antibody for the treatment of cancer. The company also licensed to develop Oraxol for the treatment of breast, advanced gastric, and esophageal cancer; KX01 for the treatment of psoriasis and actinic keratosis. It also focuses on the drug research and development programs in the areas of hematology, infectious disease, oncology, and dermatology. The company has a research collaboration agreement with Axis Therapeutics Limite for the development of T Cell Receptor-T therapy based on the T cell receptor affinity enhancing specific T cell therapy technology platform. PharmaEssentia Corporation was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Hycon Technology Corporation
summary: Hycon Technology Corporation designs, produces, and sells mixed signal microcontroller units, and battery management and touch panel ICs in Taiwan and China. The company offers battery management ICs, such as single cell and multi-cell, and secondary protectors, as well as balance ICs and gas gauges; mixed signal microcontroller units, including microcontroller units, data converters, digital multi-function meters, AC impedance measurement, sensor signal conditioners, low-dropout voltage regulators, LCD controllers and drivers, and application specific standard parts; and capacitive touch ICs. Its products are used in no-switch electronic scale, blood pressure monitor, PIR detector, digital multi-meter, and touch panel applications. The company provides its products under the HYCON brand name. Hycon Technology Corporation was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Intech Biopharm Corporation
summary: Intech Biopharm Corporation focuses on developing and manufacturing generic drugs to treat respiratory diseases. It owns iLEF (inhaled low ethanol formulation), a metered dose inhaler platform to treat asthma and chronic pulmonary obstructive disease; and dry powder inhaler. The company offers its products under the SYN006, SYN010, SYN007, Synflutide, Duasma, Synvent, and SYN011 names. Intech Biopharm Corporation is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Egis Technology Inc.
summary: Egis Technology Inc. engages in the IC design, research, development, testing, and sale of capacitive fingerprint sensors worldwide. It offers universal 2nd factor fingerprint dongle and mobile authentication solutions, and wearable devices. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: ATrack Technology Inc.
summary: ATrack Technology Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells GPS telematics hardware in Taiwan and internationally. It offers hardwired fleet tracking devices, plug and play GPS tracking units, and IP rated tracking devices, as well as accessories. The company's products are used in cars, trucks, containers and non-powered assets, trailers, and motorcycles. ATrack Technology Inc. was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Netmarble Joybomb Inc.
summary: Netmarble Joybomb Inc. develops and publishes mobile, PC, and console games in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macau. The company was formerly known as JoyBomb Entertainment Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Netmarble Joybomb Inc. in December 2014. Netmarble Joybomb Inc. was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Great Tree Pharmacy Co., Ltd.
summary: Great Tree Pharmacy Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise that operates an extensive chain of pharmacies throughout the island nation. These retail outlets offer a broad selection of goods, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, nutritional supplements, products specifically for mothers and infants, and various cosmetics. Beyond its retail presence, the company also delivers comprehensive medication procurement and coordination services to medical establishments such as individual clinics, shared outpatient facilities, and larger integrated healthcare networks. Furthermore, Great Tree Pharmacy acts as an agent for these same medical institutions, assisting them in the distribution and sale of popular health and wellness products sourced both domestically and internationally. Established in 2001, the company was initially named Tianjin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. before rebranding to its current designation. Its main corporate offices are located in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: U-MEDIA Communications, Inc.
summary: U-MEDIA Communications, Inc. engages in research, development, and manufacture of the broadband and IoT streaming technologies in Taiwan and the United States. It offers SMB products, such as outdoors, 5G routers and bridges, wi-fi routers and EAPs, and wired routers. It also provides smart home products, including wi-fi routers, APs, and extenders; 5G CPEs and adapters; and LTE routers. In addition, the company offers LTE and 5G routers for mobiles; and internet appliances, such as streaming music boxes, M2M routers, IoT gateways, and cloud management systems. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Bora Pharmaceuticals Co., LTD.
summary: Bora Pharmaceuticals Co., LTD. engages in the research, development, production, marketing, sale, and distribution of pharmaceutical products worldwide. It manufactures and sells generic, brand, and over-the-counter (OTC) drugs. The company is involved in contract development and manufacturing; consumer healthcare and OTC; and prescription drugs businesses. It also provides clinical and commercial manufacturing services, including solvent manufacturing; solid and liquid dosage forms; extrusion spheronization; immediate and extended release; core, sugar-coated, and film-coated tablets; fixed-dose combination products; and granules, and liquids sachet/stick pack filling. In addition, the company offers pharmaceutical development services, such as liquid and solid dosage forms, and immediate and modified release, analytical method development and validation; packaging and serialization services, which include bottle and blister packaging, and sachets; and raw materials and finished products testing, and analytical techniques services, as well as method verification, validation, and transfer. Further, it provides OTC medicines, foods and vitamins supplements; and skincare products. Additionally, the company also offers market analysis, drug and regulatory related services, price development, GDP warehousing, distribution, packaging, marketing planning, and sales services. The company's sales and distribution network comprises medical centers, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, drug stores, CVS, and specialty channels. Bora Pharmaceuticals Co., LTD. was founded in 2007 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: meimaii Technology Co., Ltd
summary: meimaii Technology Co., Ltd operates as a social, Web, and mobile game publisher. The company also provides live streaming service; and content production/licensing services. It operates in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macao, Japan, Thailand, and the rest of Asia. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: WFE Technology Corp.
summary: WFE Technology Corp. manufactures and sells electrical products primarily in Taiwan. It offers power integration products; and circuit protection products, CO and outside plant products, connectors, diodes, encoders, LED shunt protectors, magnetic products, microelectronic modules, position sensors, potentiometers, resistive products, switches, transistors and thyristors, trimpot trimming potentiometers, pro audio products, and automotive products. The company also provides quartz oscillators and microchips. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Assem Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Assem Technology Co., Ltd engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of board-to-board and flexible printed circuit board connectors in Taiwan. It also offers board to board battery and USB type C connectors. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Fun Yours Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Fun Yours Technology Co.,Ltd. develops online and PC games. It provides role-playing, real-time strategy, action, and puzzle games. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Original BioMedicals Co., Ltd.
summary: Original BioMedicals Co., Ltd. is a biotechnology company focused on creating novel chemical compounds to fulfill critical medical requirements, with an initial emphasis on the healthcare landscape in Taiwan. Its current product pipeline encompasses several key developments: Radprotect (A01): A pre-clinical stage compound designed to offer protection against radiation exposure. CCM-Ami (A02): Engineered to shield healthy tissues from the damaging side effects of both chemotherapy drugs and ionizing radiation. GLP-1 CCM (P01): A therapeutic agent developed for the management of type 2 diabetes. The firm was established in 2011 and operates from its base in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: ASolid Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: ASolid Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a NAND flash controller provider in Taiwan. It offers SD/microSD controllers, USB flash drive controllers, eMMC controllers, and SSD and UFD controllers. The company was founded in 2008 and is based in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Interactive Digital Technologies Inc.
summary: Interactive Digital Technologies Inc. (IDT), established in 2003 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, delivers a wide array of technological solutions and professional services. The company's expertise spans four primary domains: telecommunications, media, information technology and cloud computing, and geographical information systems (GIS). In the realm of telecommunications, IDT designs and implements sophisticated communication network solutions. These offerings encompass technologies such as cable television networks, next-generation broadband transmission and IP networks, audio and multimedia networks, alongside 2G, 3G, 4G, and WiFi wireless communication networks. They also provide systems for network service management and facilitate the seamless integration of both fixed and mobile networks. For its media clients, IDT develops systems crucial for news and program production, digital headend operations, and FM radio stations. The company's information technology and cloud division offers robust solutions focusing on server and storage management, advanced networking infrastructure, and information virtualization. Furthermore, IDT's geographical information system (GIS) offerings find application across diverse sectors. These include defense and telecommunication applications, disaster prevention and relief efforts, land and forest management, water resource management, environmental and ecological monitoring, healthcare, social and cultural initiatives, and support for law enforcement and civic activities.

name: GlobalWafers Co., Ltd.
summary: GlobalWafers Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, researches, designs, develops, and manufactures, semiconductor ingots and wafers in Taiwan and internationally. It offers silicon wafer and ingots; and annealed, diffusion, epitaxial, compound, polished, and SOI wafers. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in Hsinchu, Taiwan. GlobalWafers Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Sino-American Silicon Products Inc.

name: Senhwa Biosciences, Inc.
summary: Senhwa Biosciences, Inc., a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, identifies and develops therapies for the treatment of cancer. The company is developing CX-4945 that is in phase I/II clinical trial in combination with gemcitabine plus cisplatin for the treatment of patients with cholangiocarcinoma; CX-5461 AU, a phase I, open-label, dose escalation, safety, pharmacokinetic, and pharmacodynamics study of intravenously administered CX-5461 in patients with advanced hematologic malignancies; and CX-5461 CA, which is in phase I clinical trial in patients with solid tumors and breast cancer. It is also developing CX-4945-07, which is in phase I clinical trial, multi-center, open-label, treatment duration increment, expansion, safety, and pharmacodynamic study of CX-4945 administered orally twice daily to patients with advanced basal cell carcinoma; and CX-4945 PBTC-053, a pediatric brain tumor consortium that is in phase I/II clinical trial and surgical study of CX-4945 in patients with recurrent SHH medulloblastoma. The company was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Ttbio Corp.
summary: Ttbio Corp. manufactures and sells medical instruments under the TTBIO brand name in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers high and low speed hand piece products, dental spare parts, service rotors, maintenance units, and electric hand piece systems. It also provides precision machined parts and components to various industries, including medical, automotive, aerospace, computer components, security, maintenance parts, and custom machining. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Nyquest Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Nyquest Technology Co., Ltd. researches, designs, and sells integrated circuits (ICs). The company provides voice synthesizer ICs, 4-bit microcontrollers with voice/MIDI products, 8-bit microcontrollers, motor drivers, and other products. It offers LED control and drive, speech, and multi-channel speech/melody ICs; 8-Bit OTP MCU for home appliances; 8-bit MCU with LCD drivers; audio power amplifier ICs, low power LCD driver IC, high power motor driver ICs, 4-bit MCU with touch-keys and LED controllers, and 4-Bit MCU with universal remote controllers; and 32-bit MCUs.
