Its robust pipeline includes LBS-008, an orally administered treatment currently in Phase 3 clinical trials for adolescent Stargardt disease (STGD1) and Phase 2/3 trials for dry age-related macular degeneration (Dry AMD), both aimed at evaluating its safety and effectiveness. Other key candidates are LBS-007, a natural non-ATP CDC7 inhibitor designed to combat various cancers; LBS-002, an anti-tubulin compound targeting primary and metastatic brain tumors; and LBS-009, an oral medication for non-alcoholic fatty liver disease and Type 2 diabetes. The company is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Information Technology Total Services Co., Ltd
summary: Information Technology Total Services Co., Ltd, established in Taipei, Taiwan, in 1999, is a comprehensive provider of technology and business solutions. The company extends its services across Greater China, the Asia Pacific region, and globally, focusing on intelligent application development, extensive IT outsourcing, and business process outsourcing (BPO). Their robust portfolio of SAP solutions encompasses core enterprise resource planning platforms like SAP ERP and S/4HANA, specialized smart manufacturing applications (SAP ME/MII), customer experience management through SAP C/4HANA, and financial planning and consolidation via SAP BPC. They also manage travel and expense with SAP Concur, offer business intelligence and predictive analytics, manage data archiving, provide field service management, develop ABAP customizations, and perform SAP system upgrades and maintenance. Beyond SAP, ITTS delivers innovative IoT-driven smart services for various industries, including intelligent manufacturing, smart catering, and smart transportation. Their IT infrastructure consulting includes integrated computing solutions like Cisco UCS, strategic IT architecture planning, and outsourced IT maintenance services. Additionally, the company's BPO division handles a range of tasks, from call center operations and system implementation to document management services such as billing statement processing, envelope sealing, format printing, and mailing outsourcing. Cloud services are also a significant offering. ITTS serves a diverse clientele across numerous sectors, including governmental bodies, financial institutions, manufacturing, high-technology firms, telecommunications providers, logistics companies, and retail businesses.

name: Shiny Brands Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shiny Brands Group Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the development, formulation, and manufacturing of skincare products, serving both the Taiwanese market and international clientele. The company distributes its diverse range of offerings through its proprietary brands, which include SEXYLOOK, MIRAE, and LUDEYA. Among its notable products are the inventive ear hoop double lifting mask, the unique obsidian black cotton mask, and an extensive collection of enzyme-based skincare treatments. Established in 2009, the firm maintains its primary operations in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Gwo Xi Stem Cell Applied Technology Co. , Ltd
summary: Gwo Xi Stem Cell Applied Technology Co., Ltd. is dedicated to advancing stem cell-based therapies, addressing critical unmet medical needs in patient care. Its product pipeline currently features two pioneering autologous adipose-derived stem cell treatments: GXHPC1, which is in Phase II clinical trials for liver cirrhosis, and GXNPC1, also undergoing Phase II testing, designed for the management of chronic stroke. Further expanding its therapeutic portfolio, the company is advancing GXCPC1, an allogeneic adipose-derived stem cell therapy currently in combined Phase I/II clinical trials for osteoarthritis, alongside GXIPC1, another allogeneic fat-derived stem cell treatment in early-stage Phase I trials for diabetes. Established in 2011, the company maintains its headquarters in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: MARTAS Precision Slide Co., Ltd.
summary: MARTAS Precision Slide Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells ball bearing slides for various applications in Taiwan. Its products are used in server rails, cabinets, and cloud computing devices; tool cabinets, fire cabinets, ATM machines, ending machines, POS machines, and upright open showcases; and office furniture, computer desks, copy machines, and fax machines, as well as in kitchen cabinets, dish washers, ovens, and refrigerators. The company's products are also used for automotive applications, such as in sliding arm rests, under seat and glove box storage, and luggage compartments; and residential applications for living rooms, TV cabinets, bedrooms, closets, cupboards, and restaurants. MARTAS Precision Slide Co.,Ltd was founded in 1996 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Afastor Corporation
summary: Afastor Corporation, headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as an agent specializing in the distribution of information technology products across the country. The company's extensive catalog includes a diverse range of items such as mobile computing devices, data storage solutions, liquid crystal displays (LCDs), various computer peripherals, digital multimedia systems, household appliances, electronic signboards, and factory automation control equipment, among other product lines.

name: Mars Semiconductor Corp.
summary: Mars Semiconductor Corp., a company based in Taiwan, specializes in the development of advanced wireless chips designed for high-bandwidth, long-distance audio and video transmission. Their offerings encompass a range of wireless monitoring solutions for various applications, such as home security, automotive systems, and baby care, in addition to other electronic components. The company also provides an integrated Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) cloud application platform. Mars Semiconductor Corp. was established in 2001 and operates from its main offices in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Advagene Biopharma Co., Ltd.
summary: Advagene Biopharma Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of vaccine technology and related products in Taiwan. Its products in development include nasal spray influenza vaccine, allergy vaccines, other vaccines, etc. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Ever Supreme Bio Technology Co., Ltd
summary: This enterprise is dedicated to the investigation, advancement, and creation of pharmaceutical treatments leveraging human mesenchymal stem cells and immune cells. Its current portfolio features UMC01, a drug candidate undergoing Phase I clinical evaluation for addressing conditions such as myocardial infarction and stroke. Additionally, ADCV01 is progressing through Phase II clinical trials as a potential therapy for aggressive brain tumors. The company also develops CAR001, an innovative chimeric antigen receptor immune cell product, alongside bone-marrow stem cells (BMSC) used in managing chronic stroke, severe osteoarthritis, and spinal cord injuries. Established in 2016, the firm operates from its headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: PADAUK Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: PADAUK Technology Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells microcontrollers. Its products are used in interactive smart toys, remote control appliances, smart household appliances, industrial grade chips, and high-efficiency brushless DC motors. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: SmartDisplayer Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: SmartDisplayer Technology Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells smart display cards in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides all-in-one cards; crypto currency cards; OATH card-type OTP tokens; and EMV display cards. It also offers IC, segmented e-paper, module, and firmware design; semiconductor and graphic e-paper integration; emulation kit; and credit card personalization services, as well as various OTP seed perso solutions. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Keelung, Taiwan.

name: uPI Semiconductor Corp.
summary: uPI Semiconductor Corp., an IC design company, designs and manufactures analog and mixed-signal power management solutions in electronic systems in Taiwan and internationally. It offers Power Management products, such as DC/DC buck controllers and converters, DC/DC boost converters, power device drivers, low dropout regulators, power switch ICs, LED driver ICs, charging ICs, and voltage and current consoles; Battery Management products, including PTIC and charger ICs; and low, medium, and high voltage power MOSFET products. The company also provides application and interface, ultra speed, tiny package speed, high surge, and high voltage TVS products; OP-amplifiers; bio sensors; and GaN solutions. uPI Semiconductor Corp. was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Major-Power Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Major-Power Technology Co., Ltd., an enterprise specializing in the design of analog integrated circuits (ICs), delivers Hall sensor technology and a variety of analog power management components. Operating from its base in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, the company serves clients both domestically and across global markets. Established in 2011, its product portfolio notably includes buck, boost, and Hall ICs, specifically engineered for deployment in LED applications.

name: Sincere Security Co. Ltd.
summary: Sincere Security Co. Ltd. engages in the property management, electrical maintenance, environmental friendly cleaning, and security businesses. The company offers community, factory, and parking lot property management; and director general, administrative secretary, and other manpower dispatch services, as well as generator equipment installation and maintenance, electrical maintenance, central air conditioning system installation and maintenance, air conditioning cooling tower cleaning, water system repair and replacement, fire equipment installation and maintenance, and monitoring system installation services. It also provides environmental friendly cleaning services, such as airport, station, hospital, and building cleaning; floor waxing polishing; stone crystallization grinding; carpet, sofa chair, and office chair sterilization; disinfection; pool cleaning and water quality inspection; exterior wall cleaning; gardening planting; and waste removal services. In addition, the company offers security services, including guardian, system, and personal security, as well as central monitoring system control management services. It serves science parks, hypermarkets, commercial buildings, schools, golf courses, villas and residential areas, and government units. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: JG Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: JG Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd. specializes in the engineering, manufacturing, and implementation of advanced environmental control systems, with a primary focus on mitigating air pollution and facilitating the recovery of energy and valuable resources. The company offers bespoke solutions and expert services encompassing atmospheric purification, odor abatement, smog reduction, and solvent reclamation, alongside initiatives for energy efficiency. These crucial services are extended to demanding sectors such as high-tech electronics, synthetic polyurethane leather production, coating and printing operations, and the chemical industry. Its extensive product portfolio includes sophisticated systems for managing volatile organic compound (VOC) emissions, equipment designed for extracting organic solvents from waste gases, and specialized deodorization units for low-level gaseous molecular contaminants. Additionally, they provide solutions for inorganic acidic/alkaline and toxic gas treatment, control of airborne molecular contamination, thermal oxidizers for industrial exhaust streams, various energy-saving apparatus, and integrated automatic control systems. Beyond its core offerings, the company also delivers comprehensive maintenance services for high-technology manufacturing facilities. Established in 2006, JG Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Cica-Huntek Chemical Technology Taiwan Co., Ltd.
summary: Cica-Huntek Chemical Technology Taiwan Co., Ltd. specializes in providing chemical management solutions across Asia. The company's operations span the design, development, manufacturing, and sale of essential chemical supply systems. Their product range includes specialized equipment for various chemical processes, such as dispensing, mixing, diluting, collecting waste, and regenerating and recycling chemicals. Complementing these systems, Cica-Huntek also offers comprehensive services, including installation, piping, and ongoing system maintenance. The firm's primary business activities are directed from its headquarters located in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Asia Metal Industries, Inc.
summary: Established in 1973 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, Asia Metal Industries, Inc. is a prominent manufacturer and supplier of specialized coating machinery. The company serves a global clientele, with its products reaching markets throughout Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Its extensive portfolio comprises equipment tailored for various applications, including the production of synthetic paper, solar energy components, optical devices, high-frequency and flexible copper clad laminates (CCL), passive electronic parts, batteries, carbon fiber materials, industrial tapes, and transparent conductive films. In addition to its manufacturing activities, the firm delivers comprehensive engineering solutions, offering services such as initial consultations, post-sale support, technical guidance, R&D testing, and facility planning.

name: Up Young Cornerstone Corp.
summary: Up Young Cornerstone Corp. specializes in the distribution of both commercial and residential laundry equipment. Their product range further encompasses a variety of household appliances, including kitchen essentials like refrigerators, dishwashers, and ovens, alongside energy-efficient inverter air conditioning units and automated ironing machines. The company also leverages e-commerce, operating online stores to make its products accessible to customers. Founded in 1968, Up Young Cornerstone Corp. maintains its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Luminescence Technology Corp.
summary: Luminescence Technology Corp. manufactures and sells organic chemicals in North America, Europe, Asia, and Taiwan. Its product-range includes organic light emitting diode (OLED) material, OPV material, OTFT material, organic intermediates, boronic acid, and ITO patterned glass and components. The company offers patented materials, biomedical science, organic light emitting diode (OLED), thermally activated delayed fluorescence OLED, solution-processed OLED, organic photovoltaic, dye-sensitized solar cell, perovskite solar cells, organic thin-film transistor, flexible printed electronics, photonic and optical device, synthetic intermediates and reagents, and electrode/substrate and sealing. It offers organic optoelectronic materials in the markets of OLED, OPV, and OTFT have led luminescence technology. Luminescence Technology Corp. is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Lagis Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Lagis Enterprise Co., Ltd., a medical device development company, develops and markets medical devices for the laparoscopic and endoscopic surgical markets worldwide. Its products include trocars, single port surgery devices, and wound protectors; endo devices, such as hand instruments and advanced bipolar devices; specimen retrieval products; suction irrigation systems and irrigation pumps; training systems; and related accessories. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Femco Steel Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Femco Steel Technology Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, markets, and distributes steel golf shafts to golf club original equipment manufacturers and distributors worldwide. The company offers steel shafts under the FST and KBS brand names. Femco Steel Technology Co., Ltd. is based in Chiayi, Taiwan.

name: Sensortek Technology Corp.
summary: Sensortek Technology Corp. provides a range of sensor chips. Its principal products include ambient light sensors, proximity sensors, and MEMS accelerometers that are used in various applications, such as mobile phones, smart phones, tablets, laptops, digital cameras, and consumer electronics. The company is based in Jhubei City, Taiwan.

name: BioGend Therapeutics Co., Ltd.
summary: BioGend Therapeutics Co., Ltd. develops regenerative bio-orthopaedic medicines. It is developing BiG-001 and BiG-006, an osteo-inductive bone graft substitute; and BiG-009, an autologous chondrocyte repair system. The company is also involved in developing bio-orthopaedic devices and treatment methods to fulfill unmet clinical needs. BioGend Therapeutics Co., Ltd. was founded in 2016 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: iXensor Co., Ltd.
summary: iXensor Co., Ltd. develops, produces, and sells hardware and software systems for in-vitro diagnostic medical devices. The company's PixoTest technology uses the lighting and image sensing module of the smartphone to detect the color change reaction on the biochemical test strip. It offers PixoTest Blood Glucose Monitoring System and PixoTest POCT System for chronic diseases management; Eveline Smart Fertility System for women's health management; and systems for infectious disease management, as well as PixoHealth App, which measures, records, and uploads test readings to the cloud. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: AMIDA Technology, Inc.
summary: AMIDA Technology, Inc. develops and provides electronic testing and measurement solutions for the semiconductor and optical industries in Taiwan. The company offers CMOS image sensing testers and VCSEL wafer measurement systems; analog and mixed signal testers; and high power 3600 series testers. It also provides PCI modules, such as GPIB cards with PCI interfaces; time interval counter modules for PCI computers; and single-channel PCI-based arbitrary waveform generators. The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Solid Year Co., Ltd.
summary: Solid Year Co., Ltd. engages in the production of various single-shot and double-shot plastic injection finished products. Its products include computer keyboard, USB network camera, USB network camera module, driving recorder, hunting machine, projector, gamepad, automotive electronics, in-car multimedia audio and video system, smart rear-view mirror, head-up display, iPhone Computer electronic peripheral products, such as Car Box, infant network surveillance camera, etc. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: MAYO Human Capital Inc.
summary: MAYO Human Capital Inc. provides human resources management solutions to various industries and enterprises. The company offers Apollo, a human resources solution that integrates functions, such as attendance punching, scheduling, leave, salary, recruitment, signing, organization, and management. It also provides STAYFUN, an employee benefits integration platform that allows the company to have choices for gifts and employee benefits. In addition, the company offers Cornerstone, an integrated cloud platform, which covers online learning modules, training goal setting, performance management and core talent data management, visual talent placement and analysis, enterprises implement talent management strategies, successor bench strength building, and perfect talent development system creation. Further, it provides customized internal training courses to companies related to professional staff-only human resource consultants; and personnel administration commission professional outsourcing services. MAYO Human Capital Inc. is headquartered in Hsinchu County, Taiwan.

name: Grade Upon Technology Corp
summary: Grade Upon Technology Corp. specializes in the design, production, and distribution of sensor technologies within Taiwan. Its diverse product portfolio includes multi-sensor units, liquid detection sensors, and both wireless and wired sensor solutions crafted for various applications. The company also furnishes advanced remote control management systems for centralized monitoring and operational command. Beyond its hardware offerings, Grade Upon Technology is deeply involved in integrating intelligent hardware with bespoke software, providing Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) cloud solutions, and developing comprehensive Internet of Things (IoT) platforms. Founded in 2005, the company's headquarters are located in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Mobix Corporation
summary: Mobix Corporation operates mobile based e-commerce platform in Taiwan. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan. Mobix Corporation is a subsidiary of Kuobrothers Corp.

name: 91App, Inc.
summary: 91APP, Inc., founded in 2013 and based in Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company. It specializes in providing cloud-based software solutions engineered to merge offline and online retail experiences for businesses in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Malaysia. The company's offerings include: eCom + App Premium: A dedicated platform aimed at boosting the growth and improving the performance of online stores. OMO Essential: A specialized store assistant solution tailored for the requirements of small and medium-sized retail outlets. OMO Enterprise: A comprehensive suite that integrates e-commerce functionalities, mobile application capabilities, in-store assistance tools, advanced OMO (Offline-Merge-Online) solutions, and retail-focused artificial intelligence. Beyond its software, 91APP also manages 360 TP Operation, which serves as a digital agency. This service provides extensive brand management activities such as maintaining official websites, overseeing product catalogs, executing marketing campaigns, managing e-commerce platforms, developing advertisements (including video content), processing orders, delivering customer service, conducting data analysis, and offering OMO strategic consultation. 91APP serves a diverse range of clients, from individual e-commerce stores and traditional brick-and-mortar business owners to large-scale mega-chain enterprises.

name: Feng Chi Biotech Corp.
summary: Feng Chi Biotech Corp., a company based in Taipei, Taiwan, specializes in offering a diverse range of diagnostic and scientific services. Their core activities encompass genetic screening for both pre-implantation and prenatal stages, comprehensive life science support, and early detection screening for newborns. Additionally, they perform microbiological assessments for the food and pharmaceutical sectors, alongside engaging in medical translational research. The company also acts as a supplier for various genetic testing technologies and products specifically tailored for the field of oncology.

name: Tix Corporation
summary: Tix Corporation, through its subsidiary, operates as an entertainment company in the United States and internationally. The company provides discount ticketing and discount dinner reservations services. It offers discount tickets under short-term, exclusive, and nonexclusive agreements in Las Vegas at a discount of up to 50 percent for same day shows, concerts, attractions, and tours, as well as discount dining and shopping offers. As of March 19, 2020, the company operated nine discount ticket stores in Las Vegas under its Tix4Tonight marquee; and tix4tonight.com, an online ticket sales site. In addition, it provides online booking services for shows, concerts, tours, attractions, and other entertainment and leisure activities. The company was formerly known as Cinema Ride, Inc. and changed its name to Tix Corporation in March 2005. Tix Corporation was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Studio City, California.

name: ACRO Biomedical Co., Ltd.
summary: ACRO Biomedical Co., Ltd. is dedicated to the creation and manufacturing of biomaterial-based medical devices, specifically designed for applications in human tissue engineering and regenerative medicine. This company was established on June 26, 2014, and operates primarily from its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Tech-Top Engineering Co. Ltd.
summary: Tech-Top Engineering Co. Ltd. operates as an engineering firm across both Taiwan and mainland China. The company delivers specialized services for critical infrastructure, encompassing the design and implementation of cleanrooms, air conditioning systems, and laboratory facilities. Their capabilities further extend to providing essential utility solutions such as water and electrical supply networks, alongside advanced fire control systems. Beyond specific facility setups, Tech-Top offers end-to-end project management, from initial engineering design and procurement to construction and complete turnkey project delivery. They also provide comprehensive client support through training programs, system commissioning, and ongoing maintenance services. Diversifying its business activities, the firm is additionally involved in the renewable energy sector, operating solar power plants for electricity generation. Tech-Top Engineering Co. Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Acer Synergy Tech Corp.
summary: Acer Synergy Tech Corp. specializes in delivering a comprehensive suite of information technology solutions and related services. Their enterprise architecture offerings encompass strategic planning and design for critical IT components like computer rooms, networks, and overall infrastructure. This also includes managing virtual desktops, overseeing information security monitoring, developing business continuity strategies, and crafting virtual architecture plans. The company further excels in information system integration, handling tasks such as the complete construction of computer room networks, meticulous installation and configuration of networks, and the building, installation, and fine-tuning of infrastructure, alongside associated design and implementation services. For ongoing operational support, Acer Synergy Tech delivers information infrastructure maintenance services. These cover server and storage equipment monitoring and upkeep, managing maintenance for data center networks and communications, virtual system support, terminal desktop management, and troubleshooting for other office automation (OA) equipment. Their outsourcing capabilities include managing outsourced IT personnel, supplying short-term staffing, and offering project-specific support. Additionally, Acer Synergy Tech develops intelligent innovation solutions, spanning areas such as terminal devices, public sector applications, industry-specific uses, scenario-based applications, core technology platforms, and both cloud and fundamental computing services. Established in 2017, the company's headquarters are located in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Galaxy Software Services Corporation
summary: Galaxy Software Services Corporation, founded in 1987 and based in Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in a diverse range of information technology solutions. The company provides cloud-based SaaS services, software consulting, and custom software design and development for clients in Taiwan, China, and internationally. Its extensive offerings encompass enterprise application software, including systems for human resources, document management, enterprise social networking, and chatbot platforms, as well as tools for credit risk and IFRS asset management. Additionally, the company delivers IT systems management, robust information security services, project development and operational support, and sophisticated big data analysis.

name: Lungteh Shipbuilding Co., Ltd.
summary: Lungteh Shipbuilding Co, Ltd. designs and builds ships. It engages in building work boats, including environmental services craft and other special purpose vessels, as well as passenger ferries and naval combat boats. The company was founded in 1979 and is based in Dongshan, Taiwan.

name: Lian Hong Art. Co., Ltd.
summary: Lian Hong Art. Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise specializing in the development and production of diverse hinge mechanisms. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of hinge types, such as auto-lock, dual-axis synchronization, center, sheathed pipespring, autostand, Webcam kickstand, link, POM, motor clutch, and car seat headrest adjustment hinges. Additionally, it fabricates specialized hinge stands. These high-quality components are engineered for integration into various products, including laptop computers, digital cameras, display stands, and automotive applications. Lian Hong Art. Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Tigerair Taiwan Co., Ltd.
summary: Tigerair Taiwan Co., Ltd. provides airline services. It offers international transportation services for passengers and cargo; and ground handling services. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan. Tigerair Taiwan Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Airlines Co., Ltd.

name: A-SPINE Asia Co., Ltd.
summary: A-SPINE Asia Co., Ltd. functions as a medical device enterprise, specializing in the entire cycle of research, development, production, and worldwide distribution of spinal implants and surgical instruments. The company's market presence spans numerous countries, including Taiwan, China, the Philippines, Australia, New Zealand, Iran, Vietnam, Indonesia, Spain, Trinidad, and Sri Lanka. Their product catalog features a variety of spinal stabilization systems, such as solutions for cervical anterior fixation, alongside thoracic and lumbar fixation devices. Additionally, A-SPINE Asia provides a comprehensive range of interbody fusion systems, encompassing ACDF, PLIF, TLIF, and ALIF cages. Its offerings further extend to balloon kyphoplasty and vertebral body replacement devices. Beyond its own manufactured products, the firm also acts as a distributor for a selection of imported orthopedic medical equipment. Established in 2001, A-SPINE Asia Co., Ltd. is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Wendell Industrial Co., Ltd
summary: Wendel is a private equity firm specializing in equity financing in middle markets and later stages through leveraged buy-out transactions. It invests in both listed and non-listed companies. The firm seeks to invest in United States, Canada, Africa, Europe, and European Developed Markets. It invests between €250 million ($305.51 million) and €500 million ($611.03 million) in companies. It prefers to take a majority stake in its portfolio companies. The firm seeks to take a seat on the board of directors or supervisory board of its portfolio companies. It makes balance sheet investments. Wendel was founded in 1704 and is headquartered in Paris, France with additional offices across Asia, North America, United Kingdom and Europe.

name: Delta Asia International Corporation
summary: Delta Asia International Corporation, headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, specializes in the production and distribution of both components and finished goods for the medical device industry. This Taiwanese firm commenced operations in 2004.

name: Green World Fintech Service Co., Ltd.
summary: Green World Fintech Service Co., Ltd. operates as a financial technology enterprise, primarily focused on delivering third-party payment solutions. Their diverse service portfolio includes processing credit card transactions, providing both traditional and internet-based ATM functionalities, and enabling payments via supermarket codes or barcodes. This company was established in 1996 and maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Ace Edulink Co., Ltd.
summary: Ace Edulink Co., Ltd. provides small to high school short-term study and tutoring services. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Wiltrom Co., Ltd.
summary: Wiltrom Co., Ltd. researches, develops, and produces a range of implantable medical devices. Its products include spinal fixation systems, interbody fusion systems, bone graft substitutes, vertebral body augmentation systems, and vertebroplasty bone cement. The company is based in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp.
summary: Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation provides chip design and manufacturing services. It offers foundry, design, overhaul, manufacturing, and memory wafer testing services. The company was formerly known as Maxchip Electronics Corp and changed its name to Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation in September 2018. Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corporation was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan. Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp. operates as a subsidiary of Powerchip Technology Corporation.

name: Entire Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Entire Technology Co.,Ltd. operates in the optoelectronics material technology industry in Taiwan. The company offers light guide and diffuser plates for various applications, including TV screens, commercial displays, computer monitors, notebooks, tablets, SATNAV, POS terminals, industrial computers, gaming machines, and advertising signs, as well as LED backlight modules car displays, edge-lit LED panels, emergency lights, commercial advertising lights, illumination components, and equipment lightings; composite plates for 5G applications and consumer electronics cases; polycarbonate composites injections for backlight module plastic frames, which are used in electronic, machinery, and automobile industries; and composite materials and optical films for used in smartphones or in-car displays. Entire Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Study King Co., Ltd.
summary: Study King Co., Ltd. provides digital learning content. It offers high school audio-visual interactive teaching materials. The company was founded in 2012 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Tsky Co.,Ltd
summary: Tsky Co., Ltd. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of GPS watches and bands, and wearable devices that are used for golf, running, cycling, swimming, and track record. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Zhubei City, Taiwan.

name: Alar Pharmaceuticals Inc.
summary: Alar Pharmaceuticals Inc., a drug development company, focuses on developing long-acting release drug products for CNS disorders and chronic diseases in Taiwan. The company develops ALA-1000 for the treatment of opioid use disorder. Its pre-clinical stage product includes ALA-1300 and ALA-2000 for the treatment of opioid use disorder; ALA-4000 to treat Parkinson’s disease; ALA-3000 for treating treatment-resistant depression; and ALA-5000 to treat schizophrenia. Alar Pharmaceuticals Inc. was founded in 2016 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: iSTART-TEK INC.
summary: Istart-Tek Inc. provides memory testing and repairing solutions for SoC designers worldwide. The company is based in Zhubei City, Taiwan.

name: Kingray Technology Corporation, Ltd.
summary: Kingray Technology Corporation, Ltd. engages in the semiconductor wafer, diode, and LED epitaxil wafer business. It offers narrow band pass filters, new blue glasses, organic blue glasses, blue glass filters, reflective and UV IR cut filters, optical filters, rectangle and octagon OEM dicing products, and circular OEM drills; high reflective filters, anti-reflective filters, IR pass filters, beam spiltters, and dichroic color filters; and mobile phone camera module assemblies and security surveillance camera modules. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Brillian Network & Automation Integrated System Co. Ltd.
summary: Brillian Network & Automation Integrated System Co. Ltd. provides and integrates the network communication systems and automation technologies to its clients in Taiwan and China. The company offers RFID system for critical material tracking, advanced material handling module and integrated tracking systems, advanced material transfer module system, micro pollution control transmission system, and fire protection system, as well as customization products and solutions. Brillian Network & Automation Integrated System Co. Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Miaoli, Taiwan.

name: VisEra Technologies Company Ltd.
summary: VisEra Technologies Company Limited manufactures and sells electronic spare parts in Taiwan. It also researches, develops, designs, manufactures, sells, packages, and tests color filters. In addition, the company offers image sensor foundry solutions, which include CMOS image sensor that performs the role of an electronic film in digital photography equipment; and wafer level testing and wafer level optical thin film services. Its CMOS image sensor products are used in various areas, such as digital cameras, camera phones, web cameras, notebooks, security devices, automobiles, and miniature imaging devices used in medical applications. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan. VisEra Technologies Company Limited is a subsidiary of Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited.

name: Yuen Foong Yu Consumer Products Co., Ltd.
summary: Yuen Foong Yu Consumer Products Co., Ltd produces and sells household paper in Taiwan. The company is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Auto-Design Co.
summary: Taiwan Auto-Design Co., founded in 1980 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in providing engineering analysis and SAP system software. Their extensive offerings include Ansys software, which facilitates diverse simulations like structural and fluid dynamics, electronic and motor design, 3D modeling, material management, system optimization, and optical and virtual reality applications. The company also delivers cloud-based services, encompassing computing platforms, infrastructure hosting, and custom private cloud planning. Furthermore, their portfolio features specialized professional simulation software for mechanism and system motion analysis, chemical process and system thermodynamics, material engineering and scientific applications, and calculations involving plasma and rare gas reactions, alongside various enterprise e-software solutions.

name: Unictron Technologies Corporation
summary: Unictron Technologies Corp. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of antennas and piezoelectric ceramic elements for use in various electronic devices in Taiwan and internationally. The company provides antennas, such as chip, patch, and custom-made antennas; and piezoelectric ceramic elements, including automobile parking sensors, ultrasonic transducers, weaving machine actuators, and touch panel sensors. It also offers over-voltage and over-current circuit protection components comprising spark gaps, gas tubes, thyristors, transient voltage suppressors, ZnO-based varistors, PPTC resettable fuses, and other fuses. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Hsin-Chu, Taiwan.

name: Tien Li Offshore Wind Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Tien Li Offshore Wind Technology Co., Ltd. produces and sells wind turbine blades, wind turbine molds, and other products. It also provides offshore wind operation and maintenance, as well as blade or composite materials research and development technical advisory services. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: UnicoCell Biomed Co., Ltd.
summary: UnicoCell Biomed Co., Ltd., a biomedical company, researches and develops stem cell therapeutic products, cell therapy technology, and regenerative medicine applications in Taiwan. It develops CT21-ELIXCYTE, which is in Phase 2 clinical trials for the treatment of knee osteoarthritis; and CT31-ELIXCYTE for the treatment of renal failure. The company offers Perfectin, a stem cell secretion and can be used as a raw material for skin care products; and UnicoVial, a cell storage container. UnicoCell Biomed Co., Ltd. was founded in 2018 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Medimaging Integrated Solution Inc.
summary: Medimaging Integrated Solution Inc. provides digital and portable diagnostic solutions. It designs and manufactures digital hand-held diagnostic scopes, as well as auxiliary tools. The company was founded in 2010 and is based in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Advanced Nanotech Inc.
summary: Taiwan Advanced Nanotech Inc. (TAN) specializes in the creation and manufacturing of products essential for isolating nucleic acids. The company's diverse range of offerings includes specialized reagent kits, which are utilized for extracting DNA and RNA from a wide array of biological specimens such as blood, cells, tissues, plants, bacteria, and viruses. TAN also supplies magnetic nanoparticles, specifically super-paramagnetic iron oxide and ultra-small super-paramagnetic iron oxide, designed for various molecular biology applications. Their product line extends to automated instruments for efficient genetic material extraction and crucial consumables like spin tips and deep well plates. These solutions are provided to public health agencies, diagnostic laboratories, hospitals, and other related clinical and research institutions. The company, established in 2004, operates out of Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Flight International Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, Flight International Co., Ltd. specializes in three core areas: brand promotion, the organization and management of sporting events, and talent representation.

name: ECOVE Environment Corp.
summary: ECOVE Environment Corp. provides engineering and environmental services to public and private entities in Taiwan, Macau, China, Southeast Asia, India, and the United States. It finances, plans, constructs, operates, and maintains energy-from-waste plants, hazardous and special waste treatment plants, water and wastewater treatment plants, photovoltaic power plants, and resource reclamation and treatment plants. The company's services include operations and maintenance, consulting, and investment and development of public and private entities. It also offers technical and consulting services, such as mechatronics system and equipment maintenance and upgrade, commissioning, and testing for energy-from-waste, railway, waste management, and public utility sectors. In addition, the company is involved in developing, operating, and managing photovoltaic power plants with a total capacity of 25 megawatts; and the recycling of PET bottles. The company was formerly known as KD Holding Corp. ECOVE Environment Corp. was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan. ECOVE Environment Corporation operates as a subsidiary of CTCI Corporation.

name: Axman Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Axman Enterprise Co., Ltd. designs, develops, manufactures, tests, and sells bicycles. It provides road bikes, mountain bikes, and carbon fiber frames. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Changhua County, Taiwan.

name: Fositek Corp.
summary: Fositek Corp. designs, manufactures, and distributes consumer electronic components. The company produces connecting rotating shafts, cantilever brackets, and other components for computers, optics, appliances, and communications and medical equipment. It markets its products in Asia, the United States, and internationally. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Shinfox Energy Co., Ltd
summary: Shinfox Energy International Inc. engages in oil trading business. The company is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

name: 3D Global Biotech Inc.
summary: Based in New Taipei City, China, 3D Global Biotech Inc. (3DGBI) specializes in the development of advanced medical materials designed for human body reconstruction. The company leverages sophisticated cell culture systems, cutting-edge 3D printing technology, and proprietary bio-inks hydrogel to create personalized, patient-specific cell-based medical products. Beyond product manufacturing, 3DGBI is dedicated to building platforms for human tissue and organ regeneration, engineering customized medical equipment, and undertaking significant professional research. Its extensive product range includes artificial bone substitutes, skull fixation systems, biological dressings, bio-inks, and bioprinting machinery. They also offer specialized solutions for orthopedic, dental, cranial, and scalp reconstruction. The company serves a broad spectrum of clients, including medical centers, research institutions, businesses, and distributors. 3DGBI actively fosters an interdisciplinary alliance, bringing together expertise from industry, government, academia, research, and medicine. It was established in 2014.

name: Bio Preventive Medicine Corp.
summary: Bio Preventive Medicine Corp., a biotechnology firm currently in the clinical development phase, specializes in the proactive identification and mitigation of various illnesses. The company develops comprehensive strategies for the prevention, screening, and ongoing oversight of chronic conditions and cancer treatment. A key offering is the DNlite test, a suite of proprietary and medically validated non-intrusive urine analyses designed to aid in the management of diabetic kidney disease, encompassing specific products like DNlite-IVD103 and DNlite-DN_Score. Established in 2014, its main operations are located in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Acer E-Enabling Service Business Inc.
summary: Acer E-Enabling Service Business Inc. (AEB) specializes in providing a broad spectrum of information and communication technology (ICT) solutions and services, with its primary operations located in Taiwan. The company's diverse offerings encompass an electronic publishing platform, advanced 4GL systems with graphical interfaces, a cloud-based ticketing system, and comprehensive tools for managing Microsoft Azure accounts along with performance analytics dashboards. Additionally, AEB provides the eSupplier hub for optimizing supply chain cash flow, a system for tracking remote work attendance and meeting check-ins, and its own proprietary AEB cloud management platform. Beyond these specific products, AEB delivers extensive services including strategic industry planning and consultation, value-added application development planning, custom system creation, robust information security protocols, and ongoing operational support. These services are tailored for a wide range of industries, such as the public sector, finance, telecommunications, manufacturing, healthcare, education, and high technology. Incorporated in 2012, AEB is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, and functions as a subsidiary of Acer BeingWare Holding Inc.

name: Saultech Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Saul Tech Technology Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and sells precision equipment. It offers IC products in various series, such as wafer to tray, wafer to wafer, wafer to tape, and multi-function sorter products; LED mapping sorters and mini LED die attachments; and LD bar attachments. The company is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: GeneTouch Corp., Ltd
summary: GeneTouch Corp., Ltd. designs and manufactures touch technology products. The company offers infrared touch, PCAP touch, and digital signage products, as well as wireless presentation solutions and accessories. It also provides electronics manufacturing service FOR OEM/ODM customers. GeneTouch Corp., Ltd. Was founded in 2009 is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Lukas Biomedical Inc.
summary: Lukas Biomedical Inc. engages in the research and the development of immunotherapy for cancer treatment. It is also involved in the rental of medical equipment. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Diamond Biotechnology Co., Ltd
summary: Diamond Biotechnology Co., Ltd is a company focused on the entire lifecycle of medical equipment and skincare products, from research and development to manufacturing and sales. Operating both domestically within Taiwan and across international markets, the firm's beauty care offerings include well-known lines such as Timera and Diamond Beauty. In addition to its core product activities, the company also provides leasing services for medical apparatus. Diamond Biotechnology was established in 2014 and maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: MetaEdge Corporation
summary: MetaEdge Corporation provides data warehousing and business intelligence (BI) consulting services to enterprise customers in China. Its solutions cover BI tools and software, and education and training related services. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Winston Medical Supply Co.,Ltd
summary: Winston Medical Supply Co.,Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, and distribution of pharmaceuticals, nutrition supplements, and cosmeceutical products. It offers sterile ophthalmic preparations comprising gels, suspensions, solutions, and emulsions; hormone preparations, which primarily cover birth control and oral suspension for cancer related cachexia; external use preparations comprising ointments; and other oral preparations, which are in oral dosage forms, such as powders, troches, tables, film coated tablets, chewables, and capsules for the treatment of colds, gastrointestinal issues, or other indications. The company was founded in 1974 and is based in Tainan City, Taiwan. As of January 2014, Winston Medical Supply Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Medigen Biotechnology Corp.

name: Advanced Wireless & Antenna Inc.
summary: Advanced Wireless & Antenna Inc. manufactures and sells computer and communication connectors in Taiwan and internationally. It offers Wi-Fi, NFC, networking, and 3D antennas; and NFC modules with antennas, as well as Netcom antennas. Its products are used in computer, electronic communication, telecommunications, automotive, medical, and Internet of Things and other related markets. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Oriental System Technology Inc.
summary: Oriental System Technology Inc., established in 1979 and headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, specializes in supplying optoelectronic components to the Taiwanese market. Its offerings encompass a variety of products, including thermopile array modules, as well as thermopile and non-dispersive infrared (NDIR) gas sensors.

name: Acon Optics Communications Inc.
summary: Acon Optics Communications Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells fiber optical components worldwide. It offers connectors, adapters, patch cords, FTTA cables with mesh cover and angled boot, accessories, fiber optic extenders, fiber optic and copper transceivers, and water repellent materials; MPO/MTP solutions; and data center solutions, such as cassette series, panel series, and cable management. The company was founded in 2017 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: LinkCom Manufacturing Co.,LTD.
summary: LinkCom Manufacturing Co., Ltd. designs, produces, and sells magnetic components, intelligent power supplies, and intelligent lighting control solutions worldwide. Its products are used in 5G, electric car, IoT, ehealth, network communication, and industrial control applications. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Greenfiltec Ltd.
summary: Greenfiltec Ltd. is a Taiwan-based company, established in 2014 and headquartered in Taoyuan City, that provides advanced solutions for the prevention and control of airborne molecular contaminants (AMC) to the semiconductor and panel industries worldwide. Their extensive product range includes various specialized filtration systems such as modular and panel-type chemical filters, cartridge filters, magnetic adhesion filter frames, V-shaped panel filters, high-capacity multi-function filters, mobile micro-pollution filtration systems, and ChemFFU systems. Additionally, they offer AMC measurement and analysis tools. Greenfiltec also delivers comprehensive services, encompassing filter installation and replacement, total AMC management, and custom AOI/OM (Automated Optical Inspection/Optical Microscopy) solutions. Their primary customers are wafer foundries, panel manufacturers, and dynamic random access memory (DRAM) producers.

name: Qbic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Qbic Technology Co., Ltd. develops and sells commercial and industrial grade devices in Taiwan. The company provides smart panel-PCs, embedded and fanless ARM box-PCs, fanless AI edge computers, embedded and fanless x86 box-PCs, single board computers, OQupancy manager devices, kiosks, and accessories It offers devices for facility management, embedded computing, retail and hospitality solution, interactive smart technology, and design and manufacturing. The company is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Puritic Corp.
summary: Taiwan Puritic Corp., founded in 1985 and headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, operates within the Taiwanese market, specializing in the distribution and upkeep of integrated circuit semiconductors, various electronic devices, and computer systems. The company provides a diverse array of offerings, including advanced LN2 delivery mechanisms, PSA-type nitrogen gas generators, wet processing apparatus, and purification units. Additionally, it supplies gas distribution and monitoring networks, as well as chemical dispensing solutions. Taiwan Puritic is also involved in original equipment and design manufacturing (OEM/ODM), offering equipment modernization, custom development services, nebulizer meshes/plates, and comprehensive material analysis.

name: MegaPro Biomedical Co., Ltd
summary: MegaPro Biomedical Co., Ltd. operates as a biotechnology enterprise primarily focused on pioneering nanodrugs. Its innovative development pipeline includes MPB-1523, an IOP injection currently in Phase II clinical evaluation for addressing hepatocellular carcinoma. Simultaneously, MPB-1514, an iron injection, is also undergoing Phase II clinical trials, targeting iron deficiency anemia. Furthermore, the firm is advancing MPB-1734, an anti-cancer pharmaceutical, which is in preclinical assessment for the treatment of malignant tumors. Established in 2014, this company is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: ChenFull Precision Co., Ltd.
summary: ChenFull Precision Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese manufacturer specializing in high-precision components for two distinct global sectors: the civil aviation industry and the advanced optoelectronic and semiconductor equipment industry. For aerospace, the company fabricates essential structural parts and critical engine cases for commercial aircraft worldwide. These structural components are crafted using advanced multi-axis (3-axis and 5-axis) milling and integrated turning processes. They also contribute key aerospace components, including specific parts for friction stirring welding development, and various commercial aircraft engine housings (excluding automatic data capture elements). Within the optoelectronic and semiconductor sectors, ChenFull provides a comprehensive array of specialized vacuum solutions. These include diverse vacuum parts, integrated aluminum alloy and stainless steel vacuum chambers, high vacuum welded aluminum chambers, and a variety of customized and special process vacuum coating chambers. Established in Taichung, Taiwan, in 1976, ChenFull Precision Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Chen Full International Co., Ltd.

name: King's Metal Fiber Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: King's Metal Fiber Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based enterprise providing a variety of materials and specialized solutions. The company's primary offerings encompass thermal-resistant materials, particularly those integral to hollow glass formation and automotive glass blending. These products and services are supplied to diverse clients, including the glass manufacturing industry and the smart clothing retail sector. Operating from its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan, King's Metal Fiber Technologies also serves as a subsidiary of Tex-Ray Industrial Co., Ltd.

name: T-Conn Precision Corporation
summary: T-Conn Precision Corporation engages in the engages in the production and sales of electronic connectors. T-Conn Precision Corporation was founded in 2002 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Power Master II Holdings. Co., Ltd.
summary: Power Master II Holdings Co., Ltd. is a specialized firm dedicated to providing comprehensive solar power solutions. The company's extensive services cover the entire lifecycle of solar projects, including engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracts, strategic investments in power generation facilities, ongoing maintenance and operational management, and advanced energy storage systems. Additionally, Power Master II Holdings is involved in the development and manufacturing of crucial solar photovoltaic (PV) components, such as solar modules, mounting brackets, and power inverters. This Taiwanese company, established in 1999, operates from its headquarters in New Taipei City.

name: BTL Inc.
summary: BTL, Inc. provides testing and certification services for electronic products. Its products include mobile communications, BQB, Sar/Ota, IoT, EMC, RF, telecom, safety and new energy. It offers certifications for electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), radiofrequency (RF), and safety. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Ever Fortune.AI Co., Ltd.
summary: Ever Fortune.AI Co Ltd is a Taiwan-based company mainly engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of medical artificial intelligence software related products. The Company mainly provides medical big data and cloud biomedical platform, medical artificial intelligence (AI) technology solutions, analysis technology and services, and customized medical AI technology solutions.

name: Nexora Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: E-Elements Technology Co., LTD., based in Taiwan, specializes in delivering advanced field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and programmable logic gate array (PLGA) design services. The company further provides expert technical consulting and comprehensive education and training programs. Its robust product portfolio features integrated Multi-Processor Systems-on-Chip (MPSoC), high-performance accelerator cards, and HAPS connectivity solutions. These cutting-edge offerings serve diverse industries such as intelligent manufacturing, healthcare, wireless communication, financial technology (Fintech), and design verification. E-Elements Technology Co., LTD. was established in 2005 and operates from its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: JDV Control Valves Co., Ltd.
summary: JDV Control Valves Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, engineering, and manufacturing of various types of valves. These crucial components are utilized across a wide array of sectors, including semiconductors, petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, steel production, natural gas, power generation, and the paper industry, among others. The enterprise was established by Shun Tien Fan in 1975 and is headquartered in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Norbel Baby Co., Ltd
summary: Norbel Baby Co., Ltd is a Taiwanese company that offers a diverse range of products, encompassing maternity and infant care items, medical provisions, nutritional supplements, and beauty products. Their merchandise is also available for purchase through a network of franchised retail locations. Established in 1986, this firm maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Greenyn Biotechnology Co., Ltd
summary: Greenyn Biotechnology Co., Ltd is an enterprise specializing in dietary supplements, dedicated to the development, production, and worldwide distribution of health-enhancing products. Their product portfolio includes a range of proprietary active ingredients. These feature notable components such as Insumate, derived from bitter melon extract; Antromax, which utilizes antrodia cinnamomea; and the Zymologist 101 Phyto fermented drink. Beyond individual ingredients, Greenyn provides an extensive selection of functional product series catering to a diverse array of health and wellness needs. These encompass solutions for youth and beauty, digestive and brain health, overall body regulation, throat care, hair care, vision support, and various lifestyle enhancement formulas. Additional ranges include joint health, general nutritional and energy supplementation, immune modulation, low-burden options, sleep assistance, body contouring, circulatory support, specific formulas for men's vitality and women's intimate health, and dedicated products for mature women. Moreover, the company extends its expertise through various services, including custom product development, Original Design Manufacturing (ODM), dosage form optimization, and application support. Established in 2012, the firm's operations are headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Puriblood Medical Co., Ltd.
summary: Puriblood Medical Co., Ltd., based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, and established in 2016, specializes in manufacturing and distributing advanced solutions for blood component separation. The company's diverse product portfolio features filters designed for leukoreduction in various blood products, including red blood cells, platelets, and whole blood. They also provide immediate filtration systems for whole blood, alongside Devin blood fractionation membrane filters and Minipuri cell screening syringe filters. A key innovation from Puriblood Medical is its proprietary P-Tex Technology, which leverages a bio-inspired molecular design based on a zwitterionic copolymer structure.

name: RBC Bioscience Corporation
summary: RBC Bioscience Corporation is a firm dedicated to the research, development, production, and sale of specialized reagents and advanced equipment. These products cater to the life sciences and molecular diagnostic sectors. Its market reach is extensive, covering Europe, the United States, Asia, Taiwan, Africa, and Australia. The company's diverse product line includes reagents tailored for molecular biomedical diagnostics and scientific research, alongside automated instruments for gene and nucleic acid extraction. It also provides a range of nucleic acid extraction kits and associated reagent tissues. Sales are primarily conducted through a global network of distributors. Established in 1995, RBC Bioscience Corporation maintains its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: BiOptic Inc.
summary: BiOptic Inc. specializes as a biotechnology instrumentation firm, crafting scientific tools designed for both laboratory research and clinical applications. Their extensive product line features various instruments, including sophisticated bio-fragment analyzers and PCR thermocyclers. Additionally, they supply essential consumables such as cartridges for DNA, RNA, and protein analysis, alongside quantification kits. The company further provides specialized PCR reagents, encompassing premixed formulas and polymerases. Completing their offerings are diverse diagnostic kits tailored for veterinary, human, and food-related testing. Founded in 1993, BiOptic Inc. is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Eclatorq Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Eclatorq Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2006 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, specializes in the production and distribution of hand tools across the island nation. The company's comprehensive product line prominently features a range of advanced digital and wireless precision instruments. This includes various digital torque wrenches (standard, angle, and mini models), digital adjustable spanners, and digital screwdrivers. Additionally, Eclatorq offers wireless digital angle torque wrenches, digital adaptors, general adaptors, digital torque testers, and essential calibration equipment.

name: SHINE TREND International Multimedia Technology Co. Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1986 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, SHINE TREND International Multimedia Technology CO., LTD. specializes in developing and airing news along with various other programs across Taiwan.

name: Acer Medical Inc.
summary: Acer Medical Inc. is a company dedicated to the healthcare industry, providing advanced solutions that incorporate artificial intelligence, clinical data analysis, and specialized software. Their product lineup features VeriSee DR, an AI-powered diagnostic tool for detecting diabetic retinopathy; VeriSee AMD, an AI-enabled screening application focused on identifying age-related macular degeneration; and VeriOsteo OP, an AI-assisted screening software used to detect anomalies in bone mineral density. The company was established in 2018 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: IPEVO Corporation
summary: IPEVO Corporation, founded in 1996 in Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the design, research, development, and sale of computer peripheral hardware products. Their diverse hardware offerings primarily feature a range of video collaboration and teaching cameras, including popular models like the DO-CAM and V4K, as well as HDMI/USB dual-mode and wireless teaching cameras. Accompanying these are accessories such as uplift video phone holders, laptop mirror cameras, flip learning mirrors, and specialized teaching camera bags. Complementing their hardware, the company also develops a comprehensive suite of software applications. These include AI-driven tools like IPEVO EyeStage for smart video, general visualizer software, and utility applications such as CamControl for managing camera functions and image settings. They also offer IPEVO Annotator for screen annotation, capture, and recording; IPEVO VirtualCam Controller for virtual camera creation and image manipulation; iDocCam, which converts smartphones into teaching cameras; and the IPEVO WHITEBOARD APP for interactive drawing and presentation.

name: Best Precision Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Best Precision Industrial Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of high-precision components. These crucial parts are widely utilized in various optics-related sectors, including the production of optical molds and other optical elements. Beyond its core offerings, the company supplies automotive components, specialized optical tooling accessories, and metallic parts designed for optical applications. Founded in 2003, Best Precision Industrial Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Anti-Microbial Savior BioteQ Co., Ltd
summary: Established in 2018, Anti-Microbial Savior BioteQ Co., Ltd. is a Kaohsiung, Taiwan-based enterprise primarily engaged in the research and development of medicinal drugs.

name: WebComm Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: WebComm Technology Co., Ltd. furnishes comprehensive digital transformation solutions and services to enterprises, with its operations spanning both Taiwan and international markets. It caters to a varied clientele across numerous industries, including governmental bodies, healthcare providers, manufacturing firms, and the retail sector. WebComm Technology maintains its primary operational base in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Tan De Tech Co., Ltd
summary: Tan De Tech Co., Ltd, established in 2013 and headquartered in Douliu, Taiwan, specializes in automotive lighting technology. The company innovates, manufactures, and distributes advanced LED headlights for a diverse array of car manufacturers. Its product offerings also encompass a full suite of exterior vehicle lighting fixtures, including taillights, turn signals, fog lights, and daytime running lights.

name: Iscom Online International Information Inc.
summary: Iscom Online International Information Inc. is a Taiwanese firm specializing in advanced information technology, delivering services across cloud platforms, 5G networks, and artificial intelligence. Its comprehensive portfolio includes solutions for well-known software like Microsoft Office 365, SAP Business ByDesign, and the Autodesk suite. They also provide specialized offerings such as machine networking, Arrowsoft solutions, LINE official account consulting and Chatbot services, alongside various management systems including information asset management, procurement audit platforms, consumer protection case management, and smart street information. Additionally, they offer their proprietary iWorking place cloud enterprise digital package. Further extending its capabilities, Iscom Online is involved in blockchain and Big and Open data services. Operating exclusively within Taiwan, the company caters to a diverse clientele including government bodies, educational institutions, and various enterprise clients. Established in 1989, Iscom Online maintains its headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Turn Cloud Technology Service Inc.
summary: Turn Cloud Technology Service, Inc. is a company that specializes in providing innovative financial technology (FinTech) solutions. The firm offers a diverse portfolio of platforms and tools, including: OLink: A comprehensive, all-in-one system designed for managing payments, loyalty points, digital coupons, and other related services. HOYABOX: A solution that facilitates information tracking by seamlessly integrating various payment applications with cloud-based financial services. Tomorrow POS: A specialized point-of-sale (POS) device engineered with built-in marketing capabilities. TShop: A platform for the efficient administration and management of multiple retail outlets. TCMS: A robust commercial management system. TCRM: The company's dedicated customer relationship management solution. iFore: An essential business intelligence tool designed to provide data-driven insights. TLife: A comprehensive solution tailored specifically for digital marketing efforts. The company's operations are headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: NaviFUS Corp.
summary: NaviFUS Corporation operates within the medical device sector, specializing in the development and commercialization of advanced focused ultrasound (FUS) technologies tailored for neurological applications. The company's primary offering is NaviFUS, a sophisticated transcranial FUS system precisely guided by neuronavigation. This innovative system is engineered to deliver concentrated energy to deep brain regions, supporting a range of clinical interventions such as enhanced drug delivery, neuromodulation, and immuno-stimulation. Additionally, NaviFUS Corp. provides NAVIRFA, a sophisticated navigation system that utilizes optical three-dimensional surgical tracking technology. Its purpose is to accurately monitor the exact placement of needle tips during various ultrasonic interventional procedures. Founded in 2015, the company's headquarters are located in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: M-POWER INFORMATION Co., Ltd.
summary: M-POWER INFORMATION Co., LTD. offers information software solutions in Taiwan and internationally. It provides GCRS Group Consolidated Statement System, a direct report generation system without preliminary interviews; CarbonKeeper, provides tools for carbon inventory and reduction simulations to meet government requirements; and EZSO and EZPI, tool for audit reports and detailed working papers. It also offers Oracle Database and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), data management and cloud infrastructure solutions; Weblogic, a productivity developer tool; Toad for Oracle, an automated migration tool; Foglight for Database, a monitoring tool; InTrust, a collection, storage, and analyzing tool; ApexSQL, offers SQL server management and development tool; Enterprise Reporter, a security and system administrator tool; ChangeAuditor, a tool for auditing and security for enterprise networks; LiteSpeed for SQL Server, a backup and recovery solution; Security Explorer, a centralized management tool for accessing controls, permissions, and security across various Microsoft platforms; SharePlex, a data replication tool; and Spotlight on SQL Server, a diagnostic and resolution tool. In addition, it offers Sybase Adaptive Server Enterprise, a low-cost database management system; IQ, a columnar relational database management system; SAP Data Service, an enterprise data management software; PowerDesigner, data modeling and metadata management tool; Identity Manager, identity governance and administration solution; Syslog NG, a cornerstone of log management; Safeguard, a protection and security tool; Active Roles, account and group management; PowerBuilder, applications into Java or .NET web conversion tool; PowerServer Mobile, a mobile applications builder tool; PowerServer Web, an automatic conversion tool; AppDynamics, a centric management for application; and INSTANA, application performance enhancement tool. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Pharmosa Biopharm Inc.
summary: Pharmosa Biopharm Inc., a biotechnology firm based in Taiwan, specializes in the development of pharmaceutical products. Its current pipeline includes two key candidates: L606 and L608. L606 is an investigational inhalation/device combination therapy designed to treat both pulmonary arterial hypertension and pulmonary hypertension linked to interstitial lung disease. Similarly, L608 is another inhalation-based therapy, paired with a device, aimed at addressing pulmonary vascular disease. The company, which was established in 2000, originally operated under the name Pharmosa Limited before adopting its current name, Pharmosa Biopharm Inc., in October 2016. Its main offices are located in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: LAUNXP Biomedical Co., Ltd
summary: LAUNXP Biomedical Co. Ltd. specializes in developing innovative pharmaceutical treatments for various types of cancer. Their product line includes therapies designed to combat tumor growth and inhibit cell proliferation, notably utilizing advanced platforms such as virus-like nanoparticles and other nanoparticle-based drug delivery systems. The company was established on September 24, 2015, and its primary corporate operations are based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Hye Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Hye Technology Co.,Ltd. specializes in the creation, production, and distribution of intelligent automated detection systems. These advanced solutions are supplied to manufacturers within the semiconductor and optoelectronic industries across both Taiwan and China. The company's extensive offerings include the development and integration of fully and semi-automated inspection and measurement systems, along with overarching automation equipment planning. They also provide sophisticated AOI/AVI (Automated Optical Inspection/Automated Visual Inspection) machine vision systems and dedicated quality assurance apparatus for semiconductor products. Furthermore, Hye Technology Co.,Ltd. offers essential maintenance and support services. The company was established in 2014 and operates from its base in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: O'Pay Electronic Payment Co., Ltd.
summary: O'Pay Electronic Payment Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise that specializes in providing a comprehensive electronic payment solution. The company's core offerings include facilitating both international and domestic money transfers, encompassing services for sending and receiving funds across borders. Additionally, O'Pay handles foreign exchange transactions and currency conversion processes. This firm was established in 2011 and its main operations are based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: TCI GENE Inc.
summary: TCI GENE Inc., based in Taipei, Taiwan, specializes in delivering personalized preventative healthcare solutions. The company offers an extensive range of genetic screenings, including tests for nutrient metabolism, weight management, and specific G2 and ACE2 markers. Its diverse product portfolio encompasses dietary supplements, skincare items, anti-aging treatments, products designed to support children's development, and solutions targeting Alzheimer's disease. Additionally, TCI GENE provides specialized serums for DNA typing and offers professional nutrition counseling services.

name: Ruentex Interior Design Inc.
summary: Operating out of Taiwan, Ruentex Interior Design Inc. specializes in a broad range of services, including interior design and decoration, landscape architectural engineering, and construction. The company's extensive project portfolio encompasses diverse settings, from corporate offices and various residential and commercial properties to specialized landscape developments, laboratory installations, and educational or cultural institutions. Beyond its primary design and build capabilities, Ruentex also supplies an array of interior, landscape, and construction materials, complemented by comprehensive project management services. Established in 1991, the firm is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Reallusion Inc.
summary: Reallusion Inc., founded in 1982 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a global developer and vendor of 2D and 3D animation software and digital content. The company specializes in crafting innovative tools for real-time cinematic animation, advanced motion capture techniques, and virtual production environments. Its product portfolio includes iClone, a powerful real-time 3D animation software utilized for creating professional animations across various fields such as film, pre-visualization, video games, content development, education, and art. Complementing this is Character Creator, a robust solution that empowers designers to develop, import, and customize realistic or stylized character assets. These characters are designed for compatibility with iClone and other prominent 3D applications like Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine 4, and Unity. Reallusion also provides ActorCore, a comprehensive library offering 3D asset collections, including motion capture data and animated 3D human models for efficient crowd rendering. For 2D animation, the company offers Cartoon Animator software, along with popVideo for general video creation. Further expanding its capabilities, Reallusion features advanced motion capture solutions: the Motion LIVE plug-in for iClone acts as a full-body motion capture platform, integrating data streams from multiple mocap devices to simultaneously animate 3D character faces, hands, and bodies. Similarly, the Motion LIVE 2D plug-in for Cartoon Animator adapts 3D motion capture inputs for 2D animation workflows. Additional enhancements for Character Creator come in the form of plug-ins like Headshot, SkinGen Editor, and Iray render. The company's diverse clientele spans trainers, educators, game developers, and filmmakers worldwide.

name: Highpoint Service Network Corp.
summary: Highpoint Service Network Corporation provides after-sale service of information technology (IT) products in Taiwan, Malaysia, Thailand, the Philippines, Indonesia, and Vietnam.
