It offers repair and maintenance services for out-of-warranty smartphones, computers, aircons, TVs, and consumer electronics; information and communication technology (ICT) and CE boards repair services; deployment services, such as IT consulting, project planning, configuration, staging and installation, system integration, and relocation services; and IT managed services, which include maintenance, network and desktop management, call center, and engineering services. The company also provides helpdesk communications services through various mediums, including e-mails, chats, videos, and phones; IT product refurbishment services; and resells refurbished IT products, as well as involved in sale of value added products. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan. Highpoint Service Network Corporation operates as a subsidiary of Acer Incorporated.

name: Far East Bio-Tec Co., Ltd.
summary: Far East Bio-Tec Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise, founded in 1976 and headquartered in Taipei. The company is a significant producer and distributor of various health and wellness items, including organic chlorella, spirulina, and a wide array of dietary supplements. Its comprehensive product line further encompasses nutraceuticals, immune-boosting solutions, antiviral sprays, and specialized nutritional aids for pets.

name: Locus Cell Co., Ltd.
summary: Locus Cell Co., Ltd. is a specialist in the biotechnology and cell therapy sector. The company primarily offers contract development and manufacturing (CDMO) services for a variety of cellular products. This includes handling diverse cell types such as adipose-derived stem cells, nerve cells, chondrocytes, and fibroblasts. Furthermore, their capabilities extend to advanced manufacturing processes like 3D bioprinting for cellular constructs. Locus Cell also provides CDMO support for cutting-edge regenerative medical products, including therapies based on CAR-T, mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), and induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs).

name: Taiwan Bio Therapeutics Co., Ltd
summary: Taiwan Bio Therapeutics Co., Ltd. is an enterprise specializing in regenerative medicine, primarily dedicated to the development of novel cellular therapeutics. These advanced treatments are crafted to address a range of medical conditions, including degenerative disorders, cardiovascular ailments, complications stemming from diabetes, and autoimmune diseases. The company was established in 2014 and its operations are headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Waste Recovery Technology Inc.
summary: Waste Recovery Technology Inc., established in 1990 and headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, specializes in delivering advanced electrolytic recycling solutions. The company primarily serves Taiwan's printed circuit board (PCB) industry by enabling the recovery of copper from industrial wastewater. Their comprehensive product portfolio includes various specialized anodes, such as insoluble anodes for PCB copper plating and platinum titanium anodes. Additionally, they furnish sophisticated automated systems for the continuous extraction, regeneration, and electrolytic reclamation of copper. The firm also supplies specialized recycling units designed to efficiently isolate and retrieve copper ions from both acid and alkaline etching effluents generated by PCB manufacturing. A notable offering is RecoCell, their proprietary electrolytic recovery and treatment equipment tailored for copper-rich PCB waste streams.

name: Wave Power Technology Inc.
summary: Wave Power Technology Inc. specializes in the full spectrum of activities, from research and development to manufacturing and sales, for advanced components designed for high-frequency, high-power, high-voltage, and high-vacuum applications. Their extensive product range includes industrial-grade microwave generators, magnetrons, variable capacitors, various disks, and heating elements. Additionally, they provide electrical feedthroughs, vacuum-sealed windows, ceramic insulators for high-voltage systems, and solutions for vacuum-hermetic welding. The company was established in 2002 and operates from its base in Toufen, Taiwan.

name: ChainSea Information Integration Co.,Ltd.
summary: Based in Taipei, Taiwan, ChainSea Information Integration Co., Ltd. delivers a comprehensive array of business solutions focused on customer relationship management (CRM). Founded in 1993, the company's offerings encompass outsourced call center operations, specialized education and training for call center personnel, and professional consultation and advisory services. Furthermore, ChainSea acts as a distributor for network switch and call center system technologies. The firm also undertakes the installation and ongoing maintenance of critical systems, including call center infrastructure, CRM platforms, and advanced AI voice-activated dialing solutions.

name: Apex Material Technology Corp.
summary: Founded in 1998 and based in Keelung City, Taiwan, Apex Material Technology Corp., along with its affiliated companies, specializes in delivering touch technology solutions across Taiwan. The company manufactures and distributes both resistive and projected capacitive touch screens, as well as PenMount touch screen controllers. Beyond these core products, they offer an extensive range of services, including advanced touchscreen display and e-paper display solutions, open-frame touchscreen monitors, and optical bonding, supported by comprehensive touch solutions and dedicated post-purchase assistance. These offerings are widely utilized across various industries such as industrial, medical, public commercial, transportation, and outdoor environments.

name: Jiu Han System Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiu Han System Technology Co., Ltd. provides engineering services in Taiwan. The company offers central system air conditioning engineering; sanitary water supply and drainage gas engineering; fire engineering; clean room engineering; air conditioning constant temperature and humidity; and monitoring and automatic control engineering services. It also engages in the indoor and outdoor high and low voltage power distribution projects. In addition, the company engages in the design and installation of water, electricity, fire safety equipment installation, piping, and instrument and meter installation, as well as the sale and purchase of related materials. Jiu Han System Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1989 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Proxene Tools Co., Ltd.
summary: Proxene Tools Co., Ltd., headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan, has been a producer and seller of a diverse range of adjustable wrenches since its establishment in 1984. In addition to supplying the Taiwanese market, the company also engages in the export of its products globally.

name: Grandsys Inc.
summary: Grandsys Inc. specializes in delivering comprehensive solutions for contact and telemarketing center management, encompassing consulting, strategic planning, and systems integration. Among its key offerings are: LOG800, a recording platform engineered for big data analytics. QMS8100, a robust quality management and control solution designed to evaluate customer service representative performance. WFM8200, an operational and workforce management system providing critical data insights, forecasting capabilities, and intuitive graphical interfaces. eVoice8300, a comprehensive telemarketing and CRM system that streamlines various enterprise operations, including inbound service, outbound marketing campaigns, customer care, order processing, and survey management. Beyond its core products, Grandsys also extends its expertise through consulting, general system and cloud application planning and integration, and dedicated technical support. Its diverse client base spans a wide array of sectors, such as cloud/hosting, insurance, finance, banking, telecommunications, transportation, education, government, utilities, outsourcing, marketing, IT, gaming, TV shopping, healthcare, manufacturing, and logistics. Grandsys primarily operates across Taiwan and mainland China. Established in 1992, the company maintains its headquarters in Taipei City, Taiwan. It further extends its presence with offices in Taichung, Yunlin, and Kaohsiung within Taiwan, and in major Chinese cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Nanjing.

name: Chyunn Environment Corporation
summary: Chyunn Environment Corporation functions as a leading environmental services provider in Taiwan, focusing on comprehensive waste management solutions. The company's diverse range of offerings includes household refuse collection, extensive resource recycling initiatives, and the specialized handling and disposal of both general and hazardous commercial and industrial waste streams. Furthermore, it manages construction debris, oversees facilities for the storage and disposal of earth and stone materials, and conducts machinery dismantling. Beyond these core services, Chyunn Environment also delivers environmental protection consultancy to businesses and operates a water truck transport division. The enterprise was founded in 1981 and maintains its headquarters in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Yi Chun Green Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Yi Chun Green Technology Co., Ltd. operates within the environmental sector, delivering comprehensive recycling solutions. A key aspect of their work involves the specialized reprocessing of used diapers, in addition to the commercialization of the recovered raw materials. The firm was established on June 12, 2019, and is primarily situated in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: VSO Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: VSO Electronics Co., Ltd. is a company that specializes in producing both connectivity solutions and advanced functional materials. Their extensive product line includes essential cabling for industrial automation and Internet of Things (IoT) devices, as well as connection cables designed for cloud infrastructure and fifth-generation (5G) applications. The firm also supplies various optical materials. Established by Chung Cheng Chien on August 13, 1994, the company's headquarters are situated in New Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Igiant Optics Co., Ltd.
summary: Igiant Optics Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based company specializing in the design and manufacturing of optical components. Their expertise spans the entire product development lifecycle, from initial research and optical engineering to precision tool fabrication, sophisticated injection molding, automated production processes, and rigorous quality inspection. They focus on creating intricate micro-molded and optical components. The company's product portfolio includes high-precision micro-molded parts, as well as specialized dual-shot and insert molding solutions. These critical components are integral to a wide array of advanced applications, serving sectors such as portable electronics and 3C consumer goods, semiconductor manufacturing, medical endoscopy, automotive sensing systems, aerospace technology, and advanced optical camera modules. Igiant Optics is headquartered in Hsinchu.

name: Andros Pharmaceuticals Co.,Ltd
summary: Andros Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd. operates as a biopharmaceutical enterprise, concentrating on the advancement of novel drug delivery platform technologies. Its development pipeline features APC101, a metered-dose, quick-drying, film-forming spray undergoing Phase IIa clinical investigation for the management of pain linked to post-herpetic neuralgia. Also in development is APC201, an innovative topical anesthetic formulation currently in Phase I/II trials for Osteoarthritis treatment, alongside an siRNA (small interfering RNA) compound functioning as an antisense oligonucleotide and DNA candidate. In the preclinical phase, the company is advancing APC310 and APC501, both intended as anesthetics for intravenous catheter insertion and venipuncture. Another preclinical asset, APC401, is a specialized emulsified solution targeting post-surgical pain relief. Beyond its developmental programs, Andros Pharmaceuticals also provides LALP cream for dermal analgesic use, iMinos solution for treating Alopecia Androgenetica, and T4 endonuclease V. Established in 2008, the firm maintains its headquarters in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Phoenix Pioneer technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Phoenix Pioneer Technology Co., Ltd., based in Taiwan, specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of integrated circuit (IC) substrates. The firm provides a comprehensive range of these essential components, including FCCSP IC and SiP module substrates. Their offerings also extend to various other substrate types such as xQFN/routable LF/MIS, FCCSP/FC-LGA, FP-COIL, PLP, Cu stud, COIL, EPS, interposer, and ultra-thin substrates. This company was founded in 2013 and operates from its headquarters located in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: Neousys Technology Inc.
summary: Neousys Technology Inc. is a company that specializes in the design and manufacturing of highly durable, industrial-grade embedded computer systems. Their comprehensive product portfolio spans a variety of specialized computing solutions: Industrial PCs: These include robust fanless models, expandable box PCs, and ultra-compact computing units. In-vehicle Computing: Tailored for mobile environments, their offerings feature E-mark/EN 50155 certified products, GMSL camera hubs, and various expansion cards. Edge AI GPU Computing: Addressing the demands of artificial intelligence at the edge, they provide powerful GPU computing platforms, such as rugged NVIDIA Jetson systems, NVIDIA Quadro RTX, and NVIDIA L4 solutions. SEMIL Extreme-Rugged Products: For the most challenging operational conditions, this line boasts fanless GPU technology, integrated supercapacitor UPS for power backup, and IP67 ingress protection. Machine Vision: The company supports machine vision applications with dedicated vision computers, real-time control I/O devices, expansion frame grabber cards, and LED controllers. Mobile Surveillance: Their range includes comprehensive surveillance systems, industrial Ethernet switches, and PoE+ cards for camera integration. Industrial IoTs: Neousys caters to the Industrial Internet of Things with both ARM-based and X86-based IoT gateways, complemented by 4G LTE communication modules. Industrial SuperCAP UPS: They also provide industrial-grade SuperCAP UPS products, available as expansion cards and standalone modules to ensure power continuity. Neousys Technology Inc. was established in 1999 and operates from its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: eLand Information Co., Ltd
summary: eLand Information Co., Ltd is a globally-active intelligent data analytics firm dedicated to the research and development of cutting-edge software technologies, with operations spanning both China and international markets. Its expertise lies in crafting solutions across diverse domains, including intelligent search engine platforms, automated semantic analysis, and sophisticated network community analysis tools. The company's portfolio features prominent offerings like OpView, a dedicated social media monitoring platform. It also provides PeopleView, a comprehensive crowd intelligence database. This powerful platform utilizes semantic and community observation technologies to gather insights into the browsing patterns and behaviors of roughly 20 million active devices each month. Furthermore, eLand Information supplies clients with advanced knowledge retrieval systems, its proprietary ENLP semantic analysis systems, and the eKM enterprise knowledge management platform. The firm is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Shine-On BioMedical Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shine-On BioMedical Co.,Ltd. is dedicated to the research, development, and manufacturing of pharmaceutical products aimed at combating cancer. The company's innovative pipeline features a range of antibody-based oncology therapies. These include exosome anti-cancer drugs like SOB101 and SOB102, as well as SOB201, an engineered multi-target exosome. Additionally, their portfolio encompasses specialized antibody treatments such as SOA101, a dual immune checkpoint T cell adapter, and SOA201, a trispecific adapter immune cell antibody. This Taiwanese firm, founded in 2021, is based in Taichung.

name: Integrated Solutions Technology, Inc.
summary: Integrated Solutions Technology, Inc. specializes in providing integrated circuit (IC) drivers specifically for the flat panel display sector. Their comprehensive product line includes EPD/ESL driver ICs, which are engineered for graphic and segment display applications. The company also manufactures STN/TN single-chip driver ICs, serving a diverse range of uses such as electronic shelf labels (ESL), wearable technology, automotive systems, instrumentation, and devices employing capacitive display components. Additionally, they offer STN SEG/COM drive ICs, commonly found in personal digital assistants (PDAs), e-books, gaming consoles, and various instrument displays. Their portfolio is completed with PMOLED driver ICs, likewise designed for wearable devices and instrumentation requirements. Established in 1988, Integrated Solutions Technology, Inc. is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: We Can Medicines Co., Ltd.
summary: We Can Medicines Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based enterprise that manages a network of pharmacies across the island. These retail establishments offer a diverse array of health-related products, encompassing pharmaceuticals, nutritional supplements, mother-and-baby care items, and various medical devices. The company markets many of these goods under its own VITALPLUS and Sapporo brand names. Founded in 1987, the firm's corporate headquarters are situated in Taichung, Taiwan, and it operates as a subsidiary of Yousheng Medical Technology Co., Ltd.

name: Mercury Biopharmaceutical Corporation
summary: Founded in 2019 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Mercury Biopharmaceutical Corporation is dedicated to creating innovative pharmaceutical solutions for medical conditions currently lacking adequate treatment options. A cornerstone of their strategy is the proprietary StackDose platform, an advanced drug development system designed to formulate novel medication delivery methods. This platform facilitates precisely timed drug release, targeted absorption at specific locations within the body, and flexible dosage modifications. The primary objective of StackDose is to significantly boost the bioavailability of active pharmaceutical ingredients, leading to a reduction in required drug dosages and fewer adverse effects. Their development pipeline currently addresses a variety of ailments, such as erectile dysfunction, pulmonary hypertension, sleep disturbances, benign prostatic hyperplasia, angina, migraines, hypertension, and pain management.

name: Prince Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Prince Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates in the production and global sale of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), primarily focusing on vitamin B1. Its market presence extends across Taiwan, Japan, Korea, and other international territories. The company's product portfolio also encompasses a variety of consumer health items and general medicines. These offerings include popular formulations such as vitamin C tablets and vitamin B complex tablets, alongside specialized supplements like natto and rhodiola extract capsules, probiotic sachets, and various plant extract capsules. In addition to vitamin B1, Prince Pharmaceutical supplies a comprehensive array of other APIs, notably felbinac, aldioxa, tulobuterol, ufenamate, bisbentiamine, thiamine disulfide, potassium guaiacolsulfonate, potassium cresolsulfonate, fusultiamine hydrochloride, and fursultiamine. The company's distribution network specifically includes countries within Spain and the wider European continent. Established in 1962, Prince Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is based in Yunlin County, Taiwan.

name: Neweb Information Co., Ltd.
summary: Neweb Information Co., Ltd. provides integrated cross-platform cloud computing and system hosting services in China. It engages in the integrated planning, consulting, introduction, cloud construction, management, maintenance, and sale of information software and hardware products. The company also provides information security, robust and secure basic network architecture, AI big data intelligent platform, hybrid cloud infrastructure, and data storage and backup solutions. In addition, it offers mainframe and cloud platforms, services, and product sales services; cloud IT room construction and maintenance services; virtualization and cloud digital solution services; system integration, construction, and maintenance services; system and database management and maintenance services; recovery services; network information security construction and consulting services; and cloud information system integration and maintenance services to government and corporate customers. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: TFBS Bioscience Inc.
summary: TFBS Bioscience Inc. functions as a contract research organization (CRO), specializing in offering biological analysis and testing services throughout Taiwan. The company plays a crucial role in supporting advanced medical innovations by fabricating viral vectors, which are essential for cell and gene therapy products. Furthermore, TFBS Bioscience conducts comprehensive biosafety and final product release evaluations for a diverse range of biopharmaceutical items, including cell and gene therapies, vaccines, and other biologics. Established in 2016, the firm's main operational base is located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Gus Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Gus Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the manufacturing and supply of lithium-ion battery solutions. Their offerings span a range of products, from individual pouch cells and integrated battery modules to complete energy storage systems. These advanced power solutions are specifically designed for both electric vehicle applications and various household uses. The enterprise was established in 2017 and operates from its main office located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: AP Biosciences Inc
summary: AP Biosciences Inc. is a pioneering clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the research and development of bispecific antibody drugs, aiming to fulfill critical unmet medical needs. Its robust pipeline features several promising candidates: Leading the pack, IBI302 is in Phase III clinical trials for the treatment of neovascular age-related macular degeneration (nAMD). Further along, AP505 is undergoing Phase I clinical trials for various solid tumors. AP203, also in Phase I, is being investigated for non-small cell lung cancer, head and neck squamous cell carcinoma, and esophageal squamous cell carcinomas. In earlier development, AP402 is currently in the pre-clinical research phase, focusing on breast cancer patients. Additionally, AP601 is also in pre-clinical research, targeting a broader spectrum of malignancies including lung cancer, pancreatic cancer, bladder cancer, ovarian cancer, and other solid tumors. Founded in 2013, the company maintains its headquarters in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Gudeng Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan, Gudeng Equipment Co., LTD specializes in the development and sale of automated technological solutions for the transfer and handling of photomasks. Their product offerings include EUV mask cleaning systems, sophisticated high-end photomask delivery mechanisms, and PVD (Physical Vapor Deposition) equipment technology solutions.

name: Ion Electronic Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Ion Electronic Materials Co., Ltd., headquartered in Hsinchu County, Taiwan, specializes in supplying advanced materials to the domestic semiconductor and optoelectronic manufacturing industries. The company's product portfolio includes various specialized gases for applications such as ion implantation, electronic cleaning, laser processes, and electron deposition. Additionally, it offers comprehensive logistics solutions for the secure storage and transportation of hazardous goods. Established in 2016, Ion Electronic Materials also boasts an international presence, exporting its offerings to markets like Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and other global destinations.

name: Uni Travel Services Co., Ltd.
summary: Uni Travel Services Co., Ltd. is a company specializing in tourism, which commenced its operations in 2014 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Texture Maker Enterprise Co., Ltd
summary: Texture Maker Enterprise Co., Ltd. (6963.TWO) specializes in the creation and distribution of a variety of baked goods and milk tea items. The company's offerings fall into three primary segments: Baking products, Milk tea products, and Raw Materials. Their selection of baked goods includes popular items such as rice donuts, muffins, Korean bread, and fruit balls. For milk tea enthusiasts, they provide products like creamers, powdered mixes for frozen beverages, and convenient three-in-one drink powders. Additionally, Texture Maker supplies fundamental raw ingredients, specifically wheat protein and tapioca starch. The company was founded on December 26, 2003, by Jen You Tseng, and maintains its headquarters in New Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Trans-Sun Materials Technology Company Limited
summary: Trans-Sun Materials Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 1992 and based in Taichung City, Taiwan, is a company focused on the innovation, manufacturing, and provision of electronic functional material solutions for clients both domestically and abroad. Its broad product portfolio serves a multitude of applications, including those in printing, conductive cooling and EMI shielding, mesh and breathable membrane technology, insulation and cushioning, medical equipment, protective film, and the automotive industry. Furthermore, the company acts as a distributor for various items, such as adhesives, single and double-sided tapes, specialized medical materials, hook and reclosable fastening systems, and Bumpons protective products.

name: Wonder Pets Enterprises Corporation
summary: Wonder Pets Enterprises Corporation, a Taiwanese firm established in 1999 and based in Taipei City, specializes in offering a comprehensive range of pet food and various animal care products. Its diverse services encompass essential daily pet supplies, professional grooming, aesthetic treatments for pets, and a dedicated e-commerce platform. The company operates under several prominent brands, including Pet Park, Kaiduo Pet, and Cat and Dog Captain, effectively serving the broader pet care market. Its products and services are readily available to customers through both online channels and traditional retail outlets.

name: Hui Min Environmental Tech Corporation
summary: Hui Min Environmental Tech Corporation operates as an engineering and construction company dedicated to environmental protection, with its core business centered on the production of specialized environmental equipment. The company offers a comprehensive array of machinery, including water screening systems, wastewater degrit equipment, sludge settling units, and various solutions for sludge and organic waste management (dewatering, drying, and carbonizing). Additionally, their portfolio extends to solid conveyor systems, automated food waste separation systems, biological process systems tailored for wastewater treatment plants, and industrial deodorizers, among other related devices. Hui Min Environmental Tech serves a wide client base, extending its operations across Taiwan, mainland China, and other international territories. The company was established on April 8, 1997, and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: U-Neuron Biomedical Inc
summary: U-Neuron Biomedical Inc. specializes in the pioneering development of stem cell technologies. The company's core activities revolve around advancing methods for stem cell preservation, isolation, and their subsequent application in therapeutic treatments. Their research specifically targets Amniotic Fluid Stem Cells, Olfactory Stem Cells, and Adipose-derived Stem Cells. This enterprise was established on September 4, 2015, and is based in New Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Acepodia, Inc.
summary: Acepodia, Inc. is an advanced-stage biotechnology firm focused on pioneering cell-based treatments. The company utilizes its distinctive Antibody Cell Conjugation (ACC) platform technology to innovate therapeutic approaches and address critical unmet needs in oncology. Through this proprietary method, Acepodia engineers novel ACE therapies by precisely attaching tumor-specific antibodies to its specialized immune cells, such as gamma delta 2 T cells. Established in 2017, the company's corporate headquarters are situated in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands.

name: United Purification Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: United Purification Technology Co., Ltd. provides end-to-end water treatment solutions, encompassing design, planning, development, assembly, installation, upkeep, and sales of advanced purification systems. Established in 1987 and based in Taichung, Taiwan, the company caters to a diverse range of high-demand industrial sectors. Its clientele includes semiconductor fabricators and other electronics manufacturers, as well as facilities in petrochemicals, cogeneration power, specialized semiconductor-grade chemical production, biotechnology, and pharmaceuticals.

name: Victory for Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Victory for Technology Co., Ltd., which was founded on July 26, 2010, and maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, is primarily involved in the fabrication of essential semiconductor materials, electronic tapes, and electroluminescent sheets. The firm also directs its efforts towards the innovation and engineering of transparent anti-reflective (AR) films and specialized protective films designed to repel dust.

name: Rapidtek Technologies Inc.
summary: Rapidtek Technologies Inc., a company headquartered in New Taipei, Taiwan, specializes in the development and provision of radio frequency (RF) testing solutions. Its extensive product range encompasses individual RF test components, intelligent devices, and cutting-edge advanced RF technologies. The organization was established on April 17, 2015, by its founder, I Hsing Wang.

name: Walrus Pump Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1967 and based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Walrus Pump Co., Ltd. is actively involved in the full lifecycle of water pumps, from initial research and development through to manufacturing, sales, and after-sales service. For residential applications, their extensive product range features innovative antimicrobial electronic control, automatic booster, and direct water pumps, as well as conventional electronic control, automatic flow-controlled, hot water, multistage centrifugal, and atomizing models. The company's industrial offerings include self-priming, multistage centrifugal (both standard and vertical configurations), immersible, and coolant pumps. Additionally, Walrus Pump caters to commercial needs with its constant pressure inverter control systems.

name: UA YANG Precision Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: UA YANG Precision Machinery Co., Ltd. specializes in the comprehensive development, production, and distribution of high-precision optical instruments. Their product portfolio encompasses automated optical inspection (AOI) systems, precision optical measurement devices, integrated optical solutions, and advanced image detection modules. The company commenced operations on October 9, 2012, and its principal location is in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: ACpay Co., Ltd.
summary: ACpay Co., Ltd. researches and develops payment gateway system. It also offers de-identified digital identity certification system, digital asset certification system, machine learning recommendation system, merchant public opinion analysis system, and automated account processing system. The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: HeXun Biosciences Co., Ltd.
summary: HeXun Biosciences Co., Ltd., a Taiwanese enterprise, focuses on the research, development, and application of stem cell technologies and treatments. The company also offers a comprehensive suite of related services, including contract development and manufacturing for various cell types and their derivatives, outsourced production capabilities, quality control inspections, expert consulting, laboratory information management system (LIMS) implementation, and sterile (aseptic) filling solutions. Founded in 2019, its operations are headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Plum-Monix Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: Plum-Monix Industry Co Ltd is a Taiwan-based company engaged in petrochemical waste treatment and resource recovery. The company produces and reprocesses rare elements like vanadium and molybdenum from petrochemical waste catalysts. Its main products, including molybdenum trioxide, vanadium pentoxide, ferromolybdenum, and ferrovanadium, serve the iron and steel, green energy, and alloy industries.

name: Forcelead
summary: Forcelead Technology Corp. is an integrated circuit (IC) design specialist dedicated to the development, production, and worldwide distribution of display driver chips and touch-integrated driver chips. Their product range includes specialized display driver chips tailored for the automotive industry, which are utilized in components such as instrument panels, central consoles, heads-up displays (HUDs), electronic rearview mirrors, and circular control knobs. They also supply display driver chips for AIoT (Artificial Intelligence of Things) applications, catering to devices like point-of-sale (POS) systems, smart home technologies, and human-machine interfaces used in both consumer electronics and industrial control systems. Furthermore, Forcelead provides custom, OLED-specific, and application-specific integrated circuit (ASIC) display driver solutions. Founded in 1998, the company's main operations are based in Zhubei, Taiwan, and it operates as a subsidiary of Sitronix Technology Corporation.

name: Nextlink
summary: Nextlink Technology Co.,Ltd., established in 2006 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, specializes in the provision, resale, and deployment of cloud computing service platforms. As of November 5, 2018, the company functions as a subsidiary under New Century InfoComm Tech Co., Ltd.

name: Brinno Incorporated
summary: Brinno Incorporated designs, develops, produces, and sells imaging devices. The company offers time lapse, construction, and outdoor security cameras; camera kits; and smart home security products, as well as time lapse accessories. It also provides contact tracing COVID-19 products; and Friday home smart locks. The company offers its products through distributors worldwide. Brinno Incorporated was founded in 2003 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Mortech Corporation
summary: Mortech Corporation develops and provides polyimide films in Taiwan. Its products include PIF, PIN, PIB/PMB, PIA/PAB, and PIT type polyimide films. The company was founded in 2004 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Great Novel Therapeutics Biotech & Medicals
summary: Great Novel Therapeutics Biotech & Medicals specializes in crafting pharmaceutical solutions to combat advanced and treatment-resistant cancers. Their primary focus lies in the realm of cancer immunotherapy, encompassing the creation of compounds such as tumor microenvironment regulators, epigenetic immunoactivators, and immune-regulating multi-kinase inhibitors. The company was previously known as GNT Biotech & Medicals Corporation. Established in 2013, its headquarters are situated in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Fluxtek International Corp.
summary: Fluxtek International Corp. manufactures and sells RO water purification equipment in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers compact systems, residential systems, purifier systems, commercial systems, dispensers, filters/membranes, housing caps, pumps/transformers, tanks/faucets, fittings, and coconut shell carbon products. It also provides accessories, such as leak detectors, housing wrenches, shut off valves, pressure regulators, flow restrictors, mini digital TDS meters, pressure gauges, high and low pressure switches, solenoid and needle valves, and control boxes. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Pingtung City, Taiwan.

name: Enrestec Inc.
summary: Enrestec Inc engages in the pyrolysis and recycling of used plastic, rubber, and organic wastes. It is also involved in the development of soil thermal desorption technology and application. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Pingtung, Taiwan.

name: Sea Mild Biotechnology Co., Ltd.
summary: Sea Mild Biotechnology Co., Ltd., headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, specializes in the production and distribution of a diverse range of items within the country. Its product portfolio includes paints, coatings, and various cleaning solutions. Operating under its "Sea Mild Biotech" brand, the company supplies specific categories such as laundry, household, and personal detergents, in addition to vital epidemic prevention products.

name: Forward Science Corp.
summary: Established in 1992 and based in Zhunan, Taiwan, Forward Science Corp. primarily focuses on the production of vacuum pumps. The company's diverse portfolio extends beyond manufacturing to include the sale of various vacuum equipment, comprehensive repair and maintenance services for these systems, and the fabrication of precision mechanisms. Additionally, Forward Science Corp. provides OEM/ODM manufacturing solutions and specializes in advanced intelligent electromechanical systems. These systems encompass central management functionalities, prognostic and health management capabilities, artificial intelligence testing platforms, and smart manufacturing technologies.

name: Intumit Inc.
summary: Intumit, Inc. provides artificial intelligence and CX solutions primarily in China. The company's products include SmartRobot, a solution to help enterprises in establishing automate smart service platforms across Websites, FB Messenger, LINE, WeChat, WhatsApp, Microsoft Services, APPs, and other channels; SmartKMS, a cognitive knowledge management system; SmartWork, a Microsoft 365 internal helpdesk; WFH solutions, a personal internal helpdesk assistant for information technology, human resource, call centers, and other areas; AOG, a Google assistant solution; SmartForce, a solution for customer interaction; SmartNow, a workplace management solution; SmartXP, a customer engagement solution; and Smartonnect, a solution to collect customers' interests and info from conversations and speech dialogues. It primarily serves financial services, insurance, healthcare, retail/FMCG, public service/education, tourism/transportation, and manufacturing sectors. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Flashaim Inc.
summary: Flashaim Inc. provides digital marketing services to major portals and messaging software of Yahoo, Google, LINE, Facebook, and Bing and other advertising agencies. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: Yeedex Electronic Corporation
summary: Yeedex Electronic Corporation provides parts, materials, and sub-systems for semiconductor process equipment in Taiwan and China. The company offers fine ceramic parts and materials; perfluoroelastomer seals; precision vacuum chucks; refurbish and repair precious parts, including ESC, heaters, vacuum chucks, ceramic coatings, anodizing products, etc.; plasma coated chamber parts; quartz and others parts; tungsten carbide blades; and heat resistant phosphor plates. It also serves flat display panel, passive electronic component, LED, solar cell, automobile, medical, and special material industries. The company also exports its products to other Asian and American countries. Yeedex Electronic Corporation was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Bryton Inc.
summary: Bryton Inc. develops, sells, and retails GPS cycle computers and accessories in Taiwan and internationally. It also operates an online store for products. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Bioray Biotech Co., Ltd
summary: BioRay Biotech Co., Ltd. engages in the development and manufacture of biological agents. Its biological agents include functional probiotics, medicinal fungi, and immune cell preparations. The company was founded in 1994 is based in Pingtung, Taiwan.

name: Lex Computech Co., Ltd.
summary: Lex Computech Co., Ltd. is a Taiwan-based enterprise, established in 1990 in New Taipei, specializing in the development and distribution of robust industrial computing solutions. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses industrial-grade motherboards, passively cooled embedded systems, resilient panel PCs, network infrastructure devices, and controllers for machine vision and industrial automation. Moreover, they provide advanced solutions for AI edge computing and the Internet of Things (IoT). These offerings cater to a diverse range of demanding applications and sectors, including Edge AI and gateway solutions, general IoT deployments, automation, network appliances, transportation, medical, military, aerospace, and government.

name: Argo Yachts Development Co.,Ltd.
summary: Argo Yachts Development Co., Ltd. engages in the operation of water recreation activities and ship leasing business in Taiwan. The company was founded in 2003 is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Revivegen Co., Ltd.
summary: Revivegen Environmental Technology Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese firm specializing in industrial waste management. Its operations encompass both the physical and thermal treatment of waste solvents. Beyond waste processing, Revivegen also manufactures and supplies a range of specialized products, including semiconductor and wafer cleaners, additives for paints and coatings, and auxiliary materials for lithium batteries. Founded in 1999, the company is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: International Ocean Group
summary: International Ocean Group specializes in offering oceanic geophysical and hydrogeological survey solutions. This enterprise, which began operations in 2013, was previously recognized as IOVTEC Co., Ltd. Its primary base of operations is situated in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Happytuk Co., Ltd.
summary: Happytuk Co., Ltd., founded in 2012, specializes in delivering online gaming experiences across various platforms, including personal computers and mobile devices. This company, headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, operates as a subsidiary of HANBIT SOFT Inc.

name: YIHO International Co., Ltd.
summary: YIHO International Co., Ltd., a Taiwanese enterprise, primarily focuses on the solar electric power generation industry. The company's services also encompass providing financial backing and construction expertise for solar power facilities. Beyond renewable energy, YIHO offers a range of financial solutions, including funding for land purchases and construction projects, installment payment options, and the leasing of both vehicles and various machinery and equipment. Furthermore, it provides financing to support the establishment of biogas power generation plants. YIHO was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Pharmigene, Inc.
summary: PharmiGene, Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells diagnostic tests worldwide. It primarily develops DNA genetic tests. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: DuoGenic StemCells corporation
summary: Duogenic Stemcells Corporation is primarily engaged in the biotechnology and healthcare industries, offering a variety of services. Their core offerings include cell therapy and the development of closed-culture cell systems. The company was established on March 22, 2018, and its main corporate office is situated in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Champ Ray
summary: Champ-Ray Industrial Co., Ltd. is primarily engaged in the research, development, manufacture and sale of aromatic diffusers and related products. Its main products include ultrasonic aromatic diffusers, nebulizing diffusers and related accessories. The company's products are mainly sold to Europe, America and Asia.

name: APEX Wind Power Equipment Manufacturing
summary: Apex Wind Power Equipment Manufacturing Co., LTD. is a Taiwanese company specializing in the fabrication and supply of steel structures for offshore wind energy projects within Taiwan. Its product portfolio encompasses a range of specialized steel components, including standard, beveled, and pre-bent plates, as well as cylindrical cans, structural sections, and conical shapes. Established in 2018, the firm is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Rayzher
summary: Rayzher Industrial Co., Ltd. provides engineering and design planning services throughout Taiwan and China. Its core competencies include the comprehensive design, planning, and construction of major plant systems, as well as the installation and intricate secondary configuration of all types of factory equipment. Beyond services, Rayzher also manufactures and supplies its own factory equipment and a range of consumables. The firm is additionally involved in the fabrication and setup of specialized gas supply systems. Furthermore, it handles the global import and export of essential instruments, materials, and components specifically for semiconductor equipment. Established in 1996, Rayzher's headquarters are situated in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: Finesse Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Established in 1999 and headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan, Finesse Technology Co., Ltd specializes in the creation and distribution of advanced technological components. Their primary offerings encompass ozone and remote plasma source (RPS) generators, sophisticated RF systems, microwave devices, electronic circuits, and comprehensive control systems. These solutions are provided to clients both within Taiwan and across the global market. Beyond these core offerings, the company's product line also includes gas pressure regulators, along with a suite of ozone-related products such as sensors, systems, and controllers. Complementing their hardware, Finesse Technology delivers crucial services, including technical support, trading facilitation, and comprehensive repair solutions. Their primary clientele is within the demanding semiconductor industry.

name: Acer Synergy Manpower Corp.
summary: Acer Synergy Manpower Corp. provides human resource services in Taiwan, China, and internationally. It offers long-term and short-term information manpower dispatch and outsourcing services; mid-to-high-level talent recruitment services; talent management and training development services; and headhunting services. The company also provides multifunctional software in line with customer strategic needs. It serves semiconductor, manufacturing, financial, and medical industries. The company was founded in 2018 and is headquartered in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: CMSC, Inc.
summary: Based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, CMSC, Inc. is a key player in the integrated circuit sector, specializing in both the conceptualization and production of advanced ICs. The company's reach extends across Taiwan, Japan, South Korea, and various international markets. Its extensive product portfolio features components such as modules, system-in-packages (SiP), printed circuit boards (PCBs), and tailored system designs. Beyond hardware, CMSC offers a broad array of specialized services. These include physical design, optimization, and System-on-Chip (SoC) integration; comprehensive analog IC design (covering both front-end and back-end aspects); intricate IC chip engineering; and diligent management of mass production processes. Furthermore, CMSC provides System-on-Chip (SoC) and Application-Specific Integrated Circuit (ASIC) design expertise, alongside valuable intellectual property (IP) solutions and critical process migration services. The company was founded in 1990.

name: Family International Gourmet Co. Ltd.
summary: Family International Gourmet Co., Ltd., established in 2011 and based in Taipei, Taiwan, is an enterprise active in the catering sector. The firm functions as a subsidiary of Taiwan FamilyMart Co., Ltd.

name: Honor
summary: Honor Seiki Co. Ltd. specializes in providing computer numerical control (CNC) vertical lathes and comprehensive turnkey manufacturing solutions. Their diverse product portfolio includes vertical turning centers, vertical grinding machines, integrated planar turning-milling-grinding centers, and bespoke special purpose machinery. Founded by Charles Chen in 1987, the company is headquartered in Kaohsiung, China.

name: Potens
summary: Potens Semiconductor Corp. specializes in the design, development, and global sale of power discrete devices. Operating across Taiwan, Asia, Europe, and other international markets, the company offers a diverse portfolio of components, including low and medium voltage MOSFETs, power IGBTs, and cutting-edge power semiconductor products utilizing GaN and SiC technologies. These solutions cater to various industries such as consumer electronics, telecommunications, industrial applications, and the automotive sector. Specific applications include critical areas like 5G infrastructure, fully automated vehicles, wireless power transmission systems, and cloud data centers. Established in 2012, Potens Semiconductor Corp. maintains its headquarters in Zhubei, Taiwan.

name: WeLeader Biomedical Co., Ltd.
summary: WeLeader Biomedical Co. Ltd. is primarily involved in the development and distribution of medical diagnostic instruments and related supplies. The company offers specialized products such as integrated systems for serum biochemistry, alongside comprehensive solutions for clinical care and the management of medical information. Established on April 28, 2003, its principal operations are based in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.

name: Uniforce Technology Corp.
summary: Uniforce Technology Corporation, founded in Taipei, Taiwan in 2010, delivers specialized consulting and technical services, with a particular focus on the construction industry. The company plays a key role in the market by sourcing and distributing a wide range of products related to operational maintenance, information security, and integrated joint defense systems. Furthermore, Uniforce develops and implements advanced solutions across several domains. These offerings include comprehensive website services, multi-layered detection and defense against advanced persistent threats (APTs), systems for internet traffic decryption and collaborative security, and robust IT/OT security management frameworks. They also provide intelligent network flow control capabilities, as well as tools for wide area network (WAN) line balancing and bandwidth auditing.

name: Yuh Shan Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Yuh Shan Environmental Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the environmental protection business in Taiwan. The company provides environmental engineering technology consulting, soil and groundwater pollution remediation, and waste removal and treatment services. It also engages in the pollution prevention and control equipment business. The company was founded in 1982 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: ITI International Transportation, Inc.
summary: ITI International Transportation, Inc. delivers a comprehensive suite of services, specializing in freight management across sea, air, and land routes, complemented by broader logistics solutions. This enterprise commenced operations in September 1994 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Lightel Corp
summary: Lightel Corporation researches, develops, and provides fiber optic and optoelectronic products and solutions in the United States, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers satellite laser communication equipment; fiber lasers; smart lighting products; instruments and equipment; and optical and communication components. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: SPEC Products Corp.
summary: SPEC Products Corp., located in Tainan, Taiwan, manufactures a diverse array of fastening solutions and precision components for both industrial and automotive clients. Their extensive product catalog includes essential items like nuts, screws, bolts, washers, and pins, alongside specialized offerings such as machined and turned parts, reheaded and forged head bolts, various assemblies (e.g., nut/washer, sems, stamping), cold-formed products, flange screws and nuts, stainless steel screws, round head and shoulder bolts, clinch and double-ended screws, weld nuts and studs, blind and miniature rivets, out-center pins, T-bolts, rivet nuts, tamper-proof screws, and a selection of square, clinch, and licensee fasteners.

name: Carbon-Based Technology Inc.
summary: Carbon-Based Technology, Inc. specializes in the innovation, engineering, and production of advanced composite materials, as well as comprehensive systems and airframes for unmanned aerial vehicles. Its cutting-edge solutions are widely adopted across various sectors, including defense and commercial drone applications, electric vehicle manufacturing, composite structure repair, and the creation of bespoke carbon fiber components. The firm, which was established in 1996, operates from its headquarters located in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Jhu Jian Catering Co., Ltd.
summary: Jhu Jian Catering Co Ltd., established in 2010, oversees a network of dining establishments throughout Taiwan. The company's primary operations are situated in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: LabTurbo Biotech Corporation
summary: LabTurbo Biotech Corporation engages in the research, manufacture, and sale of gene detection systems and kits in Taiwan, the United States, the Czech Republic, Spain, France, Israel, Singapore, the Philippines, and Malaysia. It serves hospitals. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Carilex
summary: Carilex Medical, Inc. specializes in the development and production of healthcare devices designed for the prevention of pressure ulcers and overall wound care management. The company's offerings include advanced therapeutic air mattresses, specialized seating cushions, and systems for negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT). Carilex Medical, Inc. was established on May 23, 2012, and is based in Taoyuan, China.

name: Enli Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Enli Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in providing sophisticated testing solutions exclusively for the optical sensor market. Their extensive services cover detailed evaluations for image sensors, including those utilized in fingerprint-on-display technology, alongside precise testing for photo detectors and the analysis of photon-electron conversion efficiency (EQE). Furthermore, the company offers a range of products, such as both standard and custom-designed light simulators, specialized measurement tools like full-spectrum irradiance meters, and the necessary software to operate these systems. Founded in 2009, Enli Technology maintains its headquarters in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Steminent Biotherapeutics Inc.
summary: Steminent Biotherapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to pioneering novel cellular therapeutics, with a primary focus on the research and development of innovative stem cell drugs. Their flagship product is Stemchymal, which is recognized for its significant therapeutic benefits and broad range of potential applications. The firm was established on December 18, 2007, and operates from its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: MARX Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: MARX Biotech Co., Ltd., established in 2016 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, focuses on the online distribution of health and cosmeceutical products specifically for men.

name: AblePrint Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, AblePrint Technology Co., Ltd. has been delivering advanced process solutions since its establishment in 1996. Serving a global clientele, with a primary focus on the semiconductor industry, the company excels at resolving complex manufacturing challenges. Their expertise includes vital areas such as preventing voids, ensuring void-free soldering, managing heat dissipation, optimizing high-temperature reflow soldering, and suppressing package warpage. Beyond these technical fixes, AblePrint also engineers solutions to boost production efficiency and achieve cost reductions. Their comprehensive suite of offerings features specialized pneumatic and thermal process protocols, integrated process performance strategies, and sophisticated automation system developments.

name: Eastern Union Interactive Corp.
summary: Eastern Union Interactive Corp. (EUI) operates as a FinTech firm, specializing in the delivery of financial services across several Southeast Asian markets, including Taiwan, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Thailand. These offerings are primarily accessible through its dedicated mobile application. Established in 2016, EUI maintains its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: KEE Fresh & Safe Foodtech Co., Ltd.
summary: "Established by Liao Jih Hsing on June 9, 2011, KEE Fresh & Safe Foodtech Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of products that leverage High Pressure Processing (HPP) technology. Based in Pingtung, Taiwan, the company's offerings prominently include various vegetable juices and other functional beverages."

name: Grandtech Cloud Services Inc.
summary: GrandTech Cloud Services Inc. (GCSI) specializes in delivering comprehensive cloud advisory and operational solutions to businesses, both in Taiwan and across international markets. Its diverse portfolio of offerings includes Infrastructure-as-a-Service (IaaS), a robust cloud security monitoring system, and the innovative ARMIN FinOps platform. ARMIN is designed to provide advanced financial operations capabilities for cloud environments, allowing enterprises to effectively monitor usage across leading cloud providers like AWS and GCP, implement stringent cost control and optimization strategies, and streamline cross-regional account management. Established in 2017, the company maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Horng Terng
summary: Horng Terng Automation Co., Ltd. specializes in developing and manufacturing advanced machinery tailored for the LED and solar energy sectors. Their extensive product portfolio encompasses a variety of inspection systems, including visual inspection, electrical testing, and dark collapse detection machines. They also provide solutions for adhesive application, offering both general dispensing equipment and specialized glue dispensing and printing machinery. Rounding out their offerings are automated material handling and connection systems, such as product exchange machines, loading equipment, and automatic connection units. Established in 1994, the company is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Century Huaxin Wind Energy Co. Ltd.
summary: Century Huaxin Wind Energy Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise specializing in the production and distribution of subsea foundation piles. Their offerings also encompass small-diameter steel pipes and essential components for wind turbine towers. Established in 2020, the company's primary base of operations is situated in Taichung City, Taiwan.

name: AnnJi
summary: Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, AnnJi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. specializes in the creation of innovative medicinal treatments. The company's research and development pipeline addresses neurological, dermatological, and inflammatory conditions. Among its key therapeutic candidates are AJ201, which is being developed for the neurodegenerative disorder spinal and bulbar muscular atrophy, and AJ202, targeting androgenetic alopecia. AnnJi also works on AJ302, a histone deacetylase 6 inhibitor aimed at preventing and treating chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, and AJ303, an anti-fibrotic and anti-inflammatory agent intended for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and other fibrotic diseases.

name: Lebledor F&B Co., Ltd.
summary: Based in New Taipei City, Taiwan, Lebledor F&B Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese company that manages restaurant establishments. Founded in 1993, this firm provides a selection of beverages, notably including various beers. Customers can also acquire its products through its online sales platform.

name: Alpha Microelectronics Corporation
summary: Alpha Microelectronics Corporation specializes in the full lifecycle of integrated circuits (ICs), from initial research and development to their design, application, and commercialization. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses a range of specialized integrated circuits, including those for speech, multi-channel voice processing, and recording capabilities. The company also offers diverse microcontrollers (MCUs), from general-purpose to specific LCD and 32-bit versions. Beyond core ICs, Alpha Microelectronics provides essential hardware and software development tools, alongside a suite of supporting 'accessory' ICs. These accessories feature components like motor drivers, audio amplifiers, analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) with microphone inputs, and wireless power transfer solutions. These ICs are predominantly integrated into a wide array of consumer electronics, powering devices such as audio equipment, personal electronic gadgets, home appliances, toys, gifts, and various interactive consumer products. Established in 1992, Alpha Microelectronics maintains its corporate headquarters in Hsinchu, Taiwan.

name: E&R Engineering Corp.
summary: E&R Engineering Corporation engages in the planning, designing, manufacturing, installation, and selling of automatic machines, related components, computer software, and pollution controlling equipment. The company provides automation machines for semiconductor, light emitting diode (LED), passive component, material, and medical industries in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Mainland China, Southeast Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company offers laser solutions, including wafer and package marking; and micromaching, such as laser drilling, cutting, scribing, and grooving solution. It also provides plasma technology products comprising wafer and panel forms, and L/F substrates; flexible printed circuit equipment that consists of RTR, STS, lamination, punch, plating, and open cover machines; embossed carrier tape, cover tape, and E&R tape and reel products; and workshop and laser process development services. E&R Engineering Corporation was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Koryo Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Koryo Electronics Co., Ltd. engages in the production, sale, and import/export of electronic parts and components, and computers and computer peripherals. It also imports/exports electric appliances and components, such as TV sets, video and radio cassette recorders, air conditioners, refrigerators, and microwave ovens; and acts as an agent for related products of Taiwan and international companies on sales, bids, and quotes. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: OPNET Technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: OPNET Technologies Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and markets telecommunication network access and optical transport equipment worldwide. Its access network products include DLC/E1-MUX/IP-MUX, MSAN/SVG, Mini-DSLAM, VoIP gateway, and GPON; and transmission network products comprise CWDM/DWDM/ROADM, carrier grade switching platform, fiber optical multiplexers, TDMo-PSN, Ethernet over PDH, and G.SHDSL.bis bridges/routers. The company also offers enterprise network products, such as EPON; distribution network products that consist of telecom cables, ODF/FDC, FOSC, FDP/FDB, and box panels, as well as accessories; and submarine cable systems, including submarine power, submarine optical fiber, optical fiber composite submarine, special underwater, and high voltage power cables, as well as transoceanic communication system accessories. In addition, the company provides fiber optic sensor solutions; and supports network planning, installation, training, and maintenance services. It serves incumbent fixed-network operators, mobile operators, cable TV operators, utility companies, enterprises, and military entities. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Changs Ascending Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Changs Ascending Enterprise Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of rechargeable batteries and cell materials in Taiwan. The company offers vehicle batteries, including starter batteries for golf carts, forklifts, and hybrids and E-cars; and electronic storage systems (ESS) and uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems for use in office and home applications, ESS UPC backup power, off the grid applications, and solar LED lights. It also provides grid and industrial ESS/UPS energy storage and back-up systems for large UPS, micro grid ESS, mission critical UPS, and traffic light back-up applications. The company was formerly known as Changs Enterprise Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Changs Ascending Enterprise Co., Ltd. in July 2000. Changs Ascending Enterprise Co., Ltd. was founded in 1997 and is based in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: IC Plus Corp.
summary: Established in 1997 and based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, IC Plus Corp. delivers comprehensive, ready-to-use solutions, primarily targeting the Taiwanese market. The company's core offerings include transceivers, Ethernet switches, media converters, and Power over Ethernet (PoE) devices. Specifically, their product portfolio encompasses PHY transceivers, PoE PSE controllers, various media converters, microcontroller unit (MCU) products and their associated drivers, along with a range of Ethernet switches. These versatile solutions are utilized across diverse sectors such as surveillance, industrial operations, smart grid infrastructure, and by small and medium-sized businesses.

name: Taiwan Chinsan Electronic Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Chinsan Electronic Industrial Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and distributes electrolytic capacitors. The company offers aluminum electrolytic capacitors, such as radial lead type, snap-in lug terminal type, and screw terminal type capacitors; and aluminum polymer capacitors comprising polymer radial lead type and polymer SMD type capacitors. Taiwan Chinsan Electronic Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1970 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Honey Hope Honesty Enterprise Co.,Ltd
summary: Honey Hope Honesty Enterprise Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sales agency of multilayer ceramic capacitors and inductors in passive components in Taiwan, Asia, and internationally. It provides electronic components, and related products. The company also engages in investment activities. Honey Hope Honesty Enterprise Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: PChome Online Inc.
summary: PChome Online Inc. provides e-commerce and portal services in China and internationally. It operates through E-Commerce-Sales, Market Place, and Other segments. The company operates PChome 24h Shopping, PChome Shopping, and PChome Global Shopping Websites. It also operates portals that provide a range of network services, including news platforms, stock markets, email, Kaza personal blog, news, travel, car-buying, customized photo album, search channels, etc., as well as online adverting services, such as display advertising and display network. In addition, the company offers type II telecommunications, magazine publication, international trade and investment, online payment processing, travel agency, information, transportation and logistics, clothing sales, information processing, electronic information, and Internet services. PChome Online Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: TWOWAY Communications, Inc.
summary: TWOWAY Communications, Inc. specializes in the conception, manufacturing, and global distribution of advanced radio frequency (RF) and optical transmission equipment for both indoor and outdoor applications. The company's market footprint spans Taiwan, the United States, various regions in Asia, and Europe. Primarily serving the cable television and telecommunications industries, TWOWAY provides essential infrastructure components such as broadband signal amplifiers, optical nodes, and core headend optoelectronics. Its extensive product catalog also features comprehensive fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) solutions, optical workstations, and a variety of optical fiber line and network terminal units. Furthermore, the company offers sophisticated headend optical transmission platforms, intelligent modular optical transmission systems, and associated hardware including main frame chassis, platform control modules, and both VAC and DC power supply units. Its optical product range extends to downlink optical transmitter modules, forward optical transmitters, and both downlink and uplink light receiving modules, in addition to optical amplification EDFA modules. The company also supplies specialized EDFA fiber amplifiers, headend amplifiers, robust outdoor optical workstation platforms, 1U forward OTX series headend equipment, outdoor RF amplifiers, automatic gain modules (DSIM series), and a selection of client-specific products. Founded in 1992, TWOWAY Communications, Inc. operates from its corporate headquarters located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Great Computer Corp.
summary: Great Computer Corp. (GCC) is a technology firm that produces and markets a diverse array of computing hardware, encompassing electronic components, complete computer systems, and various peripheral devices. The company's operations span major global markets, including Taiwan, the United States, Europe, and China. Beyond hardware, GCC also engages in the wholesale and retail distribution of information software solutions. Its product portfolio further includes a range of specialized digital fabrication and printing machinery, such as laser engravers, markers, cutters, cutting plotters, vinyl cutters, advanced UV-curable inkjet printers, and other digital finishing equipment. These offerings cater to numerous sectors, finding application in industries like signage, advertising, personalization, identification, gifts, promotions, apparel, and electronics. Great Computer Corp. distributes its products through an extensive network of partners. Established in 1989, the company is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Ruby Tech Corporation
summary: Ruby Tech Corporation manufactures and sells networking products in Taiwan. It offers PoE Ethernet and industrial switches; managed, Web-smart, unmanaged, PoE, mode, and industrial converters; fiber NICs; and OLT and ONU products, and splitters, as well as HW/SW customization services. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Ampire Co., Ltd.
summary: Ampire Co., Ltd. designs, manufactures, and sells liquid crystal display (LCD) modules and touch screens for industrial applications. The company offers large, medium, and small TN, STN, FSTN, TFT, and capacitive TP modules, as well as graphic, character, and open frame products. Its products are used in non-consumer application panels, such as white home appliances, HMI, card reader, industrial instrumentation, medical devices, automobile display panel, touch panel PC/Monitor, maritime information display panel, on-board entertainment panel, smart home control display panel, kiosks, and multi-functional office machines. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: IBASE Technology Inc.
summary: IBASE Technology Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, and sells industrial PCs in Taiwan and internationally. The company primarily offers industrial motherboards, embedded systems, panel PCs, digital signage players, and network appliances, as well as RISC computing products, such as ARM-based Freescale i.MX6 SBCs, SMARC modules and carrier boards, and SMARC development kits for various applications in industrial automation, smart retail, networking and communication, intelligent transportation, medical, gaming, healthcare, smart factory, and entertainment and hospitality markets. It also provides original and joint design manufacturing services, such as board/system specification design, software design, manufacturing, validation, and after services. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Alcor Micro,Corp.
summary: Alcor Micro,Corp., a fabless IC design company, designs, develops, and markets integrated semiconductor chips and software solutions for the personal computer peripherals and consumer electronics worldwide. The company offers human interface input and output solutions, such as flash media reader, USB hub, camera, and other multimedia related controllers. It also provides mobile device, data link, USB flash disk, and SSD storage controllers, as well as SD card controllers. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: CastleNet Technology Inc.
summary: CastleNet Technology Inc. develops, manufactures, and sells network communication equipment in Taiwan. It offers data cable modems, data and EMTA gateway products, and embedded cable modem modules, as well as products in the WAN, LAN, and wireless fields to MSO, telecom, and ISP companies. It also supplies its products to Europe, Japan, and Korea. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Contrel Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Contrel Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of LCD equipment in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers panel automation products, such as CF/TFT whole plant, LCD whole factory panel, and RTP/RTS whole line panel transmission equipment integration system, as well as pack/unpack equipment; panel process equipment; and glass appearance inspection, burr check, electrical testing, light on test, MACRO, and mini LED test equipment, as well as PAD inspection machine. It also provides semiconductor automation solutions, such as EFEM integrated system, OHS automated handling system, storage systems, and automatic optical inspection products, as well as laser cutting, pattering, drilling, and repair equipment. In addition, the company offers laser equipment, including TFT array and LCD cell repair equipment, LCD bright point repair systems, OLED dark point repair equipment, circuit missing line repair machine, carbonization machine, glass cutting machine, OLED mask clean equipment, and laser marking/automatic optical inspection systems; logistic systems, including sorting system, automatic warehouse and handling system, and intelligent logistics equipment; LED vacuum coating equipment, such as glue, evaporation, optical, and continuous sputtering machine; and micro nano products. Contrel Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Lifestyle Global Enterprise Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, Lifestyle Global Enterprise Inc., along with its group companies, specializes in the global distribution of furniture. Their product line includes a variety of seating options like sofas and chairs, as well as other wooden and leather furnishings. Established in 1996, the company adopted its current name in June 2012, having previously operated as FuPo Electronics Corporation.

name: Gish International Co., Ltd
summary: Gish International Co., Ltd operates as a distribution company in Japan, Singapore, China, Canada, the United States, Australia, and Chile. It offers a range of products, including fragrances and beauty products. The company was founded in 1989 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Chander Electronics Corp.
summary: Chander Electronics Corp. engages in the distribution and maintenance of electronic components, integrated circuits, and design and test equipment. The company is also involved in the maintenance of computers and related spare parts; and analysis, planning, designing, development, import and export, distribution, and maintenance of computer and software systems. It also provides cloud services. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: E Ink Holdings Inc.
summary: E Ink Holdings Inc. is a global enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and distribution of electronic paper display (EPD) panels. The company manufactures a wide array of high-resolution modules, which are utilized in e-readers, digital note-taking tools, mobile phone accessories, wearable technology, electronic shelf labels, logistic and luggage tags, smart cards, digital signage, and smart packaging solutions. Additionally, E Ink provides segmented displays for integration into consumer electronics, timepieces, medical instruments, industrial gauges, PC peripherals, smart cards, electronic price tags, and mobile communication devices. Its product portfolio also encompasses electronic ink films, flexible substrate materials, and polyimide and other functional material films. These innovative products find applications across numerous sectors, including reading and writing, computing and peripherals, mobile and wearable devices, retail, logistics and warehousing, healthcare, transportation and outdoor displays, smart home systems, and various design-centric uses. Founded in 1992 as Prime View International, Inc., the company officially rebranded to E Ink Holdings Inc. in June 2010 and maintains its headquarters in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: ABICO NetCom Co.,Ltd.
summary: ABICO NetCom Co.,Ltd. operates as a pre-recorded disk manufacturing company. The company engages in the real estate investment business; film production/marketing/acting agent business; and investment businesses. It offers contact lenses; digital business machines, POS systems, and communication systems; sports related supplies; machines and printers; components and production molds; auto parts, modules, power tool machine gear packs, and residential appliances/ OA-related parts; mobile phones, digital cameras, 3C electronics products, metal and plastic chassis exterior parts, and internal components; and digital imaging products. The company was formerly known as ABICO-FS Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ABICO NetCom Co.,Ltd. in 2019. ABICO NetCom Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Aurona Industries, Inc.
summary: Aurona Industries, Inc. produces phenolic resin laminates of drilling backup boards, and insulating materials to print circuit board and mechanical industries. The company's product portfolio includes PCB drilling back-up/entry boards, routing back-up/entry boards, bakelites, diamond coating routers, medium-density fiberboards, aluminum lubrication entry boards, cushion craft papers, collets, and pressure brushes.
