It supplies its products to the high-end PCB and IC carrier fabricators, as well as for use in the PCB applications, including smart phone, flash memory chip, PBGA, flip chip drilling, etc. The company supplies its products to approximately 10 countries, such as Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Germany, and the United States. Aurona Industries, Inc. was founded in 1996 and is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Firich Enterprises Co., Ltd.
summary: Firich Enterprises Co., Ltd. engages in the design and manufacture of POS systems worldwide. The company offers XPOS and mobile POS products; POS and BOX systems; lite, fanless, and performance panel PCs; monitors; kiosks; and peripherals. It provides POS solutions for the hospitality and retail markets. The company was founded in 1995 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Green World Hotels Co., Ltd.
summary: Green World Hotels Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates hotels and restaurants in Taiwan. The company offers hotel room and catering, room accommodation, leasing and management services. The company was formerly known as Applied Vacuum Coating Technologies Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Green World Hotels Co., Ltd. in July 2015. The company was founded in 1978 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan. Green World Hotels Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of HIS Hotel Holdings Co., Ltd.

name: TerraLink Enterprise Co Ltd
summary: Taiwan Ostor Corporation manufactures and sells electronic components. It offers electrolytic capacitors for use in the motherboard and power supply markets; solid capacitors; and Trusted Platform Module, a microcontroller installed on the motherboard of a PC or laptop designed to provide security-related functions and create cryptographic keys and digital certificates. The company also offers fingerprint solutions, interquip electronics, and multilayer ceramic capacitors. In addition, it provides medical crystal products, such as scintillator. Further, the company offers crystalline solar modules, photovoltaic (PV) ethylene-vinyl-acetate films, PV backsheets, PV module automatic equipment, and PV junction boxes, as well as conductive silver paste. Taiwan Ostor Corporation was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Pro-Hawk Corporation
summary: Pro-Hawk Corporation operates globally, specializing in the design, development, manufacturing, and marketing of a wide array of bearings, rollers, injection-molded components, and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) parts. Their extensive product portfolio includes custom and garage door bearings, alongside various rollers for garage doors, car washes, and truck doors. The company also supplies rollers for sliding windows, doors, and wardrobe systems. Furthermore, Pro-Hawk manufactures wheels and rollers for skateboarding and conveyor systems, such as conveyor bearings, gravity rollers, carton flow rollers, and PVC rollers. Additional offerings encompass rollers for sports equipment, exercise machines, and treadmills, as well as a selection of pulleys, including nylon and plastic versions tailored for casters, lawnmowers, tractors, and diverse automotive applications. These versatile components are integral to conveyor systems, garage and truck door mechanisms, sliding door assemblies, caster and wheel setups, and the automotive industry. Established in 1976, Pro-Hawk Corporation is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Chip Hope Co., Ltd
summary: Chip Hope Co., Ltd. specializes in the development, production, and distribution of computer hardware and associated software solutions. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a broad spectrum of technological goods, including electronic components, semiconductors, and various types of equipment such as communications gear, machinery, electrical apparatus, general instrumentation, and advanced optical and precision devices. They also supply medical equipment, metrology and measuring instruments, and a range of computer and software products. Notably, their offerings extend to specialized items like integrated caller ID telephone modules and switch systems, alongside cutting-edge AI smart hearing aids. Beyond its tech ventures, Chip Hope diversifies its operations into the hospitality sector, managing hotels, restaurants, recreational facilities, and hot springs, in addition to engaging in food wholesale and catering services. The company also dedicates resources to the research and development of biotech medical products and maintains a general investment portfolio. Established in 1982, Chip Hope Co., Ltd. has its headquarters situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Forward Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Forward Electronics Co., Ltd., founded in 1970 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, is a prominent manufacturer and supplier of electronic components. The company's primary business involves producing and distributing tuners along with a diverse range of precision electronic parts, such as switches, encoders, potentiometers, and sensors. Furthermore, Forward Electronics offers optoelectronic products and provides original equipment/design manufacturing (OEM/ODM) services. Their comprehensive product portfolio also includes LED packaging and lighting solutions, backlight modules, digital TV modules, and video boxes. Additionally, they produce variable resistors and various consumer electronics like Bluetooth mice, headphones, remote controls, card readers, and LCD display modules.

name: Advanced Wireless Semiconductor Company
summary: Founded in Tainan City, Taiwan, in 1998, Advanced Wireless Semiconductor Company operates as a dedicated semiconductor foundry. The firm delivers a suite of advanced process technologies, including InGaP/GaAs HBT, specifically engineered for power amplifier and gain block circuit designs. Additionally, they offer GaAs E/D pHEMT processes, which are ideal for switch and low noise amplifier applications. Their ED BiHEMT technology further enables high-level integration for single-chip solutions, particularly relevant for modern smartphone and WiFi devices. Beyond these core offerings, AWSC's comprehensive services encompass HBT, ED pHEMT, ED BiHEMT, Integrated Passive Devices (IPD), and bumping services tailored for radio frequency and wireless applications, as well as VCSEL/optical solutions.

name: Leadsun Greentech Corporation
summary: Homenema Technology Incorporation manufactures and sells professional pre-recorded optic discs in Taiwan. The company offers compact discs (CDs) consisting of audio and video CDs, as well as mixed mode, ROM, and card CDs; and digital versatile discs. It also provides packaging services. The company's products are used in digital music and videos, gaming, software, and business cards applications. Homenema Technology Incorporation was founded in 1997 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Panram International Corp.
summary: Panram International Corp. provides electronic manufacturing services in Taiwan. The company offers services, such as ODM and OEM services, as well as product design, raw material procurement, logistic management, transportation, product testing, and RMA services. Its products include DRAM modules; flash memory products, such as pen drives and fingerprint drives; I/O products; keyboards, touch panel control boards, and VGA cards; and embedded storage products, touch screen controllers, and card readers. The company also provides SSDs, SD/microSD cards and USB modules, FDM modules, conformal coatings, and anti-sulfur modules. Panram International Corp. was founded in 1994 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Comtrend Corporation
summary: Comtrend Corporation designs and manufactures broadband communication equipment worldwide. The company offers switches, SMB wireless products, powerline and coax adapters, and power over Ethernet products. Comtrend Corporation was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Feedback Technology Corp.
summary: Feedback Technology Corp. manufactures and sells components for semiconductor, LCD, LED, and vacuum industries in Taiwan. The company offers helium leak detectors, MV multi-traps, pureron gas filters, SiC coated susceptors, and silicon boat for vertical furnace; and high precision matching and surface treatment products; as well as provides repair and overhaul services. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Chien Wei Precise Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Chien Wei Precise Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells precise molding and measuring machines, and machine tools worldwide. Its products include 2D/3D precise measuring instruments, precision JIG grinders, machining centers, vertical grinding machines, IC-semiconductor special accessories, trimming and forming products, ultra-precision optics, and DVD molds. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Enermax Technology Corporation
summary: Enermax Technology Corporation manufactures and sells PC components and peripherals worldwide. It offers power supplies; cases comprising full, mid, and mini towers; fans; air and liquid coolers; peripherals, such as monitor stands, USB fans, air guides, headset holders, blackplane modules, mobile racks, card readers, HDD enclosures, keyboards, and notebook coolers; and audio products, including speakers and earphones. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: CoAsia Electronics Corp.
summary: CoAsia Electronics Corp. provides components for mobile multimedia in Taiwan and internationally. It offers CMOS, 3D, and automotive image sensors; processors, PMICs, and NFC components; memory solutions; mobile and IT AMOLEDs; and balanced membrane drivers, chip solutions, driver IC's, and battery protection circuit packages, as well as micro controller units for remote controllers, small home application, and LCD applications. The company was formerly known as CoAsia Microelectronics Corp. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: ATW Technology Inc.
summary: ATW Technology Inc. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells wireless communication products in the United States, Europe, and Asia. It offers wireless indoor and outdoor APs/repeaters, including Wi-Fi range extenders and routers; wireless indoor network adapters, which includes Bluetooth speaker adapters, and display and wireless USB dongles; wireless outdoor adapters; indoor signal boosters; and networking adapters, such as Wi-Fi and USB adapters, PCI and PCI-E cards, modems, and modem cards. The company also provides 4G/4.5G products; switch hubs; smart IoT products; dual Wan xDSL 4G Indoor Wi-Fi routers; ADSL routers; routers with VoIP; and VDSL products. In addition, it offers cellular phone peripheral components, power adaptors, IP cameras, etc. The company was formerly known as L&K Precision Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ATW Technology Inc. in September 2013. ATW Technology Inc. was founded in 1986 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Duratek
summary: Established in Tainan, Taiwan, in 1983, Dura Tek, Inc. (Duratek) operates as a specialist in the creation and fabrication of simulation testing apparatus for diverse industrial components. Its comprehensive product portfolio encompasses critical items such as retaining rings, CVD Shower Plates, Conditioners, Susceptors, and CVD Heaters. Beyond its core offerings, Duratek is actively involved in pioneering research and development focused on advanced manufacturing technologies. Furthermore, the company is a manufacturer of essential components for semiconductor equipment, as well as specialized inspection equipment.

name: Tatung System Technologies Inc.
summary: Tatung System Technologies Inc. provides professional services and assistance in digital transformation. The company provides services, including intelligent solutions, consultancy services, cloud services, information and communication system integration and construction, protection of data security, and uninterrupted services, as well as AI medical image recognition system for mammography and smart medical services. It serves customers in a range of industries, such as telecommunication, financial holdings, manufacturing, media, retail, government, military, universities, and research organizations. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Jeilin Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jeilin Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the development, research, and distribution of integrated circuits for image processing. Their offerings include system-on-chip (SoC) solutions for digital video recorders (DVRs) and digital still cameras (DSCs), ranging from high-definition (HD) and full-HD (FHD) to 2.7K resolution, with certain 2.7K models incorporating Wi-Fi capabilities. The company also supplies a comprehensive selection of SoCs for trail cameras, featuring HD, FHD, and 3-megapixel to 12-megapixel options. Advanced trail camera SoCs are available with integrated Wi-Fi or 4G-LTE connectivity, alongside 2.7K and 4K Ultra HD (UHD) support. Furthermore, Jeilin Technology manufactures VPX fully digital control modules for both radio frequency (RF) transmitter/receiver functions and precision timing generation. Founded in 1992, the enterprise is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Tayih Kenmos Auto parts Co., Ltd.
summary: Tayih Kenmos Auto parts Co., Ltd. researches, develops, manufactures, and sells automotive blow molding and filtration parts in Taiwan and internationally. It offers automobile cabin air filters, automatic transmission filters, home air purifier filters, face masks, and other products; running boards; and pickup sport bars, tonneau covers, and other exteriors. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: P-Duke Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1992, P-Duke Technology Co.,Ltd. operates from its headquarters in Taichung, Taiwan. The company is a specialist in the comprehensive development, manufacturing, sales, and support of DC/DC converters and associated power conversion products, serving markets across Europe, the United States, and Japan. Under its P-DUKE brand, the firm’s diverse portfolio includes AC-DC power supplies, DC-DC converters, medical-grade DC-DC and AC-DC solutions, railway power systems, and surge suppression modules.

name: Ligitek Electronics Co.,Ltd
summary: Ligitek Electronics Co.,Ltd designs, develops, manufactures, and sells a range of optoelectronic components in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers LED products, such as through hole LEDs, PCB type surface-mount device (SMD), PLCC SMDs, leads type SMDs, invisible LED, automotive LED, ambient light sensors, smart LED, arrays, SMD type displays, LED displays, dot matrixes, and LED back lights. Its products are used in the LED lighting, mass transit and MRT system, automobile and motorcycle LED module, customized lighting, imaging lighting infrared module products and ODM, UV module group product and ODM, solar energy, and e-bike applications. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Clientron Corp.
summary: Clientron Corp. provides integrated embedded solutions worldwide. It designs, manufactures, and supplies thin client solutions, POS systems, automotive electronics, and embedded computing solutions, as well as offers after sales services. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Acme Electronics Corporation
summary: Acme Electronics Corporation produces and sells soft ferrite products in Taiwan. The company primarily offers Mn-Zn ferrite cores, Ni-Zn ferrite cores, and Mg-Zn ferrite cores for use in telecommunication, power conversion, and interference suppression applications. Its soft ferrite products comprise inductance passive electronic components, such as power transformers, loaded coils, and choke and demagnetization coils, which are used in various 3C devices, including power supplies, desktop monitors, notebooks, broadband network systems, telephone switching systems, relay stations, mobile phones, PDAs, LCD TVs, digital cameras, digital video cameras, video games handsets, scanners, etc. The company also provides sapphire ingots to sapphire wafer customers. Acme Electronics Corporation was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Nextronics Engineering Corp.
summary: Nextronics Engineering Corp. provides connectors, and PICMG components and solutions for medical, aerospace, transportation, industrial, cloud/communication, and automation applications in Taiwan. The company offers high speed I/O, push pull circular, backplane signal, and combo power connectors; and embedded system connectors and components. It also provides terminal blocks, press-fit machine and tooling products, and customized-solutions, as well as Compact PCI, ATCA, and AMC and Micro TCA product solutions. The company was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Allied Circuit Co., Ltd.
summary: Allied Circuit Co., Ltd., a Taiwanese company, specializes in the production and distribution of printed circuit boards (PCBs) for industrial and commercial sectors within Taiwan. The company's offerings include robust, high-reliability, and rigid multi-layer PCBs, alongside advanced High-Density Interconnect (HDI) technology. Established in 1995, Allied Circuit's operations are headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Formosa Electronic Industries Inc.
summary: Formosa Electronic Industries Inc. manufactures and sells single-string battery modules, mobile power supplies, wireless charging devices, green energy battery modules, and distributed energy storage systems. The company provides renewable energy sites, system integration, engineering construction, and import and export of related products. It also offers energy storage systems, energy storage equipment, battery modules, cells, and other products. In addition, the company offers industrial and commercial energy storage, home energy storage, AGV battery pack, BBU battery pack, ups battery pack, power battery, and other batteries. The company was founded in 1983 and is based in Taipei Hsien, Taiwan.

name: Z-Com, Inc.
summary: Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, Z-Com, Inc. specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of wireless networking solutions. The company's reach extends throughout Taiwan, Mainland China, Germany, and various international markets. Z-Com's product portfolio includes advanced wireless LAN controllers for carrier-grade, SMB, and industrial private network applications, as well as indoor and outdoor access points and Wi-Fi modules. Additionally, they provide 4G LTE cellular gateways and crucial accessories such as antennas, power adapters, and Power over Ethernet (PoE) injectors. Beyond hardware, Z-Com delivers comprehensive wireless solutions tailored for diverse needs, including new energy communication management, private networks, surveillance systems, hospitality, rural connectivity, in-vehicle Wi-Fi, smart campus environments, and carrier Wi-Fi offload. The company also offers expert system integration services for complex wireless communication infrastructures.

name: Subtron Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Subtron Technology Co., Ltd manufactures and sells IC carrier boards and soft boards in Taiwan. Its products primarily include system in package RF, LED lighting, optical communication module, sensor, 5G related, and PBGA/CSP/TFBGA products, as well as TAB, COF, EMV TAB, and INK products. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Harmony Electronics Co. Ltd
summary: Harmony Electronics Co. Ltd, established in 1976 and based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, specializes in the global manufacturing and distribution of precision frequency control devices. The company's diverse product range encompasses quartz crystals, crystal oscillators, microphones, and various related electronic components. These essential parts are widely adopted across numerous industries, playing a crucial role in consumer electronics such as mobile phones and personal computers, as well as in demanding industrial and automotive applications.

name: Progate Group Corporation
summary: Progate Group Corporation is a global provider of comprehensive integrated circuit (IC) design services. The company specializes in end-to-end solutions spanning a wide spectrum of IC development needs. Its offerings include full ASIC development, implementation platform services, and complete product turnkey solutions. Progate's capabilities extend to MPW (Multi-Project Wafer) and cyber shuttle programs, advanced CoWoS (Chip-on-Wafer-on-Substrate) turnkey, gate array turnkey, and conversions from FPDA to ASIC. Furthermore, it provides specialized solutions such as embedded flash, high voltage, and System-on-Chip (SoC) platform turnkey services. Additional offerings encompass IP design, APR (Automatic Place and Route) layout, COT (Customer-Owned Tooling)/foundry turnkey, and sophisticated system-in-package (SiP) and 3D package turnkey solutions. Beyond these comprehensive design services, Progate is also a key provider of diverse IP (Intellectual Property) cores. This IP portfolio features CPU, digital, mixed-signal, and analog IPs, alongside specialized IO and memory IPs, as well as high-speed interface PHY services. Established in 1991, Progate Group Corporation maintains its corporate headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: NEXCOM International Co., Ltd.
summary: NEXCOM International Co., Ltd. provides Internet of Things (IoT) automation solutions, intelligent platform and services, mobile computing solutions, network and communication solutions, intelligent digital security, and medical and healthcare informatics products worldwide. The company offers IoT automation solutions, such as industrial fanless computer, google cloud IoT ready solution, industrial wireless solution, industry firewall solution, IoT solution, industrial touch computer, machine automation, PC-based factory automation, and software solution; and smart system solutions, including AI accelerators, interactive signage solution packs, multimedia player application platforms, multimedia machine tablets, embedded computer, open frame tablets, TV wall digital electronic signage solutions, digital electronic signboard dedicated hardware platforms, point of sale terminals, and rack industrial computers. It also provides car computer suctions comprising AI edge telematics solutions, embedded add-on modules, mobile NVRs, car computers, car network equipment, car touch screen computers, rugged car displays, modular on-board computers, and railway computers. In addition, the company offers network communication solutions, including cyber security solutions, edge and cloud solutions, industrial gateway solutions, network peripheral solutions, and SoC capability and S/W services; and smart medical solutions, such as healthcare medical, IoT gateway, software package, and video conference system. Further, it provides intelligent monitoring solutions comprising 3D cameras, panoramic cameras, license plate recognition cameras, monitoring video platforms, and webcams; and smart system and movie and film solutions. NEXCOM International Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Wah Hong Industrial Corp.
summary: Wah Hong Industrial Corp. is a Taiwanese enterprise with a global presence, specializing in the research, manufacturing, and distribution of sophisticated plastic compounds and composite materials. Its extensive portfolio encompasses a wide array of advanced solutions. These include various optical films, such as diffusion, reflection, prism, quantum dot, and polarizing films, along with diffusion and guide plates, and essential materials for touch panels. Wah Hong also provides numerous precision coating products, including protective, screen protector, anti-shatter, and hard coating films, offering both standard products and OEM/ODM services. Furthermore, it supplies a diverse range of molding compounds (both bulk and precise), high-performance engineering plastics, various composite materials, and specialized dry BMCs and DAP pellets. For thermal management, the company develops high thermal conductivity composites, multi-functional heat-dissipating metallic materials, and custom thermal graphite products. Finally, it produces critical components for semiconductor manufacturing, specifically Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) guide and retainer rings. These specialized materials find broad applications across key sectors, including sports equipment, automotive manufacturing, telecommunications, and consumer electronics. Established in 1973, the company is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. It operated under the name Wah Hong Chemical Corp. until 1997 when it adopted its current designation, Wah Hong Industrial Corp.

name: Actron Technology Corporation
summary: Actron Technology Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells electronic components of vehicles for automakers worldwide. It offers high and low cup, and JP pressfit diodes; dish diodes; and TO-220, standard, micro, and jumbo button diodes. The company also provides alternators, regulators, and anti-lock brake system controls. Actron Technology Corporation was founded in 1998 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Changing Information Technology Inc.
summary: Headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, Changing Information Technology Inc. specializes in delivering robust digital authentication and cybersecurity solutions. The company's diverse offerings include advanced zero-trust authentication systems, specialized security measures for the financial technology (Fintech) sector, and innovative applications designed to facilitate digital transformation.

name: Unifosa Corp.
summary: Unifosa Corp. operates as a memory modules ODM/OEM company in Taiwan. The company offers notebook and niche product memory modules, including DRAM and FLASH memories. It also provides storage products and polymer films, such as stretch hood, synthetic paper, PE and PP separators, multi-layer separator, and PE film products. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Syngen Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: Syngen Biotech Co., Ltd. operates as a biotech company in Taiwan. The company manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients, including Mupirocin, an antibiotic against gram-positive bacteria that is used for the topical treatment of superficial infections, such as impetigo and infections, as well as to control infected eczema, wounds, and burns; and nutraceutical ingredients comprising probiotics, medicinal fungi, and entomogenous fungi. It also offers biology fermentation, biology agriculture and aquaculture, and functional food products. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Appro Technology Inc.
summary: Appro Technology Inc. engages in the design and development of a range of security and surveillance systems in Taiwan. The company offers cloud IP cameras, including Wi-Fi and IP cameras; professional IP cameras, such as box IP, fixed-dome, speed dome, bullet, and fisheye IP cameras; video servers; network video recorders; and accessories, such as racks and mounts. It also provides software solutions comprising AppPro APP and Central Management System 1030. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Mitake Information Corporation
summary: Mitake Information Corporation engages in the computer equipment installation, information software services, and electronic communication and information equipment trading business in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1991 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Taitien Electronics Co., Ltd.
summary: Taitien Electronics Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells quartz frequency control components in Taiwan, the United States, Europe, and China. Its products include crystal units, crystal oscillators, VCXO, TCXO, OCXO, QCM, equipment, mini oven, and timing modules. The company serves automotive, consumer electronics, information technology, and telecommunication industries. Taitien Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: ShineMore Technology Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: ShineMore Technology Materials Co., Ltd. provides copper clad laminates and carbon and glass fiber composites. It offers FR-4 CCL, prepreg/bonding sheet, and metal CCL products. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Genie Networks Limited
summary: Genie Networks Limited provides networking and security solutions worldwide. It offers GenieATM, GenieATM FLB, GenieATM visual portal, GenieATM MSP server, GenieATM traffic optimizer, GenieAnalytics, and GenieAnalytics deep trace. The company also offers AI-enabled network security, data correlation for forensic insights, network traffic analytics, insight-driven optimization, DDoS protection, managed service enabling, and traffic data exploration solutions. It serves Internet service providers, government organizations, academic institutions, and large-scale enterprises. Genie Networks Limited was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Phison Electronics Corp.
summary: Phison Electronics Corp. designs, manufactures, and sells flash memory controllers and peripheral system applications in Asia, the United States, Europe, Australia, and internationally. The company offers controllers and modules of SSD; controllers and modules of embedded flash used on portable applications; controllers and modules of USB; and controllers and modules of memory cards. It also designs, researches, develops, produces, sells, imports, and exports storage devices, integrated circuits, and systems and electronics hardware and software, as well as technical support services. In addition, the company manufactures and trades in electronic components. Further, it is involved in the investment activities. The company serves consumer, industrial, and enterprise markets. Phison Electronics Corp. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Miaoli, Taiwan.

name: Taiwan Television Enterprise Co.,Ltd.
summary: Taiwan Television Enterprise Co.,Ltd. (TTV) is a prominent television broadcaster operating within Taiwan. The company manages and airs a diverse range of channels, including its flagship "Taiwan TV" station, dedicated news coverage through "Taiwan TV News," a financial and economic programming channel known as "TTV Finance and Economics Channel," and the "TTV integrated station" which features classic dramas, various entertainment programs, and informational content. Beyond its core broadcasting activities, TTV has a broad operational scope. This includes the publication and distribution of magazines, books, and audio materials, as well as video distribution. It also orchestrates the planning and execution of public relations campaigns and performing arts events. Furthermore, it offers comprehensive conference and exhibition services, advertising solutions, and provides venues for music performances. Established in 1951, Taiwan Television Enterprise Co.,Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: I Jang Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: I Jang Industrial Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells commercial storage equipment, and custom-made and household products worldwide. The company offers store display products, such as fruit, display, and flower racks; display, shopping basket, and mesh shop display stands; display tables; and wire rotary displays, as well as healthcare products comprising binder, shelves binder, and medical trolley carts; and shelving covers. It also provides moving storage rack systems, cylinder and cargo trolleys, warehouse cages, trolley and tool carts, and metal pallets for logistics and warehouses; and stainless steel trolleys and storage racks, working carts, stainless steel work tables, and storage racks for food services and restaurants. In addition, the company offers customized display stands, AGV pallets, and foldable display racks. Further, it provides home furniture products, such as wagons, heavy duty and corner shelving, slimline and other shelving, and magazine racks. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Changhua City, Taiwan.

name: QST International Corp.
summary: QST International Corp. manufactures and sells automotive fasteners and metal parts worldwide. It provides proprietary fasteners, such as screws and induction hardened bolts; and auto fasteners, including weld bolts and weld studs, screws and washer assemblies, multi-die headed pins and rivets, and special screws per print, as well as internal, external, and non-fasteners. The company also offers third party testing and consulting services, as well as training services; and logistics services, including tailored services that consist of JIT, kanban, VMI, Bar Code, 2 Bin, in-house crib and products integration, localization, joint design, and value analysis and engineering to OEM assembly plants, as well as operates Halofast.com/VMI, a Web-based EDI platform to provide remote VMI service. QST International Corp. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: QST International Corp.
summary: QST International Corp. manufactures and sells automotive fasteners and metal parts worldwide. It provides proprietary fasteners, such as screws and induction hardened bolts; and auto fasteners, including weld bolts and weld studs, screws and washer assemblies, multi-die headed pins and rivets, and special screws per print, as well as internal, external, and non-fasteners. The company also offers third party testing and consulting services, as well as training services; and logistics services, including tailored services that consist of JIT, kanban, VMI, Bar Code, 2 Bin, in-house crib and products integration, localization, joint design, and value analysis and engineering to OEM assembly plants, as well as operates Halofast.com/VMI, a Web-based EDI platform to provide remote VMI service. QST International Corp. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: Koan Hao Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Koan Hao Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells self-adhesive labels in Taiwan. It offers release papers, including PE coated Kraft, glassine, clay coated Kraft, and super calandered Kraft paper; film release liners, such as PET, PP, and HDPE release liners; and adhesive tapes, such as surface protective films, adhesive transfer tapes, and film and non-woven tissue double sided adhesive tapes. The company also provides PSA label materials comprising paper, film, tamper evident, and re-sealable labels; and thermal and UV release film tapes, and PE laminated non-woven products, as well as contract coatings. It serves decorative, electronics and optoelectronics, automobiles, logistics, food and beverage, and consumer commodity industries. The company was formerly known as Koan Hao Enterprise Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Koan Hao Technology Co., Ltd. in 2013. Koan Hao Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1992 and is headquartered in Nantou City, Taiwan.

name: Co-Tech Development Corporation
summary: Co-Tech Development Corporation (CTDC), along with its affiliated companies, specializes in the production and distribution of copper foils throughout Taiwan and mainland China. The company's operations are segmented into its core Copper Foil business and other diversified areas. CTDC's comprehensive product line includes essential materials such as fiberglass, epoxy resin, copper foil, fiberglass cloth, and polyimide (PI). They also manufacture a range of critical components, including copper foil substrates, various types of printed circuit boards (PCBs) – such as flexible PCBs and copper clad laminates – BGA carrier boards, TAB, and chip-on-film solutions. These advanced products are vital for a broad spectrum of modern applications, including AIoT, cloud computing, 5G communication, automotive electronics, medical devices, wearables, home appliances, and personal computers. Originally incorporated in 1998 as Co-Tech Copper Foil Corporation, the company officially rebranded to Co-Tech Development Corporation in June 2014. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Cashbox Partyworld Co., Ltd.
summary: Cashbox Partyworld Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the karaoke business in Taiwan and China. The company conducts its operations through Services Industries segment. It offers karaoke entertainment services. The company is also involved the distribution and trade of karaoke equipment and supplies; sale of food and beverages; retail of stationery, toys, entertainment products, books, and tobacco; and management consulting business. It operates 12 branches and 16 direct stores. The company was formerly known as Cashbox Consulting Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Cashbox Partyworld Co., Ltd. in September 2000. Cashbox Partyworld Co., Ltd. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Chen Full International Co., Ltd.
summary: Chen Full International Co., Ltd., established in 1976 and based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is a global enterprise active in both engineering and manufacturing. The company provides a comprehensive suite of engineering services, including the design and installation of custom hook-up systems, cleanroom environments, strategic space planning, and advanced ultrapure water, chemical, and gas supply networks, alongside air pollution control solutions. It also acts as a primary distributor for specialized materials: SIMONA-brand engineering plastics, such as plates, rods, welding rods, and pipe fittings, and an extensive range of +GF+ branded products like semiconductor components, various pipe fittings, valves, electronic control instrumentation, and welding equipment. Additionally, Chen Full offers ACT-brand process exhaust systems. Beyond its material and engineering offerings, the company is involved in critical water treatment services, providing seawater desalination, ultrapure water generation, wastewater recycling, and potable water purification. On the manufacturing side, it produces machinery for the shoemaking industry, precision structural parts and engine casings for the aerospace sector, and essential components for optoelectronic and semiconductor equipment. Chen Full serves a diverse clientele that spans shoemaking machinery manufacturers, as well as companies in the aerospace, optoelectronic, semiconductor, and water resource industries.

name: Jiin Yeeh Ding Enterprises Corp.
summary: Jiin Yeeh Ding Enterprises Corp. engages in recycling and refining precious metals in Taiwan. It operates professional cleaning and recycling facilities that clean shutters, recycle precious metals, sift disintegrated materials, and prevent pollution, as well as owns recycling and cleaning vehicles. The company serves semiconductor, printer circuit, computer components, electro-optical, passive components, telecommunication, and other industries. Jiin Yeen Ding Enterprise Corp. was founded in 1997 and is based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.

name: Bai Sha Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Bai Sha Technology Co., Ltd. offers a comprehensive range of print products and services, serving both the domestic market in Taiwan and an international client base. The company's diverse portfolio features various packaging solutions, including vibrant color boxes, transparent polypropylene boxes, and custom bags. It also specializes in numerous book formats such as durable hardcover, flexible paperback, saddle-stitched, glue-bound, and loose-leaf publications. Additional offerings include essential corporate stationery like business cards, envelopes, letterheads, official document covers, presentation folders, triangular desk calendars, and exclusive VIP cards. Bai Sha further provides custom color and shaped stickers, alongside automated labeling services. Its promotional materials segment covers invitation cards, detailed catalogs, striking posters, large-format image output, practical display stands, and unique paper fans. Beyond manufacturing, the company furnishes specialized print finishing techniques, including sophisticated cold foil printing, various surface treatments, meticulous prepress proofing, and distinctive 3D embossing. Established in 1989, Bai Sha Technology's main operations are based in Taichung City, Taiwan.

name: ShareHope Medicine Co., Ltd.
summary: ShareHope Medicine Co., Ltd. provides integrated medical services in Taiwan. It engages in the health management and operation activities; human resource dispatch of professional medical staff; provision of medical, pharmaceutical, and health devices, as well as long-distance health care services; and rental of medical devices. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Taoyuan, Taiwan.

name: Ginko International Co., Ltd.
summary: Ginko International Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells non-disposable and disposable contact lenses, and lens care products in China, Germany, the United Kingdom, Australia, Poland, Canada, Brazil, Iran, and internationally. The company offers various optical products, such as high definition contact lenses, toric lenses, cosmetic lenses, and others, as well as lens solutions under the Horien and Hydron brands. Ginko International Co., Ltd. was founded in 2007 and is based in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.

name: EBM Technologies Incorporated
summary: EBM Technologies Incorporated develops and markets software and integrity solutions to the health sector in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers Enterprise PACS (picture archiving and communication systems), including SoliPACS that unites various products of the radiology, mammography, and dental fields; SoliPACS Gateway, a DICOM gateway; SoliPACS Server, an interface between HIS and RIS patient data and PACS; SoliPACS Web Viewer, which enables radiologists and physicians to view DICOM-compliant images, compare them to examination results, utilize image enhancement tools, and select images for review; SoliPACS Report that offers a tool for generating customized reports; and Advanced Server Archive, a PACS storage system. It also provides MobiPACS applications, which allow clinicians to retrieve, view, and compare various medical images; MobiPACS Server to store, process, and retrieve image files for mobile devices; MobiPACS App, an in mobile medical image viewing app; MobiPACS Web Viewer for viewing images from Internet-enabled end devices; and MobiPACS Share, a cloud-based platform. In addition, the company offers MobiPACS Multi that supports doctors to connect various iPads/iPad Pros for image display; Vital-Sign On-the-Go, a patient monitoring solution; Rad@, which enables doctors and radiologists to view medical-grade images and diagnose; and Digital Pathology scanner. Further, it provides Telemed, which interlinks medical facilities; Electronic Medical Record, a digital version of the paper-based individual medical record for patients' medical history; Personal Health Record that offers electronic access to the individual's medical history; and eHealth solutions for retrieving and reviewing patient images, sign data, and ECG waveforms, as well as technical and after sales services. EBM Technologies Incorporated was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Sentien Printing Factory Co., Ltd.
summary: Sentien Printing Factory Co., Ltd. produces, supplies, and sells heat transfer, insert mold, and in-mold label and release foils in Taiwan. Its heat transfer films are used in house wares, cosmetics, stationeries, appliances, and janitorial applications; and in-mold labels are used in plastic plates or cups applications. The company's in-mold decoration films are used in consumer electronic products, appliances, and automotive interior components applications; and insert molding films are used in smart appliances, and interior and exterior of automobiles and motorbikes applications. Sentien Printing Factory Co., Ltd. was founded in 1956 and is based in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Brighton-Best International (Taiwan) Inc.
summary: Brighton-Best International (Taiwan) Inc. sells screws and nuts primarily in Taiwan, North America, and Oceania. It also engages in import, export, and sale of aluminum products; and investment activities. The company was founded in 2007 and is based in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: Solidwizard Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Solidwizard Technology Co., Ltd. provides software, hardware, and consulting service solutions in Taiwan and China. The company offers CAID, CAD, RP, RE, CAE, CAM, and PDM solutions. It also provides subscription services; 3D CAD, product data management, simulation solution, technical communication, CAM, and education software products; 3D printer and scanner products; and collaborative robots. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Xu Yuan Packaging Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xu Yuan Packaging Technology Co., Ltd., a company based in Hsinchu City, Taiwan, specializes in the global manufacturing and distribution of various plastic packaging materials. Established in 1993, its primary focus is on heat-shrinkable films and tube-sleeving plastics. The company offers a comprehensive range of packaging products, including diverse shrinkable films, multi-layered films, and pouches. Their specialized label solutions feature PET, PVC, and OPS shrink labels. Furthermore, they supply associated machinery like shrink labeling machines, automatic label shrinking equipment, and label inserting systems. Complementing their packaging materials and labeling machines, Xu Yuan also manufactures and supplies shrink tunnels, reel handling systems, and precision-engineered components, including polyformaldehyde, iron, and aluminum CNC parts, along with rectifiers. Beyond packaging, the company's diverse activities encompass the production and retail of molds, the wholesale distribution of various chemicals, and the sale of sleeve (sticker) labeling machines and vibrant shrink labels. They are also involved in the manufacturing and wholesale of general plastic products and related industrial machinery, as well as the assembly of spare parts, grinding machines, and large industrial beds. Xu Yuan extends its services to include technical consultation, product design, and international trade operations. Their solutions are widely adopted across numerous industries, such as food and beverages, transparent product packaging, pharmaceuticals, personal care, and for creating secure cap seals and tamper-evident features.

name: Polygreen Resources Co., Ltd.
summary: Polygreen Resources Co., Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in resource recycling and environmental protection business in Malaysia. The company manufactures and sells Tyrec, a tyrec reclaimed rubber for use in tires, conveyor belts, inner tubes, ring pads, rubber matting, shoe soles, vibration pads, dock fenders, and other rubber products; Burec, a butyl reclaimed rubber for use in butyl inner tubes, tire inner liners, butyl adhesives, and other butyl rubber-related products; and Narec, a natural inner tube reclaimed rubber for use in rubber matting, shoe soles, and other rubber products. Its products also comprise T-Mesh, a crumb rubber for use in various applications in rubber products as compounding substitute, such as tire, ring pads, and rubber matting; and rubber granules that are recycled from the tire and industrial rubber waste that is used in the underlayment for running tracks, children's playgrounds, gym, and rubber tiles. The company also exports its products to Japan, Europe, Taiwan, Vietnam, the Philippines, Indonesia, Thailand, Pakistan, China, the Middle East, Australia, Singapore, and internationally. It serves manufacturers in the tire and conveyor-belt industries. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Grand Cayman, the Cayman Islands.

name: Wellpool Co., Ltd.
summary: Wellpool Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells fireproof and environmental protection green building materials. It offers calcium silicate and fiber cement boards. The company was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Redwood Group Ltd
summary: Redwood Group Ltd, along with its various divisions, specializes in providing interior design and fit-out services for luxury retail boutiques across Asia, the Middle East, the United States, and Europe. The company also serves as a bespoke manufacturer, producing custom interior elements for high-end brands. Its expertise further extends to the conception, fabrication, and distribution of artisanal craftsmanship, metalwork, specialized carpentry, and a diverse range of other interior furnishing products. The firm, headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, was established in 1992.

name: Superior Plating Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Superior Plating Technology Co., Ltd. operates as a surface treatment company in Taiwan. The company engages in the research and development of metal and plastic surface treatment technology and manufacturing services. It also provides plating services for the semiconductor lead frames, terminals, strips, and LED stents. In addition, the company provides plating services for HDD products, medical equipment, auto parts, connectors, and OA products; and anodizing services to 3C products and industrial products. Superior Plating Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: TSH Biopharm Corporation Limited
summary: TSH Biopharm Corporation Limited develops and markets medicines for chronic diseases in Taiwan. It offers products for cardiovascular, central nervous, gastrointestinal, and others, as well as liquid-biopsy diagnosis. The company is headquartered in Taipei city, Taiwan. TSH Biopharm Corporation Limited is a subsidiary of TTY Biopharm Company Limited.

name: Bon Fame Co., Ltd.
summary: Bon Fame Co., Ltd. operates in fashion market in Taiwan. It offers hair accessories, jewelry, hairstyling products, beauty tools, bags and purses, fashion accessories, and novelty products, as well as event products, such as kid's masks. The company was founded in 1985 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Zimmite Taiwan Ltd.
summary: Zimmite Taiwan Ltd. engages in the industrial water treatment activities in Taiwan and China. It offers cooling water treatment agents, such as corrosion inhibitors, scale inhibitors, algaecides, biocides, rust removers, and cooling water all-in-one tablets; and boiler water treatment agents, including internal treatment additives, oxygen scavengers, neutralizing amines, and filming amines. The company also provides boiler fireside treatment additives comprising fuel oil additives and soot removers; and oil refinery and petrochemical process additives consisting of corrosion inhibitors, antifoulants, desalting agents, demulsifiers–emulsion breakers, antifoamers/defoamers, metal passivating agents, polymerization inhibitors, and antioxidants. In addition, it offers wastewater treatment agents, including polymer flocculants, dewatering aids, heavy metal chelators, deodorants, and COD degradation agents; slow release tablets, such as cooling water treatment tablets, drain pan slime preventive tablets, and chlorine donors; and RO and scrubber chemicals. Further, the company provides environmental protection testing and technical services; water treatment technology supports; and oil mud dispersants, as well as sells water treatment raw materials. It primarily serves oil refineries and petrochemicals production plants, steel mills, power generation plants, office buildings, textile manufacturing processes, plastic manufacturing plants and processors, electronic manufacturing sector, and public facilities. Zimmite Taiwan Ltd. was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: TCI Co., Ltd.
summary: TCI Co., Ltd. functions as an Original Design Manufacturer (ODM), overseeing the comprehensive process from research and development to the production and distribution of functional health foods, nutritional supplements, and skincare formulations. The company's diverse product range in health and nutrition encompasses both liquid and solid supplements tailored for immune enhancement, functional probiotics for gut health, basic nutritional support, detoxification, weight control, general well-being, and sports performance. Additionally, TCI manufactures household items such as laundry detergents and hand sanitizers, alongside a selection of functional snacks including jellies, bars, chocolates, and gummies. Within its skincare division, TCI provides an extensive array of products, featuring various masks (for the face, body, eyes, and lips), essences, sprays, creams, and gels. Furthermore, the company offers full-scope turnkey services to its clients. Established in 1980, TCI Co., Ltd. maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Dadi Early-Childhood Education Group Limited
summary: Dadi Early-Childhood Education Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides early childhood education management consulting services in Mainland China, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. It offers campus development, classroom decoration, curriculum design, and teaching materials and teaching aids development services; early childhood education supplies; preschool textbooks and toys; and preschool software. The company also wholesales and retails cultural and education products, musical instruments, educational and entertainment materials, computers and office equipment, and information software; and leases office equipment and teaching devices. In addition, it engages in the trading business; IPRs; provision of system integration services; books, audio, and software publication business; and provision of management consultation, general advertising, product design, art and culture, agent, convention and exhibition, and overseas study services. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in George Town, the Cayman Islands.

name: Amia Co.,Ltd
summary: Amia Co.,Ltd manufactures and sells copper sulfate in Taiwan. It also offers oxides and carbonates. The company also exports its products. Amia Co.,Ltd was founded in 1974 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: E&E Recycling,Inc.
summary: E&E Recycling, Inc. is an Asian-based company specializing in the reclamation and processing of discarded electrical household appliances and electronic waste. The firm handles a wide array of defunct consumer electronics, from major appliances like televisions, air conditioners, refrigerators, washing machines, and fans, to IT equipment such as desktop computers, monitors, LCDs, keyboards, printers, and laptops. Beyond its core recycling operations, the company also markets proprietary systems for treating various waste streams, including specialized equipment for household appliances, PCBs, CRTs (including funnel glass cleaning), and freon recovery, while also offering operational management services. E&E Recycling, Inc. was established in 1998 and operates out of its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Green River Holding Co. Ltd.
summary: Green River Holding Co. Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing and sale of various wood-based products, including engineered particle boards, diverse solid wood items, and resins. Their product portfolio also features parawood, solid rubberwood panels, and raw rubberwood materials. Beyond its core production, the company is involved in investment ventures. Established in 2000 and headquartered in Songkhla, Thailand, Green River Holding distributes its offerings across Thailand, Malaysia, China, Indonesia, Korea, and Vietnam, in addition to serving broader international markets.

name: HIM International Music Inc.
summary: HIM International Music Inc. engages in the recording and distribution of music. It also offers copyright licensing and artist management services. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Pili International Multimedia Co.,Ltd.
summary: Pili International Multimedia Co.,Ltd. produces and distributes dramatic puppetry series in Taiwan. It is also involved in the Pili satellite television station; production and distribution of DVD's and soundtrack; performance and movie activities; publications and posters, etc.; and licensing development of peripheral products. In addition, the company fan club and cosplay activity; operates puppetry community Website; manages allied counters and boutiques in Taiwan; and produces and distributes 3D animation. The company was formerly known as Da Chih Entertainment Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Pili International Multimedia Co.,Ltd. in August 2000. Pili International Multimedia Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Daito Me Holdings Co., Ltd
summary: Daito Me Holdings Co., Ltd, alongside its group of companies, specializes in the production and distribution of electronic components and mechanical machinery across Japan and Taiwan. Their product portfolio is extensive, featuring integrated computing systems; complete mechanical assemblies such as control panels, coils, and robotic arm solutions; and a range of individual components like CPU motherboards, various control equipment parts, servo motors, power units, and connectors. Furthermore, the company is actively involved in the fabrication, processing, and commerce of copper foil circuit boards and adhesive films. Established in 1957, the firm's primary corporate base is located in George Town, Cayman Islands.

name: 1 Production Film Co.
summary: Based in Taipei City, Taiwan, 1 Production Film Co. is an entertainment company that specializes in producing various forms of visual content, including feature films, short-form cinematic pieces (micro-films), and television programs. Additionally, the firm extends its services to encompass talent management for artists.

name: Tekho Marine Biotech Co., Ltd
summary: Tekho Marine Biotech Co., Ltd researches and develops aquatic and aquarium products in Taiwan and internationally. It offers blood fish, larva fish, and adult fish, as well as giant, leopard coral, tiger, and orange-spotted grouper. The company also develops hardware-software products; and imports peripheral products of aquarium fish. In addition, it publishes aquarium books. Tekho Marine Biotech Co., Ltd was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Navicare Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: GOMAJI Corp., LTD provides e-commerce and advertising services in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1999 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Xxtechec Co., Ltd.
summary: Xxtechec Co., Ltd. is an e-commerce enterprise based in Taipei City, Taiwan, established in 2012. The company manages various digital marketplaces within the Taiwanese market, notably operating under the brand names Life Market, Pinecone Shopping, and Collection of Good Things in Life. Its business activities are organized into distinct segments: Non-Store Online Retailing, Online Trading Platform Operations, and additional services. Through these platforms, Xxtechec offers a diverse array of products for online purchase, including everyday essentials, consumer electronics (3C products), fresh produce, recreational items, and general groceries.

name: ELTA Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: ELTA Technology Co.,Ltd. operates platform for digital content in Taiwan. The company has library of digital content and broadband-delivered AV materials. It offers IP/TV (STB or MOD), PC/TV, VOD, and mobile TV, as well as large-sized data transfer technology and wireless communications support services. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Samebest Co., Ltd.
summary: Samebest Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of digital cloud curriculum systems primarily in Taiwan. The company also develops personalized action learning solutions through the integration of virtual reality. Its products cover high school, junior high school, middle and upper grades primary school, lower middle grade primary school, kindergarten, and preschool. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Eagle Cold Storage Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Eagle Cold Storage Enterprise Co., Ltd. engages in the processing and trade of vegetables and meat products in Taiwan. It offers frozen beef, hot pot meat, and canned products, as well as imports and sells meat, french fries, green beans, and other commodities. The company also develops, constructs, leases, and sells residential houses. In addition, it is involved in the cold storage, warehousing, logistics, and distribution business. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Taichung City, Taiwan.

name: Forward Graphic Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Forward Graphic Enterprise Co., Ltd. operates in the printing industry in Taiwan. The company provides product design, prepress, printing equipment, and post press services. It offers printing services for various packages, such as boxes, gift boxes, chocolate boxes, and bags; books; notebooks; catalogue/flyers; calendars; and special, DIY, and ECO friendly products. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: ShinHsiung Natural Gas Inc.
summary: ShinHsiung Natural Gas Inc. supplies natural gas in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1975 and is based in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Kwong Lung Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Kwong Lung Enterprise Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells apparel in Taiwan, China, Vietnam, and Japan. The company operates through Apparel department, Down Material Department, and Home Textile Department segments. It offers down and bedding; wholesale of outdoor supplies, household wares, clothing, and related packaging materials; food; and import and export of goods and technology. The company provides down products, including natural down, water repellent down, antibacterial deodorant down, color down, and flame retardant, as well as Thermobrid plus products for use in outdoor and home textile. In addition, it provides clothing products, such as snowboard wear, skiing wear, mountain climbing jackets, seamless wind and rain-proof jackets, biking wear, sportswear, jeans, casual jackets and pants, etc. Further, it manufactures winter quilts, cushions, seating pads, sofas, pillows, sleeping bags, gloves, and home decoration products. It also offers bedding products under the Kong lung brand. Kwong Lung Enterprise Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Kwong Lung Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Kwong Lung Enterprise Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells apparel in Taiwan, China, Vietnam, and Japan. The company operates through Apparel department, Down Material Department, and Home Textile Department segments. It offers down and bedding; wholesale of outdoor supplies, household wares, clothing, and related packaging materials; food; and import and export of goods and technology. The company provides down products, including natural down, water repellent down, antibacterial deodorant down, color down, and flame retardant, as well as Thermobrid plus products for use in outdoor and home textile. In addition, it provides clothing products, such as snowboard wear, skiing wear, mountain climbing jackets, seamless wind and rain-proof jackets, biking wear, sportswear, jeans, casual jackets and pants, etc. Further, it manufactures winter quilts, cushions, seating pads, sofas, pillows, sleeping bags, gloves, and home decoration products. It also offers bedding products under the Kong lung brand. Kwong Lung Enterprise Co., Ltd. was founded in 1966 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Hsin Tai Gas Co., Ltd.
summary: Hsin Tai Gas Co., Ltd. operates as a natural gas provider throughout Taiwan. The company's activities encompass building natural gas distribution networks, offering sales and installation services for gas meters, and manufacturing and selling various gas-powered appliances. Additionally, it engages in the leasing of office properties. The firm was founded in 1975 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Shen's Art Printing Co., Ltd.
summary: Shen's Art Printing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, processes, and sells various printed materials in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers creative design services, such as event execution and promotion campaign planning, editing, and visual portion; various services for small quantity orders and large format printing services; and special printing services, such as 3D lenticular and dynamic printing, as well as pattern technology. It also provides cultural and commercial printing for magazines, books, commercial promotion materials, stationary packs, and posters and pamphlet products; and delicate packages and handbags. The company was founded in 1977 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: China Times Publishing Comp.
summary: China Times Publishing Company specializes in the creation and global distribution of Chinese-language books, serving both its domestic market in Taiwan and international readerships. Its comprehensive catalog features an incredibly diverse array of subjects. This includes traditional literary forms like fiction, prose, and biographical accounts, alongside academic disciplines such as history, law, politics, philosophy, religion, and broader humanities and social studies. The company also delves into arts and culture, offering titles on art, photography, cinema, and television, complemented by multimedia products including DVDs, VCDs, and CDs. Educational content forms a significant part of their offerings, encompassing nature, popular science, mathematics, travel guides, and general knowledge, as well as dedicated learning encyclopedias, children's books, picture books, and fairy tales. For personal development and lifestyle interests, their catalog covers subjects such as parenting, gender medicine, health, beauty, diet, leisure, entertainment, psychology, and inspirational guides, alongside niche areas like astrology, marketing trends, and finance. Furthermore, they cover a variety of other miscellaneous subjects, from stationery to retail-related themes. Established in 1975, China Times Publishing Company maintains its operational base in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: O-TA Precision Industry Co., Ltd.
summary: O-TA Precision Industry Co., Ltd., a company based in Pingtung, Taiwan, primarily focuses on the manufacture, contract processing, assembly, and sale of golf club heads and their semi-finished components. Their product catalog features a variety of golf equipment, including metal woods, iron heads, CNC-machined putters, shafts, and complete club assemblies. Beyond its core golf business, O-TA has diversified its offerings. The company develops and markets bicycles under its proprietary VOLANDO brand and also supplies ALLTAS stainless steel faucets. Furthermore, O-TA Precision Industry extends its reach internationally, exporting products to major markets such as Japan and the United States. The company was established in 1988.

name: North-Star International Co., Ltd.
summary: North-Star International Co., Ltd. oversees a network of fuel stations across Taiwan. Beyond distributing various petroleum products, the company also provides automotive care services, such as vehicle cleaning, washing, and waxing. Originally founded in 1988 as North-Star Petroleum Co., Ltd., the enterprise adopted its current name, North-Star International Co., Ltd., in 2012. Its operational base is situated in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Dynamic Precision Industry Corporation
summary: Dynamic Precision Industry Corporation, established in 1973 and headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, operates as a global manufacturer and distributor of golf equipment. The company's product range encompasses various types of golfing gear, including iron, putter, and fairway equipment. Additionally, the firm supplies golf hardware casting equipment. The company underwent a name change in January 2000, transitioning from its former identity as DYNAMIC Precision Industry Manufacturing Company, Ltd. to its current appellation.

name: Fu Burg Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1977 and based in Taipei City, Taiwan, Fu Burg Industrial Co., Ltd. operates as a key manufacturer and distributor of personal hygiene solutions. Initially focused on producing and selling adult diapers within Taiwan, the company has since expanded its product lines considerably. Their diverse offerings include: Adult Care Products: Such as incontinence brief pants, absorbent pads, and personal cleansing wipes, marketed under brands like ANAN, Feelfree, AQUA, Ancare, Medicos, and Parents. Baby Care Items: Featuring infant diapers, training pants, and pure water wipes, primarily sold under the Tino brand. Feminine Hygiene Products: Encompassing menstrual pants, sanitary napkins, tampons, light incontinence pads, and wet wipes for women, available through the ANAN, Feelfree, and AQUA labels. Protective Masks: Produced under the Mori brand name.

name: CKM Applied Materials Corp.
summary: CKM Applied Materials Corp. develops metal building materials in Taiwan. The company offers ceiling suspension systems, such as exposed T grids and partition frame systems; metal ceilings, including flat, perforated, embossed, mesh, baffle, curve, linear grid, honeycomb, extrusion, crossing, triangular, strip, and cell ceilings; and micro-perforated acoustical panels. Its products are used in governmental buildings, hospitals, schools, department stores, hotels, factories, public and residential buildings, and commercial buildings. The company was formerly known as CKM Building Material Corp. and changed its name to CKM Applied Materials Corp. in July 2017. The company was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Tainan city, Taiwan.

name: Ta-Yuan Cogeneration Company Ltd.
summary: Ta-Yuan Cogeneration Company Ltd. generates and supplies electricity and heat to Dayuan industrial park in Taiwan. It operates and manages cogeneration plants. The company also engages in operating and repairing equipment, processing waste disposal, managing incinerators, producing petrochemical materials, and processing refuse derived fuel. Ta-Yuan Cogeneration Company Ltd. was founded in 1993 and is based in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.

name: Wiselink Co., Ltd.
summary: Max Zipper Co., Ltd. manufactures and markets zippers worldwide. It offers nylon, delrin, metal, invisible, specialized, water repellent, heat transfer, pattern tape, coil vacuum, satin tape, chameleon, reflective, spear teach, weave tape, delrin inkjet, and contrast slit zippers; invisible, nylon, delrin, metal, and tape attachable sliders; plastic and spring lock sliders; and metal, plastic, diamante, cord, leather, woven, and stone pullers. The company also provides special slider treatment, such as pattern coating and double plating services. Max Zipper Co., Ltd. offers its products under the MAX brand. The company was formerly known as Horng Dah Zippers Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Max Zipper Co., Ltd. in September 2009. Max Zipper Co., Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan.

name: Ideal Bike Corporation
summary: Ideal Bike Corporation manufactures and sells bicycles worldwide. The company was founded in 1980 and is headquartered in Taichung, Taiwan.

name: Pontex Polyblend Co.,Ltd
summary: Pontex Polyblend Co., Ltd. engages in footwear injection molding and engineering plastics compound materials businesses in Taiwan. It offers ABS, PC, nylon, PP, PBT, NPE, TPU, PLA, PBS, and r-PET plastic products for applications in the areas of 3C/electronic products, industrial equipment parts, auto/moto parts, household goods, sports/toy parts, and medical supplies. The company also provides sports equipment, such as baseball, football, soccer, and bicycle outsoles; and shoe components, including midsoles, shanks, and counters. In addition, it manufactures various women vamps injection products on an OEM basis for the CROCS' brand. Pontex Polyblend Co., Ltd. was founded in 1982 and is headquartered in Taichung City, Taiwan.

name: Kuo Toong International Co., Ltd.
summary: Kuo Toong International Co., Ltd. designs, produces, and assembles water supply and division pipes in Taiwan. The company offers various concrete products, including prestressed concrete cylinder and non-cylinder pipes, reinforced concrete pipes, reinforced concrete cylinder pipes, concrete pipes for sewerage in jacking method, prestressed beams, precast prestressed concrete culverts, manholes for sewerage, shield-segments, and other concrete products. It also provides ductile iron pipes, DI flexible pipes, connecting closures, and accessories; and various steel pipe items comprising coated steel pipes for water service, polyethylene coated and lined steel pipes, steel pipes by jacking method, steel flexible pipe joints, connecting closures, fittings, and weight-coated offshore pipes. In addition, the company offers services for the design, manufacturing, and construction of water supply and division pipes through no-dig jacking methods; and specific mechanical equipment and plant set up, and operation of seawater desalination, water, and sewage water. Kuo Toong International Co., Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Her Chee Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Founded in 1976 and based in Chiayi, Taiwan, Her Chee Industrial Co., Ltd. specializes in the production and sale of a wide array of specialized vehicles, marketed primarily under their ADLY moto brand. Their comprehensive product range features all-terrain vehicles (ATVs) for utility, recreational sports, and agricultural purposes, as well as mini cars, scooters, go-karts, and electric bikes. Furthermore, the company manufactures engines and associated components. Her Chee Industrial Co., Ltd. not only serves the Taiwanese market but also engages in significant international export activities.

name: Advanced International Multitech Co., Ltd.
summary: Advanced International Multitech Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells golf club heads, shafts, golf club sets, golf balls, carbon fiber components, aviation products, and composite materials worldwide. The company offers various golf products, including metal woods, irons/wedges, putters, graphite shafts, and club assemblies; carbon fiber bicycle components, such as frames, forks, and parts; DIZO bicycles; and investment casting services for components of aircraft interior, bike, industrial, and hardware in titanium and stainless steel. It also provides composite products, such as aircraft interiors comprising seat backrests, seat pads, and seat arm rests; automotive products consisting of engine covers, spoilers, and driving shafts; electronic device protectors, such as laptop carbon covers and pad soft goods; and industrial structures, including robot arm accessories, frame tubes, and assistive devices. In addition, the company offers prepreg products. Advanced International Multitech Co., Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.

name: Grand Hall Enterprise Co., Ltd.
summary: Grand Hall Enterprise Co., Ltd., an enterprise founded in 1965 and headquartered in Taipei, Taiwan, focuses on the development and production of gas-powered outdoor equipment and related components. While primarily based in Taiwan, its product range is diverse, encompassing consumer items like barbecue grills and various outdoor living amenities. The company's manufacturing expertise also extends to crucial gas system elements, including LP gas cylinder valves, general gas valves, specialized brass forged parts, and even valves for scuba diving. Furthermore, Grand Hall produces larger appliances such as substantial gas ovens, a variety of heaters, water heaters, barbecue stoves, and outdoor decorative flame features, along with their associated accessories. These offerings are marketed and sold internationally, reaching consumers in North America, Europe, and Australia.

name: Xxentria Technology Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Xxentria Technology Materials Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells metal composite materials worldwide. The company develops products with metal and plastic components. It offers exterior facades cladding and interior furnishing for new buildings, as well as refurbishment; and lacquer coated solid aluminum panels, as well as anodized and PVD-coating materials for architectural applications. The company also provides solar receiver tubes and tube coatings; and reflective composites materials for solar thermal applications. In addition, it offers wall and door panels for truck and trailer bodies; galvanized steel composite panels; and high tensile aluminum composite panels for transportation applications. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: Tittot Company Limited
summary: Tittot Company Limited provides glass-art products in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in New Taipei City, Taiwan.

name: Eminent Luggage Corporation
summary: Eminent Luggage Corporation designs, manufactures, and sells luggage products worldwide. The company provides a range of ABS, PP, PC, nylon, and polyester cases; bags and leisure products; and hard shell and beauty cases, soft luggage, trolleys, suitcase sets, business suitcases, and laptop backpacks. It offers its products under the Eminent, Case-Star, Mine, and Probeetle brands. Eminent Luggage Corporation was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Tainan City, Taiwan.

name: Macauto Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Macauto Industrial Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of automotive sunshade products. The company offers automotive interiors, such as Sunshades for roof systems, luggage cover systems, side and rear window shades, wind deflectors, divider net systems, and mobile phone/tablet holder. It also provides garden tools, including cordless electric mower, electric wheelbarrows, and robotic golf caddy cart. Macauto Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Tainan, Taiwan.

name: Yieh United Steel Corp.
summary: Yieh United Steel Corp. produces and sells stainless steel products in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers stainless steel billets, hot rolled black coils and plates, coils and sheets, cold rolled coils and sheets, and slabs for home and office uses, and industrial and transport applications, as well as for architecture, building, and construction applications. It also provides carbon steel products, including carbon steel slabs, billets, blacks, and plates for industrial applications. The company was founded in 1988 and is based in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.

name: Dacome International Ltd.
summary: Dacome International Ltd. distributes golf brands in Taiwan, the United States, and Japan. The company offers balls, golf products, footwear, bags, apparel, hats, belts, gloves, accessories, audiovisual books, team gifts, and gift certificates, as well as training supplies. It also markets its products through its Website, golfshop.com.tw; and provides golf equipment bidding, golf courses booking, golf tours at home and abroad, golf skills teaching, handicap system, etc. The company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.

name: Yeou Yih Steel Co., Ltd.
summary: Yeou Yih Steel Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells hot rolled stainless steel plates and flat bars primarily in Taiwan. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Kaohsiung City, Taiwan.
